original_source_bindings.text:
There are $N$ required output slots and a set $U$ of $q$ one-use tools.
The complete stage order and compatibility sets $S_i\subseteq U$ are
known. An erroneous output at stage $i$ can be genuinely corrected only
with a previously unused tool $r\in S_i$. Such a correction guarantees
the required value, consumes $r$, changes no other output and supplies
no additional hidden-state information.

At stage $i$, a fresh binary fact $X_i$ has a known nondegenerate prior
$\pi_i$. A review costs $c_i>0$ and has distribution $P_i^x$ on a
finite alphabet when $X_i=x$. The two distributions are distinct and
have full support. Conditional on every history generated before the
stage is entered, the same prior and iid observation kernel apply;
old history does not reveal the current observation tape. The next
fact and its review port are inaccessible until its stage opens.
All finite probabilities and fees are supplied rational inputs.

\item If $\rho=\infty$, take no observations, write blindly, and after each
actual reported error choose an infinite-rank child and execute its real
compatible correction.
\item If $d_b=0$, use a posterior-error SPRT of target $p=r/2$ and write
MAP.  After a correct report continue with risk $r/2$; after an error the
task fails and the controller may abandon.
\item Otherwise $d_b\ge1$ is finite.  Use target $p=p_{d_b}(r)$ and write
MAP.  After a correct report continue with risk $r/2$.  After an error
execute a real correction using any tool maximizing the bad-child rank,
and continue with
\[
 r'=\min\{1/4,r/(2p)\}.
\]
\end{enumerate}
There is no missing finite-rank case with $d_b=\infty$, since
$d_g\ge d_b$ would make the current rank infinite.  The laminar table
supplies exactly the ranks and tools required by this rule; the rule does
not require comparison of real-valued coefficients between equal-rank
children.

Let Z be the complete transcript before the first true report, including
private random seeds and any abandonment; unvisited facts retain their
fair priors.  Conditional on Z the hidden bits have a product posterior.
Indeed, after fixing the seed and transcript, the sampling, stopping, and
writing rules contribute common factors, and the remaining likelihood is
the product of the separate BSC likelihoods.  This remains true when the
numbers of observations depend on earlier visible history.  Let $p_i(Z)$
be the individual MAP errors, with $p_i=1/2$ for an unvisited stage, and let
$s(Z)$ be the conditional ultimate failure probability of the original
policy.  An abandoned transcript has s=1.  Otherwise its fixed ordinary
writes have independent conditional errors, each at least $p_i(Z)$.
The all-error set is unmatchable, even if the policy later makes the best
possible repairs.  Consequently
\[
 s(Z)\ge\prod_{i=1}^n p_i(Z).
\]
Apply \eqref{eq:example-bsc-information} to each actual stopped experiment
and sum \emph{before} conditioning on any success-selected event.  Jensen's
inequality now yields, for every $\delta$-safe LR policy,
\begin{align*}
 \E C_{\mathrm{obs}}
 &=a\E\sum_i\phi(p_i(Z))\\
 &\ge a\E\sum_i\log(1/p_i(Z))-2an\\
 &\ge a\E\log(1/s(Z))-2an\\
 &\ge a\log(1/\delta)-2an.
\end{align*}
Infinite expected cost already satisfies the bound.  It covers non-MAP
writes, random stopping, abandonment, arbitrary final repair decisions,
and spending on failed paths.  It also applies when the universal stage
is last, since the same all-error event is the unique matching obstruction.

For the cost induction, $r'\ge r$ and $r'\to0$ as $r\to0$.
Lemma~\ref{lem:price-local}'s SPRT construction gives local expected cost
\[
 A_i\log(1/p)+O_i(1)
 =A_i\ell_{d_b+1}(1/r)+O_i(1)
\]
in the third case.  The error child's observation cost is
$O(\ell_{d_b}(1/r'))=O(\ell_{d_b}(1/r))$; multiplying by
$e\le p=O(1/\ell_{d_b}(1/r))$ leaves only $O(1)$.
The correct child's leading term is unchanged by $r\mapsto r/2$.
The case $d_b=0$ gives $A_i\log(1/r)+O_i(1)$.  Comparing the terms
therefore gives exactly \eqref{eq:price-coefficient} as an upper bound.
Every actual correction, including one on a later-failing path, is charged.
Their pathwise total is at most $\min(N,q)f_{\max}$, which is $O(1)$ and
does not affect any finite-depth divergent leading term.

For an integer vector $c=(c_T:T\in\mathcal L)$, define
\begin{equation}
 \mathcal I(c)
 =\bigl\{D\subseteq U:
          |D\cap T|\le c_T\text{ for every }T\in\mathcal L\bigr\}.
 \label{eq:laminar-capacity-family}
\end{equation}
Here $D$ will be the used-tool set, so the available tools are $U\setminus D$.
We also use the separate symbol $\mathsf{VOID}$ for the empty family.
It cannot be identified with the vector of all zero capacities: that
vector represents the nonempty family $\{\varnothing\}$.

A capacity vector is \emph{normalized} if its singleton capacities lie
in $\{0,1\}$, all capacities are nonnegative, and every internal node
satisfies
\begin{equation}
 c_T\le\sum_{C\text{ a child of }T}c_C.
 \label{eq:laminar-normalized}
\end{equation}
Starting from capacities $0\le c_T\le |T|$, normalize by processing
nodes from leaves to top and replacing each internal capacity by
\[
 c_T\leftarrow
 \min\left\{c_T,\sum_{C\text{ a child of }T}c_C\right\}.
\]
This does not change $\mathcal I(c)$: the children partition $T$, so
their constraints already imply the additional upper bound.  The
operation costs $O(t)$ and leaves every capacity in $[0,q]$.

\begin{lemma}[Extension by one compatible tool]
\label{lem:laminar-extension}
Let $c$ be normalized, let $D\in\mathcal I(c)$, and let
$\varnothing\ne S\in\mathcal L$.  There exists
$r\in S\setminus D$ such that $D\cup\{r\}\in\mathcal I(c)$ if and
only if
\begin{equation}
 |D\cap T|<c_T\qquad\text{for every }T\in\mathcal A(S).
 \label{eq:laminar-strict-path}
\end{equation}
When it exists, such a tool can be found by a descent in the tree.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
Adding a tool in $S$ increases the count at every node of
$\mathcal A(S)$, which proves necessity.  For sufficiency, call a node
$T$ \emph{slack} when $|D\cap T|<c_T$.  If an internal node $T$ is
slack, then
\[
 \sum_{C\text{ a child of }T}|D\cap C|
 =|D\cap T|
 <c_T
 \le\sum_{C\text{ a child of }T}c_C.
\]
Thus at least one child is slack.  Start at $S$, which is slack by
\eqref{eq:laminar-strict-path}, and repeatedly choose a slack child.
At the resulting singleton $\{r\}$, slackness and integrality give
$|D\cap\{r\}|=0$ and $c_{\{r\}}=1$, so $r$ is unused.  Every node
containing $r$ is either on the selected descent or an ancestor of
$S$.  All these nodes are slack, and all other counts remain unchanged.
Consequently $D\cup\{r\}$ satisfies every capacity constraint.
The descent examines at most $O(t)$ nodes and child entries.
\end{proof}

\item $D$ satisfies its capacity vector $c^{i+1,k}$;
\item $d_T<c^{i+1,k}_T$ for every $T\in\mathcal A(S_i)$.
\end{enumerate}

\eqref{eq:laminar-rank-membership} give the exact equivalence
\begin{equation}
 e_k
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \exists r\in S_i\cap R:
                 \rho(i+1,R\setminus\{r\})>k.
 \label{eq:laminar-bad-existence}
\end{equation}
These predicates are nonincreasing in $k$.

Write $d_b=0$ when $S_i\cap R=\varnothing$, and otherwise write
$d_b=\max_{r\in S_i\cap R}\rho(i+1,R\setminus\{r\})$.
If $e_0$ is false, then $S_i\cap R=\varnothing$ and $d_b=0$.
If the first false predicate is $e_b$ for $b\ge1$, then
\eqref{eq:laminar-bad-existence} implies $d_b=b$.
Perform the slack-child descent of
Lemma~\ref{lem:laminar-extension} using $c^{i+1,b-1}$ to obtain a
tool $r$.  Its successor has rank at least $b$, while failure of $e_b$
bounds every successor rank by $b$.  Thus the chosen tool attains the
maximum.  If $e_{q+1}$ is true, perform the descent using
$c^{i+1,q+1}$.  The selected successor has infinite rank, since no
finite rank exceeds $q+1$, so $d_b=\infty$.

The correct successor rank $d_g=\rho(i+1,R)$ is obtained by
\eqref{eq:laminar-rank-extraction}, and the current rank is
\[

\]
The selection rule uses the known compatibility sequence, the current
stage, and the tools already consumed.  It never reads a future error
bit.  It therefore defines a causal pure strategy against the adaptive
adversary in the original game.

$\mathsf{VOID}$ is $\mathsf{VOID}$.

downward closure.  Lemma~\ref{lem:laminar-extension} therefore

A capacity vector is \emph{normalized} if its singleton capacities lie
in $\{0,1\}$, all capacities are nonnegative, and every internal node
satisfies
\begin{equation}
 c_T\le\sum_{C\text{ a child of }T}c_C.
 \label{eq:laminar-normalized}
\end{equation}
Starting from capacities $0\le c_T\le |T|$, normalize by processing
nodes from leaves to top and replacing each internal capacity by
\[
 c_T\leftarrow
 \min\left\{c_T,\sum_{C\text{ a child of }T}c_C\right\}.
\]
This does not change $\mathcal I(c)$: the children partition $T$, so
their constraints already imply the additional upper bound.  The
operation costs $O(t)$ and leaves every capacity in $[0,q]$.

The table also avoids enumerating tool choices when extracting the
maximal erroneous-successor rank.  At a current state $(i,R)$ with
$i\le N$, put $D=U\setminus R$ and compute
$d_T=|D\cap T|$ for all tree nodes.  For each $k=0,\ldots,q+1$, define
$e_k$ to be true if and only if all of the following hold:
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\roman*)]
\item $S_i\ne\varnothing$ and $\mathcal I_{i+1,k}$ is not
$\mathsf{VOID}$;
\item $D$ satisfies its capacity vector $c^{i+1,k}$;
\item $d_T<c^{i+1,k}_T$ for every $T\in\mathcal A(S_i)$.
\end{enumerate}
Lemma~\ref{lem:laminar-extension} and
\eqref{eq:laminar-rank-membership} give the exact equivalence
\begin{equation}
 e_k
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \exists r\in S_i\cap R:
                 \rho(i+1,R\setminus\{r\})>k.
 \label{eq:laminar-bad-existence}
\end{equation}
These predicates are nonincreasing in $k$.

Write $d_b=0$ when $S_i\cap R=\varnothing$, and otherwise write
$d_b=\max_{r\in S_i\cap R}\rho(i+1,R\setminus\{r\})$.
If $e_0$ is false, then $S_i\cap R=\varnothing$ and $d_b=0$.
If the first false predicate is $e_b$ for $b\ge1$, then
\eqref{eq:laminar-bad-existence} implies $d_b=b$.
Perform the slack-child descent of
Lemma~\ref{lem:laminar-extension} using $c^{i+1,b-1}$ to obtain a
tool $r$.  Its successor has rank at least $b$, while failure of $e_b$
bounds every successor rank by $b$.  Thus the chosen tool attains the
maximum.  If $e_{q+1}$ is true, perform the descent using
$c^{i+1,q+1}$.  The selected successor has infinite rank, since no
finite rank exceeds $q+1$, so $d_b=\infty$.

The correct successor rank $d_g=\rho(i+1,R)$ is obtained by
\eqref{eq:laminar-rank-extraction}, and the current rank is
\[
 \rho(i,R)=\min\{d_g,1+d_b\}.
\]
The selection rule uses the known compatibility sequence, the current
stage, and the tools already consumed.  It never reads a future error
bit.  It therefore defines a causal pure strategy against the adaptive
adversary in the original game.

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial exact laminar strategy]
\label{thm:laminar}
Consider the current-window tool game with known stage order and a
laminar compatibility family.  For $q>0$, its suffixes admit a table of
normalized integer capacity vectors on the single tree $\mathcal L$
that determines $\rho(i,R)$ for every stage $i$ and every remaining-tool
set $R\subseteq U$.  The same table supplies a causal choice attaining
\[
 \max_{r\in S_i\cap R}\rho(i+1,R\setminus\{r\})
\]
whenever $S_i\cap R\ne\varnothing$.

Given the tree, the table uses

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial exact laminar strategy]
\label{thm:laminar}
Consider the current-window tool game with known stage order and a
laminar compatibility family.  For $q>0$, its suffixes admit a table of
normalized integer capacity vectors on the single tree $\mathcal L$
that determines $\rho(i,R)$ for every stage $i$ and every remaining-tool
set $R\subseteq U$.  The same table supplies a causal choice attaining
\[
 \max_{r\in S_i\cap R}\rho(i+1,R\setminus\{r\})
\]
whenever $S_i\cap R\ne\varnothing$.

Given the tree, the table uses
$O((N+1)(q+1)t)$ elementary integer operations and
$O((N+1)(q+1)t\log(q+2))$ bits of capacity storage.
Each rank query and each maximizing-tool query uses
$O((q+1)t)$ operations.  All capacities and counts lie in $[0,q]$.
For $N,q\ge1$, these bounds are respectively $O(Nqt)$ preprocessing
and $O(qt)$ per query.  From an explicit stage--tool incidence input,
the tree can first be constructed, and laminarity checked, in
$O((N+q+1)^2q)$ elementary set-membership operations.

If $q=0$, no tree is required: the rank is $1$ whenever a stage remains
and is $\infty$ at the terminal state.  In particular, the result does
not assume that a compact strategy is supplied as part of the input.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Full-history penalty bridge]\label{lem:price-bridge}
From every healthy native history at the first entry to stage $i$, with unused tools $R$, every legal policy satisfies
\[
 \E[\text{future actual observation charges}]
 +\lambda\Prob(\text{eventual task failure})\ge G_{i,R}(\lambda).
\]
This includes policies that delay an already allocated correction, abandon
before a write, or continue to incur charges after permanent failure.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Induct on the number of remaining stages.  Condition on all already
generated history and the private random seed.  Native freshness preserves
the current prior and conditional i.i.d. channel; it does not merely
preserve an average error rate.  The observations before the ordinary write
and its actual binary output form a legal sequential experiment.  The
correct continuation costs at least $G_g$.  After an erroneous write every
actual compatible allocation costs at least $G_b$; refusing a required
allocation or any permanent failure costs $\lambda\ge G_b$.
Thus their combined lower bound is
$G_g+\E[c_iT+(G_b-G_g)\ind\{\widehat X\ne X_i\}]$.

If the policy abandons before its ordinary write, retain every observation
it already bought and fill in an arbitrary binary decision for analysis.
The virtual continuation assigned to either outcome is at most $\lambda$,
so this replacement cannot increase the original comparison charge.
It does not declare abandonment successful or reveal a future fact to the
implemented policy.  Spending after permanent failure is nonnegative and
can be discarded.  These observations give the lower half of
\eqref{eq:price-penalty}, including immediate abandonment.  Conversely,
near-optimal local tests and near-optimal continuations implement its
right side to arbitrary accuracy, proving the recursion itself.

If allocated corrections may legally execute later, freely complete those
obligations only in the lower-bound relaxation.  Their tools remain
occupied.  Simulate the original history and its execution ledger; this
provides no new information and does not force earlier real payment.
Only one failure penalty is charged throughout this induction.
\end{proof}

An ordinary write fixes a selected bit and closes that slot's ordinary
write and review ports. Its authoritative report reveals the true bit
and, if needed, a version-bound mismatch handle. A correction requires
this actual handle; a blind guaranteed overwrite is not native. In
early-report workflows the report arrives before the next fact is
born. A late-report workflow receives all reports after all ordinary
writes; advance depends on the write, so delay causes no deadlock.

The current-window contract $I$ requires an erroneous output's tool
allocation to be irrevocable before advancing. A contract may also
require actual execution before advance. Our upper controllers execute
immediately, and the lower comparison permits the larger class in
which an already committed correction may be executed later. No such
tool can be reassigned. The retained contract $R$ instead keeps all
correction handles until a common terminal barrier and permits tools
to be assigned there. Original per-stage review quotas and a cumulative
call cap $H$ apply. There are no additional order-sensitive locks,
changing prices, cross-output effects or ways to reopen a review port.

Success means that all $N$ required final outputs are truly correct.
Abandonment, incomplete execution and unrepaired errors are failures.
A policy may use all visible history and private randomness, write
non-MAP values, decline corrections, delay where legal, and continue
spending after failure. Only the global condition
$\Prob(\mathrm{failure})\le\delta$ is imposed. If actual correction
$i,r$ costs a fixed $f_{ir}\ge0$, the variable bill is
\[
 C=\sum_i c_iT_i+\sum_{\text{actual corrections }(i,r)}f_{ir}.
\]
All failed-path charges count. Write $f_{\max}=\max f_{ir}$, or zero
when there is no compatible pair. Every policy uses at most
$\min(N,q)$ genuine corrections. Normal full-run fees $C_0$ are
accounted for separately; every successful run pays at least $C_0$,
and each constructed run pays at most $C_0$ in normal charges. Let
$H_0$ bound its normal calls on a complete execution. Local planning
work is reported as computation, separately from native calls.

First define an untruncated reference controller.  Its state has a rational

comparisons,
\[

 p_j(r)=\frac1{4(1+B_j(r))}.
\]
For each fixed $j\ge1$,
\begin{equation}
 \log(1/p_j(r))=\ell_{j+1}(1/r)+O_j(1),\qquad

 \label{eq:price-threshold-asymptotic}
\end{equation}

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]

No controller receives an enlarged observation window or a new tool.  Along

$B_j(r)\le B_1(r)\le1/r$, hence $p_j(r)\ge r/6$; the no-tool target
$r/2$ has the same bound.  Put
\[
 C_N=6\cdot2^{N+1},\qquad b_{\max}=\log(C_N/\delta),
\]
so every tested posterior target is at least $\delta/C_N$.

\[

in the third case.  The error child's observation cost is

finite alphabet when $X_i=x$. The two distributions are distinct and
have full support. Conditional on every history generated before the
stage is entered, the same prior and iid observation kernel apply;
old history does not reveal the current observation tape. The next
fact and its review port are inaccessible until its stage opens.

born. A late-report workflow receives all reports after all ordinary
writes; advance depends on the write, so delay causes no deadlock.

tool can be reassigned. The retained contract $R$ instead keeps all
correction handles until a common terminal barrier and permits tools
to be assigned there. Original per-stage review quotas and a cumulative
call cap $H$ apply. There are no additional order-sensitive locks,
changing prices, cross-output effects or ways to reopen a review port.

\begin{theorem}[Fixed-graph price law]\label{thm:price}
Under the native freshness, reporting, correction, and charging assumptions,
suppose the original contract passes the rational resource certificate in
Section~\ref{subsec:price-native}.  If $d=\rho(1,U)<\infty$, the infimum
$V_I(\delta)$ of expected actual observation and correction charges satisfies
\[
 V_I(\delta)=C(1,U)\ell_d(1/\delta)(1+o(1)),
 \qquad C(1,U)>0.
\]
For any fixed initial remaining set $R$ of finite rank $d$, its coefficient
has the ordered expression
\begin{equation}
 C(1,R)=\sum_{i=1}^N A_i\ind\{b_i=d-1\},\qquad
 b_i=\begin{cases}
 0,&S_i\cap R=\varnothing,\\
 \max_{r\in S_i\cap R}\rho(i+1,R\setminus\{r\}),&\text{otherwise}.
 \end{cases}
 \label{eq:price-head}
\end{equation}
If the initial rank is infinite, zero observations suffice and the actual
correction bill remains bounded.  The asymptotic statement is pointwise for
each fixed graph and channel instance; it is not uniform when $q,N$, or the
prices vary with $\delta$. The lower-bound direction requires no
sufficient resource certificate; that certificate is used for the
matching executable upper bound.
\end{theorem}

\begin{corollary}[A compact leading-price controller]
\label{cor:computable-price}
For laminar compatibility, the combinatorial preprocessing in
Theorem~\ref{thm:laminar} computes the depth and the critical stage
indices in~\eqref{eq:price-head} in polynomial time. It therefore returns
the exact symbolic expression for the leading coefficient in terms of
the supplied channel probabilities, as in Theorem~\ref{thm:price}; no
exact real-valued KL oracle is required. Replacing the generic subset oracle by the
capacity table implements its causal upper controller without
exponential tool-state expansion, under exactly the original resource
certificate in~\eqref{eq:price-rational-quota}--\eqref{eq:price-total-cap}.
\end{corollary}
\begin{proof}
For the fixed initial remaining set, query the table for its initial
depth and each stage's maximum bad-child rank. Sum $A_i$ at precisely
the indices in~\eqref{eq:price-head}; this takes $O(Nqt)$
combinatorial work for $N,q\ge1$, in addition to tree construction.
During actual execution, the same table returns each required maximum
bad-child rank and a compatible attaining tool. These are the only
allocation-oracle outputs used in the risk recursion. The targets,
observations, mismatch handles, actual prices and finite caps are
unchanged. Ties in bad-child rank need not be broken by comparing real
KL expressions, because their coefficients enter only a lower-order
parent term. The rational statistical arithmetic depends on the input bit
length and numerical native quotas, as specified in the price construction;
no bound polynomial in the logarithm of the call cap is asserted.

\label{lem:paid:information}
For every experiment with finite expected review count,
\begin{equation}
 c\E T=a\E\phi(P).

mean before purchase is $\kappa$ and its absolute value is $h$.

increments are bounded.  Conditional on the stopped transcript, if the
posterior of bit one is $\theta$, the expected oriented score is

argument there and average the indicated pre-birth event.  No step

work is reported as computation, separately from native calls.

The structural law above fixes correction fees while confidence increases.
This section isolates the effect of a fee that may vary with the other
parameters.  It is a restricted extension: all $K<N$ tools can correct
every output, facts are independent fair bits, and every review is a
homogeneous BSC of accuracy $1/2+\gamma$ costing $c$.
Assume rational $c>0$, $0<\gamma\le1/4$, $f\ge0$ and
$0<\delta\le1/64$.  Each actual correction costs the same $f$.
The hypotheses concerning freshness, genuine mismatch handles, exact
early reports, guaranteed one-use corrections and all-path charging
remain as in Section~\ref{sec:model}.

We strengthen the current-allocation contract to \emph{current payment},
denoted $I_{\rm pay}$: a wrong output must be physically corrected and
paid for before advance.  An irrevocable allocation with execution or
payment withheld until a later decision is not this contract.
All lawful randomized visible-history policies remain in the comparison,
including non-MAP writes, abandonment and spending on eventual failures.
Original review quotas and the total call cap remain in force; there is
no additional hard monetary spending cap.

Let $R_{\rm act}$ count physically executed corrections.  Define
$V_f^{\rm nat}(\delta)$ as the infimum of
\begin{equation}
 \E C=\E\!\left[c\sum_{i=1}^N T_i+fR_{\rm act}\right]
 \quad\text{subject to }\Prob(\mathrm{failure})\le\delta
 \label{eq:paid:bill}
\end{equation}
in this original instance.  Let $V_f^\infty(\delta)$ relax only review
and call caps, retaining the same correction rights and payment contract.
Write $h=\log((1+2\gamma)/(1-2\gamma))$ and $a=c/(2\gamma h)$ as before.
Appendix~\ref{app:paid:proofs} gives an explicit integer
$Q=Q(N,\gamma,\delta)$, independent of $f$, in
\eqref{eq:paid:certificate-numbers}.  The sufficient native qualification is
\begin{equation}
 \text{each original stage admits $Q$ reviews and its lawful operations},
 \qquad H\ge H_0+NQ+K.
 \label{eq:paid:cap-certificate}
\end{equation}
It is a test of the original resources, not permission to enlarge them.
It is separate from the fixed-structure certificate
in Appendix~\ref{subsec:price-native}.

\begin{lemma}[Record-level representation]
\label{lem:paid:representation}
In the cap-relaxed model, every finite-cost full-history policy is first
dominated by the policy that stops at permanent failure.  This dominated
policy can be simulated by symmetric integer boundary experiments and
private auxiliary records, preserving its virtual write-error,
correction, and abandonment history law up to termination, with no greater
expected review charge.  Conditional on an auxiliary writing record of
posterior level $m$, its mean review charge is $\mathsf C_m$, and its decision
error is either $p_m$ or $1-p_m$.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Let $\pi_{\rm stop}$ be the input policy stopped at permanent failure.
It has the same success event and no greater cost than the input policy.
Condition on a generated virtual history before a fresh stage.  Let $Z$ be
the local record of $\pi_{\rm stop}$, containing its seed, observations, and
binary decision or abandonment label, but not a later truth report.
For analysis fill an unmade decision on abandonment; an unopened fact
has level zero.  Given a record $z$, let $m(z)$ be the magnitude of its
integer likelihood score and $s(z)$ its MAP orientation, with a fixed
tie convention.  The conditional truth distribution depends only on
this signed score: for a fixed record, the policy's sampling and
stopping factors do not depend on the hidden bit.

Sample $z$ from its original marginal law before observing the actual
fresh bit.  Run the symmetric level-$m(z)$ test and let $s'$ be its MAP
orientation.  Define the private coordinate flip $b=s(z)\mathbin\oplus s'$.
If $z$ writes $d(z)$, actually write $d(z)\mathbin\oplus b$.
After the actual report, the virtual truth $X\mathbin\oplus b$ differs
from $s(z)$ with probability exactly $p_{m(z)}$, conditional on $z$.
It therefore has the original posterior law.  The actual and virtual
write-error indicators agree.  Feed $z$ and this virtual report to the
old controller; genuine physical correction uses the actual mismatch
handle.  Future facts remain independent of this private virtual history.
Repeating the construction preserves the marked history law.

If the boundary test is also run on an auxiliary abandonment record, its
mean review charge satisfies
\[
 \E \mathsf C_{m(Z)}=a\E\phi(p_{m(Z)})=c\E T_{\rm stop}
                                      \le c\E T_{\rm input}.
\]
Alternatively copy that abandonment immediately and delete its
nonnegative testing charge; this gives the stated no-greater bound.
Thus record-level equality comes from stopped information, whereas an
aggregated-error projection supplies only the inequality in
Lemma~\ref{lem:paid:roc}.  Arbitrary trace laws can be sampled as probability
kernels; finite-cost truncation gives the same assertion at infima.
This is a comparison proof, not an efficient compiler for an unknown
policy.  The algorithm below needs no trace-distribution oracle.

operation, then replace the remainder by a zero-charge continuation.

only on the event of that operation.  That event has probability at
least $\zeta_f-\delta$, and the old bill is at least $b_f$ there.
This argument also applies to cap-relaxed policies.

\paragraph{Bounded tests with exactly the same errors}

An endpoint policy still has unbounded review durations.  We now replace
each endpoint experiment by a bounded one without increasing its risk.
For $m=0$ write blindly.  For $1\le m\le M$, run the symmetric
level-$(m+1)$ test for at most $Q$ reviews, then write MAP, randomizing a
tie.  Call its actual error $q_m$.

Conditional on either truth, the unrestricted true-direction score has
increments of mean $\kappa$ in an interval of length $2h$.
On nonexit at time $Q$ its score is below $(m+1)h$.
Since $Q\ge(M+1)/\gamma=2(M+1)h/\kappa$, Hoeffding gives
\begin{equation}
 \Prob(T_{m+1}>Q)\le e^{-\gamma^2Q/2}
       \le e^{-E}\le2^{-E}\le\gamma\varepsilon.
 \label{eq:paid:bounded-tail}
\end{equation}
The logistic formula and \eqref{eq:paid:menu-floor} give
\[
 p_{m+1}\le(1-2\gamma)p_m,
 \qquad q_m\le p_{m+1}+\gamma\varepsilon
                   \le p_m-\gamma\varepsilon<p_m.
\]
Compute $q_m$ exactly with a length-$Q$ rational random-walk table,
absorbing at $\pm(m+1)$ and applying its terminal MAP/tie decision.

One penalty solve uses $O(N(K+1)(M+1))$ rational operations and
$O(N(K+1))$ stored actions and mean-value records.  There are at most
$J_{\rm bis}+2$ solves.  The calibration uses
$O(Q(M+1)^2)$ rational updates, summing the widths of the separate
birth--death walks; it is done once.  Thus the output is compact in these
displayed numerical parameters, with no exponential history tree.

Let $L$ bound the bit length of menu probabilities, menu costs, and input
fees.  The product of their denominators has $O((M+1)L)$ bits.
Depth-$N$ policy probabilities and mean costs have denominator bit length
$O((N+1)(M+1)L)$, with multiplier bits added for penalty objectives.
Numerators additionally count value magnitudes and the bit lengths of
$N,K$.  The calibration denominator has $O(Q L_\gamma)$ bits, where
$L_\gamma$ is the channel input length.  Initial mixture probabilities
add endpoint and $\delta$ bit lengths.  Subtracting rational endpoint
risks does not introduce an exponential number of bits.

The positive difference $\zeta_f-\delta$ is at least the reciprocal of
$2^N$ times the denominator of $\delta$; hence
$\log(1/(\zeta_f-\delta))=O(N+L_\delta)$ when it is positive.
The bit length of a very small positive $f$ is counted in $b_f$.
For fixed rational $\gamma$, $t_0,M,Q,J_{\rm bis}$ and the foregoing bit
costs are polynomial in explicit $N$ and remaining input lengths.
For variable-precision $\gamma$, dependence on numerical $1/\gamma$ is
displayed; polynomial dependence on $\log(1/\gamma)$ is not asserted.
Exact rational coins can be sampled with ordinary private randomness;
they consume no native observation or correction call.

Suppose a retained-payment contract permits all correction obligations to
remain unpaid until a final barrier.  Consider zero review quotas,
$K=N-1$, $\delta=2^{-N}$, and $N\ge6$.  Guess all bits blindly and,
with $Z\sim\operatorname{Bin}(N,1/2)$, correct exactly its $Z$ errors
when $Z<N$; abandon without correction payment when $Z=N$.
This has the minimum blind risk and expected correction count
\[
 r=N/2-N\delta.
\]
All $N$ posterior MAP errors equal $1/2$, but
$r+\delta=N/2-(N-1)\delta<N(1-\delta)/2$ for $N>2$.
Applying \eqref{eq:paid:usage} would then assert a strictly positive review
charge, although the policy buys none.  The successful-path correction
requirement alone therefore does not prove our current-payment usage
inequality.  An irrevocable assignment whose payment can still be
withheld on abandonment has this same financial issue.


This is a counterexample to transferring the actual-usage inequality,
not an impossibility theorem for every price-separation formula with
retained payment.  It also does not invalidate the main fixed-fee
structural law, whose comparison and asymptotic regime are different.
\label{sec:paid:payment-limit}

\paragraph{The structural game.}
At a healthy state $(i,R)$, tools in $R$ are unused and all earlier
required allocations are resolved. An error adversary chooses either
to declare the current stage correct or to declare an error. An error
costs the adversary one unit; the allocator observes it and chooses
$r\in S_i\cap R$, irrevocably consuming $r$. If no such tool exists,
the adversary has forced failure. Future declarations can depend on
the realized allocations. The value $\rho(i,R)$ is the smallest error
budget that forces failure against an optimal causal allocator, or

replace the independent facts in the statistical model.

\begin{corollary}[Fixed shared pool with a growing correction price]
\label{cor:fixed-pool-price}
Fix integers $N\ge1$, $0\le K<N$ and rational $c>0$,
$0<\gamma\le1/4$.  In the shared-pool $I_{\rm pay}$ model, consider
original contracts satisfying \eqref{eq:joint-certificate} as
$\delta\downarrow0$.  For any nonnegative rational price
$f=f(\delta)$, put
\[
 B_\delta=a(N-K)\ell_{K+1}(1/\delta),\qquad
 T_B=\min\{B_\delta+aN\log(1+f/a),\ aN\log(1+N/\delta)\}.
\]
Then
\[
 \frac{1-o(1)}{129}\,T_B
 \ \le\ V_f^{\rm nat}(\delta)\ \le\ 72(1+o(1))\,T_B.
\]
The $o(1)$ is independent of $f$ and of the choice of qualified native
caps, but may depend on the fixed $N,K,c,\gamma$.  In particular
$V_f^{\rm nat}(\delta)\asymp T_B$.  This is a small-risk statement for
a fixed pool, not an all-parameter uniform frontier or a sharp leading
coefficient for growing $f$.
\end{corollary}

theorem value_eq_strategyValue (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (δ : ℝ≥0∞) :
    value input C mode accounting δ = strategyValue input C mode accounting δ := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold strategyValue
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => le_iInf fun hsafe => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    exact value_le_policy input C mode accounting δ ν (strategyPolicy input C mode accounting) hsafe
  · unfold value
    refine le_iInf fun SmallSeed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
    let : MeasurableSpace SmallSeed := m
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_
    have hsafe : risk input C mode accounting (strategyPolicy input C mode accounting).rule
        (encodedSeedLaw input C mode accounting policy.val ν) ≤ δ := by
      rw [risk_encoded_eq]
      exact policy.property
    calc
      _ ≤ expectedBill input C mode accounting (strategyPolicy input C mode accounting).rule
          (encodedSeedLaw input C mode accounting policy.val ν) :=
        iInf_le_of_le (encodedSeedLaw input C mode accounting policy.val ν)
          (iInf_le_of_le (inferInstance : IsProbabilityMeasure
            (encodedSeedLaw input C mode accounting policy.val ν))
            (iInf_le_of_le hsafe le_rfl))
      _ = _ := expectedBill_encoded_eq input C mode accounting policy.val ν

end Encoding

inductive Step (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (tapes : ReviewTapes input) :
    State I → Action I → State I → Prop where
  | review (s : State I) (i : I.Stage)
      (live : liveStage s i) (port : s.ledger.written i = none)
      (resources : withinResources C mode (record accounting s (.review i)
        [.observation i (tapes i (s.ledger.reviews i).toNat).val]
        (reviewLedger s i) s.cursor false).ledger) :
      Step input C mode accounting tapes s (.review i)
        (record accounting s (.review i)
          [.observation i (tapes i (s.ledger.reviews i).toNat).val]
          (reviewLedger s i) s.cursor false)
  | write (s : State I) (i : I.Stage) (bit : Bool)
      (live : liveStage s i) (port : s.ledger.written i = none)
      (resources : withinResources C mode (record accounting s (.write i bit)
        (writeResponses C s i bit) (reportedWriteLedger C s i bit) s.cursor false).ledger) :
      Step input C mode accounting tapes s (.write i bit)
        (record accounting s (.write i bit) (writeResponses C s i bit)
          (reportedWriteLedger C s i bit) s.cursor false)
  | allocate (s : State I) (h : MismatchHandle I) (r : I.Tool)
      (active : s.halted = false) (handle : validHandle s h)
      (compatible : r ∈ I.eligible h.stage)
      (unused : ∀ a ∈ s.ledger.commitments, a.tool ≠ r)
      (unallocated : ∀ a ∈ s.ledger.commitments, a.handle.stage ≠ h.stage)
      (window : allocationOpen C s h.stage)
      (resources : withinResources C mode (record accounting s (.allocate h r)
        [.committed h r] (allocateLedger s h r) s.cursor false).ledger) :
      Step input C mode accounting tapes s (.allocate h r)
        (record accounting s (.allocate h r) [.committed h r]
          (allocateLedger s h r) s.cursor false)
  | execute (s : State I) (h : MismatchHandle I) (r : I.Tool)
      (active : s.halted = false) (handle : validHandle s h)
      (compatible : r ∈ I.eligible h.stage)
      (committed : ∃ a ∈ s.ledger.commitments, a.handle = h ∧ a.tool = r)
      (unused : ∀ e ∈ s.ledger.executions, e.tool ≠ r)
      (uncorrected : ∀ e ∈ s.ledger.executions, e.handle.stage ≠ h.stage)
      (window : executionOpen C s h.stage)
      (resources : withinResources C mode (record accounting s (.execute h r)
        [.executed h r] (executeLedger s h r) s.cursor false).ledger) :
      Step input C mode accounting tapes s (.execute h r)
        (record accounting s (.execute h r) [.executed h r]
          (executeLedger s h r) s.cursor false)
  | advance (s : State I) (i : I.Stage)
      (live : liveStage s i) (written : s.ledger.written i ≠ none)
      (resources : withinResources C mode (record accounting s (.advance i)
        [.advanced i] (advanceLedger s i) (s.cursor + 1) false).ledger) :
      Step input C mode accounting tapes s (.advance i)
        (record accounting s (.advance i) [.advanced i]
          (advanceLedger s i) (s.cursor + 1) false)
  | stop (s : State I) (active : s.halted = false) :
      Step input C mode accounting tapes s .stop (stopState s false)

theorem measurable_run (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hpolicy : MeasurableRule policy) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World ↦ run input C mode accounting policy sample n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (measurable_initial_world input).comp measurable_snd
  | succ n ih =>
    have hh : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World ↦
        (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).history) :=
      (measurable_of_countable (fun s : State I ↦ s.history)).comp ih
    have ha := hpolicy.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk hh)
    have hf := (measurable_frontierOf input).comp (ih.prodMk measurable_snd)
    have hn : Measurable (fun p : State I × Action I × Frontier input ↦
        nextFromFrontier input C mode accounting p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) :=
      measurable_of_countable _
    exact hn.comp (ih.prodMk (ha.prodMk hf))

PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_has_prefix.signature_start: theorem run_has_prefix (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_has_prefix.full_declaration_source:
theorem run_has_prefix (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting policy) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (n : ℕ) : ∃ m ≤ n, Prefix input C mode accounting policy sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) m
      (run input C mode accounting policy sample n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, .initial⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, hmn, hp⟩ := ih
    by_cases hhalt : (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).halted = true
    · refine ⟨m, hmn.trans (Nat.le_succ n), ?_⟩
      rw [run_succ_of_halted input C mode accounting policy sample n hhalt]
      exact hp
    · have hactive : (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).halted = false :=
        Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hhalt
      obtain ⟨s', hstep⟩ := hlegal sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2)
        (worldTapes input sample.2) m _ hp hactive
      refine ⟨m + 1, Nat.succ_le_succ hmn, ?_⟩
      rw [run_succ_of_step input C mode accounting policy sample n s' hactive hstep]
      exact .next hp hstep

    input.seededWorldLaw (encodedSeedLaw input C mode accounting policy ν) =
      (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (fun sample =>
        (encodeSeed input C mode accounting policy sample.1, sample.2)) := by
  change (ν.map (encodeSeed input C mode accounting policy)).prod input.worldLaw = _

    (measurable_encodeSeed input C mode accounting policy) measurable_id
  rw [Measure.map_id] at h

    (ν.prod input.worldLaw).map (fun sample =>
      (encodeSeed input C mode accounting policy sample.1, sample.2)) at h
  simpa only [StatisticalInput.seededWorldLaw] using h

    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)

    risk input C mode accounting (strategyPolicy input C mode accounting).rule

      (encodeSeed input C mode accounting policy sample.1, sample.2)) :=

  congr 1

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_history.signature_start: theorem prefix_historyReport_early (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_history.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_historyReport_early (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) {Seed : Type*}
    (policy : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I} (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes n s) :
    ∀ i : I.Stage, historyReport s.history i =
      (s.ledger.reportTime i).map (fun _ => (s.ledger.truth i, s.ledger.writeSerial i)) := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => intro i; rfl
  | @next n s s' _ step ih =>
    generalize haction : policy seed s.history = action at step
    cases step with
    | write j bit live port resources =>
      intro i
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst i
        simp [record, historyReport, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons, eventReport,
          writeResponses, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, writeLedger]
      · have hij := Ne.symm hji
        simpa [record, historyReport, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons, eventReport,
          writeResponses, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, writeLedger, hji,
          Function.update_of_ne hij] using ih i
    | review | allocate | execute | advance | stop | abandon =>
      intro i
      simpa [record, stopState, historyReport, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons,
        eventReport, reviewLedger, allocateLedger, executeLedger, advanceLedger] using ih i

theorem prefix_historyObservation_getElem (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) {Seed : Type*}
    (policy : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I} (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes n s)
    (i : I.Stage) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < (historyObservations s.history i).length) :
    (historyObservations s.history i)[k] = (tapes i k).val := by
  have hword := prefix_historyObservations_eq_tapeWord input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes hp i
  have hget := congrArg (fun word : List ℕ => word[k]?) hword
  have hk' : k < (s.ledger.reviews i).toNat := by
    simpa only [hword, List.length_ofFn] using hk
  have hright : (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (s.ledger.reviews i).toNat => (tapes i k.val).val))[k]? =
      some (tapes i k).val := by simp [hk']
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk, hright] at hget
  exact Option.some.inj hget

theorem run_prefix_of_active {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting policy) (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ)
    (hactive : (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).halted = false) :
    Prefix input C mode accounting policy sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n
      (run input C mode accounting policy sample n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact .initial
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hh : (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).halted = true
    · rw [run_succ_of_halted input C mode accounting policy sample n hh, hh] at hactive
      cases hactive
    · have ha : (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).halted = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh
      have hp := ih ha
      obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n _ hp ha
      rw [run_succ_of_step input C mode accounting policy sample n next ha hs]
      exact .next hp hs

PaperProofs.Common.Native.step_retarget_.signature_start: theorem step_retarget_before (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.step_retarget_.full_declaration_source:
theorem step_retarget_before (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (tapes tapes' : ReviewTapes input) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (next : I.Stage)
    {s s' : State I} {action : Action I} (hinv : CursorInvariant s)
    (hbefore : s.cursor < next.val)
    (htruth : ∀ i : I.Stage, i.val < next.val → truth i = s.ledger.truth i)
    (htapes : ∀ i : I.Stage, i.val < next.val → tapes' i = tapes i)
    (h : Step input C mode accounting tapes s action s') :
    Step input C mode accounting tapes' (retargetTruth s truth) action
      (retargetTruth s' truth) := by
  classical
  cases h with
  | review i live port resources =>
    have hi : i.val < next.val := by have hc := live.2; omega
    have ht := htapes i hi
    have hr : withinResources C mode (record accounting (retargetTruth s truth) (.review i)
        [.observation i (tapes' i (s.ledger.reviews i).toNat).val]
        (reviewLedger (retargetTruth s truth) i) s.cursor false).ledger := by
      simpa only [ht, withinResources, Ledger.obeysCaps, Ledger.totalCalls,
        record, retargetTruth, reviewLedger] using resources
    simpa only [retargetTruth_record, retargetTruth, reviewLedger, record, ht] using
      (Step.review (input := input) (C := C) (mode := mode) (accounting := accounting)
        (tapes := tapes') (retargetTruth s truth) i live port hr)
  | write i bit live port resources =>
    have hi : i.val < next.val := by have hc := live.2; omega
    have hrsp := writeResponses_retargetTruth C hinv next i hbefore live bit truth (htruth i hi)
    have hr : withinResources C mode (record accounting (retargetTruth s truth) (.write i bit)
        (writeResponses C (retargetTruth s truth) i bit)
        (reportedWriteLedger C (retargetTruth s truth) i bit) s.cursor false).ledger := by
      rw [hrsp, reportedWriteLedger_retargetTruth]
      simpa only [withinResources, Ledger.obeysCaps,
        Ledger.totalCalls, record, retargetTruth] using resources
    have hs := Step.write (input := input) (C := C) (mode := mode) (accounting := accounting)
      (tapes := tapes') (retargetTruth s truth) i bit live port hr
    rw [hrsp, reportedWriteLedger_retargetTruth] at hs
    rw [retargetTruth_record]
    exact hs
  | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
    have hi : handle.stage.val < next.val := lt_of_le_of_lt (hinv.validHandle_le valid) hbefore
    have hv : validHandle (retargetTruth s truth) handle := by
      simpa only [validHandle, retargetTruth, htruth handle.stage hi] using valid
    have hr : withinResources C mode (record accounting (retargetTruth s truth) (.allocate handle tool)
        [.committed handle tool] (allocateLedger (retargetTruth s truth) handle tool) s.cursor false).ledger := by
      simpa only [withinResources, Ledger.obeysCaps, Ledger.totalCalls,
        record, retargetTruth, allocateLedger] using resources
    simpa only [retargetTruth_record, retargetTruth, allocateLedger, record] using
      (Step.allocate (input := input) (C := C) (mode := mode) (accounting := accounting)
        (tapes := tapes') (retargetTruth s truth) handle tool active hv compatible unused unallocated window hr)
  | execute handle tool active valid compatible committed unused uncorrected window resources =>
    have hi : handle.stage.val < next.val := lt_of_le_of_lt (hinv.validHandle_le valid) hbefore
    have hv : validHandle (retargetTruth s truth) handle := by
      simpa only [validHandle, retargetTruth, htruth handle.stage hi] using valid
    have hr : withinResources C mode (record accounting (retargetTruth s truth) (.execute handle tool)
        [.executed handle tool] (executeLedger (retargetTruth s truth) handle tool) s.cursor false).ledger := by
      simpa only [withinResources, Ledger.obeysCaps, Ledger.totalCalls,
        record, retargetTruth, executeLedger] using resources
    simpa only [retargetTruth_record, retargetTruth, executeLedger, record] using
      (Step.execute (input := input) (C := C) (mode := mode) (accounting := accounting)
        (tapes := tapes') (retargetTruth s truth) handle tool active hv compatible committed unused uncorrected window hr)
  | advance i live written resources =>
    have hr : withinResources C mode (record accounting (retargetTruth s truth) (.advance i)
        [.advanced i] (advanceLedger (retargetTruth s truth) i) (s.cursor + 1) false).ledger := by
      simpa only [withinResources, Ledger.obeysCaps, Ledger.totalCalls,
        record, retargetTruth, advanceLedger] using resources
    simpa only [retargetTruth_record, retargetTruth, advanceLedger, record] using
      (Step.advance (input := input) (C := C) (mode := mode) (accounting := accounting)
        (tapes := tapes') (retargetTruth s truth) i live written hr)
  | stop active =>
    simpa only [retargetTruth_stopState] using
      (Step.stop (input := input) (C := C) (mode := mode) (accounting := accounting)

theorem entryHistory_eq_of_past (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting policy) (seed : Seed)
    (world world' : input.World) (next : I.Stage)
    (hpast : ∀ i : I.Stage, i.val < next.val → world' i = world i) :
    entryHistory input C mode accounting policy next (seed, world') =
      entryHistory input C mode accounting policy next (seed, world) := by
  cases he : entryHistory input C mode accounting policy next (seed, world) with
  | some history =>
    exact entryHistory_some_transport input C mode accounting policy hlegal seed world world' next hpast history he
  | none =>
    cases he' : entryHistory input C mode accounting policy next (seed, world') with
    | none => rfl
    | some history =>
      have hc := entryHistory_some_transport input C mode accounting policy hlegal seed world' world next
        (fun i hi => (hpast i hi).symm) history he'
      rw [he] at hc
      cases hc

end Runs

theorem nativePreBirthFactorization (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) :
    NativePreBirthFactorization input C mode accounting := by
  intro Seed m
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
  intro policy next
  let complete : Seed × input.PastWorld next → Seed × input.World :=
    fun sample => (sample.1, completePastWorld input next sample.2)
  have hm : Measurable complete :=
    measurable_fst.prodMk ((measurable_completePastWorld input next).comp measurable_snd)
  refine ⟨fun sample => entryHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next (complete sample),
    (measurable_entryHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule next).comp hm, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨seed, world⟩
  exact (entryHistory_eq_of_past input C mode accounting policy.rule policy.legal seed world
    (completePastWorld input next (fun i => world i.val)) next
    (fun i hi => completePastWorld_apply_past input next (fun i => world i.val) i hi)).symm

    IndepFun (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next)
      (fun sample : Seed × input.World => sample.2 next) (input.seededWorldLaw ν) := by

    Seed ‹MeasurableSpace Seed› policy next

    fun sample => (sample.1, record sample)

  have hind := input.preBirthRecord_independent_next ν next jointRecord hm
  have heq : entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next =
      fun sample => jointRecord (input.preBirthView next sample) := by
    funext sample
    simp only [entrySeedHistory, jointRecord, StatisticalInput.preBirthView, hpointwise sample]
  rw [heq]
  exact hind

theorem restrictFreshWorld_worldLaw (input : StatisticalInput I) (first : Nat) :
    input.worldLaw.map (input.restrictFreshWorld first) = (input.freshSuffix first).worldLaw := by
  cases first with
  | zero => exact Measure.map_id
  | succ first =>
    have hind := ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.precomp (freshStageLift_injective I (first + 1))
      input.worldLaw_independent_stages
    change input.worldLaw.map (fun world stage => world (I.freshStageLift (first + 1) stage)) =
      Measure.pi (fun stage => input.stageLaw (I.freshStageLift (first + 1) stage))
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.map_fun_eq_pi_map
      (fun stage => (measurable_pi_apply (I.freshStageLift (first + 1) stage)).aemeasurable) hind]
    congr 1
    funext stage
    exact input.worldLaw_coordinate (I.freshStageLift (first + 1) stage)

PaperProofs.Common.Native.runActualBill_.full_declaration_source:
theorem runActualBill_of_halted (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ)
    (hhalt : (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).halted = true) :
    runActualBill input C mode accounting policy sample =
      (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).ledger.actualBill input.fees := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro k
    by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
    · exact run_bill_mono input C mode accounting policy sample hkn

theorem normalCallCertificate_iff_completed_of_halts {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed) (H0 : ℕ)
    (hhalts : ∀ sample : Seed × input.World, ∃ n, (run input C mode accounting policy.rule sample n).halted = true) :
    NormalCallCertificate input C mode accounting policy H0 ↔
      CompletedNormalCallBound input C mode accounting policy.rule H0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hp sample n _hh
    exact hp sample n
  · intro hc sample n
    obtain ⟨finish, hh⟩ := hhalts sample
    have hm := run_normalCalls_mono input C mode accounting policy.rule sample
      (show n ≤ finish + n from Nat.le_add_left _ _)

theorem tableNativeImplementation (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (budget : ℚ) (exponent : ℕ)
    (qualification : OriginalQualification input C accounting available budget exponent) :
    ∃ policy : Policy input C .native accounting Unit,
      policy.rule = tableRule input available budget (some (referenceQuota input exponent)) ∧
      (∀ sample clock, run input C .native accounting policy.rule sample clock =
        run input C .uncapped accounting (tableRule input available budget (some (referenceQuota input exponent))) sample clock) ∧
      (∀ sample clock, (run input C .native accounting policy.rule sample clock).ledger.obeysCaps C ∧
        (run input C .native accounting policy.rule sample clock).ledger.normalCalls ≤ (C.normalCallBound : ℕ∞)) := by
  let source := tableUncappedPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget (some (referenceQuota input exponent))
  have reviews := tableRule_reviewQuotaCertificate input C hearly accounting available budget (referenceQuota input exponent)
  have normal : NormalCallCertificate input C .uncapped accounting source C.normalCallBound :=
    (tableRule_normalCalls_iff_completed input C hearly accounting available budget
      (referenceQuota input exponent) C.normalCallBound).mpr qualification.normal_completed
  let native := source.enforceCaps input C accounting (referenceQuota input exponent)
    reviews normal qualification.stage_quota qualification.total_calls
  have hrun := enforceCaps_run_eq input C accounting source (referenceQuota input exponent)
    reviews normal qualification.stage_quota qualification.total_calls
  refine ⟨native, rfl, hrun, ?_⟩
  intro sample clock
  refine ⟨run_native_obeysCaps input C accounting native.rule native.legal sample clock, ?_⟩
  rw [hrun]
  exact normal sample clock

theorem prefix_length_le_of_review_bounds {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    (quota : I.Stage → ℕ) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes n s)
    (hq : ∀ stage, s.ledger.reviews stage ≤ (quota stage : ℕ∞)) :
    n ≤ quotaActionBound I quota := by
  have hwf := prefix_ledgerWellFormed input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes hp
  have hcursor := (prefix_cursorInvariant input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes hp).bound
  have hreviews : (∑ stage, s.ledger.reviews stage) ≤ ((∑ stage, quota stage : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [natCast_sum_enat]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun stage _ => hq stage)
  have hcommitments : s.ledger.commitments.length ≤ I.toolCount := by
    have hh := hwf.commitment_tools.length_le_card
    simpa only [List.length_map, Instance.Tool, Fintype.card_fin] using hh
  have hexecutions : s.ledger.executions.length ≤ I.toolCount :=
    (Ledger.execution_count_le hwf).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hwritten : (writtenPorts s.ledger).card ≤ I.stageCount := by
    have hh := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset (fun stage : I.Stage => s.ledger.written stage ≠ none) Finset.univ)
    simpa only [writtenPorts, Finset.card_univ, Instance.Stage, Instance.stageCount, Fintype.card_fin] using hh
  have hhalted : (if s.halted then (1 : ℕ∞) else 0) ≤ 1 := by cases s.halted <;> simp
  have ht := add_le_add
    (add_le_add
      (add_le_add
        (add_le_add (add_le_add hreviews (ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr hcommitments))
          (ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr hexecutions))
        (ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr hcursor))
      (ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr hwritten)) hhalted
  have hprogress : actionProgress s ≤ (quotaActionBound I quota : ℕ∞) := by
    simpa only [actionProgress, quotaActionBound, ENat.natCast_add, ENat.natCast_one] using ht
  rw [prefix_actionProgress input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes hp] at hprogress
  exact ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp hprogress

PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_uncapped_e.signature_start: theorem run_uncapped_eq_native (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_uncapped_e.full_declaration_source:
theorem run_uncapped_eq_native (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .native accounting policy) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (n : ℕ) :
    run input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n =
      run input C .native accounting policy sample n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .native accounting policy hlegal sample n
    by_cases hhalt : (run input C .native accounting policy sample n).halted = true
    · have hhaltUncapped : (run input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n).halted = true := by
        rw [ih]
        exact hhalt
      rw [run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n hhaltUncapped,
        run_succ_of_halted input C .native accounting policy sample n hhalt]
      exact ih
    · have hactive : (run input C .native accounting policy sample n).halted = false :=
        Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hhalt
      obtain ⟨next, hnext⟩ := hlegal sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2)
        (worldTapes input sample.2) m _ hp hactive
      have hactiveUncapped :
          (run input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n).halted = false := by
        rw [ih]
        exact hactive
      have hnextUncapped : Step input C .uncapped accounting (worldTapes input sample.2)
          (run input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n)
          (policy sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n).history) next := by
        rw [ih]
        exact step_native_to_uncapped input C accounting _ hnext
      rw [run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n next
        hactiveUncapped hnextUncapped,
        run_succ_of_step input C .native accounting policy sample n next hactive hnext]

    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (δ : ℝ≥0∞) :
    value input C .uncapped accounting δ ≤ value input C .native accounting δ := by
  refine le_iInf fun Seed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
  refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_

    change risk input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule ν ≤ δ

  calc

      value_le_policy input C .uncapped accounting δ ν relaxed hrisk

  refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_
  let deferred := Policy.deferExecution input C mode accounting policy.val
  have hrisk : risk input C.deferExecution mode accounting deferred.rule ν ≤ δ := by
    change risk input C.deferExecution mode accounting policy.val.rule ν ≤ δ
    rw [risk_deferred_eq_original input C mode accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal ν]
    exact policy.property
  calc
    _ ≤ expectedBill input C.deferExecution mode accounting deferred.rule ν :=
      value_le_policy input C.deferExecution mode accounting δ ν deferred hrisk
    _ = expectedBill input C mode accounting policy.val.rule ν :=
      expectedBill_deferred_eq_original input C mode accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal ν

end Native

PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_reaccount.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_reaccount
PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_reaccount.signature_start: theorem run_reaccount (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_reaccount.full_declaration_source:
theorem run_reaccount (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting accounting' : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting policy) (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ calls, run input C .uncapped accounting' policy sample n =
      (run input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n).withNormalCalls calls := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨calls, heq⟩ := ih
    by_cases hh : (run input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n).halted = true
    · have hh' : (run input C .uncapped accounting' policy sample n).halted = true := by
        rw [heq, State.withNormalCalls_halted]
        exact hh
      rw [run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting' policy sample n hh',
        run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n hh]
      exact ⟨calls, heq⟩
    · have ha := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh
      have ha' : (run input C .uncapped accounting' policy sample n).halted = false := by
        rw [heq, State.withNormalCalls_halted]
        exact ha
      obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy hlegal sample n
      obtain ⟨next, hnext⟩ := hlegal sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2)
        (worldTapes input sample.2) m _ hp ha
      obtain ⟨calls', hs'⟩ := step_reaccount input C accounting accounting'
        (worldTapes input sample.2) hnext calls
      have hnext' : Step input C .uncapped accounting' (worldTapes input sample.2)
          (run input C .uncapped accounting' policy sample n)
          (policy sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting' policy sample n).history)
          (next.withNormalCalls calls') := by
        rw [heq, State.withNormalCalls_history]
        exact hs'
      rw [run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting' policy sample n _ ha' hnext',
        run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting policy sample n _ ha hnext]
      exact ⟨calls', rfl⟩

theorem penaltyValue_recap_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (quota : I.Stage → ℕ) (H H0 : ℕ) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    penaltyValue input (C.withCaps quota H H0) accounting penalty = penaltyValue input C accounting penalty := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · conv_rhs => unfold penaltyValue
    refine le_iInf fun SmallSeed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
    let : MeasurableSpace SmallSeed := m
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_
    have h := penaltyValue_le_policy input (C.withCaps quota H H0) accounting penalty ν
      (policy.recap input C quota H H0 accounting)
    change penaltyValue input (C.withCaps quota H H0) accounting penalty ≤
      penaltyObjective input (C.withCaps quota H H0) .uncapped accounting policy.rule ν penalty at h
    rwa [penaltyObjective_recap_eq] at h
  · conv_rhs => unfold penaltyValue
    refine le_iInf fun SmallSeed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
    let : MeasurableSpace SmallSeed := m
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_
    have h := penaltyValue_le_policy input C accounting penalty ν
      (policy.uncapMetadata input C quota H H0 accounting)
    change penaltyValue input C accounting penalty ≤
      penaltyObjective input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule ν penalty at h
    rwa [← penaltyObjective_recap_eq input C quota H H0 accounting policy.rule ν penalty] at h

    delta hd hsmall exponent budget choice

  have heq : completeNativeReferencePolicy input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget exponent qualification = policy :=
    policy_eq_of_rule_eq input C .native accounting _ policy
      ((completeNativeReferencePolicy_rule input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget exponent qualification).trans hrule.symm)

theorem NormalBilling.totalNativeValue_le_referenceIdeal_add
    (billing : NormalBilling I) (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hcurrent : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (delta : ℝ) (hd : 0 < delta) (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2)
    (exponent : ℕ) (budget : ℚ) (choice : ReferenceRiskChoice I.stageCount delta exponent budget)
    (qualification : ReferenceOriginalQualification input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget exponent)
    (C0 : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcharge : ConstructedNormalChargeUpper input
      (billing.charges input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceBoundedPolicy input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget exponent)) C0) :
    billing.totalValue input C .native accounting (ENNReal.ofReal delta) ≤
      expectedBill input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceIdealPolicy input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget).rule (Measure.dirac ()) + C0 := by
  obtain ⟨policy, hrule, hsafe, hbill⟩ := referenceNative_policy input C hcurrent accounting
    delta hd hsmall exponent budget choice qualification
  have hnormal : ConstructedNormalChargeUpper input (billing.charges input C .native accounting policy) C0 := by
    intro sample
    have htrace : normalTrace input C .native accounting policy.rule sample =
        normalTrace input C .uncapped accounting
          (referenceBoundedPolicy input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget exponent).rule sample := by
      apply normalTrace_eq_of_run_eq
      intro n
      rw [← run_uncapped_eq_native input C accounting policy.rule policy.legal sample n, hrule]
    change billing.charge (normalTrace input C .native accounting policy.rule sample) ≤ C0
    rw [htrace]
    exact hcharge sample
  exact (billing.totalValue_upper_of_constructed input C .native accounting (ENNReal.ofReal delta) C0
    (Measure.dirac ()) policy hsafe hnormal).trans (add_le_add hbill le_rfl)

PaperProofs.Structure.safe_restrict_iff.signature_start: theorem safe_restrict_iff (schedule : List (Finset Tool)) (restriction remaining : Finset Tool)
PaperProofs.Structure.safe_restrict_iff.full_declaration_source:
theorem safe_restrict_iff (schedule : List (Finset Tool)) (restriction remaining : Finset Tool)
    (budget : Nat) :
    Safe (schedule.map (fun eligible => eligible ∩ restriction)) remaining budget ↔
      Safe schedule (remaining ∩ restriction) budget := by
  induction schedule generalizing remaining budget with
  | nil => simp only [List.map_nil, safe_terminal]
  | cons eligible later ih =>
    cases budget with
    | zero => exact ⟨fun _ => safe_zero _ _, fun _ => safe_zero _ _⟩
    | succ budget =>
      rw [List.map_cons, safe_cons_succ_iff, safe_cons_succ_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hgood, tool, htool, hbad⟩
        refine ⟨(ih remaining (budget + 1)).mp hgood, tool, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa only [Finset.mem_inter, and_assoc, and_left_comm, and_comm] using htool
        · simpa only [Finset.erase_inter] using (ih (remaining.erase tool) budget).mp hbad
      · rintro ⟨hgood, tool, htool, hbad⟩
        refine ⟨(ih remaining (budget + 1)).mpr hgood, tool, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa only [Finset.mem_inter, and_assoc, and_left_comm, and_comm] using htool
        · apply (ih (remaining.erase tool) budget).mpr
          simpa only [Finset.erase_inter] using hbad

PaperProofs.Structure.safe_cons_succ_iff.name: PaperProofs.Structure.safe_cons_succ_iff
PaperProofs.Structure.safe_cons_succ_iff.full_declaration_source:
theorem safe_cons_succ_iff (eligible : Finset Tool)
    (later : List (Finset Tool)) (remaining : Finset Tool) (budget : Nat) :
    Safe (eligible :: later) remaining (budget + 1) ↔
      Safe later remaining (budget + 1) ∧
      ∃ tool ∈ eligible ∩ remaining, Safe later (remaining.erase tool) budget := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨plan, hp⟩
    cases plan with
    | decline good =>
      exact False.elim (hp 1 (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le budget))
        (.unassigned good remaining))
    | choose good tool next =>
      have hgood : SafePlan good remaining (budget + 1) := by
        intro errors herr hplay
        exact hp errors herr (.correct_choose hplay)
      refine ⟨⟨good, hgood⟩, ?_⟩
      have hlegal : tool ∈ eligible ∩ remaining := by
        by_contra hillegal
        exact hp 1 (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le budget))
          (.unavailable good next remaining tool hillegal)
      refine ⟨tool, hlegal, next, ?_⟩
      intro errors herr hplay
      exact hp (errors + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ herr) (.repaired hlegal hplay)
  · rintro ⟨⟨good, hgood⟩, tool, hlegal, next, hnext⟩
    refine ⟨.choose good tool next, ?_⟩
    intro errors herr hplay
    cases hplay with
    | correct_choose continuation => exact hgood errors herr continuation
    | unavailable _ _ _ _ hillegal => exact hillegal hlegal
    | repaired _ continuation =>
      exact hnext _ (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ herr) continuation

representation is chosen. This uses remaining rather than used tools. -/

theorem safe_iff_lt_errorRank (stages : List (Finset Tool))
    (remaining : Finset Tool) (budget : Nat) :

  classical
  unfold errorRank
  split_ifs with hfail
  · rw [ENat.natCast_lt_natCast, Nat.lt_find_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hsafe smaller hle hnot
      exact hnot (safe_mono hsafe hle)
    · intro hall
      exact not_not.mp (hall budget (Nat.le_refl _))
  · simp only [ENat.natCast_lt_top, iff_true]
    by_contra hnot
    exact hfail ⟨budget, hnot⟩

PaperProofs.Structure.play_errors_le_car.full_declaration_source:
theorem play_errors_le_card_add_one {stages : List (Finset Tool)}
    {plan : Plan Tool stages} {remaining : Finset Tool} {errors : Nat} {success : Bool}
    (play : Play plan remaining errors success) : errors ≤ remaining.card + 1 := by
  induction play with
  | terminal => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | correct_decline _ ih => exact ih
  | correct_choose _ ih => exact ih
  | unassigned => exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)
  | unavailable => exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)
  | repaired legal _ ih =>
    rw [Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_inter.mp legal).2] at ih
    exact Nat.succ_le_succ ih

It follows from the independent play bound, not from a bounded DP table. -/

theorem errorRank_finite_le_card_add_one (stages : List (Finset Tool))
    (remaining : Finset Tool) (hfinite : errorRank stages remaining ≠ ⊤) :
    errorRank stages remaining ≤ ((remaining.card + 1 : Nat) : ℕ∞) := by
  classical
  by_cases hfail : ∃ budget, ¬ Safe stages remaining budget
  · have hcap : ¬ Safe stages remaining (remaining.card + 1) := by
      intro hsafe
      exact (Nat.find_spec hfail) (safe_of_card_add_one hsafe (Nat.find hfail))
    unfold errorRank
    rw [dite_eq_left hfail]
    exact ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr (Nat.find_min' hfail hcap)
  · exact False.elim (hfinite (by simp [errorRank, hfail]))

PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.name: PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTreePreprocessingClaims.FullClaims
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.full_declaration_source:
def FullClaims : Prop :=
  ∃ (constant wordFactor : Nat) (program : List PackingOp),
    0 < constant ∧ 0 < wordFactor ∧
    ∀ (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))), 0 < q →
    let N := full.length
    let bits := indexWidth wordFactor N q
    let rom := rawIncidenceROM q full
    let heap := fun _ => BitVec.ofNat bits 0
    ∃ (steps heapWords : Nat),
    DynamicRunCorrect heapWords rom program steps heap ∧
    totalCost heapWords rom program steps heap ≤ constant * treeWork N q ∧
    (let result := packingRun rom program steps (packingInitial heap)
     (result.register .value).toNat ≤ 1 ∧
     ((result.register .value).toNat = 1 ↔ LaminarSchedule full) ∧
     (LaminarSchedule full → TreeOutputCorrect q full heapWords result))

end PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTreePreprocessingClaims
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.type_evidence_kind: Full immutable formal source declaration plus active variable context; not a new kernel #check or reconstructed Lean type.

PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.name: PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTreePreprocessingNat.raw_preprocessing
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.signature_start: theorem raw_preprocessing (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q) :
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.full_declaration_source:
theorem raw_preprocessing (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ steps ≤ 16384 * treeWork full.length q,
      let result := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program steps natInitial
      result.halted = true ∧ result.register .value ≤ 1 ∧
        (result.register .value = 1 ↔ LaminarSchedule full) ∧
        (LaminarSchedule full → Output q full result) := by
  by_cases hl : LaminarSchedule full
  · obtain ⟨steps, hsteps, output⟩ := succeeds q full hq hl
    refine ⟨steps, hsteps.trans (successClockBound_le q full hq),
      output.halted, ?_, ?_, fun _ => output⟩
    · rw [output.accepted]
    · exact ⟨fun _ => hl, fun _ => output.accepted⟩
  · obtain ⟨steps, hsteps, hhalted, hvalue⟩ := rejects q full hl
    have hchecker := checkerSteps_le full.length q hq
    have hunit : 1 ≤ treeWork full.length q := by
      unfold treeWork
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega : 1 ≤ full.length + q + 1) 2) hq
    refine ⟨steps, by omega, hhalted, ?_, ?_, fun h => False.elim (hl h)⟩
    · rw [hvalue]; omega
    · rw [hvalue]
      simp only [Nat.zero_ne_one, false_iff]
      exact hl

end PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTreePreprocessingNat
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.type_evidence_kind: Full immutable formal source declaration plus active variable context; not a new kernel #check or reconstructed Lean type.

def PrefixSafety : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))), 0 < q →
    PrefixSafe (SafePoint q full) (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial
      (16384 * treeWork full.length q)

code addresses and accesses, and does not contain tree/output/cost answers. -/

PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.name: PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.fullClaims_of_prefixSafety
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.full_declaration_source:
theorem fullClaims_of_prefixSafety (hsafety : PrefixSafety) : FullClaims := by
  refine ⟨262144, 16, program, by decide, by decide, ?_⟩
  intro q full hq
  let bits := indexWidth 16 full.length q
  let rom := rawIncidenceROM q full
  let heap : BitVec bits → BitVec bits := fun _ => BitVec.ofNat bits 0
  obtain ⟨steps, hsteps, hhalt, hflag, hcorrect, houtput⟩ :=
    RawTreePreprocessingNat.raw_preprocessing q full hq
  have hsafe : PrefixSafe (SafePoint q full) rom program natInitial steps :=
    PrefixSafe.mono _ _ _ _ hsteps (hsafety q full hq)
  obtain ⟨first, hfirst, hsame, hh, hbefore⟩ := exists_first_halt rom program natInitial steps hhalt
  have hword (count : Nat) (hc : count ≤ first) :
      packingRun rom program count (packingInitial heap) =
        (natRun rom program count natInitial).toWord bits := by
    change packingRun rom program count (natInitial.toWord bits) = _
    apply natRun_toWord rom program natInitial count (RawTreePreprocessingCostBounds.code_wordsFit full.length q)
    intro k hk
    have hs := hsafe k (hk.trans_le (hc.trans hfirst))
    exact ⟨hs.1, safePoint_pcFit q full _ hs⟩
  have hNatFlag : (natRun rom program first natInitial).register .value ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hsame]
    exact hflag
  have hflagFit : Fits bits ((natRun rom program first natInitial).register .value) :=
    RawTreePreprocessingCodeBounds.constant_fits full.length q _ (hNatFlag.trans (by decide))
  refine ⟨first, heapWords full.length q, ?_,
    RawTreePreprocessingCostBounds.totalCost_le q full hq first heap (hfirst.trans hsteps), ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨RawTreePreprocessingCostBounds.code_wordsFit full.length q, raw_rom_wordsFit q full,
      RawTreePreprocessingCostBounds.footprint_fits q full, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hword first le_rfl]
      exact hh
    · intro count hc
      have hs := hsafe count (hc.trans_le hfirst)
      dsimp only
      rw [hword count hc.le]
      refine ⟨hbefore count hc, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change (BitVec.ofNat bits (natRun rom program count natInitial).pc).toNat + 4 < _
        rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (safePoint_pcFit q full _ hs)]
        exact safePoint_fetchWindow q full _ hs
      · rw [safePoint_physicalFetch q full _ hs]
        obtain ⟨_hr, _index, _hi, _hp, ha⟩ := hs
        have ha' := ha (hbefore count hc)
        cases hd : PackingOp.decode (natFetch program (natRun rom program count natInitial).pc) with
        | none => simpa only [hd] using ha'
        | some op =>
          apply physical_access_of_nat rom (heapWords full.length q) _ op _hr
          simpa only [hd] using ha'
  · rw [hword first le_rfl]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (BitVec.ofNat bits ((natRun rom program first natInitial).register .value)).toNat ≤ 1
      rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hflagFit]
      exact hNatFlag
    · change (BitVec.ofNat bits ((natRun rom program first natInitial).register .value)).toNat = 1 ↔ _
      rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hflagFit, hsame]
      exact hcorrect
    · intro hl
      apply wordOutput_of_natOutput q full hq hl
      rw [hsame]
      exact houtput hl

end PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface
