PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.signature_start: theorem initialized_entry (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hl : LaminarSchedule full) :
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.full_declaration_source:
theorem initialized_entry (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hl : LaminarSchedule full) :
    ∃ clock ≤ checkerSteps full.length q + 17,
      PrefixSafe (SafePoint q full) (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial clock ∧
      StartReady q full (natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock natInitial) ∧
      packingRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock
        (packingInitial (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (indexWidth 16 full.length q) 0)) =
          (natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock natInitial).toWord (indexWidth 16 full.length q) := by
  obtain ⟨first, hfirst, entry⟩ := gate_entry q full
  let before := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program first natInitial
  have hpc : before.pc = 5 * 128 := by
    have h := (entry.accepts hl).1
    simpa only [checker_length] using h
  have hv : before.register .value = 1 := (entry.accepts hl).2
  have hinit := RawCandidateWorkspaceInit.initialize_workspace q full program 128
    init_slice.1 init_slice.2 before hpc entry.active
  have hs := RawCandidateWorkspaceInitWord.natRun_prefix_safe q full program 128
    init_slice.1 init_slice.2 before hpc entry.active entry.fit
      (RawTreePreprocessingCodeBounds.constant_fits full.length q _ (by decide)) 16 le_rfl
  have hstart : StartReady q full (natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program 16 before) := by
    refine ⟨hs.1, hinit.active, hinit.pc, hinit.value.trans hv, hinit.base_cell, hinit.count_cell, ?_⟩
    intro address ha h8 hB
    rw [hinit.heap_frame address h8 hB]
    exact entry.untouched address ha
  have hsafe : PrefixSafe (SafePoint q full) (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial (first + 16) :=
    PrefixSafe.add _ _ _ _ first 16 entry.safe (init_prefix q full before hpc entry.active entry.fit)
  refine ⟨first + 16, by omega, hsafe, ?_, prefix_word_eq q full (first + 16) hsafe⟩
  rwa [natRun_add]

end PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTreePreprocessingStartWord

PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.name: PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTreePreprocessingRejectWord.rejects
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.signature_start: theorem rejects (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q)
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.RawTre.full_declaration_source:
theorem rejects (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hl : ¬ LaminarSchedule full) :
    ∃ steps ≤ checkerSteps full.length q + 2,
      DynamicRunCorrect (heapWords full.length q) (rawIncidenceROM q full) program steps
        (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (indexWidth 16 full.length q) 0) ∧
      totalCost (heapWords full.length q) (rawIncidenceROM q full) program steps
        (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (indexWidth 16 full.length q) 0) ≤ 262144 * treeWork full.length q ∧
      ((packingRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program steps
        (packingInitial (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (indexWidth 16 full.length q) 0))).register .value).toNat = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨clock, hclock, entry⟩ := RawTreePreprocessingStartWord.gate_entry q full
  let before := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock natInitial

theorem ordered_entry (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hl : LaminarSchedule full) :
    ∃ clock ≤ clockBound q full,
      PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full)
        (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial clock ∧
      Ready q full (natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock natInitial) ∧
      packingRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock
        (packingInitial (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (indexWidth 16 full.length q) 0)) =
          (natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock natInitial).toWord (indexWidth 16 full.length q) := by
  obtain ⟨first, hfirst, hsafePrefix, entry, _word⟩ := RawTreePreprocessingRetentionWord.retained_entry q full hl
  let before := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program first natInitial
  let steps := RawCandidateOrderingRAM.totalSteps (candidateCount full.length q)
  let after := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program steps before
  have hord : RawCandidateOrderingWord.OrdFits q full before := by
    intro position hp
    rw [entry.high_zero _ (by unfold RawCandidateOrderingRAM.arraySlot; omega)]
    exact RawCandidateWorkspaceWordMacros.small_constant_fits _ _ _ (by decide)
  have hend : Fits (indexWidth 16 full.length q) (5 * (542 + 303)) :=
    RawTreePreprocessingCodeBounds.constant_fits _ _ _ (by decide)
  have hs := RawCandidateOrderingWord.sort_nat_safe q full program 542 ordering_slice.1 ordering_slice.2
    before entry.fit entry.ptr entry.header entry.tables hord entry.pc entry.active hend
  have sem : RawCandidateOrderingRAM.Sorted q full (workspaceBase full.length q) 542 before after :=
    RawCandidateOrderingRAM.sort (rawIncidenceROM q full) program 542 ordering_slice.1 ordering_slice.2
    q full (workspaceBase full.length q) before (workspaceBase_ge full.length q)
    entry.ptr entry.header entry.tables entry.pc entry.active
  have hM : candidateCount full.length q = full.length + q + 1 := rfl
  have hout : Ready q full after := by
    refine ⟨hs.2, ⟨before, sem⟩, ?_, ?_, sem.returned.pc, sem.returned.active⟩
    · intro index hi
      change after.heap (RawCandidateOrderingRAM.arraySlot (workspaceBase full.length q) (full.length + q + 1) 3 index) ≤ full.length + q + 1
      rw [sem.output.inverse index hi]
      have hless := RawCandidateRankScan.lessCount_lt_candidateCount q full index hi
      split <;> omega
    · intro address hadr
      rw [sem.frame address ⟨by have hb := workspaceBase_ge full.length q; omega,
        by omega, by omega, by omega,
        fun index hi => by unfold RawCandidateOrderingRAM.arraySlot; omega,
        fun index hi => by unfold RawCandidateOrderingRAM.arraySlot; omega,
        by unfold RawCandidateOrderingRAM.arraySlot; omega⟩]
      exact entry.high_zero address (by omega)
  have lifted : PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full)
      (rawIncidenceROM q full) program before steps :=
    fun count hc => ordering_point q full _ (hs.1 count hc)
  have allSafe : PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full)
      (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial (first + steps) :=
    PrefixSafe.add _ _ _ _ first steps hsafePrefix lifted
  refine ⟨first + steps, by unfold clockBound; dsimp only [steps]; omega, allSafe, ?_,
    RawTreePreprocessingStartWord.prefix_word_eq q full (first + steps) allSafe⟩
  rw [natRun_add]
  exact hout

theorem parent_entry (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q) (hl : LaminarSchedule full) :
    ∃ clock ≤ clockBound q full,
      PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full)
        (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial clock ∧
      Ready q full (natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock natInitial) ∧
      packingRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock
        (packingInitial (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (indexWidth 16 full.length q) 0)) =
          (natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program clock natInitial).toWord (indexWidth 16 full.length q) := by
  obtain ⟨first, hfirst, hsafePrefix, entry, _word⟩ := RawTreePreprocessingOrderingWord.ordered_entry q full hl
  let state := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program first natInitial
  obtain ⟨before, sorted⟩ := entry.sorted
  let B := workspaceBase full.length q
  let M := candidateCount full.length q
  let nodes := (RawCandidateOrder.retainedCandidateIndices q full).length
  let order := RawCandidateParentRAM.observedOrder q full B state
  let inverse := RawCandidateParentRAM.observedInverse q full B state
  let steps := RawCandidateParentRAM.totalSteps full.length q nodes order
  let after := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program steps state
  have hb : 16 ≤ B := workspaceBase_ge _ _
  have tables := RawCandidateParentRAM.InputTables.of_sorted q full B 542 before state sorted hq
  have hend : Fits (indexWidth 16 full.length q) (5 * (845 + 361)) :=
    RawTreePreprocessingCodeBounds.constant_fits _ _ _ (by decide)
  have hs := RawCandidateParentWord.parents_of_sorted_nat_safe q full program 845 parent_slice.1 parent_slice.2
    542 before state sorted hq entry.pc entry.active entry.fit hend
  have sem := RawCandidateParentRAM.parents q full program 845 parent_slice.1 parent_slice.2
    B nodes order inverse state hb tables entry.pc entry.active
  have hp := RawCandidateParentRAM.parents_prepared q full hq program 845 parent_slice.1 parent_slice.2
    B 542 before state hb sorted entry.pc entry.active
  have hout : Ready q full after := by
    refine ⟨hs.2, ⟨?_, hp, sem.2.2.2.2.1, sem.2.2.2.2.2⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact RawCandidateTreePrefix.inputSpec_of_parent_tables q full hq before state after sorted sem.1
    · intro address hadr
      have frame : ∀ address, RawCandidateParentRAM.ProtectedAddress B M nodes address →
          after.heap address = state.heap address := sem.2.2.2.1
      rw [frame address ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩]
      · exact entry.high_zero address (by omega)
      · right
        have hnodes : nodes ≤ M := tables.nodes_le
        change B + 5 + 5 * M ≤ address at hadr
        unfold RawCandidateParentRAM.parentSlot RawCandidateOrderingRAM.arraySlot
        omega
  have lifted : PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full)
      (rawIncidenceROM q full) program state steps := fun count hc => parent_point q full _ (hs.1 count hc)
  have allSafe : PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full)
      (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial (first + steps) :=
    PrefixSafe.add _ _ _ _ first steps hsafePrefix lifted
  have hcost := RawCandidateParentRAM.totalSteps_le full.length q nodes order
  have hcost' : steps ≤ 512 * (M + 1) * (M + 1) * (q + 1) := hcost.trans (by
    change 512 * (nodes + 1) * (M + 1) * (q + 1) ≤ _
    gcongr
    exact tables.nodes_le)
  refine ⟨first + steps, by unfold clockBound; dsimp only [M] at hcost'; omega, allSafe, ?_,
    RawTreePreprocessingStartWord.prefix_word_eq q full (first + steps) allSafe⟩
  rw [natRun_add]
  exact hout

theorem all_prefix_safe (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q) (count : Nat) :
    PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full) (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial count := by
  by_cases hl : LaminarSchedule full
  · obtain ⟨first, _bound, hparentSafe, entry, _word⟩ := RawTreePreprocessingParentWord.parent_entry q full hq hl
    let before := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program first natInitial
    have hpc : before.pc = 5 * 1206 := by
      simpa only [RawCandidateTreePrefix.inputStart_eq] using entry.entry.pc
    have hend : Fits (indexWidth 16 full.length q) (5 * (1206 + 443)) :=
      RawTreePreprocessingCodeBounds.constant_fits _ _ _ (by decide)
    obtain ⟨steps, _stepsBound, hsafe, hfit, ready, _written, frame⟩ :=
      RawCandidateSerializedInputWord.materialize_serialized_prefix_nat_safe q full program 1206
        input_slice.1 input_slice.2 before entry.entry.input hpc entry.entry.active entry.fit hend hq hl
    let after := natRun (rawIncidenceROM q full) program steps before
    have next : RawCandidateSerializedChildrenRAM.InputSpec q full after :=
      children_input_of_input_phase q full before after entry.entry ready frame
    have lifted : PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full)
        (rawIncidenceROM q full) program before steps := fun k hk => input_point q full _ (hsafe k hk)
    have allSafe : PrefixSafe (RawTreePreprocessingWordInterface.SafePoint q full)
        (rawIncidenceROM q full) program natInitial (first + steps) :=
      PrefixSafe.add _ _ _ _ first steps hparentSafe lifted
    apply finish_children_all_prefix_safe q full hq hl (first + steps) allSafe
    · rw [natRun_add]
      exact next
    · rw [natRun_add]
      exact ready.pc
    · rw [natRun_add]
      exact ready.active
    · rw [natRun_add]
      exact hfit
  · exact RawTreePreprocessingFooterWord.rejects_all_prefix_safe q full hl count

    ((Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_union_le _ _) 1).trans

theorem prepared_indexed_parent_iff (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full)
    (child parent : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.NodeId) :
    (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.parents.get child = some parent ↔
      IsParent (nodeFamily full) ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode child)
        ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode parent) := by
  let : Nonempty (Fin q) := ⟨⟨0, hq⟩⟩
  have hnodup : (prepareNormalization q full).order.toArray.toList.Nodup := by
    simpa only [List.toList_toArray] using prepared_order_nodup q full
  have hcache : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.parents.get child = some parent ↔
      (prepareNormalization q full).parentSupport ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode child) =
        some ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode parent) :=
    indexNodes_parent_iff _ hnodup _ child parent
  rw [hcache]
  rw [prepared_parentSupport q full _ (prepared_indexed_node_mem q full child),
    explicitParent_agrees q full hq hlaminar (prepared_indexed_node_mem q full child)]
  exact parent?_eq_some_iff (nodeFamily_laminar full hlaminar)
    (nodeFamily_nonempty_nodes full _ (prepared_indexed_node_mem q full child))

theorem prepared_indexed_children_decode (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full)
    (parent : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.NodeId) :
    (((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.children.get parent).toList.toFinset.image
      (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode) =
        children (nodeFamily full) ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode parent) := by
  let : Nonempty (Fin q) := ⟨⟨0, hq⟩⟩
  ext node
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨child, hchild, rfl⟩
    apply (mem_children_iff (nodeFamily_laminar full hlaminar) (nodeFamily_nonempty_nodes full) _ _).mpr
    refine ⟨prepared_indexed_node_mem q full child, ?_⟩
    apply (prepared_indexed_parent_iff q full hq hlaminar child parent).mp
    exact (indexNodes_child_mem _ _ child parent).mp
      (Array.mem_toList_iff.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp hchild))
  · intro hchild
    obtain ⟨hactive, hparent⟩ := (mem_children_iff (nodeFamily_laminar full hlaminar)
      (nodeFamily_nonempty_nodes full) _ _).mp hchild
    obtain ⟨child, hdecode⟩ := prepared_indexed_node_exists q full node hactive
    refine ⟨child, List.mem_toFinset.mpr (Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr ?_), hdecode⟩
    apply (indexNodes_child_mem _ _ child parent).mpr
    apply (prepared_indexed_parent_iff q full hq hlaminar child parent).mpr
    simpa only [hdecode] using hparent

      (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode child = Finset.univ := by

theorem prepared_indexed_edge_count (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) :
    (∑ parent : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.NodeId,
      ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.children.get parent).size) =
        (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size - 1 := by
  obtain ⟨root, hroot⟩ := prepared_indexed_node_exists q full Finset.univ (root_mem full)
  have hnone (child : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.NodeId) :
      (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.parents.get child = none ↔ child = root := by
    rw [prepared_indexed_parent_none_iff q full hq hlaminar child]
    exact ⟨fun heq => prepared_indexed_decode_injective q full (heq.trans hroot.symm),
      fun heq => heq ▸ hroot⟩
  have hnoneSet :
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.NodeId).filter
        (fun child => (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.parents.get child = none)) = {root} := by
    ext child
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton, hnone child]
  have hcount := indexed_child_size_sum_add_noneCount (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
    (fun parent => indexNodes_children_nodup _ _ parent)
    (fun child parent => indexNodes_child_mem _ _ child parent)
  rw [hnoneSet, Finset.card_singleton] at hcount
  omega

theorem capacityFamily_zero (layout : CapacityLayout Tool Node)
    (hsingletons : layout.HasSingletonNodes) :
    capacityFamily layout (fun _ => 0) = {∅} := by
  apply Set.ext
  intro used
  change (∀ node ∈ layout.nodes, (used ∩ layout.support node).card ≤ 0) ↔ used = ∅
  constructor
  · intro hused
    apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
    intro tool htool
    obtain ⟨node, hnode, hsupport⟩ := hsingletons tool
    have hin : tool ∈ used ∩ layout.support node := by
      exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨htool, by simp [hsupport]⟩
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hused node hnode)) (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨tool, hin⟩)
  · intro hused
    subst used
    intro node _
    simp

theorem capacityFamily_normalizeAt (layout : CapacityLayout Tool Node)
    (parent : Node) (children : Finset Node) (capacity : Node → ℕ)
    (hactive : children ⊆ layout.nodes)
    (hcover : children.biUnion layout.support = layout.support parent) :
    capacityFamily layout (normalizeAt parent children capacity) =
      capacityFamily layout capacity := by
  apply Set.ext
  intro used
  constructor
  · intro hused node hnode
    exact (hused node hnode).trans (normalizeAt_le parent children capacity node)
  · intro hused node hnode
    by_cases heq : node = parent
    · subst node
      rw [normalizeAt_self]
      exact le_min (hused parent hnode)
        (used_count_le_sum_children_capacity layout parent children capacity
          hactive hcover hused)
    · rw [normalizeAt_of_ne parent children capacity heq]
      exact hused node hnode

end NormalizeAt

theorem used_count_eq_sum_children (layout : CapacityLayout Tool Node)
    (parent : Node) (children : Finset Node)
    (hdisjoint : (children : Set Node).PairwiseDisjoint layout.support)
    (hcover : children.biUnion layout.support = layout.support parent)

    (used ∩ layout.support parent).card =
      ∑ child ∈ children, (used ∩ layout.support child).card := by
  rw [← hcover, Finset.inter_biUnion]
  apply Finset.card_biUnion
  intro left hleft right hright hne
  exact (hdisjoint hleft hright hne).mono
    Finset.inter_subset_right Finset.inter_subset_right

theorem prepared_normalization_correct_run (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full)
    (capacity : IndexedCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
    (hbounded : ∀ node, capacity.get node ≤ ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode node).card)
    (initial : State) (hpc : initial.pc = 0) :
    ∃ final operations,
      HaltingRuns ((treeROM (prepareNormalization q full).indexed).withInput capacity)
        (normalizationProgram (prepareNormalization q full).indexed) initial final operations ∧
      HeapAgrees final.heap ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.normalize capacity) ∧
      (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.capacityFamily
        (IndexedClosureRAM.readCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap) =
        (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.capacityFamily capacity ∧
      IndexedNormalized (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
        (IndexedClosureRAM.readCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap) ∧
      (∀ node, (IndexedClosureRAM.readCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap).get node ≤ q) ∧
      operations.length ≤ 176 * (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size := by
  have hsingle : ∀ node, ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode node).card = 1 → capacity.get node ≤ 1 := by
    intro node hn
    simpa only [hn] using hbounded node
  obtain ⟨final, operations, hrun, hagrees, hcost⟩ :=
    prepared_haltingNormalization_run q full hq hlaminar capacity initial hpc
  refine ⟨final, operations, hrun, hagrees, ?_⟩
  rw [IndexedClosureRAM.readCapacity_eq _ _ _ hagrees]
  exact ⟨prepared_indexed_normalizeAlong_preserves q full hq hlaminar _ capacity,
    prepared_indexed_normalize_normalized q full hq hlaminar capacity hsingle,
    prepared_indexed_normalize_capacity_le_q q full hq hlaminar capacity hsingle, hcost⟩

theorem prepared_childSet_eq (q : Nat) (stages : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule stages) (parent : Finset (Fin q)) :
    (prepareNormalization q stages).childSet parent = children (nodeFamily stages) parent := by
  ext child
  rw [mem_data_childSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨entry, hentry, hchild, hparent⟩
    change entry ∈ (explicitNodeList q stages).map
      (fun node => (node, parentFromList (explicitNodeList q stages) node)) at hentry
    obtain ⟨node, hnode, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hentry
    dsimp only at hchild hparent
    subst child
    have hactive : node ∈ nodeFamily stages := by
      have hin := List.mem_toFinset.mpr hnode
      rw [explicitNodeList_toFinset] at hin
      exact hin
    have hagree : parentFromList (explicitNodeList q stages) node =
        parent? (nodeFamily stages) node := explicitParent_agrees q stages hq hlaminar hactive
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hactive, hagree.symm.trans hparent⟩
  · intro hchild
    obtain ⟨hactive, hcanonical⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hchild
    have hlist : child ∈ explicitNodeList q stages := by
      apply List.mem_toFinset.mp
      rw [explicitNodeList_toFinset]
      exact hactive
    refine ⟨(child, parentFromList (explicitNodeList q stages) child), ?_, rfl, ?_⟩
    · change (child, parentFromList (explicitNodeList q stages) child) ∈
        (explicitNodeList q stages).map
          (fun node => (node, parentFromList (explicitNodeList q stages) node))
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨child, hlist, rfl⟩
    · exact (explicitParent_agrees q stages hq hlaminar hactive).trans hcanonical

    (capacity : IndexedCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed) :

      Structure.capacityFamily (layout full) ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.unindexCapacity capacity) := by

  · intro hused node hnode

    exact hbound
  · intro hused index _
    have hbound := hused _ (prepared_indexed_node_mem q full index)
    rw [unindexCapacity_at _ (prepared_indexed_nodes_nodup q full)] at hbound
    exact hbound

theorem prepared_selectStage_exists (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q)

    (hnormalized : Normalized full capacity) (used : Finset (Fin q))
    (hused : used ∈ capacityFamily (layout full) capacity) (stage : Fin full.length)
    (hnonempty : full[stage.val] ≠ ∅) (hancestors : AncestorSlack full capacity used full[stage.val]) :
    ∃ tool, selectStage (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
      (IndexedStaticMetadata.buildPositive q full hq).stageNodes
      (leafTools (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
      (usedCounts (prepareNormalization q full).indexed used)
      (IndexedEntry.reifyCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed capacity) stage = some tool ∧
      tool ∈ full[stage.val] ∧ tool ∉ used ∧ insert tool used ∈ capacityFamily (layout full) capacity := by
  obtain ⟨node, hnode, hdecode⟩ := IndexedStaticMetadata.buildPositive_stage_nonempty q full hq stage hnonempty
  have ha : AncestorSlack full capacity used ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode node) := by
    rw [hdecode]
    exact hancestors
  obtain ⟨tool, hresult, htool, hunused, hinsert⟩ :=
    prepared_selectAt_exists q full hq hlaminar capacity hnormalized used hused node ha
  refine ⟨tool, ?_, ?_, hunused, hinsert⟩
  · simp only [selectStage, hnode, Option.bind_some]
    exact hresult
  · rw [← hdecode]
    exact htool

theorem prepared_descentWork_le_twice_nodes (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full)
    (leaves : Vector (Option (Fin q)) (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size)
    (counts capacity : IndexedCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
    (node : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.NodeId) :
    descentWork (prepareNormalization q full).indexed leaves counts capacity
      (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size node ≤
        2 * (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size := by
  let cache := (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
  let trace := descentTrace cache leaves counts capacity cache.nodes.size node
  have hnd : trace.Nodup := descentTrace_nodup cache
    (fun parent child hc => prepared_child_index_lt q full hq hlaminar parent child hc) leaves counts capacity _ node
  have hsum : (trace.map (fun parent => (cache.children.get parent).size)).sum ≤
      ∑ parent : cache.NodeId, (cache.children.get parent).size := by
    rw [← List.sum_toFinset _ hnd]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by intros; exact Nat.zero_le _)
  have hedge := prepared_indexed_edge_count q full hq hlaminar
  have hlength := descentTrace_length_le cache leaves counts capacity cache.nodes.size node
  have hwork := descentWork_le_trace cache leaves counts capacity cache.nodes.size node
  change (trace.map (fun parent => (cache.children.get parent).size)).sum ≤ _ at hsum
  change (∑ parent : cache.NodeId, (cache.children.get parent).size) = cache.nodes.size - 1 at hedge
  change trace.length ≤ cache.nodes.size at hlength
  change descentWork cache leaves counts capacity cache.nodes.size node ≤
    trace.length + (trace.map (fun parent => (cache.children.get parent).size)).sum at hwork
  change descentWork cache leaves counts capacity cache.nodes.size node ≤ 2 * cache.nodes.size
  omega

end PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.IndexedDescent

    (leaves : Vector (Option (Fin q)) cache.nodes.size) (counts capacity : IndexedCapacity cache) :

  | 0, _ => none
  | fuel + 1, node => match leaves.get node with
      | some tool => some tool
      | none => match firstSlackChild cache counts capacity node with
          | none => none
          | some child => descend cache leaves counts capacity fuel child

PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.Indexe.full_declaration_source:
theorem descentTrace_nodup {q : Nat} (cache : IndexedNodeCache (Fin q))
    (hdown : ∀ parent child, child ∈ (cache.children.get parent).toList → child.val < parent.val)
    (leaves : Vector (Option (Fin q)) cache.nodes.size) (counts capacity : IndexedCapacity cache)
    (fuel : Nat) (node : cache.NodeId) : (descentTrace cache leaves counts capacity fuel node).Nodup := by
  induction fuel generalizing node with
  | zero => exact List.nodup_nil
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases hl : leaves.get node with
    | some tool => simp only [descentTrace, hl, List.nodup_singleton]
    | none =>
      cases hc : firstSlackChild cache counts capacity node with
      | none => simp only [descentTrace, hl, hc, List.nodup_singleton]
      | some child =>
        simp only [descentTrace, hl, hc, List.nodup_cons]
        refine ⟨?_, ih child⟩
        intro hmem
        have hle := descentTrace_index_le cache hdown leaves counts capacity fuel child node hmem
        exact (not_le_of_gt (hdown node child (firstSlackChild_spec cache counts capacity node child hc).1)) hle

/-- The real tree's t-1 edges amortize child-array scans across the entire
descent. Thus node visits PLUS child entries examined are at most 2t.
The cost of constructing counts and metadata is not included in this query. -/

def RawClosureClaims : Prop :=
  ∃ constant : Nat, 0 < constant ∧
    ∀ (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q), LaminarSchedule full →
      let cache := (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
      (∃ program : List IndexedClosureRAM.Op,
        (IndexedClosureRAM.haltingWords program).length ≤ constant * cache.nodes.size ∧
        ∀ (eligible : Finset (Fin q)), (eligible = ∅ ∨ eligible ∈ nodeFamily full) →
          ∀ entry : IndexedEntry.FixedEntry cache, IndexedEntry.IsNormalized cache entry →
            ∀ initial : State, initial.pc = 0 →
              ∃ final operations,
                IndexedClosureRAM.HaltingRuns (rawExtensionROM q full hq entry eligible)
                  program initial final operations ∧
                IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult cache final.heap = IndexedEntry.extend cache eligible entry ∧
                (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult cache final.heap).denote cache =
                  usedExtension eligible (entry.denote cache) ∧
                IndexedEntry.IsNormalized cache (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult cache final.heap) ∧
                (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult cache final.heap).Bounded q ∧
                operations.length ≤ constant * cache.nodes.size) ∧
      (∀ left right : IndexedEntry.FixedEntry cache, IndexedEntry.IsNormalized cache left →
        IndexedEntry.IsNormalized cache right → ∀ initial : State, initial.pc = 0 →
          ∃ final operations,
            HaltingRuns (intersectionROM cache left right) (intersectionProgram cache) initial final operations ∧
            IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult cache final.heap = IndexedEntry.intersect cache left right ∧
            (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult cache final.heap).denote cache = left.denote cache ∩ right.denote cache ∧
            IndexedEntry.IsNormalized cache (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult cache final.heap) ∧
            (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult cache final.heap).Bounded q ∧
            operations.length ≤ constant * cache.nodes.size)

end PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.IndexedIntersectionRAM

theorem prepared_rawExtension_correct_run (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (eligible : Finset (Fin q))
    (heligible : eligible = ∅ ∨ eligible ∈ nodeFamily full)
    (entry : IndexedEntry.FixedEntry (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
    (hnormalized : IndexedEntry.IsNormalized (prepareNormalization q full).indexed entry)
    (initial : State) (hpc : initial.pc = 0) :
    let cache := (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
    ∃ final operations,
      HaltingRuns (rawROM q full hq entry eligible) (rawExtensionProgram cache.nodes.size q) initial final operations ∧
      decodeResult cache final.heap = IndexedEntry.extend cache eligible entry ∧
      (decodeResult cache final.heap).denote cache = usedExtension eligible (entry.denote cache) ∧
      IndexedEntry.IsNormalized cache (decodeResult cache final.heap) ∧
      (decodeResult cache final.heap).Bounded q ∧ operations.length ≤ 414 * cache.nodes.size := by
  dsimp only
  have hout := prepared_rawExtensionResult_eq q full hq hlaminar entry eligible heligible initial
  change decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
    (execute (rawROM q full hq entry eligible)
      (rawExtensionProgram (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size q) initial).heap = _ at hout
  refine ⟨_, _, execute_halts _ _ initial hpc, hout, ?_⟩
  rw [hout]
  have hn := IndexedEntry.prepared_extend_normalized q full hq hlaminar eligible heligible entry hnormalized
  refine ⟨IndexedEntry.prepared_extend_denote q full hq hlaminar eligible heligible entry hnormalized,
    hn, IndexedEntry.prepared_normalized_bounded q full hq hlaminar _ hn, ?_⟩
  rw [List.length_append, haltTrace_length, rawExtensionProgram_trace_length]
  have hqnodes := prepared_q_le_nodes q full hq
  omega

theorem rawExtensionProgram_trace_length (size q : Nat) :
    (trace (rawExtensionProgram size q)).length = 246 * size + 61 * q + 101 := by
  have hf : (trace flagReset).length = 8 := rfl
  have ht : (trace (extensionTail size)).length = 19 := rfl

    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule stages) (eligible : Finset Tool)

        simp only [extendEntry, extensionEntry, hempty, hzero, ↓reduceIte, EntryNormalized]

theorem decrementAlong_normalized (stages : List (Finset Tool))
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule stages) (capacity : Finset Tool → Nat)
    (hnormalized : Normalized stages capacity) {eligible : Finset Tool}
    (heligible : eligible ∈ nodeFamily stages)
    (hzero : ¬ HasZeroAncestor stages capacity eligible) :
    Normalized stages (decrementAlong eligible capacity) := by
  refine ⟨fun tool => (decrementAlong_le eligible capacity {tool}).trans (hnormalized.1 tool), ?_⟩
  intro node hnode hinternal
  have hold := hnormalized.2 node hnode hinternal
  by_cases hancestor : eligible ⊆ node
  · by_cases heq : node = eligible
    · subst node
      have hchildren : ∀ child ∈ children (nodeFamily stages) eligible,
          decrementAlong eligible capacity child = capacity child := by
        intro child hchild
        have hstrict := ((mem_children_iff (nodeFamily_laminar stages hlaminar)
          (nodeFamily_nonempty_nodes stages) child eligible).mp hchild).2.2.1
        have hnot : ¬ eligible ⊆ child := by
          intro hsub
          exact (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hstrict).2
            (Finset.Subset.antisymm hstrict.subset hsub)
        simp [decrementAlong, hnot]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hchildren]
      exact (decrementAlong_le eligible capacity eligible).trans hold
    · have hstrict : eligible ⊂ node :=
        Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hancestor, Ne.symm heq⟩
      have hsum := decremented_children_sum_add_one stages hlaminar capacity
        heligible hnode hstrict hzero
      rw [decrementAlong_of_subset eligible capacity node hancestor]
      omega
  · have hchildren : ∀ child ∈ children (nodeFamily stages) node,
        decrementAlong eligible capacity child = capacity child := by
      intro child hchild
      have hstrict := ((mem_children_iff (nodeFamily_laminar stages hlaminar)
        (nodeFamily_nonempty_nodes stages) child node).mp hchild).2.2.1
      have hnot : ¬ eligible ⊆ child := fun h => hancestor (h.trans hstrict.subset)
      simp [decrementAlong, hnot]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hchildren]
    simp only [decrementAlong, hancestor, ↓reduceIte]
    exact hold

end NonemptyTree

theorem prepared_parent_index_lt (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full)
    (child parent : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.NodeId)
    (hparent : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.parents.get child = some parent) :
    child.val < parent.val := by
  have hstrict := ((prepared_indexed_parent_iff q full hq hlaminar child parent).mp hparent).2.1
  have hcard := Finset.card_lt_card hstrict
  by_contra hnot
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot) with hlt | heq
  · have hsorted := (prepared_order_sorted q full).rel_get_of_lt
      (a := ⟨parent.val, parent.isLt⟩) (b := ⟨child.val, child.isLt⟩) hlt
    have hreverse : ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode parent).card ≤
        ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode child).card := by
      change ((prepareNormalization q full).order.toArray[parent.val]).card ≤
        ((prepareNormalization q full).order.toArray[child.val]).card
      simpa only [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_toArray] using hsorted
    exact (not_le_of_gt hcard) hreverse
  · have heqNode : parent = child := Fin.ext heq
    subst parent
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _) hcard

    (left right : IndexedEntry.FixedEntry cache) (initial : State) :
    intersectionResult cache left right initial = IndexedEntry.intersect cache left right := by

  have hagrees := execute_intersectionProgram_agrees cache left right initial

  cases left with
  | void => simp only [tag, Nat.zero_min, ↓reduceIte, IndexedEntry.intersect, IndexedEntry.coordinateMin, IndexedEntry.normalize]

    cases right with
    | void => simp only [tag, Nat.min_zero, ↓reduceIte, IndexedEntry.intersect, IndexedEntry.coordinateMin, IndexedEntry.normalize]

      simp only [tag, Nat.min_self, Nat.one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]

      rfl

theorem prepared_intersection_correct_run (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full)
    (left right : IndexedEntry.FixedEntry (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
    (hleft : IndexedEntry.IsNormalized (prepareNormalization q full).indexed left)
    (initial : State) (hpc : initial.pc = 0) :
    ∃ final operations,
      HaltingRuns (intersectionROM (prepareNormalization q full).indexed left right)
        (intersectionProgram (prepareNormalization q full).indexed) initial final operations ∧
      IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap =
        IndexedEntry.intersect (prepareNormalization q full).indexed left right ∧
      (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap).denote
        (prepareNormalization q full).indexed =
        left.denote (prepareNormalization q full).indexed ∩ right.denote (prepareNormalization q full).indexed ∧
      IndexedEntry.IsNormalized (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
        (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap) ∧
      (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap).Bounded q ∧
      operations.length ≤ 274 * (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size := by
  obtain ⟨final, operations, hrun, hout, hcost⟩ :=
    prepared_intersection_halting_run q full hq hlaminar left right initial hpc
  refine ⟨final, operations, hrun, hout, ?_⟩
  rw [hout]
  have hn := IndexedEntry.prepared_intersect_normalized q full hq hlaminar left right hleft
  exact ⟨IndexedEntry.prepared_intersect_denote q full hq hlaminar left right,
    hn, IndexedEntry.prepared_normalized_bounded q full hq hlaminar _ hn, hcost⟩

theorem prepared_tree_node_extension_correct_run (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full)
    (node : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.NodeId)
    (entry : IndexedEntry.FixedEntry (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
    (hnormalized : IndexedEntry.IsNormalized (prepareNormalization q full).indexed entry)
    (initial : State) (hpc : initial.pc = 0) :
    ∃ final operations,
      IndexedClosureRAM.HaltingRuns
        (IndexedClosureRAM.extensionROM (prepareNormalization q full).indexed entry (some node))
        (IndexedClosureRAM.extensionProgram (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size 0) initial final operations ∧
      IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap =
        IndexedEntry.extend (prepareNormalization q full).indexed ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode node) entry ∧
      (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap).denote
        (prepareNormalization q full).indexed =
        usedExtension ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode node) (entry.denote (prepareNormalization q full).indexed) ∧
      IndexedEntry.IsNormalized (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
        (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap) ∧
      (IndexedClosureRAM.decodeResult (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap).Bounded q ∧
      operations.length ≤ 239 * (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size := by
  let : Nonempty (Fin q) := ⟨⟨0, hq⟩⟩
  have hmem := prepared_indexed_node_mem q full node
  have hne := (nodeFamily_nonempty_nodes full _ hmem).ne_empty
  have hfind : findNodeId (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes
      ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode node) = some node :=
    (findNodeId_eq_some_iff _ (prepared_indexed_nodes_nodup q full) _ node).mpr rfl
  have h := prepared_eligible_extension_correct_run q full hq hlaminar
    ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.decode node) (Or.inr hmem) entry hnormalized initial hpc
  simpa only [hne, ↓reduceIte, hfind] using h

theorem buildCapacityTable_rows_correct (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (maxBudget : Nat) :
    List.Forall₂ (fun suffix layer => LayerCorrect full suffix layer) full.tails
      (buildCapacityTable q full maxBudget).rows.toList := by
  cases q with
  | zero =>
    change List.Forall₂ _ full.tails (full.tails.map (zeroToolLayer maxBudget)).toArray.toList
    rw [List.toList_toArray]
    generalize full.tails = suffixes
    induction suffixes with
    | nil => exact List.Forall₂.nil
    | cons suffix suffixes ih =>
      exact List.Forall₂.cons (zeroToolLayer_correct full hlaminar maxBudget suffix) ih
  | succ q =>
    change List.Forall₂ _ full.tails
      (capacityRowsList (prepareNormalization (q + 1) full) full maxBudget full).toArray.toList
    rw [List.toList_toArray]
    exact (capacityRows_correct (q + 1) full (Nat.zero_lt_succ q) hlaminar maxBudget full
      (fun _ hmem => hmem)).2

theorem buildCapacityTable_entry_correct (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (maxBudget : Nat)
    (next : Fin (full.length + 1)) (budget : Fin (maxBudget + 1)) :
    let table := buildCapacityTable q full maxBudget
    let row : Fin table.rows.size :=
      ⟨next.val, (buildCapacityTable_size q full maxBudget).symm ▸ next.isLt⟩
    EntryNormalized full (table.entry row budget) ∧
      (table.entry row budget).denote (layout full) =
        safeUsedFamily (full.drop next.val) budget.val := by
  have hrows := buildCapacityTable_rows_correct q full hlaminar maxBudget
  have hleft : next.val < full.tails.length := by simpa only [List.length_tails] using next.isLt
  have hright : next.val < (buildCapacityTable q full maxBudget).rows.toList.length := by
    simpa only [Array.length_toList, buildCapacityTable_size] using next.isLt
  have hrow := hrows.get hleft hright
  rw [List.get_tails] at hrow
  exact hrow budget

theorem prepared_extend_denote (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (eligible : Finset (Fin q))
    (heligible : eligible = ∅ ∨ eligible ∈ nodeFamily full)
    (entry : FixedEntry (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
    (hnormalized : IsNormalized (prepareNormalization q full).indexed entry) :
    (extend (prepareNormalization q full).indexed eligible entry).denote (prepareNormalization q full).indexed =
      usedExtension eligible (entry.denote (prepareNormalization q full).indexed) := by
  cases entry with
  | void => simp [extend, CapacityBits.Entry.denote, CapacityBits.Entry.toCapacityEntry, CapacityEntry.denote, extension_void]
  | vector capacity =>
    have hnormOld := prepared_indexed_normalized_to_original q full hq hlaminar capacity hnormalized
    by_cases hempty : eligible = ∅
    · subst eligible
      simp [extend, CapacityBits.Entry.denote, CapacityBits.Entry.toCapacityEntry, CapacityEntry.denote, extension_empty]
    · by_cases hzero : zeroAncestor (prepareNormalization q full).indexed capacity eligible = true
      · have hzeroOld := (prepared_zeroAncestor_iff q full capacity eligible).mp hzero
        simp only [extend, hempty, hzero, ↓reduceIte, CapacityBits.Entry.denote,
          CapacityBits.Entry.toCapacityEntry, CapacityEntry.denote]
        change ∅ = usedExtension eligible ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.capacityFamily capacity)
        rw [prepared_indexed_family_eq]
        exact (usedExtension_eq_empty_of_zeroAncestor full _ eligible hzeroOld).symm
      · have hnoOld : ¬ HasZeroAncestor full ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.unindexCapacity capacity) eligible :=
          fun h => hzero ((prepared_zeroAncestor_iff q full capacity eligible).mpr h)
        simp only [extend, hempty, hzero, ↓reduceIte]
        change (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.capacityFamily
          (ancestorDecrement (prepareNormalization q full).indexed capacity eligible) =
          usedExtension eligible ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.capacityFamily capacity)
        rw [prepared_indexed_family_eq, prepared_indexed_family_eq]
        exact (family_of_active_eq full _ _ (prepared_ancestorDecrement_active q full capacity eligible)).trans
          (decremented_family_eq_extension full hlaminar _ hnormOld eligible (heligible.resolve_left hempty)
            (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty) hnoOld)

  have hbadIndexed := prepared_reify_normalized q full hq hlaminar bad hbad

    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (eligible : Finset (Fin q))

    (capacity : IndexedCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
    (hraw : coordinateMin (prepareNormalization q full).indexed good
      (extend (prepareNormalization q full).indexed eligible bad) = .vector capacity)
    (initial : IndexedRAM.State) (hpc : initial.pc = 0) :
    ∃ final trace,
      IndexedRAM.HaltingRuns
        ((IndexedRAM.treeROM (prepareNormalization q full).indexed).withInput capacity)
        (IndexedRAM.normalizationProgram (prepareNormalization q full).indexed) initial final trace ∧
      CapacityBits.Entry.vector (heapCapacity (prepareNormalization q full).indexed final.heap) =
        cell (prepareNormalization q full).indexed eligible good bad ∧
      trace.length ≤ 176 * (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size := by
  obtain ⟨final, trace, hrun, hagrees, hlength⟩ :=

  rw [heapCapacity_eq _ _ _ hagrees]
  change CapacityBits.Entry.vector ((prepareNormalization q full).indexed.normalize capacity) =
    normalize (prepareNormalization q full).indexed

  rw [hraw]

theorem build_rows_correct (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (maxBudget : Nat) :
    List.Forall₂ (fun suffix row => RowCorrect (build q full maxBudget).cache suffix row)
      full.tails (build q full maxBudget).rows.toList := by
  cases q with
  | zero =>
    change List.Forall₂ _ full.tails (full.tails.map (zeroRow maxBudget)).toArray.toList
    rw [List.toList_toArray]
    generalize full.tails = suffixes
    induction suffixes with
    | nil => exact List.Forall₂.nil
    | cons suffix suffixes ih => exact List.Forall₂.cons (zeroRow_correct maxBudget suffix) ih
  | succ q =>
    change List.Forall₂ _ full.tails
      (rowsList (prepareNormalization (q + 1) full).indexed maxBudget full).toArray.toList
    rw [List.toList_toArray]
    exact (prepared_rows_correct (q + 1) full (Nat.zero_lt_succ q) hlaminar maxBudget full
      (fun _ hmem => hmem)).2

theorem build_entry_correct (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (maxBudget : Nat)
    (next : Fin (full.length + 1)) (budget : Fin (maxBudget + 1)) :
    let table := build q full maxBudget
    let row : Fin table.rows.size := ⟨next.val, (build_size q full maxBudget).symm ▸ next.isLt⟩
    IsNormalized table.cache (table.entry row budget) ∧ (table.entry row budget).Bounded q ∧
      (table.entry row budget).denote table.cache = safeUsedFamily (full.drop next.val) budget.val := by
  have hrows := build_rows_correct q full hlaminar maxBudget
  have hleft : next.val < full.tails.length := by simpa only [List.length_tails] using next.isLt
  have hright : next.val < (build q full maxBudget).rows.toList.length := by
    simpa only [Array.length_toList, build_size] using next.isLt
  have hrow := hrows.get hleft hright
  rw [List.get_tails] at hrow
  exact hrow budget

theorem prepared_stage_budget_correct_run (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hq : 0 < q) (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (stage : Fin full.length) (budget : Nat)
    (good bad : IndexedEntry.FixedEntry (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
    (hgood : IndexedEntry.IsNormalized (prepareNormalization q full).indexed good)
    (goodBase badBase output : Nat)
    (hgoodBase : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size < goodBase)
    (hbadBase : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size < badBase)
    (hout : (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size < output)
    (initial : State) (hpc : initial.pc = 0)
    (hg : SlotRep (prepareNormalization q full).indexed initial.heap goodBase good)
    (hb : SlotRep (prepareNormalization q full).indexed initial.heap badBase bad) :
    let cache := (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
    let node := (IndexedStaticMetadata.buildPositive q full hq).stageNodes.get stage
    ∃ final operations,
      IndexedClosureRAM.HaltingRuns (cellROM cache node) (budgetProgram cache goodBase badBase output budget) initial final operations ∧
      slot cache final.heap output = IndexedEntry.budgetCell cache full[stage.val] budget good bad ∧
      SlotRep cache final.heap output (IndexedEntry.budgetCell cache full[stage.val] budget good bad) ∧
      IndexedEntry.IsNormalized cache (slot cache final.heap output) ∧
      (slot cache final.heap output).Bounded q ∧
      (∀ address, cache.nodes.size < address → (∀ i ≤ cache.nodes.size, address ≠ output + i) →
        final.heap address = initial.heap address) ∧
      operations.length ≤ 523 * cache.nodes.size := by
  dsimp only
  let cache := (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
  let node := (IndexedStaticMetadata.buildPositive q full hq).stageNodes.get stage
  have heq := budgetResult_eq cache node goodBase badBase output budget hgoodBase hbadBase hout good bad initial hg hb
    (fun node => IndexedAncestors.prepared_ancestorChain_nodup q full hq hlaminar node)
  rw [IndexedStaticMetadata.buildPositive_budgetCellAt_eq_indexed q full hq hlaminar stage budget] at heq
  unfold budgetResult at heq
  refine ⟨_, _, execute_halts _ _ initial hpc, heq,
    slotRep_of_decode cache _ output _
      (budgetProgram_outputTag_le_one cache node goodBase badBase output budget hgoodBase hbadBase hout bad initial hb) heq, ?_⟩
  rw [heq]
  have hn : IndexedEntry.IsNormalized cache (IndexedEntry.budgetCell cache full[stage.val] budget good bad) ∧
      (IndexedEntry.budgetCell cache full[stage.val] budget good bad).Bounded q := by
    by_cases hz : budget = 0
    · rw [IndexedEntry.budgetCell, ite_eq_left hz]
      exact ⟨IndexedTable.prepared_free_normalized q full hq hlaminar, IndexedEntry.free_bounded q cache⟩
    · rw [IndexedEntry.budgetCell, ite_eq_right hz]
      exact IndexedEntry.prepared_cell_normalized_bounded q full hq hlaminar full[stage.val] good bad hgood
  exact ⟨hn.1, hn.2, fun address ha ho => budgetProgram_frame cache node goodBase badBase output budget hbadBase initial address ha ho,
    prepared_budgetProgram_trace_le q full hq hlaminar goodBase badBase output budget⟩

theorem fixedSlots_preserved [DecidableEq Tool] [Fintype Tool] (cache : IndexedNodeCache Tool)
    (node : Option cache.NodeId) (budget : Nat) (initial : State) :

theorem built_extractedRank_eq_errorRank (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (next : Fin (full.length + 1)) (used : Finset (Fin q)) :
    (buildCapacityTable q full (q + 1)).extractedRank q
      (builtTableRow q full (q + 1) next) used =
        errorRank (full.drop next.val) (Finset.univ \ used) := by
  let table := buildCapacityTable q full (q + 1)
  let row := builtTableRow q full (q + 1) next
  let rank := errorRank (full.drop next.val) (Finset.univ \ used)
  have hcheck (budget : Nat) (hbudget : budget < q + 1 + 1) :
      table.acceptsBudget row used budget = true ↔ (budget : ℕ∞) < rank :=
    (built_acceptsBudget_iff q full hlaminar (q + 1) next used budget hbudget).trans
      (safe_iff_lt_errorRank _ _ _)
  by_cases htop : rank = ⊤
  · have hnone : table.firstUnsafeBudget q row used = none := by
      apply List.find?_eq_none.mpr
      intro budget hmem
      obtain ⟨offset, hoffset, rfl⟩ := List.mem_range'.mp hmem
      have hbudget : 1 + 1 * offset < q + 1 + 1 := by omega
      have hsafe := (hcheck _ hbudget).mpr (by rw [htop]; exact ENat.natCast_lt_top _)
      simp only [one_mul] at hsafe
      simp [hsafe]
    change table.extractedRank q row used = rank
    simp only [CapacityTable.extractedRank, hnone]
    exact htop.symm
  · obtain ⟨finiteRank, hfiniteRank⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp htop
    have hpositive : 0 < finiteRank := by
      have hpos := errorRank_pos (full.drop next.val) (Finset.univ \ used)
      change 0 < rank at hpos
      rw [← hfiniteRank] at hpos
      exact ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mp hpos
    have hcard : (Finset.univ \ used : Finset (Fin q)).card ≤ q := by
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Finset.card_le_univ (Finset.univ \ used : Finset (Fin q))
    have hbounded : finiteRank ≤ q + 1 := by
      have hbound := errorRank_finite_le_card_add_one
        (full.drop next.val) (Finset.univ \ used) htop
      change rank ≤ _ at hbound
      rw [← hfiniteRank] at hbound
      have hnat := ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp hbound
      omega
    have hfail : table.acceptsBudget row used finiteRank = false := by
      apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
      intro hsafe
      have hlt := (hcheck finiteRank (by omega)).mp hsafe
      rw [← hfiniteRank] at hlt
      exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt)
    have hsome : table.firstUnsafeBudget q row used = some finiteRank := by
      apply find_range'_first _ 1 (q + 1) finiteRank (by omega) (by omega) (by simp [hfail])
      intro budget _ hless
      have hsafe := (hcheck budget (by omega)).mpr (by
        rw [← hfiniteRank]
        exact ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr hless)
      simp [hsafe]
    change table.extractedRank q row used = rank
    simp only [CapacityTable.extractedRank, hsome]
    exact hfiniteRank

    answer.rank = 1 ∧ answer.bad = 0 ∧ answer.tool = none ∧
      answer.good = errorRank (full.drop (stage.val + 1)) (Finset.univ \ used) := by
  let cache := IndexedTable.emptyCache (Fin 0)
  let next : Fin (full.length + 1) := ⟨stage.val + 1, by omega⟩
  have hg := goodRank_eq_of_rowCorrect cache used (full.drop next.val) (storedZeroRow full next)
    (storedZeroRow_correct full hlaminar next)
  have hb := badRank_none cache (usedCounts cache used) (storedZeroRow full next)
  have ht := maximizingTool_noneNode cache (leafTools cache) (usedCounts cache used) (storedZeroRow full next)
  have hrem : (Finset.univ \ used : Finset (Fin 0)) = ∅ :=
    Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem (fun tool _ => Fin.elim0 tool)
  have hr : min (errorRank (full.drop next.val) (Finset.univ \ used)) (1 + (0 : ℕ∞)) = 1 := by
    rw [hrem]
    have hh := errorRank_cons (∅ : Finset (Fin 0)) (full.drop next.val) ∅
    rw [errorRank_no_tools] at hh
    simpa only [badChildRank, Finset.empty_inter, Finset.sup_empty, bot_eq_zero] using hh.symm
  exact ⟨(congrArg₂ min hg (congrArg (fun r : ℕ∞ => 1 + r) hb)).trans hr, hb, ht, hg⟩

theorem built_pickMaxRankTool_spec (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q)))
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (next : Fin (full.length + 1))
    (eligible used : Finset (Fin q)) (tool : Fin q)
    (hpick : pickMaxRankTool q (buildCapacityTable q full (q + 1))
      (builtTableRow q full (q + 1) next) eligible used = some tool) :
    tool ∈ eligible ∧ tool ∉ used ∧
      errorRank (full.drop next.val) ((Finset.univ \ used).erase tool) =
        badChildRank eligible (full.drop next.val) (Finset.univ \ used) := by
  let score := fun candidate => (buildCapacityTable q full (q + 1)).extractedRank q
    (builtTableRow q full (q + 1) next) (insert candidate used)
  change List.argmax score (availableToolList q eligible used) = some tool at hpick
  have hscore (candidate : Fin q) : score candidate =
      errorRank (full.drop next.val) ((Finset.univ \ used).erase candidate) := by
    simpa only [score, remaining_after_used_insert] using
      built_extractedRank_eq_errorRank q full hlaminar next (insert candidate used)
  have hfields := (mem_availableToolList q eligible used tool).mp (List.argmax_mem hpick)
  refine ⟨hfields.1, hfields.2, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · apply childRank_le_badChildRank
    exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hfields.1,
      Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hfields.2⟩⟩
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro candidate hcandidate
    obtain ⟨heligible, hunused⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hcandidate
    have hmem := (mem_availableToolList q eligible used candidate).mpr
      ⟨heligible, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hunused).2⟩
    have hle := List.le_of_mem_argmax hmem hpick
    rw [hscore candidate, hscore tool] at hle
    exact hle

def planFromTable (q : Nat) (table : CapacityTable (Fin q) (q + 1)) :
    (suffix : List (Finset (Fin q))) → Nat → Finset (Fin q) → Plan (Fin q) suffix
  | [], _, _ => .done
  | eligible :: later, offset, used =>
      let good := planFromTable q table later (offset + 1) used
      if hrow : offset + 1 < table.rows.size then
        match pickMaxRankTool q table ⟨offset + 1, hrow⟩ eligible used with
        | none => .decline good
        | some tool => .choose good tool
            (planFromTable q table later (offset + 1) (insert tool used))
      else .decline good

theorem errorRank_cons (eligible : Finset Tool)
    (later : List (Finset Tool)) (remaining : Finset Tool) :
    errorRank (eligible :: later) remaining =
      min (errorRank later remaining) (1 + badChildRank eligible later remaining) := by
  apply enat_eq_of_nat_lt_iff
  intro budget
  cases budget with
  | zero =>
    have hpositive : (0 : ℕ∞) < 1 + badChildRank eligible later remaining :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le)
    simp only [ENat.natCast_zero, lt_min_iff, errorRank_pos, hpositive, and_self]
  | succ budget =>
    have hshift : ((budget + 1 : Nat) : ℕ∞) <
        1 + badChildRank eligible later remaining ↔
        (budget : ℕ∞) < badChildRank eligible later remaining := by
      rw [ENat.natCast_add, ENat.natCast_one, add_comm (budget : ℕ∞) 1]
      exact ENat.add_lt_add_iff_left (by simp)
    rw [← safe_iff_lt_errorRank, safe_cons_succ_iff, lt_min_iff, hshift,
      ← safe_iff_lt_errorRank, lt_badChildRank_iff]

  let cache := (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
  let nodes := List.finRange cache.nodes.size
  { input := [full.length, q, cache.nodes.size] ++ incidence full ++
      nodes.flatMap (fun node => (List.finRange q).map

      (nodes.map (fun node => (cache.children.get node).size))
    children := nodes.flatMap (fun node => (cache.children.get node).toList.map Fin.val) }

PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.Algori.signature_start: def NatRAMImplementationClaims (constant wordFactor : Nat) (implementation : Implementation) : Prop :=
PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.Algori.full_declaration_source:
def NatRAMImplementationClaims (constant wordFactor : Nat) (implementation : Implementation) : Prop :=
    ∀ (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q), LaminarSchedule full →
    let N := full.length
    let t := (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size
    let rom := givenTreeROM q full
    let build := implementation.buildProgram N q t
    let capWords := implementation.capacityWords N q t
    let heapWords := capWords + implementation.indexWords N q t
    let built := execute rom.semantic build (initial (fun _ => 0))
    tableWords N q t ≤ capWords ∧
    capWords * CapacityBits.width q ≤ constant * work N q t * Nat.clog 2 (q + 2) ∧
    implementation.indexWords N q t ≤ constant * (N + q + t + 1) ∧
    totalBuildCost rom build heapWords ≤ constant * work N q t ∧
    ExecutionClaims wordFactor N q heapWords rom build (initial (fun _ => 0)) ∧
    PhysicalTableCorrect q full built.heap ∧
    CapacityThroughout q capWords rom build (initial (fun _ => 0)) ∧
    (∀ heap : Nat → Nat, PhysicalTableCorrect q full heap →
      CapacityPrefixBounded q capWords heap →
      (∀ address < heapWords, Fits (indexWidth wordFactor N q) (heap address)) →
      ∀ stage : Fin (N + 1), ∀ used : Finset (Fin q),
      QueryClaims constant wordFactor implementation q full hq t capWords heapWords stage used heap) ∧
    (let rolling := implementation.rollingProgram N q t
     let rollingCap := implementation.rollingCapacityWords N q t
     let rollingHeap := rollingCap + implementation.rollingIndexWords N q t
     ∀ used : Finset (Fin q),
     let input := queryROM q full 0 used
     let result := execute input.semantic rolling (initial (fun _ => 0))
     2 * (q + 2) * (t + 1) ≤ rollingCap ∧
     rollingCap * CapacityBits.width q ≤ constant * queryWork q t * Nat.clog 2 (q + 2) ∧
     implementation.rollingIndexWords N q t ≤ constant * (q + t + 1) ∧

PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.Algori.full_declaration_source:
def UniformCodeGenerationClaims (constant wordFactor : Nat) (implementation : Implementation)
    (packed : PackedPrograms) : Prop :=
  ∃ generator : List PackingOp,
  ∀ (N q t : Nat), 0 < q → 0 < t → t ≤ N + q + 1 →
    let bits := indexWidth wordFactor N q
    let rom : PhysicalROM := ⟨[N, q, t], [], []⟩
    let start := packingInitial (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat bits 0)
    let target := generatedCode implementation packed N q t
    ∃ (steps heapWords : Nat),
    WordsFit bits (packingCode generator) ∧ WordsFit bits [N, q, t] ∧
    Fits bits (rom.size + heapWords + (packingCode generator).length) ∧
    target.length ≤ heapWords ∧
    (packingRun rom generator steps start).halted = true ∧
    (∀ position (hposition : position < target.length),
      ((packingRun rom generator steps start).heap (BitVec.ofNat bits position)).toNat = target[position]) ∧
    (∀ count < steps,
      let state := packingRun rom generator count start
      state.halted = false ∧ state.pc.toNat + 4 < (packingCode generator).length ∧
      let fetched : Vector Nat 5 := Vector.ofFn (fun position =>
        ((((packingCode generator).map (BitVec.ofNat bits)).getD
          (state.pc.toNat + position.val) (BitVec.ofNat bits 0))).toNat)
      match PackingOp.decode fetched with
      | none => fetched = haltWords
      | some op => packingAccessFits rom heapWords state op) ∧
    rom.size + (packingCode generator).length + heapWords + 8 +
      (packingDynamicTrace rom generator steps start).length ≤ constant * work N q t

def PackedImplementationClaims (constant wordFactor : Nat) (implementation : Implementation) : Prop :=
  ∃ packed : PackedPrograms,
  UniformCodeGenerationClaims constant wordFactor implementation packed ∧
  ∀ (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (_hq : 0 < q), LaminarSchedule full →
  let N := full.length
  let t := (prepareNormalization q full).indexed.nodes.size
  let rom := givenTreeROM q full
  let bits := indexWidth wordFactor N q
  let capWords := implementation.capacityWords N q t
  let indexWords := implementation.indexWords N q t
  PackedPhaseRefines constant wordFactor N q t capWords indexWords rom
    (implementation.buildProgram N q t) (packed.build N q t) (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat bits 0) ∧
  (∀ used : Finset (Fin q),
    PackedPhaseRefines constant wordFactor N q t (implementation.rollingCapacityWords N q t)
      (implementation.rollingIndexWords N q t) (queryROM q full 0 used)
      (implementation.rollingProgram N q t) (packed.rolling N q t) (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat bits 0)) ∧
  (∀ heap : BitVec bits → BitVec bits,
    let decoded := unpackHeap q capWords bits heap
    PhysicalTableCorrect q full decoded → CapacityPrefixBounded q capWords decoded →
    ∀ stage : Fin (N + 1), ∀ used : Finset (Fin q),
    PackedPhaseRefines constant wordFactor N q t capWords indexWords
      (queryROM q full stage.val used) (implementation.queryProgram N q t) (packed.query N q t) heap)

    intro heap htable hcap hfits stage used

theorem encodeEntries_length_le {size : Nat} (q : Nat) (entries : List (Entry size)) :
    (encodeEntries q entries).length ≤ entries.length * (1 + size * width q) := by

        rw [List.length_cons, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_comm]

theorem leafBitmap_insert {q : Nat} (cache : IndexedNodeCache (Fin q))
    (hinjective : Function.Injective cache.decode) (used : Finset (Fin q))
    (tool : Fin q) (leaf : cache.NodeId) (hleaf : cache.decode leaf = {tool}) :
    leafBitmap cache (insert tool used) =
      (leafBitmap cache used).set leaf.val 1 leaf.isLt := by
  apply Vector.ext
  intro index hi
  let node : cache.NodeId := ⟨index, hi⟩
  change (leafBitmap cache (insert tool used)).get node =
    ((leafBitmap cache used).set leaf.val 1 leaf.isLt).get node
  rw [vector_set_get]
  by_cases heq : node = leaf
  · rw [heq]
    rw [leafBitmap, cache_get_ofFn, leafTools_get, hleaf, singletonTool_singleton]
    simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right heq, leafBitmap, cache_get_ofFn, leafBitmap, cache_get_ofFn]
    cases hl : (leafTools cache).get node with
    | none => rfl
    | some other =>
      have hother : other ≠ tool := by
        intro hs
        apply heq
        exact hinjective ((singletonTool_spec _ other (by simpa only [leafTools_get] using hl)).trans
          (hs ▸ hleaf.symm))
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, hother, false_or]

    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (unavailable : Finset Tool) :

  intro left hleft right hright

  obtain ⟨sourceRight, hsright, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hright

  · left

  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Finset.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left unavailable hsub))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Finset.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left unavailable hsub))

theorem stored_query_infinite_tool (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlaminar : LaminarSchedule full) (used : Finset (Fin q)) (stage : Fin full.length)
    (htop : errorRank (full.drop stage.val) (Finset.univ \ used) = ⊤) :
    let next : Fin (full.length + 1) := ⟨stage.val + 1, by omega⟩
    let answer := query (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
      (leafTools (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
      (usedCounts (prepareNormalization q full).indexed used) (storedPositiveRow q full next)
      (storedStageNode q full hq stage)
    ∃ tool, answer.tool = some tool ∧ tool ∈ full[stage.val] ∧ tool ∉ used ∧
      errorRank (full.drop (stage.val + 1)) ((Finset.univ \ used).erase tool) = ⊤ := by
  dsimp only
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons stage.isLt] at htop
  have hbad := ((errorRank_cons_eq_top_iff full[stage.val] (full.drop (stage.val + 1))
    (Finset.univ \ used)).mp htop).2
  have hnonempty : full[stage.val] ∩ (Finset.univ \ used) ≠ ∅ := by
    intro he
    have hz := (badChildRank_eq_zero_iff full[stage.val] (full.drop (stage.val + 1))
      (Finset.univ \ used)).mpr he
    exact ENat.zero_ne_top (hz.symm.trans hbad)
  let next : Fin (full.length + 1) := ⟨stage.val + 1, by omega⟩
  cases hpick : (query (prepareNormalization q full).indexed
      (leafTools (prepareNormalization q full).indexed)
      (usedCounts (prepareNormalization q full).indexed used) (storedPositiveRow q full next)
      (storedStageNode q full hq stage)).tool with
  | none => exact (hnonempty ((stored_query_tool_none_iff q full hq hlaminar used stage).mp hpick)).elim
  | some tool =>
    obtain ⟨heligible, hunused, hchild⟩ := stored_query_tool_spec q full hq hlaminar used stage tool hpick
    exact ⟨tool, rfl, heligible, hunused, hchild.trans hbad⟩

def CallbackClaims : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))), LaminarSchedule full →
  (∀ (stage : Fin (full.length + 1)) (used : Finset (Fin q)),
    (callback q full stage used).rank = errorRank (full.drop stage.val) (Finset.univ \ used)) ∧
  (∀ (stage : Fin full.length) (used : Finset (Fin q)),
    let cursor : Fin (full.length + 1) := ⟨stage.val, by omega⟩
    let reply := callback q full cursor used
    reply.good = errorRank (full.drop (stage.val + 1)) (Finset.univ \ used) ∧
    reply.bad = badChildRank full[stage.val] (full.drop (stage.val + 1)) (Finset.univ \ used) ∧
    (reply.tool = none ↔ full[stage.val] ∩ (Finset.univ \ used) = ∅) ∧
    (∀ tool, reply.tool = some tool → tool ∈ full[stage.val] ∧ tool ∉ used ∧
      errorRank (full.drop (stage.val + 1)) ((Finset.univ \ used).erase tool) = reply.bad)) ∧
  (∀ (offset : Fin (full.length + 1)) (used : Finset (Fin q)) (budget : Nat),
    SafePlan (callbackPlan q full (full.drop offset.val) offset.val used) (Finset.univ \ used) budget ↔
      Safe (full.drop offset.val) (Finset.univ \ used) budget)

PaperProofs.Structure.LaminarTree.Compac.full_declaration_source:
def MachineControllerClaims : Prop :=
  ∃ (constant wordFactor indexFactor scratchFactor : Nat) (preprocessor live : List PackingOp),
  0 < constant ∧ 0 < wordFactor ∧ 0 < indexFactor ∧ 0 < scratchFactor ∧
  ∀ (q : Nat) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))), LaminarSchedule full →
  ∀ initialUsed : Finset (Fin q),
  let N := full.length
  let t := treeSize q full
  let bits := indexWidth wordFactor N q
  let capWords := capacityWords scratchFactor N q t
  let indexWords := indexFactor * (N + q + t + 1)
  let heapWords := physicalHeaderWords + packedCapacityWords q capWords bits + indexWords
  let input := controllerInput q full initialUsed
  let emptyHeap := fun _ => BitVec.ofNat bits 0
  let configuration : Configuration q := ⟨0, initialUsed, false⟩
  ∃ steps : Nat,
  let built := packingRun input preprocessor steps (packingInitial emptyHeap)
  DynamicRunCorrect heapWords input preprocessor steps emptyHeap ∧
  totalCost heapWords input preprocessor steps emptyHeap ≤ constant * preprocessingWork N q t ∧
  capWords * CapacityBits.width q ≤ constant * work N q t * Nat.clog 2 (q + 2) ∧
  HeapRepresents q full capWords configuration built.heap ∧
  (∀ configuration : Configuration q, ∀ heap : BitVec bits → BitVec bits,
    HeapRepresents q full capWords configuration heap →
    ∀ command : Command, Allowed full configuration command →
    ∃ steps : Nat, CallClaims constant q full capWords heapWords live configuration command steps heap) ∧
  (∀ commands : List Command, StageScript q full configuration commands →
    ∃ counts : List Nat,
    counts.length = commands.length ∧
    CommandsRunClaims constant q full capWords heapWords live configuration commands counts built.heap ∧
    commandsCost q full live commands counts built.heap ≤ 2 * constant * N * liveWork q t)

  ∀ (I : Instance), LaminarSchedule I.compatibility →
  ∀ (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (Seed : Type u)
    (policy : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    (n : Nat) (state : Native.State I),

  ∀ (stage : I.Stage), state.cursor = stage.val →
  ∃ reply, nativeReply I initialAvailable state.history = some reply ∧
    reply.rank = errorRank (I.compatibility.drop stage.val)
      (initialAvailable \ (state.ledger.commitments.map (·.tool)).toFinset) ∧
    reply.good = errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1))

    reply.bad = badChildRank (I.eligible stage) (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1))
      (initialAvailable \ historyUsed state.history) ∧
    (reply.tool = none ↔ I.eligible stage ∩ (initialAvailable \ historyUsed state.history) = ∅) ∧

        state.halted = false → validHandle state handle →

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment..signature_start: theorem divergence_pos (E : BinaryExperiment) (x : Bool) : 0 < E.divergence x := by
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment..full_declaration_source:
theorem divergence_pos (E : BinaryExperiment) (x : Bool) : 0 < E.divergence x := by
  have hdistinct : E.channel x ≠ E.channel (!x) := by
    cases x
    · exact E.channel_distinct
    · exact Ne.symm E.channel_distinct
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := not_forall.mp (fun h => hdistinct (funext h))
  have hyreal : E.channelReal x y ≠ E.channelReal (!x) y := by
    change (E.channel x y : ℝ) ≠ (E.channel (!x) y : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast hy
  have hratio : E.channelReal x y / E.channelReal (!x) y ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hyreal ((div_eq_one_iff_eq (ne_of_gt (E.channelReal_pos (!x) y))).mp h)
  have hratio_nonneg := (div_pos (E.channelReal_pos x y) (E.channelReal_pos (!x) y)).le
  have hkl_ne : InformationTheory.klFun
      (E.channelReal x y / E.channelReal (!x) y) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hratio ((InformationTheory.klFun_eq_zero_iff hratio_nonneg).mp h)
  have hkl_pos : 0 < InformationTheory.klFun
      (E.channelReal x y / E.channelReal (!x) y) :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (InformationTheory.klFun_nonneg hratio_nonneg) (Ne.symm hkl_ne)
  rw [E.divergence_eq_sum_klFun]
  apply Finset.sum_pos'
  · intro z _
    exact mul_nonneg (E.channelReal_pos (!x) z).le
      (InformationTheory.klFun_nonneg
        (div_pos (E.channelReal_pos x z) (E.channelReal_pos (!x) z)).le)
  · exact ⟨y, Finset.mem_univ y, mul_pos (E.channelReal_pos (!x) y) hkl_pos⟩

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment..name: PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment.bayesObjective_eq_seed_integral
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment..full_declaration_source:
theorem bayesObjective_eq_seed_integral (E : BinaryExperiment)
    (ν : Measure Seed) (test : E.AdmissibleRule Seed) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    E.bayesObjective ν test penalty =
      ∫⁻ seed, E.bayesObjective (Measure.dirac ())
        (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) penalty ∂ν := by
  have hc (truth : Bool) := E.measurable_fixedSeedTest_charge test truth
  have he (truth : Bool) := E.measurable_fixedSeedTest_error test truth
  have hcs : Measurable (fun seed =>
      E.priorMass true * E.expectedObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) true +
      E.priorMass false * E.expectedObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) false) :=
    ((hc true).const_mul (E.priorMass true)).add ((hc false).const_mul (E.priorMass false))
  have hes : Measurable (fun seed =>
      E.priorMass true * E.conditionalError (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) true +
      E.priorMass false * E.conditionalError (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) false) :=
    ((he true).const_mul (E.priorMass true)).add ((he false).const_mul (E.priorMass false))
  simp only [bayesObjective, bayesObservationCharge, bayesError, Fintype.sum_bool]
  rw [lintegral_add_left hcs
    (fun seed => penalty *
      (E.priorMass true * E.conditionalError (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) true +
        E.priorMass false * E.conditionalError (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) false))]
  rw [lintegral_add_left ((hc true).const_mul (E.priorMass true))
    (fun seed => E.priorMass false *
      E.expectedObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) false),
    lintegral_const_mul _ (hc true), lintegral_const_mul _ (hc false)]
  rw [lintegral_const_mul penalty hes]
  rw [lintegral_add_left ((he true).const_mul (E.priorMass true))
    (fun seed => E.priorMass false *
      E.conditionalError (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) false),
    lintegral_const_mul _ (he true), lintegral_const_mul _ (he false)]
  rw [← observationCharge_eq_seed_integral, ← observationCharge_eq_seed_integral,
    ← conditionalError_eq_seed_integral, ← conditionalError_eq_seed_integral]

theorem localValue_eq_deterministic (E : BinaryExperiment) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    E.localValue penalty =
      ⨅ test : E.AdmissibleRule Unit, E.bayesObjective (Measure.dirac ()) test penalty := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_iInf fun test => E.localValue_le_test (Measure.dirac ()) test penalty
  · unfold localValue
    refine le_iInf fun SmallSeed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
    let : MeasurableSpace SmallSeed := m
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => le_iInf fun test => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    rw [bayesObjective_eq_seed_integral]
    have hp (seed : SmallSeed) :
        (⨅ test : E.AdmissibleRule Unit, E.bayesObjective (Measure.dirac ()) test penalty) ≤
          E.bayesObjective (Measure.dirac ()) (E.fixedSeedTest test seed) penalty :=
      iInf_le _ _
    simpa using (lintegral_mono hp :
      (∫⁻ _ : SmallSeed,
        (⨅ test : E.AdmissibleRule Unit, E.bayesObjective (Measure.dirac ()) test penalty) ∂ν) ≤ _)

theorem localValue_le_penalty (E : BinaryExperiment) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    E.localValue penalty ≤ penalty := by
  let ν : Measure Unit := Measure.dirac ()

    _ ≤ E.bayesObjective ν (E.constantGuess Unit false) penalty :=
      E.localValue_le_test ν (E.constantGuess Unit false) penalty

    _ ≤ penalty := by

noncomputable def posteriorSPRT (E : BinaryExperiment) (p : ℚ) : E.AdmissibleRule Unit where
  rule := {
    stop := fun _ tape => E.posteriorThresholdStop p tape
    decision := fun _ tape => decide (0 ≤ E.logOddsScore tape (E.posteriorThresholdStop p tape).toNat)
    stopping := E.posteriorThresholdStop_stopping p
    stoppedDecision := by
      intro _seed tape tape' n hs hs' hp
      simp only [hs, hs', ENat.toNat_natCast]
      rw [E.logOddsScore_eq_of_prefix tape tape' n hp]
  }
  measurable_stop := (E.measurable_posteriorThresholdStop p).comp measurable_snd
  measurable_decision := by
    have hn : Measurable (fun sample : Unit × E.Tape => (E.posteriorThresholdStop p sample.2).toNat) :=
      (measurable_of_countable ENat.toNat).comp ((E.measurable_posteriorThresholdStop p).comp measurable_snd)
    have hjoint : Measurable (fun pair : E.Tape × ℕ => E.logOddsScore pair.1 pair.2) :=
      measurable_from_prod_countable_left (fun n => E.measurable_logOddsScore n)
    have hscore := hjoint.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk hn)
    apply measurable_to_bool
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Set.preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, decide_eq_true_eq] using
      (measurableSet_le measurable_const hscore)

theorem posteriorSPRT_sharpObservationCharge (E : BinaryExperiment) (p : ℚ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpquarter : p ≤ 1 / 4) (x : Bool) :
    (E.expectedObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ()) (E.posteriorSPRT p) x).toReal ≤
      (E.observationFee : ℝ) / E.divergence x *
        (Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + (E.logIncrementBound true +
          2 * |Real.log (E.priorReal true / E.priorReal false)|)) := by
  have hplt : p < 1 := by linarith
  apply (E.posteriorSPRT_expectedObservationCharge_le p (posteriorThreshold_nonneg p hp hpquarter) x).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left

theorem exists_rationalLocalPenaltyTarget (penalty : ℝ) (hpenalty : 4 ≤ penalty) :
    ∃ p : ℚ, 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 1 / 4 ∧
      (1 / penalty) / 2 ≤ (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ 1 / penalty ∧
      penalty * (p : ℝ) ≤ 1 ∧
      Real.log penalty ≤ Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) ∧
      Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log penalty + Real.log 2 := by
  have ht : 0 < penalty := by linarith
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp_lo, hp_hi⟩ :=
    exists_rationalRisk_factorTwo (1 / penalty) (one_div_pos.mpr ht)
  have hpr : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hp_quarter_real : (p : ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4 :=
    hp_hi.trans (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hpenalty)
  have hp_quarter : p ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    apply (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mp
    simpa using hp_quarter_real
  have hbudget : penalty * (p : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_hi ht.le
    simpa [ne_of_gt ht] using h
  have hinv_lo : penalty ≤ 1 / (p : ℝ) := (le_div_iff₀ hpr).mpr hbudget
  have hinv_hi : 1 / (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * penalty := by
    have h := (div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).mp hp_lo
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h ht.le
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hpr).mpr
    simpa [ne_of_gt ht, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hmul
  refine ⟨p, hp, hp_quarter, hp_lo, hp_hi, hbudget,
    Real.log_le_log ht hinv_lo, ?_⟩
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (one_div_pos.mpr hpr) hinv_hi
  simpa [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (ne_of_gt ht), add_comm] using hlog

/-- The paper's iterated logarithms: depth zero is the identity and depth one is log.
All statistical depth laws use fixed positive depth and sufficiently small risk. -/

theorem bayesObjective_finite_expectedSamples (E : BinaryExperiment) (ν : Measure Seed)
    (test : E.AdmissibleRule Seed) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hfinite : E.bayesObjective ν test penalty ≠ ⊤) (x : Bool) :

    rw [E.expectedObservationCharge_eq, htop]
    simp [hfee, hprior]
