theorem measurable_stoppedTranscript (E : BinaryExperiment) (test : E.AdmissibleRule Seed) :
    Measurable (E.stoppedTranscript test) := by
  have hword : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × E.Tape =>
      (⟨(test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2).toNat, fun k => sample.2 k.val⟩ : E.StoppedWord)) := by
    apply measurable_to_countable'
    rintro ⟨n, word⟩
    have hset :
        (fun sample : Seed × E.Tape =>
          (⟨(test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2).toNat, fun k => sample.2 k.val⟩ : E.StoppedWord)) ⁻¹'
            {⟨n, word⟩} =
          {sample : Seed × E.Tape | (test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2).toNat = n} ∩
            ⋂ k : Fin n, {sample : Seed × E.Tape | sample.2 k.val = word k} := by
      ext sample
      simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff,
        Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter] using E.stoppedWord_eq_iff test sample n word
    rw [hset]
    have hlength : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × E.Tape =>
        (test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2).toNat) :=
      (measurable_of_countable ENat.toNat).comp test.measurable_stop
    refine (hlength (measurableSet_singleton n)).inter (MeasurableSet.iInter fun k => ?_)
    exact (measurableSet_singleton (word k)).preimage
      ((measurable_pi_apply k.val).comp measurable_snd)
  exact measurable_fst.prodMk hword

theorem integral_stoppedIncrement (E : BinaryExperiment) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (test : E.AdmissibleRule Seed) (x : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ sample, E.continueIndicator test n sample * E.logIncrement x n sample ∂(E.conditionalLaw ν x) =
      E.divergence x * ∫ sample, E.continueIndicator test n sample ∂(E.conditionalLaw ν x) := by
  have hind := (E.continueIndicator_independent_next ν test x n).comp measurable_id
    (measurable_of_countable (fun y => Real.log (E.channelReal x y / E.channelReal (!x) y)))
  have hi := hind.integral_mul_eq_mul_integral
    (E.measurable_continueIndicator test n).aestronglyMeasurable (E.measurable_logIncrement x n).aestronglyMeasurable
  change (∫ sample, E.continueIndicator test n sample * E.logIncrement x n sample ∂(E.conditionalLaw ν x)) =
    (∫ sample, E.continueIndicator test n sample ∂(E.conditionalLaw ν x)) *
      (∫ sample, E.logIncrement x n sample ∂(E.conditionalLaw ν x)) at hi
  rw [E.integral_logIncrement] at hi
  simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, mul_comm] using hi

theorem integral_stoppedSum_wald (E : BinaryExperiment) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (test : E.AdmissibleRule Seed) (x : Bool)
    (hfinite : E.expectedSamples ν test x ≠ ⊤) :
    (∫ sample, E.wordLogLikelihood x (E.stoppedTranscript test sample).2 ∂(E.conditionalLaw ν x)) =
      E.divergence x * (E.expectedSamples ν test x).toReal := by
  have hcount := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (f := fun sample : Seed × E.Tape => ((test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2).toNat : ℝ))
    (fun sample : Seed × E.Tape => ((test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2).toNat : ℝ))
    (fun N => (E.measurable_truncatedCount test N).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (E.expectedSamples_finite_integrable_toNat ν test x hfinite)
    (fun N => by
      filter_upwards [E.expectedSamples_finite_stop ν test x hfinite] with sample hs
      exact E.truncatedCount_norm_le test N sample hs)
    (by
      filter_upwards [E.expectedSamples_finite_stop ν test x hfinite] with sample hs
      exact Filter.Tendsto.congr'
        (Filter.Eventually.mono (E.truncatedCount_eventually_eq test sample hs) (fun _ hN => hN.symm))
        tendsto_const_nhds)
  have hsum := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (f := fun sample : Seed × E.Tape => E.wordLogLikelihood x (E.stoppedTranscript test sample).2)
    (fun sample : Seed × E.Tape => E.logIncrementBound x * ((test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2).toNat : ℝ))
    (fun N => (E.measurable_truncatedStoppedSum test x N).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((E.expectedSamples_finite_integrable_toNat ν test x hfinite).const_mul (E.logIncrementBound x))
    (fun N => by
      filter_upwards [E.expectedSamples_finite_stop ν test x hfinite] with sample hs
      exact E.truncatedStoppedSum_norm_le test x N sample hs)
    (by
      filter_upwards [E.expectedSamples_finite_stop ν test x hfinite] with sample hs
      exact Filter.Tendsto.congr'
        (Filter.Eventually.mono (E.truncatedStoppedSum_eventually_eq test x sample hs) (fun _ hN => hN.symm))
        tendsto_const_nhds)
  have hcount' := hcount.const_mul (E.divergence x)
  simp_rw [← E.integral_truncatedStoppedSum ν test x] at hcount'
  have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique hsum hcount'
  rw [E.expectedSamples_finite_integral_toNat ν test x hfinite] at heq
  exact heq

PaperProofs.Statistics.binary_kl_lower.signature_start: theorem binary_kl_lower (μ ν : Measure Bool) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
PaperProofs.Statistics.binary_kl_lower.full_declaration_source:
theorem binary_kl_lower (μ ν : Measure Bool) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (b : Bool) :
    μ {b} * negativeLogMass (ν {b}) ≤
      InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log 2) := by
  by_cases hac : μ ≪ ν
  · by_cases hb : ν {b} = 0
    · have hμ : μ {b} = 0 := hac hb
      simp [hμ]
    · by_cases hnb : ν {!b} = 0
      · have hv : ν {b} = 1 := by simpa only [hnb, add_zero] using bool_mass_add_compl ν b
        simp [hv]
      · have hp : 0 ≤ μ.real {b} := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        have hp1 : μ.real {b} ≤ 1 := by
          have hmass : μ {b} ≤ (1 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
            calc
              μ {b} ≤ μ Set.univ := measure_mono (Set.subset_univ {b})
              _ = 1 := measure_univ
          simpa only [measureReal_def, ENNReal.toReal_one] using
            (ENNReal.toReal_mono (by simp : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)
              hmass)
        have hq : 0 < ν.real {b} := ENNReal.toReal_pos hb (measure_ne_top ν {b})
        have hqn : 0 < ν.real {!b} := ENNReal.toReal_pos hnb (measure_ne_top ν {!b})
        have hq1 : ν.real {b} < 1 := by rw [bool_real_mass_compl ν b] at hqn; linarith
        have hbound := binary_real_kl_lower hp hp1 hq hq1
        rw [← bool_real_mass_compl μ b, ← bool_real_mass_compl ν b] at hbound
        rw [InformationTheory.klDiv_of_ac_of_integrable hac Integrable.of_finite]
        simp only [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
        rw [bool_integral_llr μ ν hac b hb hnb]
        rw [negativeLogMass, ite_eq_right hb, ← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ {b}),
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound).trans ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
  · simp [InformationTheory.klDiv_of_not_ac hac]

theorem decisionLaw_kl_lower (E : BinaryExperiment) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (test : E.AdmissibleRule Seed) (x : Bool) :
    (1 - E.conditionalError ν test x) * negativeLogMass (E.conditionalError ν test (!x)) ≤
      InformationTheory.klDiv (E.decisionLaw ν test x) (E.decisionLaw ν test (!x)) +

  have hother : E.decisionLaw ν test (!x) {x} = E.conditionalError ν test (!x) := by
    simpa only [Bool.not_not] using E.decisionLaw_error ν test (!x)
  rwa [hother] at h

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment..full_declaration_source:
theorem bayesInformationLower_le_observationCharge (E : BinaryExperiment)
    (hidentity : E.StoppedInformationIdentity) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (test : E.AdmissibleRule Seed) :
    E.bayesInformationLower ν test ≤ E.bayesObservationCharge ν test := by
  by_cases hfinite : E.bayesObservationCharge ν test = ⊤
  · rw [hfinite]
    exact le_top
  · have hobjective : E.bayesObjective ν test 0 ≠ ⊤ := by
      simpa only [bayesObjective, zero_mul, add_zero] using hfinite
    have hcounts := E.bayesObjective_finite_expectedSamples ν test 0 hobjective
    unfold bayesInformationLower bayesObservationCharge
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro x _
    have hinfo := E.decision_information_lower_of_finite hidentity ν test hcounts x
    have hsub : E.decisionInformationDemand ν test x - ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log 2) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (E.divergence x) * E.expectedSamples ν test x :=
      (tsub_le_iff_right).mpr hinfo
    calc
      _ ≤ E.informationWeight x *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (E.divergence x) * E.expectedSamples ν test x) :=
        mul_le_mul' le_rfl hsub
      _ = E.priorMass x * E.expectedObservationCharge ν test x := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, E.informationWeight_mul_divergence,
          mul_assoc, E.expectedObservationCharge_eq]

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment..full_declaration_source:
theorem localValue_ratio_eventually_le_of_sprt (E : BinaryExperiment)
    (hsprt : E.PosteriorSPRTGuarantee) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop,
      E.localValueReal t / (E.coefficient * Real.log t) ≤ 1 + ε := by
  obtain ⟨C, _, hlarge⟩ := E.localValue_log_upper_of_sprt hsprt
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => C / (E.coefficient * Real.log t)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => C) atTop (nhds C)).div_atTop
      (Tendsto.const_mul_atTop E.coefficient_pos Real.tendsto_log_atTop)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop, C / (E.coefficient * Real.log t) < ε :=
    hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (4 : ℝ), eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ), hsmall]
    with t ht ht1 hsmall
  have hdenom : 0 < E.coefficient * Real.log t :=
    mul_pos E.coefficient_pos (Real.log_pos ht1)
  have hratio : E.localValueReal t / (E.coefficient * Real.log t) ≤
      1 + C / (E.coefficient * Real.log t) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdenom).mpr
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ C hdenom.ne']
    exact hlarge t ht
  exact hratio.trans (by linarith)

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment..full_declaration_source:
theorem localValue_lower_curve (E : BinaryExperiment) (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 < t)
    (he1 : E.cheapError t ≤ 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (E.localLowerCurve t) ≤ E.localValue (ENNReal.ofReal t) := by
  unfold localValue
  apply le_iInf
  intro TestSeed
  apply le_iInf
  intro m
  let : MeasurableSpace TestSeed := m
  apply le_iInf
  intro ν
  apply le_iInf
  intro hν
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  apply le_iInf
  intro test
  by_cases hsmall : E.bayesObjective ν test (ENNReal.ofReal t) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * E.coefficient * Real.log t)
  · have herrors := E.conditionalError_le_cheapError ν test t ht hsmall
    have hinfo := E.observationCharge_ge_uniform_error ν test
      (E.cheapError t) (E.cheapError_pos t ht) he1 herrors
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (E.coefficient *
          ((1 - E.cheapError t) * (-Real.log (E.cheapError t)) - Real.log 2)) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (min_le_right _ _)
      _ ≤ E.bayesObservationCharge ν test := hinfo
      _ ≤ _ := le_self_add
  · exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (min_le_left _ _)).trans (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hsmall))

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinaryExperiment..full_declaration_source:
theorem localValue_ratio_eventually_ge (E : BinaryExperiment) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop,
      1 - ε ≤ E.localValueReal t / (E.coefficient * Real.log t) := by
  have he1 : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop, E.cheapError t < 1 :=
    E.cheapError_tendsto_zero.eventually (gt_mem_nhds zero_lt_one)
  have hshape : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop, 1 - ε <
      ((1 - E.cheapError t) * (-Real.log (E.cheapError t)) - Real.log 2) / Real.log t :=
    E.uniformInformation_shape_tendsto_one.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by linarith))
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ), he1, hshape] with t ht he1 hshape
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos ht
  have hdenom : 0 < E.coefficient * Real.log t := mul_pos E.coefficient_pos hlog
  have hfirst : (1 - ε) * (E.coefficient * Real.log t) ≤
      2 * E.coefficient * Real.log t := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show 1 - ε ≤ 2 by linarith) hdenom.le
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
  have hsecond : (1 - ε) * (E.coefficient * Real.log t) ≤ E.coefficient *
      ((1 - E.cheapError t) * (-Real.log (E.cheapError t)) - Real.log 2) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((lt_div_iff₀ hlog).mp hshape).le E.coefficient_pos.le
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have hcurve : (1 - ε) * (E.coefficient * Real.log t) ≤ E.localLowerCurve t :=
    le_min hfirst hsecond
  have hENN := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hcurve).trans (E.localValue_lower_curve t ht he1.le)
  have hreal : (1 - ε) * (E.coefficient * Real.log t) ≤ E.localValueReal t :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal (E.localValue_ofReal_ne_top t)).mp hENN
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hdenom).mpr hreal

    letI : MeasurableSpace SmallSeed := m

PaperProofs.Common.Native.penaltyObjecti.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.penaltyObjective_availableEncoded_eq
PaperProofs.Common.Native.penaltyObjecti.signature_start: theorem penaltyObjective_availableEncoded_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.penaltyObjecti.full_declaration_source:
theorem penaltyObjective_availableEncoded_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (policy : AvailablePolicy input C accounting available Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    penaltyObjective input C .uncapped accounting
      (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available).val.rule
      (ν.map (encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy)) penalty =
        penaltyObjective input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule ν penalty := by
  have hsuccess (sample : Seed × input.World) :
      runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available).val.rule
        (encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy sample.1, sample.2) ↔
          runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample := by
    simp only [runSuccess, run_availableEncoded_eq]
  have hbill (sample : Seed × input.World) :
      runObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
        (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available).val.rule
        (encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy sample.1, sample.2) =
          runObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample := by
    simp only [runObservationBill, run_availableEncoded_eq]
  have hm : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World =>
      (encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy sample.1, sample.2)) :=
    ((measurable_encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy).comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
  have hcost : expectedObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
      (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available).val.rule
        (ν.map (encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy)) =
      expectedObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule ν := by
    unfold expectedObservationBill
    rw [seededWorldLaw_map_seed input ν _ (measurable_encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy),
      lintegral_map (measurable_runObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting _
        (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available).val.measurable_rule) hm]
    exact lintegral_congr hbill
  have hrisk : risk input C .uncapped accounting
      (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available).val.rule
        (ν.map (encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy)) =
      risk input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule ν := by
    unfold risk
    have hs : MeasurableSet {sample | ¬runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting
        (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available).val.rule sample} :=
      (measurableSet_runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting _
        (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available).val.measurable_rule).compl
    rw [seededWorldLaw_map_seed input ν _ (measurable_encodeAvailableSeed input C accounting available policy),
      Measure.map_apply hm hs]
    congr 1
    ext sample
    exact not_congr (hsuccess sample)
  unfold penaltyObjective
  rw [hcost, hrisk]

end Seed

theorem availablePenaltyValue_le_policy_any_seed (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)

    (availableStrategyPolicy input C accounting available)

PaperProofs.Common.Native.availablePenal.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.availablePenaltyValue_le_penalty
PaperProofs.Common.Native.availablePenal.signature_start: theorem availablePenaltyValue_le_penalty (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.availablePenal.full_declaration_source:
theorem availablePenaltyValue_le_penalty (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    availablePenaltyValue input C accounting available penalty ≤ penalty := by
  let ν : Measure Unit := Measure.dirac ()
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := by dsimp [ν]; infer_instance
  have h := availablePenaltyValue_le_policy input C accounting available penalty ν
    ⟨abandonPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit, abandonPolicy_usesOnly input C accounting available Unit⟩
  change availablePenaltyValue input C accounting available penalty ≤
    penaltyObjective input C .uncapped accounting (abandonPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit).rule ν penalty at h
  rw [penaltyObjective, abandon_expectedObservationBill, zero_add] at h
  have hr : risk input C .uncapped accounting
      (abandonPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit).rule ν ≤ 1 := prob_le_one
  have hmul : penalty * risk input C .uncapped accounting
      (abandonPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit).rule ν ≤ penalty := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_right hr penalty
  exact h.trans hmul

end PaperProofs.Common.Native

    penaltyObjective input C .uncapped accounting (stopPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit).rule ν penalty at h
  rw [penaltyObjective, stop_expectedObservationBill, stop_risk_empty, mul_zero, add_zero] at h

def PartialUsesOnly (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (policy : PartialRule I Seed) (available : Finset I.Tool) : Prop :=
  ∀ (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input) (n : ℕ) (s : State I),
    PartialPrefix input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes n s → s.halted = false →
      ∀ (handle : MismatchHandle I) (tool : I.Tool),
        policy seed s.history = some (.allocate handle tool) → tool ∈ available

PaperProofs.Common.Native.partialUsesOnl.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.partialUsesOnly_iff_totalized
PaperProofs.Common.Native.partialUsesOnl.signature_start: theorem partialUsesOnly_iff_totalized (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.partialUsesOnl.full_declaration_source:
theorem partialUsesOnly_iff_totalized (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PartialRule I Seed) (available : Finset I.Tool) :
    PartialUsesOnly input C accounting policy available ↔
      UsesOnly input C accounting (totalizeRule policy) available := by
  constructor
  · intro h seed truth tapes n s hp ha handle tool heq
    have hpp := (partialPrefix_iff_totalized input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes n s).mpr hp
    cases haction : policy seed s.history with
    | none =>
      simp only [totalizeRule, haction, Option.getD_none] at heq
      cases heq
    | some action =>
      have heqa : action = .allocate handle tool := by
        simpa only [totalizeRule, haction, Option.getD_some] using heq
      exact h seed truth tapes n s hpp ha handle tool (haction.trans (congrArg some heqa))
  · intro h seed truth tapes n s hp ha handle tool heq
    have hpt := (partialPrefix_iff_totalized input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes n s).mp hp
    apply h seed truth tapes n s hpt ha handle tool
    simp only [totalizeRule, heq, Option.getD_some]

PaperProofs.Common.Native.availableParti.signature_start: theorem availablePartialPenaltyValue_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.availableParti.full_declaration_source:
theorem availablePartialPenaltyValue_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    availablePartialPenaltyValue input C accounting available penalty =
      availablePenaltyValue input C accounting available penalty := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · conv_rhs => unfold availablePenaltyValue
    refine le_iInf fun SmallSeed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
    let : MeasurableSpace SmallSeed := m
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_
    let partialPolicy := policy.partialize input C accounting available
    have hle : availablePartialPenaltyValue input C accounting available penalty ≤
        partialPenaltyObjective input C accounting partialPolicy.val.rule ν penalty := by
      unfold availablePartialPenaltyValue
      exact iInf_le_of_le SmallSeed (iInf_le_of_le m (iInf_le_of_le ν
        (iInf_le_of_le hν (iInf_le_of_le partialPolicy le_rfl))))
    simpa only [partialPolicy, AvailablePolicy.partialize, partialPenaltyObjective_eq_totalized,
      totalize_partialize_rule] using hle
  · conv_rhs => unfold availablePartialPenaltyValue
    refine le_iInf fun SmallSeed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
    let : MeasurableSpace SmallSeed := m
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    exact le_iInf fun policy => availablePenaltyValue_le_partialPolicy_any_seed input C accounting
      available policy ν penalty

end PaperProofs.Common.Native

def StatisticalInput.CurrentPenaltyRecursion {I : Instance} (input : StatisticalInput I) : Prop :=
  ∀ (stage : I.Stage) (available : Finset I.Tool) (penalty : ℝ), 0 < penalty →
    input.healthyPenaltyReal stage.val available penalty =
      min penalty (input.goodPenaltyReal stage available penalty +
        (input.experiment stage).localValueReal
          (input.badPenaltyReal stage available penalty - input.goodPenaltyReal stage available penalty))

PaperProofs.Common.Native.healthyPenalty.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.healthyPenalty_head_upper
PaperProofs.Common.Native.healthyPenalty.signature_start: theorem healthyPenalty_head_upper (input : StatisticalInput I) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.healthyPenalty.full_declaration_source:
theorem healthyPenalty_head_upper (input : StatisticalInput I) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (price : ℝ) (hprice : 0 ≤ price) :
    input.healthyPenalty 0 available (ENNReal.ofReal price) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (input.goodPenaltyReal head available price + (input.experiment head).localValueReal
        (input.badPenaltyReal head available price - input.goodPenaltyReal head available price)) := by
  classical
  let E := input.experiment head
  let g := input.goodPenaltyReal head available price
  let b := input.badPenaltyReal head available price
  have ho := input.penalty_successor_order head available price hprice
  have hj : ENNReal.ofReal (E.localValueReal (b - g)) = E.localValue (ENNReal.ofReal (b - g)) :=
    ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (E.localValue_ofReal_ne_top (b - g))
  change input.healthyPenalty 0 available (ENNReal.ofReal price) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (g + E.localValueReal (b - g))
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add ho.1 (E.localValueReal_nonneg (b - g)), hj]
  apply bellman_le_of_forall_two_epsilon
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  obtain ⟨Local, mLocal, localRest⟩ := exists_localObjective_near E (ENNReal.ofReal (b - g))
    ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top epsilon hepsilon
  let : MeasurableSpace Local := mLocal
  obtain ⟨localLaw, hLocal, test, htest⟩ := localRest
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure localLaw := hLocal
  obtain ⟨Good, mGood, goodRest⟩ := exists_availablePenaltyObjective_near (input.freshSuffix 1)
    (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available
    (ENNReal.ofReal price) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top epsilon hepsilon
  let : MeasurableSpace Good := mGood
  obtain ⟨goodLaw, hGood, good, hgoodNear⟩ := goodRest
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure goodLaw := hGood
  have hgoodValue : availablePenaltyValue (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available (ENNReal.ofReal price) = ENNReal.ofReal g := by
    change input.healthyPenalty 1 available (ENNReal.ofReal price) = _
    simpa only [g, StatisticalInput.goodPenaltyReal, hhead, Nat.zero_add] using
      (ofReal_healthyPenaltyReal input 1 available price).symm
  have hgoodCost : penaltyObjective (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) good.val.rule goodLaw (ENNReal.ofReal price) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (g + epsilon) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add ho.1 hepsilon.le]
    simpa only [hgoodValue] using hgoodNear.le
  have hweights := BellmanExpectation.correctMass_add_bayesError input head localLaw test
  by_cases hnonempty : (I.eligible head ∩ available).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨tool, htool, hmin⟩ := exists_badPenaltyReal_minimizer input head available price hnonempty
    obtain ⟨Bad, mBad, badRest⟩ := exists_availablePenaltyObjective_near (input.freshSuffix 1)
      (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) (available.erase tool)
      (ENNReal.ofReal price) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top epsilon hepsilon

noncomputable def bellmanIndependentPolicy {Local Good Bad : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Local] [MeasurableSpace Good] [MeasurableSpace Bad]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (head : I.Stage) (available : Finset I.Tool) (repair : Option I.Tool)
    (test : (input.experiment head).AdmissibleRule Local)
    (good : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available Good)
    (badAvailable : Finset I.Tool)
    (bad : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) badAvailable Bad) :
    AvailablePolicy input (currentRelaxedContract I) (zeroNormalAccounting I) available
      (CombinedSeed Local Good Bad) := by
  let test' : (input.experiment head).AdmissibleRule (CombinedSeed Local Good Bad) :=
    pullbackTest (input.experiment head) test localSeed measurable_localSeed
  let good' : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available (CombinedSeed Local Good Bad) :=
    pullbackAvailable (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
    (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available good goodSeed measurable_goodSeed
  let bad' : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) badAvailable (CombinedSeed Local Good Bad) :=
    pullbackAvailable (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
    (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) badAvailable bad badSeed measurable_badSeed
  exact bellmanHeadThenPolicy input (currentRelaxedContract I) rfl rfl (zeroNormalAccounting I)
    head test' available (bellmanPostHeadRaw input head repair good'.val.rule bad'.val.rule)
    (measurable_bellmanPostHeadRaw input head repair good'.val.rule bad'.val.rule
      good'.val.measurable_rule bad'.val.measurable_rule)

PaperProofs.Common.Native.BellmanExpecta.signature_start: theorem someTool_objective_le (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.BellmanExpecta.full_declaration_source:
theorem someTool_objective_le (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (hdeferred : C.execution = .terminalBarrier) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (localLaw : Measure Local) (goodLaw : Measure Good) (badLaw : Measure Bad)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure localLaw] [IsProbabilityMeasure goodLaw] [IsProbabilityMeasure badLaw]
    (test : (input.experiment head).AdmissibleRule Local) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (tool : I.Tool) (htool : tool ∈ available) (heligible : tool ∈ I.eligible head)
    (good : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available Good)
    (bad : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) (available.erase tool) Bad) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    let test' := pullbackTest (input.experiment head) test
      (localSeed (Good := Good) (Bad := Bad)) measurable_localSeed
    let good' := pullbackAvailable (input.freshSuffix 1) _ _ available good
      (goodSeed (Local := Local) (Bad := Bad)) measurable_goodSeed
    let bad' := pullbackAvailable (input.freshSuffix 1) _ _ (available.erase tool) bad
      (badSeed (Local := Local) (Good := Good)) measurable_badSeed
    penaltyObjective input C .uncapped accounting
      (bellmanHeadThenRule input head test' available
        (bellmanPostHeadRaw input head (some tool) good'.val.rule bad'.val.rule))
      (combinedLaw localLaw goodLaw badLaw) penalty ≤
      (input.experiment head).bayesObservationCharge localLaw test +
        ((localLaw.prod (input.stageLaw head)) (headCorrectGate input head test) *
          penaltyObjective (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
            (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) good.val.rule goodLaw penalty +
        (input.experiment head).bayesError localLaw test *
          penaltyObjective (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
            (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) bad.val.rule badLaw penalty) := by
  intro test' good' bad'
  let after := bellmanPostHeadRaw input head (some tool) good'.val.rule bad'.val.rule
  have hafter : MeasurableRule after :=
    measurable_bellmanPostHeadRaw input head (some tool) good'.val.rule bad'.val.rule
      good'.val.measurable_rule bad'.val.measurable_rule
  have hobs : Measurable (fun sample : CombinedSeed Local Good Bad × input.World =>
      (input.experiment head).observationCharge (test'.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head))) :=
    (measurable_of_countable (input.experiment head).observationCharge).comp
      (test'.measurable_stop.comp
        (measurable_fst.prodMk (((measurable_pi_apply head).comp measurable_snd).snd)))
  rw [penaltyObjective_eq_lintegral_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _
    (measurable_bellmanHeadThenRule input head test' available after hafter)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ sample, (input.experiment head).observationCharge
          (test'.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head)) +
        (if test'.rule.decision sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = input.truthAt sample.2 head then
          runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
            (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) good'.val.rule penalty
            (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input 1 sample.2)
        else runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) bad'.val.rule penalty
          (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input 1 sample.2))
        ∂input.seededWorldLaw (combinedLaw localLaw goodLaw badLaw) := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro sample
      exact bellmanHeadThen_someTool_penaltyCharge_le input C hearly hcurrent hdeferred accounting
        head hhead test' available tool htool heligible good' bad' sample penalty
    _ = _ := by
      rw [lintegral_add_left hobs, headObservation_integral input head localLaw goodLaw badLaw test]
      congr 1
      exact selectedPolicyCharges_integral input head hhead localLaw goodLaw badLaw test
        available (available.erase tool) good bad penalty

theorem noTool_objective_le (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (hdeferred : C.execution = .terminalBarrier) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (localLaw : Measure Local) (goodLaw : Measure Good) (badLaw : Measure Bad)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure localLaw] [IsProbabilityMeasure goodLaw] [IsProbabilityMeasure badLaw]
    (test : (input.experiment head).AdmissibleRule Local) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (good : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available Good)
    (bad : PolicyRule (I.freshSuffix 1) (CombinedSeed Local Good Bad))
    (hbad : MeasurableRule bad) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    let test' := pullbackTest (input.experiment head) test
      (localSeed (Good := Good) (Bad := Bad)) measurable_localSeed
    let good' := pullbackAvailable (input.freshSuffix 1) _ _ available good
      (goodSeed (Local := Local) (Bad := Bad)) measurable_goodSeed
    penaltyObjective input C .uncapped accounting
      (bellmanHeadThenRule input head test' available
        (bellmanPostHeadRaw input head none good'.val.rule bad))
      (combinedLaw localLaw goodLaw badLaw) penalty ≤
      (input.experiment head).bayesObservationCharge localLaw test +
        ((localLaw.prod (input.stageLaw head)) (headCorrectGate input head test) *
          penaltyObjective (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
            (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) good.val.rule goodLaw penalty +
        (input.experiment head).bayesError localLaw test * penalty) := by
  intro test' good'
  let after := bellmanPostHeadRaw input head none good'.val.rule bad
  have hafter : MeasurableRule after :=
    measurable_bellmanPostHeadRaw input head none good'.val.rule bad good'.val.measurable_rule hbad
  have hobs : Measurable (fun sample : CombinedSeed Local Good Bad × input.World =>
      (input.experiment head).observationCharge (test'.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head))) :=
    (measurable_of_countable (input.experiment head).observationCharge).comp
      (test'.measurable_stop.comp
        (measurable_fst.prodMk (((measurable_pi_apply head).comp measurable_snd).snd)))
  rw [penaltyObjective_eq_lintegral_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _
    (measurable_bellmanHeadThenRule input head test' available after hafter)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ sample, (input.experiment head).observationCharge
          (test'.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head)) +
        (if test'.rule.decision sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = input.truthAt sample.2 head then
          runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
            (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) good'.val.rule penalty
            (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input 1 sample.2)
        else penalty) ∂input.seededWorldLaw (combinedLaw localLaw goodLaw badLaw) := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro sample
      exact bellmanHeadThen_noTool_penaltyCharge_le input C hearly hcurrent hdeferred accounting
        head hhead test' available good' bad hbad sample penalty
    _ = _ := by
      rw [lintegral_add_left hobs, headObservation_integral input head localLaw goodLaw badLaw test]
      congr 1
      exact selectedGoodOrPenalty_integral input head hhead localLaw goodLaw badLaw test available good penalty

theorem selectedPolicyCharges_integral (input : StatisticalInput I) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (localLaw : Measure Local) (goodLaw : Measure Good) (badLaw : Measure Bad)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure localLaw] [IsProbabilityMeasure goodLaw] [IsProbabilityMeasure badLaw]
    (test : (input.experiment head).AdmissibleRule Local)
    (goodAvailable badAvailable : Finset (I.freshSuffix 1).Tool)
    (good : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) goodAvailable Good)
    (bad : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) badAvailable Bad) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ sample, if (pullbackTest (input.experiment head) test localSeed measurable_localSeed).rule.decision
        sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = input.truthAt sample.2 head then
        runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1))
          (pullbackAvailable (input.freshSuffix 1) _ _ goodAvailable good goodSeed measurable_goodSeed).val.rule
          penalty (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input 1 sample.2)
      else runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
        (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1))
        (pullbackAvailable (input.freshSuffix 1) _ _ badAvailable bad badSeed measurable_badSeed).val.rule
        penalty (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input 1 sample.2)
      ∂input.seededWorldLaw (combinedLaw localLaw goodLaw badLaw)) =
      (localLaw.prod (input.stageLaw head)) (headCorrectGate input head test) *
        penaltyObjective (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) good.val.rule goodLaw penalty +
      (input.experiment head).bayesError localLaw test *
        penaltyObjective (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) bad.val.rule badLaw penalty := by
  simp only [runPenaltyCharge_pullbackAvailable]
  rw [penaltyObjective_eq_lintegral_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _ good.val.measurable_rule,
    penaltyObjective_eq_lintegral_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _ bad.val.measurable_rule,
    ← wrongMass_eq_bayesError input head localLaw test]
  exact selectedTestBranches_integral input head hhead localLaw goodLaw badLaw test
    _ (measurable_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _ good.val.measurable_rule penalty)
    _ (measurable_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _ bad.val.measurable_rule penalty)

theorem bellmanHeadThen_someTool_penaltyCharge_le {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow) (hdeferred : C.execution = .terminalBarrier)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (test : (input.experiment head).AdmissibleRule Seed) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (tool : I.Tool) (htool : tool ∈ available) (heligible : tool ∈ I.eligible head)
    (good : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available Seed)
    (bad : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) (available.erase tool) Seed)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    runPenaltyCharge input C .uncapped accounting
      (bellmanHeadThenRule input head test available (bellmanPostHeadRaw input head (some tool) good.val.rule bad.val.rule)) penalty sample ≤
      (input.experiment head).observationCharge (test.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head)) +
        (if test.rule.decision sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = input.truthAt sample.2 head then
          runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
            (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) good.val.rule penalty
            (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input 1 sample.2)
        else runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) bad.val.rule penalty
          (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input 1 sample.2)) := by
  classical
  by_cases htop : test.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = ⊤
  · simp only [htop, Statistics.BinaryExperiment.observationCharge_top, top_add, le_top]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp htop
  by_cases hcorrect : test.rule.decision sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = input.truthAt sample.2 head
  · rw [ite_eq_left hcorrect]
    exact bellmanHeadThen_correct_penaltyCharge_le input C hearly hcurrent hdeferred accounting head hhead test available
      (some tool) good bad.val.rule bad.val.measurable_rule sample n hn.symm hcorrect penalty
  · rw [ite_eq_right hcorrect]

theorem bellmanHeadThen_noTool_penaltyCharge_le {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow) (hdeferred : C.execution = .terminalBarrier)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (test : (input.experiment head).AdmissibleRule Seed) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (good : AvailablePolicy (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1))
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) available Seed)
    (bad : PolicyRule (I.freshSuffix 1) Seed) (hbad : MeasurableRule bad)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    runPenaltyCharge input C .uncapped accounting
      (bellmanHeadThenRule input head test available (bellmanPostHeadRaw input head none good.val.rule bad)) penalty sample ≤
      (input.experiment head).observationCharge (test.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head)) +
        (if test.rule.decision sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = input.truthAt sample.2 head then
          runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix 1) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix 1)) .uncapped
            (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix 1)) good.val.rule penalty
            (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input 1 sample.2)
        else penalty) := by
  classical
  by_cases htop : test.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = ⊤
  · simp only [htop, Statistics.BinaryExperiment.observationCharge_top, top_add, le_top]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp htop
  by_cases hcorrect : test.rule.decision sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = input.truthAt sample.2 head
  · rw [ite_eq_left hcorrect]
    exact bellmanHeadThen_correct_penaltyCharge_le input C hearly hcurrent hdeferred accounting head hhead test available
      none good bad hbad sample n hn.symm hcorrect penalty
  · rw [ite_eq_right hcorrect]
    exact (bellmanHeadThen_wrong_noTool_penaltyCharge_eq input C hearly hcurrent hdeferred accounting head hhead test available
      good.val.rule bad good.val.measurable_rule hbad sample n hn.symm hcorrect penalty).le

theorem bellmanHeadSeedSuffix_law {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] :
    (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (bellmanHeadSeedSuffix input head) =
      (ν.prod (input.stageLaw head)).prod (input.freshSuffix 1).worldLaw := by
  have hheadMap : Measurable (fun world : input.World => world head) := measurable_pi_apply head
  have hfresh := input.measurable_restrictFreshWorld 1
  have hw : input.worldLaw.map (fun world => (world head, input.restrictFreshWorld 1 world)) =
      (input.stageLaw head).prod (input.freshSuffix 1).worldLaw := by
    rw [(bellmanHead_independent_freshSuffix input head hhead).map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
      hheadMap.aemeasurable hfresh.aemeasurable,
      input.worldLaw_coordinate, input.restrictFreshWorld_worldLaw]
  have hs : (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (fun sample =>
      (sample.1, (sample.2 head, input.restrictFreshWorld 1 sample.2))) =
      ν.prod ((input.stageLaw head).prod (input.freshSuffix 1).worldLaw) := by
    rw [← hw]
    exact (Measure.map_prod_map ν input.worldLaw measurable_id (hheadMap.prodMk hfresh)).symm.trans
      (by rw [Measure.map_id])
  apply (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc :
    (Seed × input.StageSample head) × (input.freshSuffix 1).World ≃ᵐ
      Seed × input.StageSample head × (input.freshSuffix 1).World).map_measurableEquiv_injective
  rw [Measure.map_map MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.measurable
    (measurable_bellmanHeadSeedSuffix input head), Measure.prodAssoc_prod]
  exact hs

theorem StatisticalInput.penalty_successor_order {I : Instance} (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (stage : I.Stage) (available : Finset I.Tool) (penalty : ℝ) (hpenalty : 0 ≤ penalty) :
    0 ≤ input.goodPenaltyReal stage available penalty ∧
      input.goodPenaltyReal stage available penalty ≤ input.badPenaltyReal stage available penalty ∧
        input.badPenaltyReal stage available penalty ≤ penalty := by
  classical
  refine ⟨input.healthyPenaltyReal_nonneg _ _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold StatisticalInput.badPenaltyReal
    split_ifs with h
    · apply Finset.le_inf'
      intro tool _
      exact input.healthyPenaltyReal_antitone (stage.val + 1) penalty (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
    · exact input.healthyPenaltyReal_le_penalty _ _ _ hpenalty
  · unfold StatisticalInput.badPenaltyReal
    split_ifs with h
    · exact (Finset.inf'_le _ h.choose_spec).trans
        (input.healthyPenaltyReal_le_penalty _ _ _ hpenalty)
    · exact le_rfl

  rule := {
    stop := headExitStop input stage rule
    decision := headExitDecision input stage rule
    stopping := headExitStop_stopping input stage rule

      intro seed tape tape' n hs hs' hp
      simp only [headExitDecision, hs, hs', ENat.toNat_natCast]
      rw [headReviewHistory_prefix input stage tape tape' n hp]
  }
  measurable_stop := measurable_headExitStop input stage rule hm
  measurable_decision := by
    have hn : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × (input.experiment stage).Tape =>

      measurable_from_prod_countable_left (fun n => measurable_headReviewHistory input stage n)
    exact (measurable_of_countable actionWriteBit).comp (hm.comp
      (measurable_fst.prodMk (hh.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk hn))))

PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_eq_headRev.signature_start: theorem run_eq_headReviewState (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.run_eq_headRev.full_declaration_source:
theorem run_eq_headReviewState (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (stage : I.Stage) (hhead : stage.val = 0)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ)
    (hbound : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ headExitStop input stage rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage)) :
    run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n =
      headReviewState input accounting stage (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hnsucc : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (n + 1 : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n
    have hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ headExitStop input stage rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) :=
      hnsucc.trans hbound
    have hr := ih hn
    have haction := headExitStop_prior_review input stage rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) (n + 1) hbound n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    let s := headReviewState input accounting stage (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) n
    have ha : s.halted = false := headReviewState_active input accounting stage _ _ n
    have hl : liveStage s stage := ⟨ha, (headReviewState_cursor input accounting stage _ _ n).trans hhead.symm⟩
    have hw : s.ledger.written stage = none := congrFun (headReviewState_written input accounting stage _ _ n) stage
    have hc : s.ledger.reviews stage = n := headReviewState_reviews input accounting stage _ _ n
    have hsc : s.cursor = 0 := headReviewState_cursor input accounting stage _ _ n
    have hs : Step input C .uncapped accounting (worldTapes input sample.2) s (.review stage)
        (headReviewState input accounting stage (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) (n + 1)) := by
      have h := Step.review (input := input) (C := C) (mode := .uncapped) (accounting := accounting)
        (tapes := worldTapes input sample.2) s stage hl hw (.inl rfl)
      rw [headReviewState]
      simpa only [hc, ENat.toNat_natCast, hsc] using h
    apply run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n _
    · rw [hr]
      exact ha
    · rw [hr, headReviewState_history]
      rw [haction]
      exact hs

PaperProofs.Common.Native.nativeHead_exi.signature_start: theorem nativeHead_exit_classification (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.nativeHead_exi.full_declaration_source:
theorem nativeHead_exit_classification (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting rule)
    (stage : I.Stage) (hhead : stage.val = 0) (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ)
    (hstop : headExitStop input stage rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) = n) :
    (∃ bit, rule sample.1 (headReviewHistory input stage (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) n) = .write stage bit) ∨
      rule sample.1 (headReviewHistory input stage (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) n) = .stop ∨
      rule sample.1 (headReviewHistory input stage (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) n) = .abandon := by
  have hr := run_eq_headReviewState input C accounting rule stage hhead sample n (by rw [hstop])
  obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample n
  have ha : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).halted = false := by rw [hr]; exact headReviewState_active input accounting stage _ _ n
  obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 _ _ m _ hp ha
  have hcursor : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).cursor = 0 := by rw [hr]; exact headReviewState_cursor input accounting stage _ _ n
  have hw : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).ledger.written = fun _ => none := by rw [hr]; exact headReviewState_written input accounting stage _ _ n
  have hreport : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).ledger.reportTime = fun _ => none := by rw [hr]; exact headReviewState_reportTime input accounting stage _ _ n
  have hhistory : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).history =
      headReviewHistory input stage (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) n := by rw [hr]; exact headReviewState_history input accounting stage _ _ n
  rw [hhistory] at hs
  have hnot := headExitStop_hits input stage rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) n hstop
  generalize haction : rule sample.1 (headReviewHistory input stage (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) n) = action at hs hnot ⊢
  cases hs with
  | review current live port resources =>
    have he : current = stage := by apply Fin.ext; have hc := live.2; omega
    subst current
    exact (hnot rfl).elim
  | write current bit live port resources =>
    have he : current = stage := by apply Fin.ext; have hc := live.2; omega
    subst current
    exact .inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩
  | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
    obtain ⟨time, ht⟩ := valid.2.2
    rw [hreport] at ht
    cases ht
  | execute handle tool active valid compatible committed unused uncorrected window resources =>
    obtain ⟨time, ht⟩ := valid.2.2
    rw [hreport] at ht
    cases ht
  | advance current live written resources => exact (written (congrFun hw current)).elim
  | stop active => exact .inr (.inl rfl)
  | abandon active => exact .inr (.inr rfl)

theorem nativeHead_observationCharge_le (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (stage : I.Stage) (hhead : stage.val = 0)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) :
    (input.experiment stage).observationCharge (headExitStop input stage rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage)) ≤
      runObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting rule sample := by
  by_cases htop : headExitStop input stage rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) = ⊤
  · have hb (n : ℕ) : ENNReal.ofReal ((input.experiment stage).observationFee : ℝ) * n ≤
        runObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting rule sample :=
      headReviewPrefix_charge_le input C accounting rule stage hhead sample n (by rw [htop]; exact le_top)
    have hsup := iSup_le hb
    rw [← ENNReal.mul_iSup, ENNReal.iSup_natCast] at hsup
    have hfee : ENNReal.ofReal ((input.experiment stage).observationFee : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (input.experiment stage).observationFee_real_pos)
    simpa only [htop, BinaryExperiment.observationCharge_top, ENNReal.mul_top hfee] using hsup
  · generalize hstop : headExitStop input stage rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) = stop at htop ⊢
    lift stop to ℕ using htop with n
    rw [BinaryExperiment.observationCharge_nat]
    exact headReviewPrefix_charge_le input C accounting rule stage hhead sample n (by rw [hstop])

PaperProofs.Common.Native.bayesObservati.full_declaration_source:
theorem bayesObservationCharge_eq_seededWorld_integral (input : StatisticalInput I) (stage : I.Stage)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (test : (input.experiment stage).AdmissibleRule Seed) :
    (input.experiment stage).bayesObservationCharge ν test =
      ∫⁻ sample, (input.experiment stage).observationCharge
        (test.rule.stop sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 stage)) ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  let E := input.experiment stage
  let f : Seed × E.Tape → ℝ≥0∞ := fun sample => E.observationCharge (test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2)
  have hf : Measurable f := (measurable_of_countable E.observationCharge).comp test.measurable_stop
  let g : input.StageSample stage → ℝ≥0∞ := fun localSample => ∫⁻ seed, f (seed, localSample.2) ∂ν
  have hg : Measurable g := (hf.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst))).lintegral_prod_right'
  have hworld : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World => f (sample.1, worldTapes input sample.2 stage)) :=
    hf.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk ((measurable_pi_apply stage).comp measurable_snd).snd)
  have hp (truth : Bool) :
      (∫⁻ localSample, g localSample ∂(Measure.dirac truth).prod (E.tapeLaw truth)) = E.expectedObservationCharge ν test truth := by
    rw [Measure.dirac_prod, lintegral_map hg measurable_prodMk_left]
    exact (lintegral_prod_symm f hf.aemeasurable).symm
  have hstage : (∫⁻ localSample, g localSample ∂input.stageLaw stage) = E.bayesObservationCharge ν test := by
    rw [StatisticalInput.stageLaw, lintegral_add_measure, lintegral_smul_measure, lintegral_smul_measure]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, BinaryExperiment.bayesObservationCharge, Fintype.sum_bool]
    rw [hp true, hp false]
  symm
  change (∫⁻ sample, f (sample.1, worldTapes input sample.2 stage) ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν) = _
  rw [StatisticalInput.seededWorldLaw, lintegral_prod_symm _ hworld.aemeasurable]
  change (∫⁻ world, g (world stage) ∂input.worldLaw) = _
  rw [← lintegral_map hg (measurable_pi_apply stage), input.worldLaw_coordinate]
  exact hstage

PaperProofs.Common.Native.firstEntry_one.signature_start: theorem firstEntry_one_head_written (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.firstEntry_one.full_declaration_source:
theorem firstEntry_one_head_written (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C mode accounting rule 1 n sample) :
    (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).ledger.written head ≠ none := by
  cases n with
  | zero => have hh := hentry.1; cases hh
  | succ n =>
    have hne := hentry.2 n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    have hcursor := hentry.1
    obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample n
    by_cases hh : (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).halted = true
    · rw [run_succ_of_halted input C mode accounting rule sample n hh] at hcursor
      exact (hne hcursor).elim
    · have ha : (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).halted = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh
      obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 _ _ m _ hp ha
      have hr := run_succ_of_step input C mode accounting rule sample n next ha hs
      rw [hr] at hcursor ⊢
      generalize rule sample.1 (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).history = action at hs
      cases hs <;> try exact (hne hcursor).elim
      case advance current live written resources =>
        have he : current = head := by
          apply Fin.ext
          have hc := live.2
          change (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).cursor + 1 = 1 at hcursor
          omega

theorem prefix_early_written_reported (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I} (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes n s)
    (head : I.Stage) (hw : s.ledger.written head ≠ none) : ∃ time, s.ledger.reportTime head = some time := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => exact (hw rfl).elim
  | @next n s next earlier hs ih =>
    generalize rule seed s.history = action at hs
    cases hs with
    | write current bit live port resources =>
      by_cases he : head = current
      · subst current
        refine ⟨s.clock, ?_⟩
        simp only [record, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, ↓reduceIte, writeLedger, Function.update_self]
      · have hframe : (reportedWriteLedger C s current bit).written head = s.ledger.written head := by
          classical
          simp only [reportedWriteLedger]
          split_ifs; simp only [writeLedger, Function.update_of_ne he]
        have hwold : s.ledger.written head ≠ none := by simpa only [record, hframe] using hw
        obtain ⟨time, ht⟩ := ih hwold
        refine ⟨time, ?_⟩
        simpa only [record, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, ↓reduceIte, writeLedger, Function.update_of_ne he] using ht
    | review | allocate | execute | advance | stop | abandon => exact ih hw

PaperProofs.Common.Native.nativeHead_dec.signature_start: theorem nativeHead_decision_of_written (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.nativeHead_dec.full_declaration_source:
theorem nativeHead_decision_of_written (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting rule) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ) (bit : Bool)
    (hw : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).ledger.written head = some bit) :
    headExitDecision input head rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = bit := by
  obtain ⟨prefixN, hprefixN, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample n
  obtain ⟨writtenN, old, hwlt, holdPrefix, hactive, haction⟩ := prefix_written_has_write input C .uncapped accounting rule sample.1 _ _ hp head bit hw
  have holdRun : run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample writtenN = old :=
    prefix_eq_run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample.1 _ _ holdPrefix
  have hactualWrite : rule sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample writtenN).history = .write head bit := by rw [holdRun]; exact haction
  have hbound := headExitStop_le_of_actual_write input C accounting rule head hhead sample writtenN bit hactualWrite
  generalize hstop : headExitStop input head rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = stop at hbound
  have hfinite : stop ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro he
    rw [he] at hbound
    exact ENat.top_ne_natCast writtenN (top_le_iff.mp hbound).symm
  lift stop to ℕ using hfinite with k
  have hkn : k < n := (ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp hbound).trans_lt (hwlt.trans_le hprefixN)
  have hr := run_eq_headReviewState input C accounting rule head hhead sample k (by rw [hstop])
  have hhistory : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample k).history = headReviewHistory input head (worldTapes input sample.2 head) k := by rw [hr]; exact headReviewState_history input accounting head _ _ k
  rcases nativeHead_exit_classification input C accounting rule hlegal head hhead sample k hstop with ⟨chosen, hwrite⟩ | hterminal
  · have ha : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample k).halted = false := by rw [hr]; exact headReviewState_active input accounting head _ _ k
    obtain ⟨m, _, hpk⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample k
    obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 _ _ m _ hpk ha
    have hactual : rule sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample k).history = .write head chosen := by rw [hhistory]; exact hwrite
    have hnextRun := run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting rule sample k next ha hs
    have hnewWrite : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample (k + 1)).ledger.written head = some chosen := by
      rw [hnextRun]
      rw [hactual] at hs
      cases hs
      classical
      simp only [record, reportedWriteLedger]
      split_ifs <;> simp only [writeLedger, Function.update_self]
    obtain ⟨extra, he⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hkn)
    have hpersist := run_written_some_after input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample (k + 1) extra head chosen hnewWrite
    rw [← he, hw] at hpersist
    have hb : chosen = bit := (Option.some.inj hpersist).symm
    rw [← hb]
    exact headExitDecision_of_write input head rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) k chosen hstop hwrite
  · obtain ⟨extra, he⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hkn.le
    have hno := headExit_terminal_no_future_write input C accounting rule head hhead sample k hstop hterminal extra
    rw [← he, hw] at hno
    cases hno

theorem firstEntry_one_local_correct_iff (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting rule) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C .uncapped accounting rule 1 n sample) :
    HeadCorrectStartup head (publicStartup (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n)) ↔
      headExitDecision input head rule sample.1 (worldTapes input sample.2 head) = input.truthAt sample.2 head := by
  have hwn := firstEntry_one_head_written input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal head hhead sample n hentry
  obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample n
  rw [headCorrectStartup_iff input C hearly .uncapped accounting rule sample.1 _ _ hp head hwn]
  cases hw : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).ledger.written head with
  | none => exact (hwn hw).elim
  | some bit =>
    have hd := nativeHead_decision_of_written input C accounting rule hlegal head hhead sample n bit hw
    rw [run_truth input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample n, hd]
    simp only [Option.some.injEq]

theorem prefix_commitments_usable (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (R : Finset I.Tool)
    (hR : UsesOnly input C accounting rule R) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule seed truth tapes n s) :
    ∀ a ∈ s.ledger.commitments, a.tool ∈ R ∧ a.tool ∈ I.eligible a.handle.stage := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => intro a ha; cases ha
  | @next n s next earlier hs ih =>
    generalize haction : rule seed s.history = action at hs
    cases hs with
    | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
      intro a ha
      change a ∈ s.ledger.commitments ++ [⟨handle, tool, s.clock⟩] at ha
      rcases List.mem_append.mp ha with hold | hnew
      · exact ih a hold
      · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp hnew
        exact ⟨hR seed truth tapes n s earlier active handle tool haction, compatible⟩
    | write current bit live port resources =>
      intro a ha
      exact ih a (by simpa only [record, reportedWrite_commitments_same] using ha)
    | review | execute | advance | stop | abandon => exact ih

theorem firstEntry_one_correct_no_commitments (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C mode accounting rule 1 n sample)
    (hcorrect : (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).ledger.written head =
      some ((run input C mode accounting rule sample n).ledger.truth head)) :
    (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).ledger.commitments = [] := by
  obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample n
  have hinv := prefix_invariant input C mode accounting rule sample.1 _ _ hp
  apply List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
  intro a ha
  have hs := firstEntry_one_commitment_stage input C mode accounting rule hlegal head hhead sample n hentry a ha
  have hg := (hinv.commitment_genuine a ha).1
  rw [hs, hcorrect] at hg
  cases ht : (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).ledger.truth head <;> simp only [ht, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false] at hg
  all_goals cases hg

theorem firstEntry_one_committedTools_singleton (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C mode accounting rule 1 n sample)
    (a : Commitment I) (ha : a ∈ (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).ledger.commitments) :
    committedTools (run input C mode accounting rule sample n) = {a.tool} := by
  classical
  have hwf := run_ledgerWellFormed input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample n
  have hall := firstEntry_one_commitment_stage input C mode accounting rule hlegal head hhead sample n hentry
  have heq (b : Commitment I) (hb : b ∈ (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).ledger.commitments) : b = a :=
    List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hwf.commitment_stages hb ha ((hall b hb).trans (hall a ha).symm)
  ext tool
  simp only [committedTools, Startup.committedTools, publicStartup, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    rw [heq b hb]
  · intro ht
    exact ⟨a, ha, ht.symm⟩

theorem run_unallocated_behind_cursor (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (start extra : ℕ) (head : I.Stage)
    (hold : head.val < (run input C mode accounting rule sample start).cursor)
    (hno : ∀ a ∈ (run input C mode accounting rule sample start).ledger.commitments, a.handle.stage ≠ head) :
    ∀ a ∈ (run input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra)).ledger.commitments, a.handle.stage ≠ head := by
  induction extra with
  | zero => exact hno
  | succ extra ih =>
    by_cases hh : (run input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra)).halted = true
    · rw [Nat.add_succ, run_succ_of_halted input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra) hh]
      exact ih
    · have ha : (run input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra)).halted = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh
      obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample (start + extra)
      obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 _ _ m _ hp ha
      rw [Nat.add_succ, run_succ_of_step input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra) next ha hs]
      have hc := run_cursor_monotone input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample (Nat.le_add_right start extra)
      change (run input C mode accounting rule sample start).cursor ≤ (run input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra)).cursor at hc
      generalize rule sample.1 (run input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra)).history = action at hs
      cases hs with
      | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
        intro a ham
        change a ∈ (run input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra)).ledger.commitments ++ [⟨handle, tool, (run input C mode accounting rule sample (start + extra)).clock⟩] at ham
        rcases List.mem_append.mp ham with hbefore | hnew
        · exact ih a hbefore
        · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp hnew
          intro he
          have hw := window hcurrent
          rw [he] at hw
          omega
      | write current bit live port resources =>
        intro a ham
        exact ih a (by simpa only [record, reportedWrite_commitments_same] using ham)
      | review | execute | advance | stop | abandon => exact ih

theorem wrong_unallocated_behind_cursor_failure (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (start : ℕ) (head : I.Stage)
    (hold : head.val < (run input C mode accounting rule sample start).cursor)
    (hwrong : (run input C mode accounting rule sample start).ledger.written head =
      some (!(run input C mode accounting rule sample start).ledger.truth head))
    (hno : ∀ a ∈ (run input C mode accounting rule sample start).ledger.commitments, a.handle.stage ≠ head) :
    ¬runSuccess input C mode accounting rule sample := by
  rintro ⟨stopped, hhalt, hsuccess⟩
  let now := max start stopped
  obtain ⟨delta, hnowStop⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_max_right start stopped)
  have hstate : run input C mode accounting rule sample now = run input C mode accounting rule sample stopped := by
    change run input C mode accounting rule sample (max start stopped) = _
    rw [hnowStop, run_after_halt input C mode accounting rule sample stopped hhalt delta]
  have hsuccessNow : (run input C mode accounting rule sample now).ledger.success C := by rw [hstate]; exact hsuccess
  obtain ⟨extra, hnowStart⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_max_left start stopped)
  have hwriteNow := run_written_behind_cursor input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample start extra head hold
  have hnoNow := run_unallocated_behind_cursor input C hcurrent mode accounting rule hlegal sample start extra head hold hno
  change max start stopped = start + extra at hnowStart
  rw [← hnowStart] at hwriteNow hnoNow
  have htruth : (run input C mode accounting rule sample now).ledger.truth head =
      (run input C mode accounting rule sample start).ledger.truth head := by
    rw [run_truth input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample now, run_truth input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample start]
  rcases hsuccessNow.2.2.2 head with hright | ⟨e, he, hes⟩
  · rw [hwriteNow, hwrong, htruth] at hright
    cases ht : (run input C mode accounting rule sample start).ledger.truth head <;> simp only [ht, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false] at hright
    all_goals cases hright
  · have hwf := run_ledgerWellFormed input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample now
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hh, _, _⟩ := hwf.backed e he
    exact hnoNow a ha ((congrArg MismatchHandle.stage hh).trans hes)

theorem nativeHead_good_branch_lower (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (R : Finset I.Tool)
    (policy : AvailablePolicy input C accounting R Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0) (n : ℕ) (startup : Startup I) (gate : Set Seed)
    (hgate : MeasurableSet gate)
    (hentry : ∀ sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
      FirstEntryAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule 1 n sample)
    (hcorrect : ∀ sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
      (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.written head =
        some ((run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.truth head))
    (price : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (input.goodPenaltyReal head R price) *
      input.seededWorldLaw ν (historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample in historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
        historyComparisonCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n (ENNReal.ofReal price) sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  classical
  let E := historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate
  by_cases he : E.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨sample, hs⟩ := he
    have hempty := firstEntry_one_correct_no_commitments input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal
      head hhead sample n (hentry sample hs) (hcorrect sample hs)
    have hcomm : startup.committedTools = ∅ := by
      rw [← hs.1]
      simp only [publicStartup, Startup.committedTools, hempty, List.map_nil, List.toFinset_nil]
    have hb := restrictedStageEntryHistoryPenaltyBridge input C hC accounting R policy ν 1 n startup gate hgate hentry (ENNReal.ofReal price)
    rw [hcomm, Finset.sdiff_empty] at hb
    simpa only [StatisticalInput.goodPenaltyReal, hhead, Nat.zero_add, ofReal_healthyPenaltyReal] using hb
  · have hzero : E = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp he
    change ENNReal.ofReal (input.goodPenaltyReal head R price) * input.seededWorldLaw ν E ≤ _
    rw [hzero, measure_empty, mul_zero]
    exact bot_le

theorem nativeHead_allocated_branch_lower (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (R : Finset I.Tool)
    (policy : AvailablePolicy input C accounting R Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0) (n : ℕ) (startup : Startup I) (gate : Set Seed)
    (hgate : MeasurableSet gate)
    (hentry : ∀ sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
      FirstEntryAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule 1 n sample)
    (a : Commitment I) (ha : a ∈ startup.commitments) (price : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (input.badPenaltyReal head R price) *
      input.seededWorldLaw ν (historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample in historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
        historyComparisonCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n (ENNReal.ofReal price) sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  classical
  let E := historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate
  by_cases he : E.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨sample, hs⟩ := he
    have ham : a ∈ (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.commitments := by
      change a ∈ (publicStartup (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n)).commitments
      rw [hs.1]
      exact ha
    obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal sample n
    have htool := prefix_commitments_usable input C accounting policy.val.rule R policy.property sample.1 _ _ hp a ham
    have hstage := firstEntry_one_commitment_stage input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal head hhead sample n (hentry sample hs) a ham
    rw [hstage] at htool
    have hsingleton := firstEntry_one_committedTools_singleton input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal head hhead sample n (hentry sample hs) a ham
    have hcomm : startup.committedTools = {a.tool} := by
      rw [← hs.1]
      exact hsingleton
    have hvalue : ENNReal.ofReal (input.badPenaltyReal head R price) ≤
        input.healthyPenalty 1 (R \ startup.committedTools) (ENNReal.ofReal price) := by
      rw [hcomm, Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]

      simpa only [hhead, Nat.zero_add, ofReal_healthyPenaltyReal] using hb
    exact (mul_le_mul_left hvalue _).trans
      (restrictedStageEntryHistoryPenaltyBridge input C hC accounting R policy ν 1 n startup gate hgate hentry (ENNReal.ofReal price))
  · have hzero : E = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp he
    change ENNReal.ofReal (input.badPenaltyReal head R price) * input.seededWorldLaw ν E ≤ _
    rw [hzero, measure_empty, mul_zero]

theorem nativeHead_unallocated_wrong_branch_lower (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (R : Finset I.Tool)
    (policy : AvailablePolicy input C accounting R Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0) (n : ℕ) (startup : Startup I) (gate : Set Seed)
    (hgate : MeasurableSet gate)
    (hentry : ∀ sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
      FirstEntryAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule 1 n sample)
    (hwrong : ∀ sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
      (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.written head =
        some (!(run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.truth head))
    (hempty : startup.commitments = []) (price : ℝ) (hprice : 0 ≤ price) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (input.badPenaltyReal head R price) *
      input.seededWorldLaw ν (historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample in historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
        historyComparisonCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n (ENNReal.ofReal price) sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  rw [← setLIntegral_const]
  apply setLIntegral_mono' (measurableSet_historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule n startup gate hgate)
  intro sample hs
  have hsourceEmpty : (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.commitments = [] := by
    change (publicStartup (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n)).commitments = []
    rw [hs.1, hempty]
  have hcursor : head.val < (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).cursor := by
    rw [(hentry sample hs).1, hhead]
    exact Nat.zero_lt_one
  have hfailure := wrong_unallocated_behind_cursor_failure input C hC.2 .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule
    policy.val.legal sample n head hcursor (hwrong sample hs) (by intro a ha; rw [hsourceEmpty] at ha; cases ha)
  have hbound : ENNReal.ofReal (input.badPenaltyReal head R price) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal price :=
    ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (input.penalty_successor_order head R price hprice).2.2
  exact hbound.trans (original_failure_penalty_le_comparison input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n (ENNReal.ofReal price) hfailure)

end BranchIntegrals
