theorem nativeHead_entry_branch_lower (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (R : Finset I.Tool)
    (policy : AvailablePolicy input C accounting R Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (head : I.Stage) (hhead : head.val = 0) (n : ℕ) (startup : Startup I) (gate : Set Seed)
    (hgate : MeasurableSet gate)
    (hentry : ∀ sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
      FirstEntryAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule 1 n sample)
    (price : ℝ) (hprice : 0 ≤ price) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (headEntryContinuationReal input head R price startup) *
      input.seededWorldLaw ν (historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample in historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
        historyComparisonCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n (ENNReal.ofReal price) sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  classical
  by_cases hc : HeadCorrectStartup head startup
  · have hcorrect sample (hs : sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate) :
        (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.written head =
          some ((run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.truth head) := by
      have hw := firstEntry_one_head_written input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal head hhead sample n (hentry sample hs)
      obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal sample n
      apply (headCorrectStartup_iff input C hC.1 .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample.1 _ _ hp head hw).mp
      rw [hs.1]
      exact hc
    simpa only [headEntryContinuationReal, hc, ↓reduceIte] using
      nativeHead_good_branch_lower input C hC accounting R policy ν head hhead n startup gate hgate hentry hcorrect price
  · by_cases hempty : startup.commitments = []
    · have hwrong sample (hs : sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate) :
          (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.written head =
            some (!(run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n).ledger.truth head) := by
        have hw := firstEntry_one_head_written input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal head hhead sample n (hentry sample hs)
        obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.legal sample n
        apply optionBool_wrong_of_ne _ _ hw
        intro hcorrect
        apply hc
        rw [← hs.1]
        exact (headCorrectStartup_iff input C hC.1 .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample.1 _ _ hp head hw).mpr hcorrect
      simpa only [headEntryContinuationReal, hc, ↓reduceIte] using
        nativeHead_unallocated_wrong_branch_lower input C hC accounting R policy ν head hhead n startup gate hgate hentry hwrong hempty price hprice
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil startup.commitments hempty
      simpa only [headEntryContinuationReal, hc, ↓reduceIte] using
        nativeHead_allocated_branch_lower input C hC accounting R policy ν head hhead n startup gate hgate hentry a ha price

end BranchMass

theorem exists_prewrite_violation :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ ∃ price : ℝ, 0 < price ∧
      0 < data.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        (historyGate data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) n (startup n) Set.univ) ∧
      (∀ sample ∈ historyGate data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) n (startup n) Set.univ,
        (run data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) sample n).cursor = 0 ∧
        DeadlineViableBefore (contract n)
          (run data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) sample n) 0 ∧
        (run data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) sample n).ledger.written head = none ∧
        (run data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) sample n).ledger.reportTime head = none ∧
        (run data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) sample n).ledger.reviews head = n) ∧
      (∀ sample : Unit × data.World,
        futureObservationBill data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) n sample = 0) ∧
      (∫⁻ sample in historyGate data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) n (startup n) Set.univ,
        historyComparisonCharge data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) n
          (ENNReal.ofReal price) sample ∂data.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) <
        data.healthyPenalty 0 (startup n).availableTools (ENNReal.ofReal price) *
          data.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
            (historyGate data (contract n) .native (zeroNormalAccounting single) (rule n) n (startup n) Set.univ) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, price, hp, hmass⟩ := exists_strict_mass_violation
  refine ⟨n, hn, price, hp, historyGate_positive n, ?_, futureObservationBill_zero n, ?_⟩
  · intro sample _hs
    obtain ⟨hc, hh, hw, hr⟩ := gate_unwritten_healthy n sample
    refine ⟨hc, hh, hw, hr, ?_⟩
    rw [run_before n n le_rfl]
    rfl
  · have htools : (startup n).availableTools = ∅ := by
      let : IsEmpty single.Tool := inferInstanceAs (IsEmpty (Fin 0))
      exact Finset.eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
    rw [htools]
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal price * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ)^n) :=
        comparison_integral_le n (ENNReal.ofReal price)
      _ < data.healthyPenalty 0 ∅ (ENNReal.ofReal price) *
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^n) := hmass
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul' le_rfl (historyGate_measure_lower n)

PaperProofs.Common.Native.stageEntryHist.signature_start: theorem stageEntryHistoryPenaltyBridge_at (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.stageEntryHist.full_declaration_source:
theorem stageEntryHistoryPenaltyBridge_at (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (policy : Policy input C .native accounting Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (next : I.Stage) (n : ℕ) (startup : Startup I) (gate : Set Seed) (hgate : MeasurableSet gate)
    (hentry : ∀ sample ∈ historyGate input C .native accounting policy.rule n startup gate,
      FirstEntryAt input C .native accounting policy.rule next.val n sample)
    (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    input.healthyPenalty next.val startup.availableTools penalty *
      input.seededWorldLaw ν (historyGate input C .native accounting policy.rule n startup gate) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample in historyGate input C .native accounting policy.rule n startup gate,
        historyComparisonCharge input C .native accounting policy.rule n penalty sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  let E := historyGate input C .native accounting policy.rule n startup gate
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw ν
  let record := entrySeedStartupAt input C .native accounting policy.rule next n
  let η := μ.map record
  let A : Set (Seed × Option (Startup I)) := gate ×ˢ {some startup}
  let D : Set ((Seed × Option (Startup I)) × (input.freshSuffix next.val).World) := A ×ˢ Set.univ
  let joint := fun sample : Seed × input.World => (record sample, input.restrictFreshWorld next.val sample.2)
  let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix next.val) startup.availableTools
    (replayedSuffixCandidate next.val accounting policy.rule startup)
  let F := fun pair : (Seed × Option (Startup I)) × (input.freshSuffix next.val).World =>
    runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix next.val) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix next.val)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next.val)) targetRule penalty (pair.1.1, pair.2)
  have hmrecord : Measurable record := measurable_entrySeedStartupAt input C .native accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule next n
  have hmA : MeasurableSet A := hgate.prod (measurableSet_singleton _)
  have hmD : MeasurableSet D := hmA.prod MeasurableSet.univ
  have hmE : MeasurableSet E := measurableSet_historyGate input C .native accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule n startup gate hgate
  have hmjoint : Measurable joint := hmrecord.prodMk ((input.measurable_restrictFreshWorld next.val).comp measurable_snd)
  have hmTarget : MeasurableRule targetRule := measurable_guardedReplayRule _ _
    (measurable_replayedSuffixCandidate next.val accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule startup)
  have hmF : Measurable F := (measurable_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _ hmTarget penalty).comp
    ((measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hmap : μ.map joint = η.prod (input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw :=
    entrySeedStartupAt_jointFreshSuffixLaw input C .native accounting policy ν next n
  have hE : E = record ⁻¹' A := historyGate_eq_entryRecordGate input C .native accounting policy.rule next n startup gate hentry
  have hpre : joint ⁻¹' D = E := by
    rw [hE]
    ext sample
    simp only [joint, D, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, and_true]
  have hmass : η A = μ E := by rw [Measure.map_apply hmrecord hmA, ← hE]
  have hrow (r : Seed × Option (Startup I)) :
      input.healthyPenalty next.val startup.availableTools penalty ≤ ∫⁻ fresh, F (r, fresh) ∂(input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw :=
    healthyPenalty_le_replayedSuffix_dirac input next.val accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule startup r.1 penalty
  change input.healthyPenalty next.val startup.availableTools penalty * μ E ≤ _
  calc
    input.healthyPenalty next.val startup.availableTools penalty * μ E =
        input.healthyPenalty next.val startup.availableTools penalty * η A := by rw [hmass]
    _ = ∫⁻ _r in A, input.healthyPenalty next.val startup.availableTools penalty ∂η := (setLIntegral_const _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ r in A, ∫⁻ fresh, F (r, fresh) ∂(input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw ∂η := lintegral_mono hrow
    _ = ∫⁻ pair in D, F pair ∂η.prod (input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw := by
      rw [setLIntegral_prod F hmF.aemeasurable, Measure.restrict_univ]
    _ = ∫⁻ sample in E, F (joint sample) ∂μ := by
      rw [← hmap, setLIntegral_map hmD hmF hmjoint, hpre]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ sample in E, historyComparisonCharge input C .native accounting policy.rule n penalty sample ∂μ := by
      apply setLIntegral_mono' hmE
      intro sample hs
      have h := replayedSuffix_penaltyCharge_le input C hC.1 hC.2 .native accounting policy.rule policy.legal sample next.val n (hentry sample hs) penalty
      have hstartup : publicStartup (run input C .native accounting policy.rule sample n) = startup := hs.1
      dsimp only at h
      rw [hstartup] at h
      exact h

universe uBridge

theorem entryStartupAt_factorization (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed) (next : I.Stage) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ record : Seed × input.PastWorld next → Option (Startup I),
      Measurable record ∧ ∀ sample : Seed × input.World,
        entryStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule next n sample =
          record (input.preBirthView next sample) := by
  let complete : Seed × input.PastWorld next → Seed × input.World :=
    fun sample => (sample.1, completePastWorld input next sample.2)
  have hm : Measurable complete :=
    measurable_fst.prodMk ((measurable_completePastWorld input next).comp measurable_snd)
  refine ⟨fun sample => entryStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule next n (complete sample),
    (measurable_entryStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule next n).comp hm, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨seed, world⟩
  exact (entryStartupAt_eq_of_past input C mode accounting policy.rule policy.legal seed world
    (completePastWorld input next (fun i => world i.val)) next n
      (fun i hi => completePastWorld_apply_past input next (fun i => world i.val) i hi)).symm

theorem entrySeedStartupAt_jointUnbornLaw (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (next : I.Stage) (n : ℕ) :
    (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (fun sample =>
        (entrySeedStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule next n sample,
          unbornView input next sample.2)) =
      ((input.seededWorldLaw ν).map
        (entrySeedStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule next n)).prod
          (input.worldLaw.map (unbornView input next)) := by
  have hind := entrySeedStartupAt_independent_unborn input C mode accounting policy ν next n
  have hm := measurable_entrySeedStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule
    policy.measurable_rule next n
  have hf : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World => unbornView input next sample.2) :=
    (measurable_unbornView input next).comp measurable_snd
  rw [hind.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hm.aemeasurable hf.aemeasurable,
    seededWorldLaw_unbornView]

theorem entry_snapshot_seedGate_unborn_mass (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (next : I.Stage) (n : ℕ) (startup : Startup I)
    (gate : Set Seed) (hgate : MeasurableSet gate) (futureEvent : Set (UnbornWorld input next))
    (hfutureEvent : MeasurableSet futureEvent) :
    input.seededWorldLaw ν
        ((entrySeedStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule next n) ⁻¹'
          (gate ×ˢ {some startup}) ∩
          (fun sample : Seed × input.World => unbornView input next sample.2) ⁻¹' futureEvent) =
      input.seededWorldLaw ν
          ((entrySeedStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule next n) ⁻¹'
            (gate ×ˢ {some startup})) *
        (input.worldLaw.map (unbornView input next)) futureEvent := by
  have hind := entrySeedStartupAt_independent_unborn input C mode accounting policy ν next n
  rw [hind.measure_inter_preimage_eq_mul (gate ×ˢ {some startup}) futureEvent
    (hgate.prod (measurableSet_singleton _)) hfutureEvent]
  congr 1
  have hm : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World => unbornView input next sample.2) :=
    (measurable_unbornView input next).comp measurable_snd
  rw [← Measure.map_apply hm hfutureEvent, seededWorldLaw_unbornView]

end UnbornFreshness

theorem settleOldExecutions_actual (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (first fuel n : ℕ) :
    let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule fuel sample.1
      (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))
    result.1 = publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)) := by
  induction fuel generalizing n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    generalize hn : silentOldNext first accounting
      (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))
      (rule sample.1 (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)).history) = next
    cases next with
    | none => simp only [settleOldExecutions, hn, Nat.add_zero]
    | some next =>
      have hnext := silentOldNext_actual input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first n next hn
      have ht := ih (n + 1)
      rw [← hnext] at ht
      simp only [settleOldExecutions, hn]
      rw [show n + ((settleOldExecutions first accounting rule fuel sample.1 next).2 + 1) =
        (n + 1) + (settleOldExecutions first accounting rule fuel sample.1 next).2 by omega]
      exact ht

successful internal step consumes a distinct actual execution slot, so no

    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (first n : ℕ) :

      (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))
    silentOldNext first accounting result.1 (rule sample.1 result.1.history) = none := by
  let start := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)
  let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1 start
  have hr : result.1 = publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)) :=
    settleOldExecutions_actual input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first (I.toolCount + 1) n
  have hlen : result.1.executions.length ≤ I.toolCount := by
    rw [hr]
    exact (run_actualCorrections_le input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample (n + result.2)).trans
      (min_le_right _ _)

    settleOldExecutions_execution_count first accounting rule _ sample.1 start
  apply settleOldExecutions_stops_of_count_lt
  change result.2 < I.toolCount + 1
  omega

theorem suffixActionAtPublicCache_actual (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (hC : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (first n : ℕ)
    (history : List (VisibleEvent (I.freshSuffix first)))
    (hcursor : first ≤ (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).cursor)
    (hactive : (settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1
      (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))).1.halted = false) :
    let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1
      (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))
    ∃ next : State I,
      Step input C mode accounting (worldTapes input sample.2)
        (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2))
        (rule sample.1 result.1.history) next ∧
      suffixActionOf first history (rule sample.1 result.1.history) =
        some (suffixActionAtPublicCache first accounting rule sample.1
          (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)) history) := by
  let start := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)
  let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1 start
  have hr : result.1 = publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)) :=
    settleOldExecutions_actual input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first _ n
  have ha : (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)).halted = false := by
    change result.1.halted = false at hactive
    rw [hr] at hactive
    exact hactive
  obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample (n + result.2)
  obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 _ _ m _ hp ha
  have hnone : silentOldNext first accounting result.1 (rule sample.1 result.1.history) = none :=
    settleOldExecutions_actual_stops input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first n
  have hreq : oldExecutionRequest first (rule sample.1 result.1.history) = none := by
    change result.1.halted = false at hactive
    simpa only [silentOldNext, hactive, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
      Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hnone
  have hc : first ≤ (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)).cursor :=
    hcursor.trans (run_cursor_monotone input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample (Nat.le_add_right n result.2))
  have hs' : Step input C mode accounting (worldTapes input sample.2)
      (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2))
      (rule sample.1 result.1.history) next := by
    rw [hr]
    exact hs
  obtain ⟨action, haction⟩ := suffixActionOf_exists_of_step input C mode accounting _ hC first history hc hs' hreq
  refine ⟨next, hs', ?_⟩
  change suffixActionOf first history (rule sample.1 result.1.history) =
    some (if result.1.halted then .stop else
      (suffixActionOf first history (rule sample.1 result.1.history)).getD .abandon)
  rw [hactive, haction]
  rfl

end CacheExtraction

    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (next : I.Stage) (n : Nat) (startup : Startup I)
    (gate : Set Seed) (hgate : MeasurableSet gate)
    (futureEvent : Set (input.freshSuffix next.val).World) (hfuture : MeasurableSet futureEvent) :
    input.seededWorldLaw ν
        ((entrySeedStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule next n) ⁻¹' (gate ×ˢ {some startup}) ∩

      input.seededWorldLaw ν
          ((entrySeedStartupAt input C mode accounting policy.rule next n) ⁻¹' (gate ×ˢ {some startup})) *

theorem entryHistorySeedRecord_independent_freshSuffix (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (next : I.Stage) :
    IndepFun (entryHistorySeedRecord input C mode accounting policy.rule next)
      (fun sample : Seed × input.World => input.restrictFreshWorld next.val sample.2)
        (input.seededWorldLaw ν) := by
  let complete : Seed × input.PastWorld next → Seed × input.World :=
    fun sample => (sample.1, completePastWorld input next sample.2)
  have hc : Measurable complete := measurable_fst.prodMk
    ((measurable_completePastWorld input next).comp measurable_snd)
  let joint : Seed × input.PastWorld next → Seed × EntryHistory I :=
    fun sample => (sample.1, entryHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next (complete sample))
  have hm : Measurable joint := measurable_fst.prodMk
    ((measurable_entryHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule next).comp hc)
  have heq : entryHistorySeedRecord input C mode accounting policy.rule next =
      fun sample => joint (input.preBirthView next sample) := by
    funext sample
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact (entryHistory_eq_of_past input C mode accounting policy.rule policy.legal sample.1 sample.2
        (completePastWorld input next (fun i => sample.2 i.val)) next
        (fun i hi => completePastWorld_apply_past input next (fun i => sample.2 i.val) i hi)).symm
  have hind := (preBirthView_independent_unborn input ν next).comp hm
    (measurable_renumberFutureWorld input next.val)
  have hf : (fun sample : Seed × input.World => input.restrictFreshWorld next.val sample.2) =
      renumberFutureWorld input next.val ∘ (fun sample : Seed × input.World => unbornView input next sample.2) := by
    funext sample
    exact restrictFreshWorld_eq_renumberFutureWorld input next.val sample.2
  rw [heq, hf]
  exact hind

theorem pastEntryGate_sourcePrefix (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (next : I.Stage) (n : ℕ)
    (startup : Startup I) (gate : Set Seed) (sample : Seed × PastWorldAt input next.val)
    (hgate : sample ∈ pastEntryGate input C mode accounting rule next n startup gate)
    (fresh : (input.freshSuffix next.val).World) :
    let world := joinPastFresh input next.val sample.2 fresh
    ∃ m ≤ n, Prefix input C mode accounting rule sample.1 (input.truthAt world) (worldTapes input world) m
      (startup.restore (input.truthAt world)) := by
  let world := joinPastFresh input next.val sample.2 fresh
  obtain ⟨_, hs, _⟩ := pastEntryGate_firstEntry input C mode accounting rule hlegal next n startup gate sample hgate fresh
  change publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule (sample.1, world) n) = startup at hs
  obtain ⟨m, hmn, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal (sample.1, world) n
  have htruth := run_truth input C mode accounting rule hlegal (sample.1, world) n
  have hstate : run input C mode accounting rule (sample.1, world) n = startup.restore (input.truthAt world) := by
    calc
      _ = (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule (sample.1, world) n)).restore
          (run input C mode accounting rule (sample.1, world) n).ledger.truth := (restore_publicStartup _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hs, htruth]
  rw [hstate] at hp
  exact ⟨m, hmn, hp⟩

PaperProofs.Common.Native.replaySuffixPa.full_declaration_source:
theorem replaySuffixPacket_actual (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) {Seed : Type*}
    (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (first n clock : ℕ)
    (before : List (VisibleEvent (I.freshSuffix first)))
    (hcursor : first ≤ (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).cursor)
    (hactive : (settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1
      (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))).1.halted = false) :
    let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1
      (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))
    ∃ (next : State I) (packet : SuffixPacket I) (lowered : SuffixPacket (I.freshSuffix first)),
      Step input C mode accounting (worldTapes input sample.2)
        (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)) (rule sample.1 result.1.history) next ∧
      packet.action = rule sample.1 result.1.history ∧
      next.history = (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)).history ++ packet.events ∧
      packet.lower first clock before = some lowered ∧
      replaySuffixPacket first accounting rule sample.1 (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))
        before lowered = some (publicStartup next) := by
  let start := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)
  let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1 start
  have hr : result.1 = publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)) :=
    settleOldExecutions_actual input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first _ n
  obtain ⟨next, hs, haction⟩ := suffixActionAtPublicCache_actual input C mode accounting rule hlegal hcurrent
    sample first n before hcursor hactive
  obtain ⟨packet, ha, hh, hupdate⟩ := nativeStep_suffixPacket input C hearly mode accounting _ hs
  have hproject := SuffixPacket.lower_action first clock before packet
  cases hlower : packet.lower first clock before with
  | none =>
    rw [hlower, Option.map_none, ha, haction] at hproject
    cases hproject
  | some lowered =>
    refine ⟨next, packet, lowered, hs, ha, hh, hlower, ?_⟩
    have hmatch : suffixActionOf first before (rule sample.1 result.1.history) = some lowered.action := by
      rw [hlower, Option.map_some, ha] at hproject
      exact hproject.symm
    have hup : applySuffixPacketPublic accounting result.1 (rule sample.1 result.1.history) lowered =
        some (publicStartup next) := by
      rw [← ha, applySuffixPacketPublic_lower accounting result.1 first clock before packet lowered hlower, hr]
      rw [← ha] at hupdate
      exact hupdate
    change result.1.halted = false at hactive
    change (if result.1.halted then none else
      if suffixActionOf first before (rule sample.1 result.1.history) = some lowered.action then
        applySuffixPacketPublic accounting result.1 (rule sample.1 result.1.history) lowered else none) = _
    rw [hactive]
    simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, hmatch, ↓reduceIte] using hup

    (hsourceTruth : source.ledger.truth = input.truthAt world)
    (htargetTruth : target.ledger.truth =
      (input.freshSuffix first).truthAt (input.restrictFreshWorld first world))
    (hcounts : ∀ stage (hf : first ≤ stage.val),
      target.ledger.reviews (suffixStageOf first stage hf) = source.ledger.reviews stage) :

  · intro stage hf

theorem replaySuffixPacket_real_target (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} (first : ℕ) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed)
    (world : input.World) (cache : Startup I)
    (source sourceNext : State I) (target targetNext : State (I.freshSuffix first))
    (targetAction : Action (I.freshSuffix first))
    (hsettled : (settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) seed cache).1 = publicStartup source)
    (hactive : source.halted = false)
    (hsource : Step input C mode accounting (worldTapes input world) source (rule seed source.history) sourceNext)
    (htarget : Step (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first))
      (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix first) (input.restrictFreshWorld first world)) target targetAction targetNext)
    (haction : suffixActionOf first target.history (rule seed source.history) = some targetAction)
    (hsourceTruth : source.ledger.truth = input.truthAt world)
    (htargetTruth : target.ledger.truth =
      (input.freshSuffix first).truthAt (input.restrictFreshWorld first world))
    (hcounts : ∀ stage (hf : first ≤ stage.val),
      target.ledger.reviews (suffixStageOf first stage hf) = source.ledger.reviews stage) :
    ∃ packet : SuffixPacket (I.freshSuffix first),
      targetNext.history = target.history ++ packet.events ∧
      replaySuffixPacket first accounting rule seed cache target.history packet = some (publicStartup sourceNext) := by
  let packet := responsePacket (input.freshSuffix first)
    (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix first) (input.restrictFreshWorld first world)) target targetAction
  refine ⟨packet, step_history_responsePacket _ _ rfl _ _ _ htarget, ?_⟩
  have hlower := responsePacket_lower_world input first world source target (rule seed source.history) targetAction
    haction hsourceTruth htargetTruth hcounts
  have hup := applySuffixPacketPublic_lower accounting (publicStartup source) first target.clock target.history
    (responsePacket input (worldTapes input world) source (rule seed source.history)) packet hlower
  rw [responsePacket_action] at hup
  have hresponse := step_publicStartup_responsePacket input C hearly mode accounting _ hsource
  unfold replaySuffixPacket
  rw [hsettled]
  change (if source.halted then none else
    if suffixActionOf first target.history (rule seed source.history) = some packet.action then
      applySuffixPacketPublic accounting (publicStartup source) (rule seed source.history) packet else none) = _
  rw [hactive]
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  have hpaction : packet.action = targetAction := responsePacket_action _ _ _ _
  rw [hpaction, haction]
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  exact hup.trans hresponse

end PaperProofs.Common.Native

theorem HistorySuffixStateView.step (input : StatisticalInput I) (first : ℕ)
    (C : Contract I) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (sourceTapes : ReviewTapes input)
    (targetTapes : ReviewTapes (input.freshSuffix first))
    {Seed : Type*} (targetRule : PolicyRule (I.freshSuffix first) Seed) (seed : Seed)
    (targetTruth : (I.freshSuffix first).Stage → Bool)
    {n : ℕ} {source sourceNext : State I} {target : State (I.freshSuffix first)}
    (hp : Prefix (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule seed targetTruth targetTapes n target)
    (view : HistorySuffixStateView input first source target)
    {action : Action I} {targetAction : Action (I.freshSuffix first)}
    (haction : suffixActionOf first target.history action = some targetAction)
    (hs : Step input C mode accounting sourceTapes source action sourceNext) :
    ∃ targetNext, Step (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetTapes target targetAction targetNext := by
  have hactive (ha : source.halted = false) : target.halted = false := view.halted.symm.trans ha
  have hlive (stage : I.Stage) (hf : first ≤ stage.val) (hl : liveStage source stage) :
      liveStage target (suffixStageOf first stage hf) := by
    refine ⟨hactive hl.1, ?_⟩
    have hc := view.cursor
    have hs : source.cursor = stage.val := hl.2
    change target.cursor = stage.val - first
    omega
  have hvalid (handle : MismatchHandle I) (hf : first ≤ handle.stage.val)
      (hv : validHandle source handle) : validHandle target (suffixHandleOf first target.history handle hf) :=
    suffixHandleOf_valid_of_prefix input first _ .uncapped _ targetRule seed targetTruth targetTapes hp
      source handle hf hv (view.written handle.stage hf) (view.truth handle.stage hf)
      (view.reported handle.stage hf hv.2.2)
  have hcompatible (stage : I.Stage) (hf : first ≤ stage.val) (tool : I.Tool)
      (hm : tool ∈ I.eligible stage) : tool ∈ (I.freshSuffix first).eligible (suffixStageOf first stage hf) := by
    rw [I.freshSuffix_eligible, freshStageLift_suffixStageOf]
    exact hm
  cases hs with
  | review stage live port resources =>
    simp only [suffixActionOf] at haction
    split at haction
    next hf =>
      cases haction
      exact ⟨_, .review target _ (hlive stage hf live) ((view.written stage hf).trans port) (.inl rfl)⟩
    next hf => cases haction
  | write stage bit live port resources =>
    simp only [suffixActionOf] at haction
    split at haction
    next hf =>
      cases haction
      exact ⟨_, .write target _ bit (hlive stage hf live) ((view.written stage hf).trans port) (.inl rfl)⟩
    next hf => cases haction
  | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
    simp only [suffixActionOf] at haction
    split at haction
    next hf =>
      cases haction
      have hu : ∀ b ∈ target.ledger.commitments, b.tool ≠ tool := by
        intro b hb heq
        obtain ⟨a, ha, _, ht⟩ := view.commitments_reverse b hb
        exact unused a ha (ht.trans heq)
      have hs : ∀ b ∈ target.ledger.commitments,
          b.handle.stage ≠ (suffixHandleOf first target.history handle hf).stage := by
        intro b hb heq
        obtain ⟨a, ha, hstage, _⟩ := view.commitments_reverse b hb
        apply unallocated a ha
        rw [hstage, heq]
        exact freshStageLift_suffixStageOf first handle.stage hf
      refine ⟨_, .allocate target _ tool (hactive active) (hvalid handle hf valid)
        (hcompatible handle.stage hf tool compatible) hu hs ?_ (.inl rfl)⟩
      intro _
      have hsource : source.cursor = handle.stage.val := window hcurrent
      have hc := view.cursor
      change target.cursor = handle.stage.val - first
      omega
    next hf => cases haction
  | execute handle tool active valid compatible committed unused uncorrected window resources =>
    simp only [suffixActionOf] at haction
    split at haction
    next hf =>
      cases haction
      have hc : ∃ b ∈ target.ledger.commitments,
          b.handle = suffixHandleOf first target.history handle hf ∧ b.tool = tool := by
        obtain ⟨a, ha, hh, ht⟩ := committed
        obtain ⟨b, hb, bh, bt⟩ := view.commitments_forward a ha (by simpa only [hh] using hf)
        exact ⟨b, hb, by simpa only [hh] using bh, bt.trans ht⟩
      have hu : ∀ b ∈ target.ledger.executions, b.tool ≠ tool := by
        intro b hb heq
        obtain ⟨a, ha, _, ht⟩ := view.executions_reverse b hb
        exact unused a ha (ht.trans heq)
      have hs : ∀ b ∈ target.ledger.executions,
          b.handle.stage ≠ (suffixHandleOf first target.history handle hf).stage := by
        intro b hb heq
        obtain ⟨a, ha, hstage, _⟩ := view.executions_reverse b hb
        apply uncorrected a ha
        rw [hstage, heq]
        exact freshStageLift_suffixStageOf first handle.stage hf
      refine ⟨_, .execute target _ tool (hactive active) (hvalid handle hf valid)
        (hcompatible handle.stage hf tool compatible) hc hu hs ?_ (.inl rfl)⟩
      intro hcurrent
      cases hcurrent
    next hf => cases haction
  | advance stage live written resources =>
    simp only [suffixActionOf] at haction
    split at haction
    next hf =>
      cases haction
      exact ⟨_, .advance target _ (hlive stage hf live)
        (by rw [view.written stage hf]; exact written) (.inl rfl)⟩
    next hf => cases haction
  | stop active => cases haction; exact ⟨_, .stop target (hactive active)⟩
  | abandon active => cases haction; exact ⟨_, .abandon target (hactive active)⟩

theorem replayAllowsAction_complete (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s next : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes n s)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) {action : Action I}
    (hs : Step input C mode accounting tapes s action next)
    (havailable : ∀ handle tool, action = .allocate handle tool → tool ∈ available) :
    replayAllowsAction available s.history action := by
  cases hs with
  | review stage live port resources =>
    change historyCursor s.history = stage.val ∧ historyWritten s.history stage = none
    rw [prefix_historyCursor input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp,
      prefix_historyWritten input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp stage]
    exact ⟨live.2, port⟩
  | write stage bit live port resources =>
    change historyCursor s.history = stage.val ∧ historyWritten s.history stage = none
    rw [prefix_historyCursor input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp,
      prefix_historyWritten input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp stage]
    exact ⟨live.2, port⟩
  | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
    refine ⟨havailable handle tool rfl, ?_,
      replayValidHandle_complete input C hearly mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp handle valid,
      compatible, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [prefix_historyCursor input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp]
      exact window hcurrent
    · apply (prefix_historyUnused_iff input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp tool).mpr
      exact unused
    · intro pair hm
      rw [prefix_historyCommitments input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp] at hm
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
      exact unallocated a ha
  | execute handle tool active valid compatible committed unused uncorrected window resources =>
    refine ⟨replayValidHandle_complete input C hearly mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp handle valid,
      compatible, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [prefix_historyCommitments input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp]
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hh, ht⟩ := committed
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, by rw [hh, ht]⟩
    · intro pair hm
      rw [prefix_historyExecutions input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp] at hm
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
      exact unused e he
    · intro pair hm
      rw [prefix_historyExecutions input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp] at hm
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
      exact uncorrected e he
  | advance stage live written resources =>
    change historyCursor s.history = stage.val ∧ historyWritten s.history stage ≠ none
    rw [prefix_historyCursor input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp,
      prefix_historyWritten input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp stage]
    exact ⟨live.2, written⟩
  | stop active => exact True.intro
  | abandon active => exact True.intro

theorem guardedReplayRule_eq_of_step (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} (rule raw : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s next : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes n s)
    (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (hs : Step input C mode accounting tapes s (raw seed s.history) next)
    (havailable : ∀ handle tool, raw seed s.history = .allocate handle tool → tool ∈ available) :
    guardedReplayRule available raw seed s.history = raw seed s.history := by
  have ha := replayAllowsAction_complete input C hearly hcurrent mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp available hs havailable
  simp only [guardedReplayRule, ha, ↓reduceIte]

theorem historySuffixStateView_firstEntry (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (first n : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C mode accounting rule first n sample) :
    HistorySuffixStateView input first (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)
      (initial ((input.freshSuffix first).truthAt (input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2))) := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hfuture⟩ := firstEntryAt_unborn input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first n hentry
  obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample n
  have hinv := prefix_invariant input C mode accounting rule sample.1 _ _ hp
  have htruth := prefix_truth input C mode accounting rule sample.1 _ _ hp
  constructor
  · simpa only [initial, Nat.add_zero] using hentry.1
  · exact ha
  · intro stage hf
    change (input.freshSuffix first).truthAt (input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2)
        (suffixStageOf first stage hf) = _
    rw [restrictFreshWorld_truth, freshStageLift_suffixStageOf, htruth]
  · intro stage hf
    exact (hfuture stage hf).1.symm
  · intro stage hf
    exact (hfuture stage hf).2.symm
  · intro stage hf ⟨time, ht⟩
    exact (hinv.report_written stage time ht (hfuture stage hf).1).elim
  · intro a ha hf
    have hg := (hinv.commitment_genuine a ha).1
    rw [(hfuture a.handle.stage hf).1] at hg
    cases hg
  · intro b hb
    cases hb
  · intro b hb
    cases hb

theorem HistorySuffixStateView.settleOld (input : StatisticalInput I) (first : ℕ)
    (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (fuel n : ℕ) (target : State (I.freshSuffix first))
    (view : HistorySuffixStateView input first (run input C mode accounting rule sample n) target) :
    let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule fuel sample.1
      (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))
    HistorySuffixStateView input first (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2)) target := by
  induction fuel generalizing n with
  | zero => simpa only [settleOldExecutions, Nat.add_zero] using view
  | succ fuel ih =>
    generalize hn : silentOldNext first accounting (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n))
      (rule sample.1 (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)).history) = next
    cases next with
    | none => simpa only [settleOldExecutions, hn, Nat.add_zero] using view
    | some next =>
      obtain ⟨ha, handle, tool, haction, hold, hnext⟩ :=
        (silentOldNext_some_iff first accounting _ next _).mp hn
      obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample n
      obtain ⟨sourceNext, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 _ _ m _ hp ha
      have hr := run_succ_of_step input C mode accounting rule sample n sourceNext ha hs
      change rule sample.1 (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).history = .execute handle tool at haction
      have hv : HistorySuffixStateView input first (run input C mode accounting rule sample (n + 1)) target := by
        rw [hr]
        rw [haction] at hs
        cases hs
        exact view.executeOld input first accounting handle tool hold ha
      have ht := ih (n + 1) hv
      have hnActual := silentOldNext_actual input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first n next hn
      rw [← hnActual] at ht
      simp only [settleOldExecutions, hn]
      rw [show n + ((settleOldExecutions first accounting rule fuel sample.1 next).2 + 1) =
        (n + 1) + (settleOldExecutions first accounting rule fuel sample.1 next).2 by omega]
      exact ht

PaperProofs.Common.Native.HistorySuffixS.full_declaration_source:
theorem HistorySuffixStateView.next (input : StatisticalInput I) (first : ℕ)
    (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (sourceTapes : ReviewTapes input)
    (targetTapes : ReviewTapes (input.freshSuffix first))
    {source sourceNext : State I} {target targetNext : State (I.freshSuffix first)}
    (hinv : Invariant C source)
    (view : HistorySuffixStateView input first source target)
    {action : Action I} {targetAction : Action (I.freshSuffix first)}
    (haction : suffixActionOf first target.history action = some targetAction)
    (hs : Step input C mode accounting sourceTapes source action sourceNext)
    (ht : Step (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetTapes target targetAction targetNext) :
    HistorySuffixStateView input first sourceNext targetNext := by
  cases hs with
  | review stage live port resources =>
    simp only [suffixActionOf] at haction
    split at haction
    next hf =>
      cases haction
      cases ht
      apply view.frame input first
      · exact view.cursor
      · rfl
      · exact view.truth
      · exact view.written
      · intro future hfuture
        change Function.update target.ledger.reviews (suffixStageOf first stage hf)
          (target.ledger.reviews (suffixStageOf first stage hf) + 1) (suffixStageOf first future hfuture) =
          Function.update source.ledger.reviews stage (source.ledger.reviews stage + 1) future
        simp only [Function.update_apply, suffixStageOf_eq_iff]
        split <;> simp_all only [view.reviews]
      · exact view.reported
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · intro a _ hfuture
        apply suffixHandleOf_append_noWrite
        rfl
    next hf => cases haction
  | write stage bit live port resources =>
    simp only [suffixActionOf] at haction
    split at haction
    next hf =>
      cases haction
      cases ht
      apply view.frame input first
      · exact view.cursor
      · rfl
      · intro future hfuture
        simp only [record, reportedWriteLedger_truth]
        exact view.truth future hfuture
      · intro future hfuture
        simp only [record, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, currentRelaxedContract, ↓reduceIte, writeLedger]
        simp only [Function.update_apply, suffixStageOf_eq_iff]
        split <;> simp_all only [view.written]
      · simpa only [record, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, currentRelaxedContract, ↓reduceIte, writeLedger] using view.reviews
      · intro future hfuture hreported
        change ∃ t, (reportedWriteLedger (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) target
          (suffixStageOf first stage hf) bit).reportTime (suffixStageOf first future hfuture) = some t
        simp only [record, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, currentRelaxedContract, ↓reduceIte, writeLedger] at hreported ⊢
        simp only [Function.update_apply, suffixStageOf_eq_iff] at hreported ⊢
        split at hreported
        next heq => subst future; exact ⟨target.clock, by simp only [↓reduceIte]⟩
        next hne =>
          simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte]
          exact view.reported future hfuture hreported
      · simp only [record, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, ↓reduceIte, writeLedger]
      · rfl
      · simp only [record, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, ↓reduceIte, writeLedger]
      · rfl
      · intro a ha hfuture
        apply suffixHandleOf_append_noWrite
        have hne := hinv.commitment_ne_open port ha
        have hd : suffixStageOf first stage hf ≠ suffixStageOf first a.handle.stage hfuture := by
          intro he
          exact hne ((suffixStageOf_eq_iff first stage a.handle.stage hf hfuture).mp he).symm
        simp only [writeResponses, currentRelaxedContract, ↓reduceIte, writeLedger,
          List.singleton_append, List.filterMap_cons, List.filterMap_nil, eventWrite, hd, ↓reduceIte]
    next hf => cases haction
  | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
    simp only [suffixActionOf] at haction
    split at haction
    next hf =>
      cases haction
      cases ht
      constructor
      · exact view.cursor
      · rfl
      · exact view.truth
      · exact view.written
      · exact view.reviews
      · exact view.reported
      · intro a ha hfuture
        change a ∈ source.ledger.commitments ++ [⟨handle, tool, source.clock⟩] at ha
        rcases List.mem_append.mp ha with hold | hnew
        · obtain ⟨b, hb, hh, ht⟩ := view.commitments_forward a hold hfuture

theorem replayedSuffix_fullRun (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (first start : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C mode accounting rule first start sample) :
    let startup := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
    let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools (replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup)
    let targetSample := (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2)
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      HistorySuffixStateView input first
        (run input C mode accounting rule sample (replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k))
        (run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k) ∧
      replaySuffixHistory first accounting rule sample.1 startup
        (run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k).history =
        some (publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample
          (replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k))) := by
  let startup := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
  let raw := replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup
  let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools raw
  let targetSample := (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2)
  let sourceAt := fun n => run input C mode accounting rule sample n
  let targetAt := fun k => run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
    (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k
  have htargetLegal : LegalRule (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule := guardedReplayRule_legal _ _ rfl rfl _ _ raw
  change ∀ k, HistorySuffixStateView input first (sourceAt (replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k)) (targetAt k) ∧
    replaySuffixHistory first accounting rule sample.1 startup (targetAt k).history =
      some (publicStartup (sourceAt (replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k)))
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨historySuffixStateView_firstEntry input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first start hentry, rfl⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    let n := replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k
    let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1 (publicStartup (sourceAt n))
    change HistorySuffixStateView input first (sourceAt n) (targetAt k) ∧
      replaySuffixHistory first accounting rule sample.1 startup (targetAt k).history = some (publicStartup (sourceAt n)) at ih
    have hclock : replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start (k + 1) =
        if (sourceAt n).halted then n else n + result.2 + 1 := rfl
    rw [hclock]
    cases hh : (sourceAt n).halted with
    | true =>
      have ht : (targetAt k).halted = true := ih.1.halted.symm.trans hh
      have hr := run_succ_of_halted (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first))
        .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k ht
      change targetAt (k + 1) = targetAt k at hr
      simp only [↓reduceIte, hr]
      exact ih
    | false =>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      have htargetActive : (targetAt k).halted = false := ih.1.halted.symm.trans hh
      have hr : result.1 = publicStartup (sourceAt (n + result.2)) :=
        settleOldExecutions_actual input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first _ n
      have hresultActive : result.1.halted = false :=
        (settleOldExecutions_halted first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1 (publicStartup (sourceAt n))).trans hh
      have hsettledActive : (sourceAt (n + result.2)).halted = false := by rw [hr] at hresultActive; exact hresultActive
      have hcursor : first ≤ (sourceAt n).cursor := by have hc := ih.1.cursor; omega
      have hview : HistorySuffixStateView input first (sourceAt (n + result.2)) (targetAt k) :=
        ih.1.settleOld input first C mode accounting rule hlegal sample (I.toolCount + 1) n (targetAt k)
      obtain ⟨sourceNext, hs, hproject⟩ := suffixActionAtPublicCache_actual input C mode accounting rule hlegal hcurrent
        sample first n (targetAt k).history hcursor hresultActive
      have hraw : raw sample.1 (targetAt k).history = suffixActionAtPublicCache first accounting rule sample.1
          (publicStartup (sourceAt n)) (targetAt k).history := by
        change (match replaySuffixHistory first accounting rule sample.1 startup (targetAt k).history with
          | none => (Action.abandon : Action (I.freshSuffix first)) | some cache => suffixActionAtPublicCache first accounting rule sample.1 cache (targetAt k).history) = _
        rw [ih.2]
      have hprojectRaw : suffixActionOf first (targetAt k).history (rule sample.1 result.1.history) =
          some (raw sample.1 (targetAt k).history) := by rw [hraw]; exact hproject
      change Step input C mode accounting (worldTapes input sample.2) (sourceAt (n + result.2))
        (rule sample.1 result.1.history) sourceNext at hs
      rw [hr] at hs hprojectRaw
      obtain ⟨targetPrefixN, _, targetPrefix⟩ := run_has_prefix (input.freshSuffix first)
        (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first))
        targetRule htargetLegal targetSample k
      obtain ⟨targetNext, ht⟩ := hview.step input first C hcurrent mode accounting (worldTapes input sample.2)
        (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix first) targetSample.2) targetRule sample.1 _ targetPrefix hprojectRaw hs
      have havailable : ∀ handle tool, raw sample.1 (targetAt k).history = .allocate handle tool → tool ∈ startup.availableTools := by
        intro handle tool ha
        have hp := hprojectRaw
        rw [ha] at hp
        obtain ⟨sourceHandle, hsourceAction⟩ := suffixActionOf_allocate_source first (targetAt k).history _ handle tool hp
        have halloc : Step input C mode accounting (worldTapes input sample.2) (sourceAt (n + result.2))
            (.allocate sourceHandle tool) sourceNext := by rw [← hsourceAction]; exact hs
        exact allocated_tool_available_at_saved_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample start (n + result.2)
          (by have hn := replaySourceClock_ge_start input C mode accounting rule sample first start k; change start ≤ n at hn; omega)
          sourceHandle tool halloc
      have hguard := guardedReplayRule_eq_of_step (input.freshSuffix first)
        (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) rfl rfl .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first))
        targetRule raw sample.1 _ _ targetPrefix startup.availableTools ht havailable
      have htargetPolicy : targetRule sample.1 (targetAt k).history = raw sample.1 (targetAt k).history := hguard
      have htargetStep : Step (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix first) targetSample.2)
          (targetAt k) (targetRule sample.1 (targetAt k).history) targetNext := by rw [htargetPolicy]; exact ht
      have htargetRun := run_succ_of_step (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first))
        .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k targetNext htargetActive htargetStep
      have hsourceRun := run_succ_of_step input C mode accounting rule sample (n + result.2) sourceNext hsettledActive hs
      obtain ⟨sourcePrefixN, _, sourcePrefix⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample (n + result.2)
      have hnextView := hview.next input first C hearly mode accounting _ _
        (prefix_invariant input C mode accounting rule sample.1 _ _ sourcePrefix) hprojectRaw hs ht
      obtain ⟨packet, hhistory, hreplay⟩ := replaySuffixPacket_real_target input C hearly mode accounting first rule sample.1
        sample.2 (publicStartup (sourceAt n)) (sourceAt (n + result.2)) sourceNext (targetAt k) targetNext
        (raw sample.1 (targetAt k).history) hr hsettledActive hs ht hprojectRaw
        (run_truth input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample (n + result.2))
        (run_truth (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule htargetLegal targetSample k) hview.reviews
      obtain ⟨packets, _, hpackets⟩ := prefix_parseSuffixPackets (input.freshSuffix first)
        (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) rfl .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first))
        targetRule sample.1 _ _ targetPrefix
      have hnextReplay : replaySuffixHistory first accounting rule sample.1 startup targetNext.history = some (publicStartup sourceNext) := by
        rw [hhistory, ← hpackets, replaySuffixHistory_append_packet]
        rw [hpackets, ih.2, Option.bind_some]
        exact hreplay
      change targetAt (k + 1) = targetNext at htargetRun
      change sourceAt (n + result.2 + 1) = sourceNext at hsourceRun
      rw [htargetRun, hsourceRun]
      exact ⟨hnextView, hnextReplay⟩

theorem replayedSuffix_prefix_observationBill (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (first start : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C mode accounting rule first start sample) (k : ℕ) :
    let startup := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
    let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools
      (replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup)
    (run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2) k).ledger.observationBill
        (input.freshSuffix first).fees =
      observationIncrement input (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
        (run input C mode accounting rule sample (replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k)) := by
  have hv := (replayedSuffix_fullRun input C hearly hcurrent mode accounting rule hlegal sample first start hentry k).1
  rw [firstEntry_observationIncrement_eq_future_sum input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first start _ hentry
    (replaySourceClock_ge_start input C mode accounting rule sample first start k)]
  unfold Ledger.observationBill
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro stage _
  have hf : first ≤ (I.freshStageLift first stage).val := by change first ≤ first + stage.val; omega
  have hh := hv.reviews (I.freshStageLift first stage) hf
  rw [suffixStageOf_freshStageLift] at hh
  have hfee : (input.freshSuffix first).fees.observation stage = input.fees.observation (I.freshStageLift first stage) :=
    congrArg BinaryExperiment.observationFee (input.freshSuffix_experiment first stage)
  rw [hfee, hh]

If it stops growing, the genuine original interpreter has already halted. -/

theorem replaySourceClock_grows_or_halted (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (first start k : ℕ) :
    start + k ≤ replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k ∨
      (run input C mode accounting rule sample (replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k)).halted = true := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact .inl le_rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [replaySourceClock]
    split
    next hh => exact .inr hh
    next hh =>
      have hbound : start + k ≤ replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k :=
        ih.resolve_right hh
      exact .inl (by omega)

/-- Exact remaining observation charge, including infinity and observations
on paths which later fail. Supremum cofinality follows from growth while
active and from unchanged genuine source state after halt. -/

theorem replayedSuffix_observationBill_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (first start : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C mode accounting rule first start sample) :
    let startup := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
    let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools
      (replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup)
    runObservationBill (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2) =
      futureObservationBill input C mode accounting rule start sample := by
  let startup := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
  let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools
    (replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup)
  let targetAt := fun k => run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
    (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2) k
  let clock := replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start
  let g := fun n => observationIncrement input (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
    (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)
  have hmono : Monotone g := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro stage _
    exact mul_le_mul_right (ENat.toENNReal_mono
      (tsub_le_tsub_right (run_reviews_mono input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample stage hab) _)) _
  have hprefix (k : ℕ) : (targetAt k).ledger.observationBill (input.freshSuffix first).fees = g (clock k) :=
    replayedSuffix_prefix_observationBill input C hearly hcurrent mode accounting rule hlegal sample first start hentry k
  change (⨆ k, (targetAt k).ledger.observationBill (input.freshSuffix first).fees) = ⨆ extra, g (start + extra)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro k
    rw [hprefix]
    obtain ⟨extra, he⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (replaySourceClock_ge_start input C mode accounting rule sample first start k)
    change clock k = start + extra at he
    rw [he]
    exact le_iSup (fun extra => g (start + extra)) extra
  · apply iSup_le
    intro extra
    have hcofinal : g (start + extra) ≤ g (clock extra) := by
      rcases replaySourceClock_grows_or_halted input C mode accounting rule sample first start extra with hbound | hhalt
      · exact hmono hbound
      · by_cases hle : start + extra ≤ clock extra
        · exact hmono hle
        · obtain ⟨delta, he⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_ge hle)
          change start + extra = clock extra + delta at he
          change observationIncrement input _ _ ≤ observationIncrement input _ _
          rw [he, run_after_halt input C mode accounting rule sample (clock extra) hhalt delta]
    exact hcofinal.trans ((hprefix extra).symm.le.trans (le_iSup (fun k => (targetAt k).ledger.observationBill (input.freshSuffix first).fees) extra))

end PaperProofs.Common.Native

theorem replayedSuffix_runSuccess (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (first start : ℕ) (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C mode accounting rule first start sample)
    (hsuccess : runSuccess input C mode accounting rule sample) :
    let startup := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
    let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools
      (replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup)
    runSuccess (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2) := by
  let startup := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample start)
  let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools
    (replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup)
  let targetSample := (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2)
  let sourceAt := fun n => run input C mode accounting rule sample n
  let targetAt := fun k => run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
    (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k
  have htargetLegal : LegalRule (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule := guardedReplayRule_legal _ _ rfl rfl _ _ _
  obtain ⟨stopped, hsHalt, hsSuccess⟩ := hsuccess
  obtain ⟨k, hsame⟩ := replaySourceClock_reaches_halted input C mode accounting rule sample first start stopped hsHalt
  let clock := replaySourceClock input C mode accounting rule sample first start k
  change sourceAt clock = sourceAt stopped at hsame
  have hsourceHalt : (sourceAt clock).halted = true := by rw [hsame]; exact hsHalt
  have hsourceSuccess : (sourceAt clock).ledger.success C := by rw [hsame]; exact hsSuccess
  obtain ⟨view, hreplay⟩ := replayedSuffix_fullRun input C hearly hcurrent mode accounting rule hlegal sample first start hentry k
  have htargetHalt : (targetAt k).halted = true := view.halted.symm.trans hsourceHalt
  obtain ⟨targetN, _, targetPrefix⟩ := run_has_prefix (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first))
    .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule htargetLegal targetSample k
  obtain ⟨entryN, _, entryPrefix⟩ := run_has_prefix input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample start
  have entryInv := prefix_invariant input C mode accounting rule sample.1 _ _ entryPrefix
  have entryFacts := firstEntryAt_unborn input C mode accounting rule hlegal sample first start hentry
  have hentryExec : ∀ e ∈ startup.executions, e.handle.stage.val < first := by
    intro e he
    by_contra hf
    have hfuture := Nat.le_of_not_gt hf
    have hg := (entryInv.wellFormed.genuine e he).1
    rw [(entryFacts.2 e.handle.stage hfuture).1] at hg
    cases hg
  obtain ⟨packets, _, hpackets⟩ := prefix_parseSuffixPackets (input.freshSuffix first)
    (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) rfl .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first))
    targetRule sample.1 _ _ targetPrefix
  have hcover := replaySuffixHistory_future_execution first accounting rule sample.1 startup (publicStartup (sourceAt clock))
    (targetAt k).history packets hpackets hreplay hentryExec
  have hlast := replaySuffixHistory_halted_stopped first accounting rule sample.1 startup (publicStartup (sourceAt clock))
    (targetAt k).history packets hpackets hreplay entryFacts.1 hsourceHalt hsourceSuccess.2.1
  have htargetAbandoned := prefix_last_stopped_not_abandoned (input.freshSuffix first)
    (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) rfl .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first))
    targetRule sample.1 _ _ targetPrefix hlast
  have hcorrect (stage : (I.freshSuffix first).Stage) :

        ∃ e ∈ (targetAt k).ledger.executions, e.handle.stage = stage := by
    have hf : first ≤ (I.freshStageLift first stage).val := by change first ≤ first + stage.val; omega
    rcases hsourceSuccess.2.2.2 (I.freshStageLift first stage) with hright | ⟨e, he, hes⟩

      have ht := view.truth (I.freshStageLift first stage) hf
      rw [suffixStageOf_freshStageLift] at hw ht
      rw [← hw, ← ht] at hright
      exact .inl hright

      obtain ⟨pair, hp, hstage, _⟩ := hcover e he hfe
      have hlower : suffixStageOf first e.handle.stage hfe = stage := by
        apply Fin.ext
        change e.handle.stage.val - first = stage.val
        have hh := congrArg Fin.val hes

      rw [prefix_historyExecutions (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first))
        .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule sample.1 _ _ targetPrefix] at hp
      obtain ⟨targetE, htargetE, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
      exact .inr ⟨targetE, htargetE, (congrArg (fun p => p.1.stage) heq).trans hstage⟩
  have targetInv := prefix_ledgerWellFormed (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first))
    .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule sample.1 _ _ targetPrefix
  have hallWritten : allWritten (targetAt k).ledger := by
    intro stage
    rcases hcorrect stage with hright | ⟨e, he, hes⟩
    · rw [hright]
      intro hn
      cases hn
    · have hg := (targetInv.genuine e he).1

      rw [hg]

      cases hn

theorem run_guardedReplayRule_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (hcurrent : C.allocation = .currentWindow)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting rule) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (halloc : ∀ n, (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).halted = false →
      ∀ handle tool, rule sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).history = .allocate handle tool →
        tool ∈ available) :
    ∀ n, run input C .uncapped accounting (guardedReplayRule available rule) sample n =
      run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hh : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).halted = true
    · have hg : (run input C .uncapped accounting (guardedReplayRule available rule) sample n).halted = true := by rw [ih]; exact hh
      rw [run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting _ sample n hg,
        run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n hh, ih]
    · have ha : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n).halted = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh
      obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample n
      obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 _ _ m _ hp ha
      have hguard := guardedReplayRule_eq_of_step input C hearly hcurrent .uncapped accounting rule rule
        sample.1 _ _ hp available hs (halloc n ha)
      have hga : (run input C .uncapped accounting (guardedReplayRule available rule) sample n).halted = false := by rw [ih]; exact ha
      have hgs : Step input C .uncapped accounting (worldTapes input sample.2)
          (run input C .uncapped accounting (guardedReplayRule available rule) sample n)
          (guardedReplayRule available rule sample.1
            (run input C .uncapped accounting (guardedReplayRule available rule) sample n).history) next := by
        rw [ih, hguard]
        exact hs
      rw [run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting _ sample n next hga hgs,
        run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n next ha hs]

PaperProofs.Common.Native.replayedSuffix.signature_start: theorem replayedSuffix_allocations_restricted (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.replayedSuffix.full_declaration_source:
theorem replayedSuffix_allocations_restricted (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hlegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting rule)
    (R : Finset I.Tool) (hR : UsesOnly input C accounting rule R)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (first start : ℕ)
    (hentry : FirstEntryAt input C .uncapped accounting rule first start sample) :
    let startup := publicStartup (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample start)
    let raw := replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup
    let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools raw
    let targetSample := (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2)
    ∀ k, (run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
        (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k).halted = false →
      ∀ handle tool, targetRule sample.1
        (run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k).history = .allocate handle tool →
        tool ∈ R \ startup.committedTools := by
  let startup := publicStartup (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample start)
  let raw := replayedSuffixCandidate first accounting rule startup
  let targetRule := guardedReplayRule (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools raw
  let targetSample := (sample.1, input.restrictFreshWorld first sample.2)
  let sourceAt := fun n => run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample n
  let targetAt := fun k => run (input.freshSuffix first) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix first)) .uncapped
    (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix first)) targetRule targetSample k
  change ∀ k, (targetAt k).halted = false → ∀ handle tool,
    targetRule sample.1 (targetAt k).history = .allocate handle tool → tool ∈ R \ startup.committedTools
  intro k hactive handle tool htargetAlloc
  have hraw := guardedReplayRule_allocate_source (I := I.freshSuffix first) startup.availableTools raw sample.1 (targetAt k).history handle tool htargetAlloc
  let n := replaySourceClock input C .uncapped accounting rule sample first start k
  let result := settleOldExecutions first accounting rule (I.toolCount + 1) sample.1 (publicStartup (sourceAt n))
  obtain ⟨view, hreplay⟩ := replayedSuffix_fullRun input C hC.1 hC.2 .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample first start hentry k
  change raw sample.1 (targetAt k).history = .allocate handle tool at hraw
  change (match replaySuffixHistory first accounting rule sample.1 startup (targetAt k).history with
    | none => (Action.abandon : Action (I.freshSuffix first))
    | some cache => suffixActionAtPublicCache first accounting rule sample.1 cache (targetAt k).history) = .allocate handle tool at hraw
  rw [hreplay] at hraw
  change (if result.1.halted then .stop else
    (suffixActionOf first (targetAt k).history (rule sample.1 result.1.history)).getD .abandon) = .allocate handle tool at hraw
  have hresultActive : result.1.halted = false := by
    cases hh : result.1.halted with
    | false => rfl
    | true => rw [hh] at hraw; cases hraw
  rw [hresultActive] at hraw
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hraw
  have hproject : suffixActionOf first (targetAt k).history (rule sample.1 result.1.history) = some (.allocate handle tool) := by
    cases hp : suffixActionOf first (targetAt k).history (rule sample.1 result.1.history) with
    | none => rw [hp] at hraw; cases hraw
    | some action =>
      have he : action = .allocate handle tool := by simpa only [hp, Option.getD_some] using hraw
      exact congrArg some he
  obtain ⟨sourceHandle, hsourceAction⟩ := suffixActionOf_allocate_source first (targetAt k).history _ handle tool hproject
  have hr : result.1 = publicStartup (sourceAt (n + result.2)) :=
    settleOldExecutions_actual input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample first _ n
  rw [hr] at hsourceAction hresultActive
  change rule sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample (n + result.2)).history =
    .allocate sourceHandle tool at hsourceAction
  obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample (n + result.2)
  obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 _ _ m _ hp hresultActive
  have hinR : tool ∈ R := hR sample.1 _ _ m _ hp hresultActive sourceHandle tool hsourceAction
  rw [hsourceAction] at hs
  have hfree := allocated_tool_available_at_saved_prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample start (n + result.2)
    (by have hn := replaySourceClock_ge_start input C .uncapped accounting rule sample first start k; change start ≤ n at hn; omega)
    sourceHandle tool hs
  exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hinR, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hfree).2⟩
