theorem restrictedStageEntryHistoryPenaltyBridge_at (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (R : Finset I.Tool)
    (policy : AvailablePolicy input C accounting R Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (next : I.Stage) (n : ℕ) (startup : Startup I) (gate : Set Seed) (hgate : MeasurableSet gate)
    (hentry : ∀ sample ∈ historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
      FirstEntryAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next.val n sample)
    (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty *
      input.seededWorldLaw ν (historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample in historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate,
        historyComparisonCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n penalty sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  let E := historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n startup gate
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw ν
  let record := entrySeedStartupAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next n
  let η := μ.map record
  let A : Set (Seed × Option (Startup I)) := gate ×ˢ {some startup}
  let D : Set ((Seed × Option (Startup I)) × (input.freshSuffix next.val).World) := A ×ˢ Set.univ
  let joint := fun sample : Seed × input.World => (record sample, input.restrictFreshWorld next.val sample.2)
  let targetPolicy := replayedSuffixRestrictedPolicy input next.val accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule R startup
  let F := fun pair : (Seed × Option (Startup I)) × (input.freshSuffix next.val).World =>
    runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix next.val) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix next.val)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next.val)) targetPolicy.val.rule penalty (pair.1.1, pair.2)
  have hmrecord : Measurable record := measurable_entrySeedStartupAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule next n
  have hmA : MeasurableSet A := hgate.prod (measurableSet_singleton _)
  have hmD : MeasurableSet D := hmA.prod MeasurableSet.univ
  have hmE : MeasurableSet E := measurableSet_historyGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule n startup gate hgate
  have hmjoint : Measurable joint := hmrecord.prodMk ((input.measurable_restrictFreshWorld next.val).comp measurable_snd)
  have hmF : Measurable F := (measurable_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _ targetPolicy.val.measurable_rule penalty).comp
    ((measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hmap : μ.map joint = η.prod (input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw :=
    entrySeedStartupAt_jointFreshSuffixLaw input C .uncapped accounting policy.val ν next n
  have hE : E = record ⁻¹' A := historyGate_eq_entryRecordGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next n startup gate hentry
  have hpre : joint ⁻¹' D = E := by
    rw [hE]
    ext sample
    simp only [joint, D, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, and_true]
  have hmass : η A = μ E := by rw [Measure.map_apply hmrecord hmA, ← hE]
  have hrow (r : Seed × Option (Startup I)) :
      input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty ≤ ∫⁻ fresh, F (r, fresh) ∂(input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw :=
    healthyPenalty_le_restrictedSuffix_dirac input next.val accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule R startup r.1 penalty
  change input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty * μ E ≤ _
  calc
    input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty * μ E =
        input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty * η A := by rw [hmass]
    _ = ∫⁻ _r in A, input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty ∂η := (setLIntegral_const _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ r in A, ∫⁻ fresh, F (r, fresh) ∂(input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw ∂η := lintegral_mono hrow
    _ = ∫⁻ pair in D, F pair ∂η.prod (input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw := by
      rw [setLIntegral_prod F hmF.aemeasurable, Measure.restrict_univ]
    _ = ∫⁻ sample in E, F (joint sample) ∂μ := by
      rw [← hmap, setLIntegral_map hmD hmF hmjoint, hpre]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ sample in E, historyComparisonCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n penalty sample ∂μ := by
      apply setLIntegral_mono' hmE
      intro sample hs
      have h := replayedSuffixRestricted_penaltyCharge_le input C hC accounting policy.val.rule
        policy.val.measurable_rule policy.val.legal R policy.property sample next.val n (hentry sample hs) penalty
      have hstartup : publicStartup (run input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule sample n) = startup := hs.1
      dsimp only at h

      FirstEntryAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule first n sample)

  · let next : I.Stage := ⟨first, Nat.lt_of_not_ge ht⟩

PaperProofs.Common.Native.EntryContinuat.signature_start: theorem entry_record_continuation_lower (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.EntryContinuat.full_declaration_source:
theorem entry_record_continuation_lower (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (R : Finset I.Tool)
    (policy : AvailablePolicy input C accounting R Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (next : I.Stage) (n : ℕ) (startup : Startup I) (gate : Set Seed) (hgate : MeasurableSet gate)
    (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty *
      input.seededWorldLaw ν (recordEvent input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next n startup gate) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample in recordEvent input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next n startup gate,
        historyComparisonCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n penalty sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  let E := recordEvent input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next n startup gate
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw ν
  let record := entrySeedStartupAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next n
  let η := μ.map record
  let A : Set (Seed × Option (Startup I)) := gate ×ˢ {some startup}
  let D : Set ((Seed × Option (Startup I)) × (input.freshSuffix next.val).World) := A ×ˢ Set.univ
  let joint := fun sample : Seed × input.World => (record sample, input.restrictFreshWorld next.val sample.2)
  let targetPolicy := replayedSuffixRestrictedPolicy input next.val accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule R startup
  let F := fun pair : (Seed × Option (Startup I)) × (input.freshSuffix next.val).World =>
    runPenaltyCharge (input.freshSuffix next.val) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix next.val)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next.val)) targetPolicy.val.rule penalty (pair.1.1, pair.2)
  have hmrecord : Measurable record := measurable_entrySeedStartupAt input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule next n
  have hmA : MeasurableSet A := hgate.prod (measurableSet_singleton _)
  have hmD : MeasurableSet D := hmA.prod MeasurableSet.univ
  have hmE : MeasurableSet E := measurableSet_recordEvent input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule next n startup gate hgate
  have hmjoint : Measurable joint := hmrecord.prodMk ((input.measurable_restrictFreshWorld next.val).comp measurable_snd)
  have hmF : Measurable F := (measurable_runPenaltyCharge _ _ _ _ _ targetPolicy.val.measurable_rule penalty).comp
    ((measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hmap : μ.map joint = η.prod (input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw :=
    entrySeedStartupAt_jointFreshSuffixLaw input C .uncapped accounting policy.val ν next n
  have hE : E = record ⁻¹' A := by ext sample; rfl
  have hpre : joint ⁻¹' D = E := by
    rw [hE]
    ext sample
    simp only [joint, D, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, and_true]
  have hmass : η A = μ E := by rw [Measure.map_apply hmrecord hmA, ← hE]
  have hrow (r : Seed × Option (Startup I)) :
      input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty ≤ ∫⁻ fresh, F (r, fresh) ∂(input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw :=
    healthyPenalty_le_restrictedSuffix_dirac input next.val accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule R startup r.1 penalty
  change input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty * μ E ≤ _
  calc
    _ = input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty * η A := by rw [hmass]
    _ = ∫⁻ _r in A, input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ startup.committedTools) penalty ∂η := (setLIntegral_const _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ r in A, ∫⁻ fresh, F (r, fresh) ∂(input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw ∂η := lintegral_mono hrow
    _ = ∫⁻ pair in D, F pair ∂η.prod (input.freshSuffix next.val).worldLaw := by
      rw [setLIntegral_prod F hmF.aemeasurable, Measure.restrict_univ]
    _ = ∫⁻ sample in E, F (joint sample) ∂μ := by
      rw [← hmap, setLIntegral_map hmD hmF hmjoint, hpre]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ sample in E, historyComparisonCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule n penalty sample ∂μ := by
      apply setLIntegral_mono' hmE
      intro sample hs
      have he := recordEvent_firstEntry input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next n startup gate sample hs
      have h := replayedSuffixRestricted_penaltyCharge_le input C hC accounting policy.val.rule
        policy.val.measurable_rule policy.val.legal R policy.property sample next.val n he.1 penalty
      dsimp only at h
      rw [he.2] at h
      exact h

theorem iUnion_indexedEvent_eq_reachGate (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (next : I.Stage) (gate : Set Seed) :
    (⋃ record : Record I, indexedEvent input C mode accounting rule next gate record) =
      reachGate input C mode accounting rule next gate := by
  classical
  ext sample
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨record, hr⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hs
    exact ⟨hr.1, record.1, (recordEvent_firstEntry input C mode accounting rule next _ _ gate sample hr).1.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨hg, he⟩
    let n := Nat.find he
    let startup := publicStartup (run input C mode accounting rule sample n)
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨(n, startup), hg, ?_⟩
    apply (entryStartupAt_some_iff input C mode accounting rule next n sample startup).mpr
    exact ⟨⟨Nat.find_spec he, fun k hk => Nat.find_min he hk⟩, rfl⟩

theorem tsum_entry_continuation_lower (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hC : C.IsCurrentAllocation) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (R : Finset I.Tool)
    (policy : AvailablePolicy input C accounting R Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (next : I.Stage) (gate : Set Seed) (hgate : MeasurableSet gate) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' record : Record I, input.healthyPenalty next.val (R \ record.2.committedTools) penalty *
      input.seededWorldLaw ν (indexedEvent input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next gate record)) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample in reachGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next gate,
        entryContinuationCharge input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next penalty sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  change _ ≤ ∫⁻ sample in reachGate input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next gate,
    pieces input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule next _ sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν
  rw [lintegral_pieces_eq_tsum input C .uncapped accounting policy.val.rule policy.val.measurable_rule next gate hgate]
  apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
  intro record
  exact entry_record_continuation_lower input C hC accounting R policy ν next record.1 record.2 gate hgate penalty

noncomputable def orderedCoefficient : WeightedSchedule Tool → Finset Tool → ℝ
  | [], _ => 0
  | (eligible, weight) :: later, remaining =>
      if errorRank (eligible :: eligibilitySchedule later) remaining = ⊤ then 0 else
        (if errorRank (eligibilitySchedule later) remaining =
            errorRank (eligible :: eligibilitySchedule later) remaining then
          orderedCoefficient later remaining else 0) +
        (if badChildRank eligible (eligibilitySchedule later) remaining + 1 =
            errorRank (eligible :: eligibilitySchedule later) remaining then weight else 0)

PaperProofs.Common.healthyFiniteLeading_.full_declaration_source:
theorem healthyFiniteLeading_all (input : StatisticalInput I) : ∀ next : ℕ, HealthyFiniteLeading input next := by
  have hall : ∀ size : ℕ, ∀ next : ℕ, I.stageCount - next = size → HealthyFiniteLeading input next := by
    intro size
    induction size using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h size ih =>
      intro next hsize
      by_cases hlive : next < I.stageCount
      · let stage : I.Stage := ⟨next, hlive⟩
        have hshort : I.stageCount - (next + 1) < size := by omega
        exact healthyPenalty_finite_step input stage (ih _ hshort (next + 1) rfl)
      · intro available depth hrank
        have hnil : I.compatibility.drop next = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by
          change I.stageCount ≤ next
          omega)
        rw [hnil, errorRank_terminal] at hrank
        exact (ENat.top_ne_natCast depth hrank).elim
  intro next
  exact hall (I.stageCount - next) next rfl

    (ih : HealthyFiniteLeading input (stage.val + 1)) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (badDepth : ℕ)
    (hbadRank : badChildRank (I.eligible stage) (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available = (badDepth : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ Tendsto (fun price : ℝ => input.badPenaltyReal stage available price /
      iteratedLog badDepth price) atTop (𝓝 B) := by
  classical
  by_cases hnonempty : (I.eligible stage ∩ available).Nonempty
  · exact input.badPenaltyReal_leading_of_shorter stage available badDepth hnonempty hbadRank ih
  · have hzero : badChildRank (I.eligible stage) (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available = 0 :=
      (badChildRank_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hnonempty)
    have hb : badDepth = 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hbadRank.symm.trans hzero)
    subst badDepth
    exact ⟨1, zero_lt_one, healthyBad_noTool_leading input stage available hnonempty⟩

theorem StatisticalInput.equalRankLocalTerm_isLittleO_of_bad_leading {I : Instance}

theorem localValueReal_sublinear (E : BinaryExperiment) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => E.localValueReal t / t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨K, _, hK⟩ := E.globalLogarithmicEnvelope
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => K * Real.log (1 + t) / t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc, mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul log_one_add_div_tendsto_zero :
        Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => K * (Real.log (1 + t) / t)) atTop (𝓝 (K * 0)))
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
    (g := fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) (h := fun t => K * Real.log (1 + t) / t)
    tendsto_const_nhds hupper
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht
    exact div_nonneg (E.localValueReal_nonneg t) ht.le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right ht).mpr (hK t ht.le)

theorem localValue_difference_negligible (E : BinaryExperiment)
    (good bad scale : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hscale : Tendsto scale atTop atTop)
    (hbad : Tendsto (fun t => bad t / scale t) atTop (𝓝 B))
    (horder : ∀ᶠ t in atTop, 0 ≤ good t ∧ good t ≤ bad t) :
    Tendsto (fun t => E.localValueReal (bad t - good t) / scale t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hscaleNe : ∀ᶠ t in atTop, scale t ≠ 0 := hscale.eventually_ne_atTop 0
  have hbadTop : Tendsto bad atTop atTop := by
    have hprod := Filter.Tendsto.pos_mul_atTop hB hbad hscale
    apply hprod.congr'
    filter_upwards [hscaleNe] with t ht
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ (bad t) ht
  have hbadPos : ∀ᶠ t in atTop, 0 < bad t := hbadTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := E.globalLogarithmicEnvelope
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun t => K * Real.log (1 + bad t) / bad t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hlog := log_one_add_div_tendsto_zero.comp hbadTop
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc, mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hlog :
        Tendsto (fun t => K * (Real.log (1 + bad t) / bad t)) atTop (𝓝 (K * 0)))
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun t => E.localValueReal (bad t - good t) / bad t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
      (g := fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) (h := fun t => K * Real.log (1 + bad t) / bad t)
      tendsto_const_nhds hupper
    · filter_upwards [hbadPos] with t ht
      exact div_nonneg (E.localValueReal_nonneg _) ht.le
    · filter_upwards [hbadPos, horder] with t ht ho
      apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right ht).mpr
      apply (hbound _ (sub_nonneg.mpr ho.2)).trans
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hK
      exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith : 0 < 1 + (bad t - good t)) (by linarith)
  have hprod : Tendsto (fun t =>
      (E.localValueReal (bad t - good t) / bad t) * (bad t / scale t)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using hratio.mul hbad
  apply hprod.congr'
  filter_upwards [hscaleNe, hbadPos] with t hs hb
  field_simp [hs, ne_of_gt hb]

PaperProofs.Common.healthyPenalty_finite.full_declaration_source:
theorem healthyPenalty_finite_step (input : StatisticalInput I) (stage : I.Stage)
    (ih : HealthyFiniteLeading input (stage.val + 1)) : HealthyFiniteLeading input stage.val := by
  intro available depth hrank
  have hfinite : errorRank (I.compatibility.drop stage.val) available ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [hrank]
    exact ENat.natCast_ne_top depth
  have hdepth : 0 < depth := by
    have hp := errorRank_pos (I.compatibility.drop stage.val) available
    rw [hrank] at hp
    exact_mod_cast hp
  have hC := input.suffixCoefficient_pos stage.val available hfinite
  obtain ⟨badDepth, hbadDepth⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (I.badChildRank_suffix_ne_top stage available hfinite)
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbad⟩ := healthyBad_leading_of_shorter input stage ih available badDepth hbadDepth.symm
  have hgoodOrder : (depth : ℕ∞) ≤ errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available := by
    rw [← hrank, I.errorRank_suffix_step stage available]
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hgood := healthyGood_scale_of_shorter input stage ih available depth hgoodOrder
  have hlocal := healthyLocal_scale_of_bad_leading input stage ih available depth badDepth hrank hbadDepth.symm B hB hbad
  have hcoefficient := input.suffixCoefficient_step stage available hfinite
  rw [hrank, ← hbadDepth, ← ENat.natCast_one, ← ENat.natCast_add] at hcoefficient
  simp only [ENat.natCast_inj] at hcoefficient
  let bracket : ℝ → ℝ := fun price => input.goodPenaltyReal stage available price +
    (input.experiment stage).localValueReal
      (input.badPenaltyReal stage available price - input.goodPenaltyReal stage available price)
  have hbracket : Tendsto (fun price => bracket price / iteratedLog depth price) atTop
      (𝓝 (input.suffixCoefficient stage.val available)) := by
    simpa only [bracket, ← add_div, hcoefficient] using hgood.add hlocal
  have hmin := min_id_iteratedLog_tendsto_of_leading bracket depth (by omega)
    (input.suffixCoefficient stage.val available) hbracket
  have hvalue : input.healthyPenaltyReal stage.val available =ᶠ[atTop] fun price => min price (bracket price) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with price hp
    exact Native.currentPenaltyRecursion input stage available price hp
  have hscale : Tendsto (fun price => input.healthyPenaltyReal stage.val available price /
      iteratedLog depth price) atTop (𝓝 (input.suffixCoefficient stage.val available)) := by
    apply hmin.congr'
    filter_upwards [hvalue] with price hp
    rw [hp]
  exact ⟨hdepth, hC, healthyLeading_normalize (input.healthyPenaltyReal stage.val available)
    depth (input.suffixCoefficient stage.val available) hC.ne' hscale⟩

theorem healthyLocal_scale_of_bad_leading (input : StatisticalInput I) (stage : I.Stage)
    (ih : HealthyFiniteLeading input (stage.val + 1)) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (depth badDepth : ℕ)
    (hrank : errorRank (I.compatibility.drop stage.val) available = (depth : ℕ∞))
    (hbadRank : badChildRank (I.eligible stage) (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available = (badDepth : ℕ∞))
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hbad : Tendsto (fun price : ℝ => input.badPenaltyReal stage available price /
      iteratedLog badDepth price) atTop (𝓝 B)) :
    Tendsto (fun price : ℝ => (input.experiment stage).localValueReal
        (input.badPenaltyReal stage available price - input.goodPenaltyReal stage available price) /
          iteratedLog depth price) atTop
      (𝓝 (if badDepth + 1 = depth then (input.experiment stage).coefficient else 0)) := by
  have hgoodOrder : (depth : ℕ∞) ≤ errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available := by
    rw [← hrank, I.errorRank_suffix_step stage available]
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hbadGood := badChildRank_le_goodRank (I.eligible stage) (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available
  rw [hbadRank] at hbadGood
  have hbadOrder : (badDepth : ℕ∞) ≤ (depth : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← hrank, I.errorRank_suffix_step stage available, hbadRank]
    exact le_min hbadGood (by simpa only [add_comm] using (le_add_of_nonneg_right (show (0 : ℕ∞) ≤ 1 from bot_le) :
      (badDepth : ℕ∞) ≤ (badDepth : ℕ∞) + 1))
  have hdepthUpper : depth ≤ badDepth + 1 := by
    have hb : (depth : ℕ∞) ≤ 1 + (badDepth : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← hrank, I.errorRank_suffix_step stage available, hbadRank]
      exact min_le_right _ _
    exact ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp (by simpa only [ENat.natCast_add, ENat.natCast_one, add_comm] using hb)
  have hbadLower : badDepth ≤ depth := ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp hbadOrder
  by_cases heq : badDepth + 1 = depth
  · have hgoodNe : errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available ≠ (badDepth : ℕ∞) := by
      intro hg
      rw [hg] at hgoodOrder
      have hh : depth ≤ badDepth := ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp hgoodOrder
      omega
    have hgood0 := healthyGood_scale_of_shorter input stage ih available badDepth hbadGood
    simp only [hgoodNe, ite_false] at hgood0
    have hgap : Tendsto (fun price : ℝ =>
        (input.badPenaltyReal stage available price - input.goodPenaltyReal stage available price) /
          iteratedLog badDepth price) atTop (𝓝 B) := by
      simpa only [sub_div, sub_zero] using hbad.sub hgood0
    have hj := (input.experiment stage).localValueReal_iteratedLog_succ_of_tendsto
      (fun price => input.badPenaltyReal stage available price - input.goodPenaltyReal stage available price)
      badDepth B hB hgap
    simpa only [heq, ite_true] using healthyLeading_unnormalize
      (fun price => (input.experiment stage).localValueReal
        (input.badPenaltyReal stage available price - input.goodPenaltyReal stage available price))
      (badDepth + 1) (input.experiment stage).coefficient (input.experiment stage).coefficient_pos.ne' hj
  · have hd : depth = badDepth := by omega
    rw [ite_eq_right heq]
    simpa only [hd] using
      input.equalRankLocalTerm_tendsto_zero_of_bad_leading stage available badDepth B hB hbad

theorem StatisticalInput.badPenaltyReal_leading_minimum_of_shorter {I : Instance}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (stage : I.Stage) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (depth : ℕ) (hnonempty : (I.eligible stage ∩ available).Nonempty)
    (hrank : badChildRank (I.eligible stage) (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available =
      (depth : ℕ∞))
    (hshorter : ∀ (childAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (childDepth : ℕ),
      errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) childAvailable = (childDepth : ℕ∞) →
        0 < childDepth ∧ 0 < input.suffixCoefficient (stage.val + 1) childAvailable ∧
          Tendsto (fun price : ℝ => input.healthyPenaltyReal (stage.val + 1) childAvailable price /
            (input.suffixCoefficient (stage.val + 1) childAvailable * iteratedLog childDepth price))
            atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧
      (∃ tool ∈ I.eligible stage ∩ available,
        errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) (available.erase tool) = (depth : ℕ∞) ∧
          input.suffixCoefficient (stage.val + 1) (available.erase tool) = B) ∧
      (∀ tool ∈ I.eligible stage ∩ available,
        errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) (available.erase tool) = (depth : ℕ∞) →
          B ≤ input.suffixCoefficient (stage.val + 1) (available.erase tool)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun price : ℝ => input.badPenaltyReal stage available price / iteratedLog depth price)
        atTop (𝓝 B) := by
  classical
  let K := I.eligible stage ∩ available
  let childRank := fun tool : I.Tool => errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) (available.erase tool)
  let rank := fun tool : I.Tool => (childRank tool).toNat
  let coefficient := fun tool : I.Tool => input.suffixCoefficient (stage.val + 1) (available.erase tool)
  let value := fun tool : I.Tool => input.healthyPenaltyReal (stage.val + 1) (available.erase tool)
  have hbound (tool : I.Tool) (htool : tool ∈ K) : childRank tool ≤ (depth : ℕ∞) := by
    exact (childRank_le_badChildRank (I.eligible stage) (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1))
      available htool).trans_eq hrank
  have hcast (tool : I.Tool) (htool : tool ∈ K) : (rank tool : ℕ∞) = childRank tool := by
    exact ENat.natCast_toNat (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.natCast_ne_top depth) (hbound tool htool))
  have hnatBound (tool : I.Tool) (htool : tool ∈ K) : rank tool ≤ depth :=
    ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast (hbound tool htool)
  have hnatMax : ∃ tool ∈ K, rank tool = depth := by
    obtain ⟨tool, htool, heq⟩ := exists_maximizing_tool (I.eligible stage)
      (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available hnonempty
    refine ⟨tool, htool, ?_⟩
    change (errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) (available.erase tool)).toNat = depth
    rw [heq, hrank, ENat.toNat_natCast]
  have hchild (tool : I.Tool) (htool : tool ∈ K) :=
    hshorter (available.erase tool) (rank tool) (hcast tool htool).symm
  have hpositive (tool : I.Tool) (htool : tool ∈ K) : 0 < coefficient tool :=
    (hchild tool htool).2.1
  have hleading (tool : I.Tool) (htool : tool ∈ K) :
      Tendsto (fun price : ℝ => value tool price / iteratedLog (rank tool) price)
        atTop (𝓝 (coefficient tool)) := by
    have hc := hpositive tool htool
    have hp := ((hchild tool htool).2.2).mul_const (coefficient tool)
    apply (show Tendsto (fun price : ℝ =>
      (value tool price / (coefficient tool * iteratedLog (rank tool) price)) * coefficient tool)
      atTop (𝓝 (coefficient tool)) from by simpa only [one_mul] using hp).congr'
    filter_upwards [(iteratedLog_tendsto_atTop (rank tool)).eventually_ne_atTop 0] with price hn
    field_simp [hc.ne', hn]
  obtain ⟨B, hB, ⟨tool, htool, htoolRank, htoolCoefficient⟩, hminimum, hlimit⟩ :=
    finiteNatRank_min_leading K hnonempty rank coefficient value depth hnatBound hnatMax hpositive hleading
  refine ⟨B, hB, ⟨tool, htool, ?_, htoolCoefficient⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hcast tool htool).symm.trans (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℕ∞)) htoolRank)
  · intro other hother hotherRank
    apply hminimum other hother
    change (errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) (available.erase other)).toNat = depth
    rw [hotherRank, ENat.toNat_natCast]
  · simpa only [StatisticalInput.badPenaltyReal, hnonempty, ↓reduceDIte] using hlimit

theorem StatisticalInput.suffixCoefficient_step (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (stage : I.Stage) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (hfinite : errorRank (I.compatibility.drop stage.val) available ≠ ⊤) :
    input.suffixCoefficient stage.val available =
      (if errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available =
          errorRank (I.compatibility.drop stage.val) available then
        input.suffixCoefficient (stage.val + 1) available else 0) +
      (if badChildRank (I.eligible stage) (I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)) available + 1 =
          errorRank (I.compatibility.drop stage.val) available then
        (input.experiment stage).coefficient else 0) := by
  let current : WeightedSchedule I.Tool := (input.freshSuffix stage.val).weightedSchedule
  let later : WeightedSchedule I.Tool := (input.freshSuffix (stage.val + 1)).weightedSchedule
  let tail : List (Finset I.Tool) := I.compatibility.drop (stage.val + 1)
  change Statistics.orderedCoefficient current available =
    (if errorRank tail available = errorRank (I.compatibility.drop stage.val) available then
      Statistics.orderedCoefficient later available else 0) +
    (if badChildRank (I.eligible stage) tail available + 1 =
        errorRank (I.compatibility.drop stage.val) available then
      (input.experiment stage).coefficient else 0)
  have hweights : current = (I.eligible stage, (input.experiment stage).coefficient) :: later :=
    input.weightedSchedule_suffix_cons stage
  have helig : eligibilitySchedule later = tail :=
    (input.freshSuffix (stage.val + 1)).weightedSchedule_eligibility
  have hcompat : I.eligible stage :: tail = I.compatibility.drop stage.val :=
    (I.compatibility_suffix_cons stage).symm
  rw [hweights]
  simp only [Statistics.orderedCoefficient, helig, hcompat, hfinite, ite_false]

theorem localValueReal_iteratedLog_succ_of_tendsto (E : BinaryExperiment)

    Tendsto (fun penalty => E.localValueReal (t penalty) /
      (E.coefficient * iteratedLog (depth + 1) penalty)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by

      (E.localValueReal (t penalty) / (E.coefficient * Real.log (t penalty))) *
        (Real.log (t penalty) / iteratedLog (depth + 1) penalty)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, one_mul] using hlocal.mul hlog
  apply hprod.congr'

    (iteratedLog_tendsto_atTop (depth + 1)).eventually_ne_atTop 0] with penalty hlogNe hnextNe
  change Real.log (t penalty) ≠ 0 at hlogNe
  field_simp [E.coefficient_pos.ne', hlogNe, hnextNe]

theorem StatisticalInput.healthyPenalty_zero_of_infiniteRank (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (next : ℕ) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (htop : errorRank (I.compatibility.drop next) available = ⊤) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :

PaperProofs.Statistics.critical_head_cri.full_declaration_source:
theorem critical_head_criterion (stages : WeightedSchedule Tool)
    (remaining : Finset Tool) (depth : Nat)
    (hrank : errorRank (eligibilitySchedule stages) remaining = (depth : ℕ∞))
    (bad : ℕ∞) :
    bad + 1 = errorRank (eligibilitySchedule stages) remaining ↔
      bad = ((depth - 1 : Nat) : ℕ∞) := by
  have hpos := errorRank_pos (eligibilitySchedule stages) remaining
  rw [hrank] at hpos ⊢
  cases depth with
  | zero => exact False.elim ((lt_irrefl (0 : ℕ∞)) hpos)
  | succ depth =>
    change bad + 1 = ((depth + 1 : Nat) : ℕ∞) ↔ bad = (depth : ℕ∞)
    rw [ENat.natCast_add, ENat.natCast_one]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact (ENat.add_left_injective_of_ne_top ENat.one_ne_top) h
    · intro h
      exact congrArg (fun value : ℕ∞ => value + 1) h

    exact h

theorem referenceBudgetPath_valid_floor (events : List ReferenceBudgetEvent) (initial current : ℚ)
    (hvalid : ReferenceBudgetValid initial) (hpath : referenceBudgetPath initial events = some current) :
    ReferenceBudgetValid current ∧ initial / (2 : ℚ) ^ events.length ≤ current := by
  induction events generalizing initial with
  | nil =>
    have heq : initial = current := Option.some.inj hpath
    subst current
    simpa only [List.length_nil, pow_zero, div_one] using (And.intro hvalid (le_refl initial))
  | cons event rest ih =>
    change (referenceBudgetStep event.1 event.2 initial).bind
      (fun child => referenceBudgetPath child rest) = some current at hpath
    obtain ⟨child, hstep, hrestpath⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hpath
    have hchild := referenceBudgetStep_valid_floor event.1 event.2 initial child hvalid hstep
    have hrest := ih child hchild.1 hrestpath
    refine ⟨hrest.1, ?_⟩
    calc
      initial / (2 : ℚ) ^ (event :: rest).length = (initial / 2) / (2 : ℚ) ^ rest.length := by
        rw [List.length_cons, pow_succ]
        ring
      _ ≤ child / (2 : ℚ) ^ rest.length := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hchild.2 (by positivity)
      _ ≤ current := hrest.2

theorem referenceBudgetPath_dyadic_target (referenceRisk : ℚ) (hpositive : 0 < referenceRisk)
    (hsmall : referenceRisk ≤ 1 / 2) (N exponent : ℕ)
    (hqualifies : DyadicQualifies (2 * N * referenceQuotaConstant N) (referenceRisk : ℝ) exponent)
    (events : List ReferenceBudgetEvent) (hlen : events.length ≤ N) (current target : ℚ)
    (hpath : referenceBudgetPath (referenceRisk / 2) events = some current)
    (kind : ReferenceBudgetCase) (htarget : referenceBudgetTarget kind current = some target) :
    (2 * N : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ exponent * (target : ℝ) := by
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) < (referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) := by
    simp only [referenceQuotaConstant, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_ofNat]
    positivity
  have hf : (referenceRisk : ℝ) / (referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) ≤ (target : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [referenceQuotaConstant, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_ofNat] using
      referenceBudgetPath_original_target_floor_real referenceRisk hpositive hsmall events N hlen current target hpath kind htarget
  have hq : (2 * N : ℝ) * (referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ exponent * (referenceRisk : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [DyadicQualifies, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_natCast, Rat.cast_ofNat] using hqualifies
  calc
    _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ exponent * (referenceRisk : ℝ)) / (referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hC).mpr hq
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ exponent * ((referenceRisk : ℝ) / (referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf (by positivity)

theorem exists_referenceRisk_same_exponent_targets (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (exponent : ℕ)
    (hminimal : IsMinimalDyadicExponent (2 * N * referenceQuotaConstant N) delta exponent) :
    ∃ referenceRisk : ℚ, 0 < referenceRisk ∧ referenceRisk ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      delta / 2 ≤ (referenceRisk : ℝ) ∧ (referenceRisk : ℝ) ≤ delta ∧
      IsMinimalDyadicExponent (2 * N * referenceQuotaConstant N) (referenceRisk : ℝ) exponent ∧
      ∀ (events : List ReferenceBudgetEvent) (_hlen : events.length ≤ N) (current target : ℚ),
        referenceBudgetPath (referenceRisk / 2) events = some current →
        ∀ kind : ReferenceBudgetCase, referenceBudgetTarget kind current = some target →
          (2 * N : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ exponent * (target : ℝ) := by
  have hC : (0 : ℚ) < 2 * N * referenceQuotaConstant N := by
    have hNQ : (0 : ℚ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    unfold referenceQuotaConstant
    positivity
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hhalf, hrdelta, hsame⟩ := exists_rationalRisk_preserves_minimal_exponent
    (2 * N * referenceQuotaConstant N) hC delta hdelta exponent hminimal
  have hrsmall : r ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    apply (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mp
    simpa only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_ofNat] using hrdelta.trans hsmall
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrsmall, hhalf, hrdelta, hsame, ?_⟩
  intro events hlen current target hpath kind htarget
  exact referenceBudgetPath_dyadic_target r hr hrsmall N exponent hsame.2.1 events hlen current target hpath kind htarget

    (hstep : referenceReplayStep input risk cache (.report i truth serial) = some result) :
    ∃ (stage : I.Stage) (written : Bool × ℕ) (kind : ReferenceBudgetCase) (current : ℚ),
      referenceReplayStage I cache = some stage ∧ historyWrite cache.seen stage = some written ∧
      referenceRankCase I stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) = some kind ∧
      referenceReplayRisk risk cache = some current ∧
      i = stage ∧ serial = written.2 ∧ cache.phase = .written ∧ cache.events.length < I.stageCount ∧
      result.events = cache.events ++ [(kind, decide (written.1 ≠ truth))] ∧
      result.entryHistory = cache.entryHistory ∧ result.phase = .reported := by
  cases hh : cache.halted with
  | true =>
    simp only [referenceReplayStep, hh, ite_true] at hstep
    cases hstep
  | false =>
    simp only [referenceReplayStep, hh, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] at hstep

    obtain ⟨written, hwrite, hrest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hrest
    obtain ⟨kind, hkind, hrest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hrest
    obtain ⟨current, hcurrent, hrest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hrest
    by_cases hg : i = stage ∧ serial = written.2 ∧ cache.phase = .written ∧ cache.events.length < I.stageCount

    · rw [ite_eq_right hg] at hrest

PaperProofs.Common.Native.historyAllowsA.signature_start: theorem historyAllowsAction_sound (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.historyAllowsA.full_declaration_source:
theorem historyAllowsAction_sound (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) {Seed : Type*}
    (policy : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I} (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes n s)
    (hactive : s.halted = false) (action : Action I) (hallow : historyAllowsAction s.history action) :
    ∃ next, Step input C .uncapped accounting tapes s action next := by
  cases action with
  | review stage =>
    change historyCursor s.history = stage.val ∧ historyWritten s.history stage = none at hallow
    rw [prefix_historyCursor input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp,
      prefix_historyWritten input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp stage] at hallow
    exact ⟨_, .review s stage ⟨hactive, hallow.1⟩ hallow.2 (.inl rfl)⟩
  | write stage bit =>
    change historyCursor s.history = stage.val ∧ historyWritten s.history stage = none at hallow
    rw [prefix_historyCursor input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp,
      prefix_historyWritten input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp stage] at hallow
    exact ⟨_, .write s stage bit ⟨hactive, hallow.1⟩ hallow.2 (.inl rfl)⟩
  | advance stage =>
    change historyCursor s.history = stage.val ∧ historyWritten s.history stage ≠ none at hallow
    rw [prefix_historyCursor input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp,
      prefix_historyWritten input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp stage] at hallow
    exact ⟨_, .advance s stage ⟨hactive, hallow.1⟩ hallow.2 (.inl rfl)⟩
  | allocate handle tool =>
    change historyCursor s.history = handle.stage.val ∧ historyValidHandle s.history handle ∧
      tool ∈ I.eligible handle.stage ∧ tool ∉ historyUsed s.history ∧
      (∀ pair ∈ historyCommitments s.history, pair.1.stage ≠ handle.stage) at hallow
    have hcursor : s.cursor = handle.stage.val := by
      simpa only [prefix_historyCursor input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp] using hallow.1
    have hhandle := historyValidHandle_sound input C hearly .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp handle hallow.2.1
    have hunused := (prefix_historyUnused_iff input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp tool).mp hallow.2.2.2.1
    have hstage : ∀ a ∈ s.ledger.commitments, a.handle.stage ≠ handle.stage := by
      intro a ha
      apply hallow.2.2.2.2 (a.handle, a.tool)
      rw [prefix_historyCommitments input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp]
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, .allocate s handle tool hactive hhandle hallow.2.2.1 hunused hstage (fun _ => hcursor) (.inl rfl)⟩
  | execute handle tool =>
    change historyCursor s.history = handle.stage.val ∧ historyValidHandle s.history handle ∧
      tool ∈ I.eligible handle.stage ∧ (handle, tool) ∈ historyCommitments s.history ∧
      (∀ pair ∈ historyExecutions s.history, pair.2 ≠ tool) ∧
      (∀ pair ∈ historyExecutions s.history, pair.1.stage ≠ handle.stage) at hallow
    have hcursor : s.cursor = handle.stage.val := by
      simpa only [prefix_historyCursor input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp] using hallow.1
    have hhandle := historyValidHandle_sound input C hearly .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp handle hallow.2.1
    have hcommitted : ∃ a ∈ s.ledger.commitments, a.handle = handle ∧ a.tool = tool := by
      have hm := hallow.2.2.2.1
      rw [prefix_historyCommitments input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp] at hm
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hpair⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
      exact ⟨a, ha, congrArg Prod.fst hpair, congrArg Prod.snd hpair⟩
    have hunused : ∀ e ∈ s.ledger.executions, e.tool ≠ tool := by
      intro e he
      apply hallow.2.2.2.2.1 (e.handle, e.tool)
      rw [prefix_historyExecutions input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp]
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    have hstage : ∀ e ∈ s.ledger.executions, e.handle.stage ≠ handle.stage := by
      intro e he
      apply hallow.2.2.2.2.2 (e.handle, e.tool)
      rw [prefix_historyExecutions input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp]
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, .execute s handle tool hactive hhandle hallow.2.2.1 hcommitted hunused hstage (fun _ => hcursor) (.inl rfl)⟩
  | stop => exact ⟨_, .stop s hactive⟩
  | abandon => exact ⟨_, .abandon s hactive⟩

theorem referenceStateAligned_review (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (risk : ℚ) (cache : ReferenceReplayCache I) (s : State I)
    (haligned : ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable risk cache s)
    (hphase : cache.phase = .testing) (hactive : s.halted = false) (stage : I.Stage)
    (hcursor : s.cursor = stage.val)
    (htarget : (referenceAvailableCacheTarget I initialAvailable risk cache).isSome) :
    ∃ nextCache nextState,
      Step input C .uncapped accounting tapes s (.review stage) nextState ∧
      ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable risk nextCache nextState := by
  let symbol := tapes stage (s.ledger.reviews stage).toNat
  let nextCache : ReferenceReplayCache I := { cache with seen := cache.seen ++ [.observation stage symbol.val] }
  let nextState : State I := record accounting s (.review stage) [.observation stage symbol.val]
    (reviewLedger s stage) s.cursor false
  have hs := referenceAvailableReplay_some_spec input initialAvailable risk s.history cache haligned.parsed
  have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans hactive
  have hstage := referenceStateAligned_stage input initialAvailable risk cache s haligned stage hcursor
  have hfields := haligned.current_fields stage hcursor
  simp only [hphase, referenceCurrentLedgerFits] at hfields
  have hport : s.ledger.written stage = none := by
    exact hfields.1
  have hstep : referenceAvailableStep input initialAvailable risk cache (.observation stage symbol.val) = some nextCache := by
    have halphabet : symbol.val < (input.experiment stage).alphabetSize := symbol.isLt
    simp [referenceAvailableStep, hh, hstage, hphase, halphabet, htarget, nextCache]
  have hfold : (s.history ++ [VisibleEvent.observation stage symbol.val]).foldlM
      (referenceAvailableStep input initialAvailable risk) (referenceReplayInitial I) = some nextCache := by
    rw [List.foldlM_append, hs.2.1]
    simpa using hstep
  have hg : nextCache.phase ≠ .written ∧ nextCache.events.length ≤ I.stageCount ∧
      historyCursor nextCache.seen ≤ I.stageCount ∧ nextCache.seen = nextState.history := by

theorem referenceStateAligned_write (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) {Seed : Type*}
    (policy : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I} (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes n s)
    (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (risk : ℚ) (cache : ReferenceReplayCache I)
    (haligned : ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable risk cache s) (hphase : cache.phase = .testing)
    (hactive : s.halted = false) (stage : I.Stage) (hcursor : s.cursor = stage.val) (bit : Bool) :
    ∃ nextCache nextState,
      Step input C .uncapped accounting tapes s (.write stage bit) nextState ∧
      ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable risk nextCache nextState := by
  obtain ⟨kind, current, hkind, hcurrent, hvalid, hlen⟩ :=
    referenceStateAligned_testing_ready input initialAvailable risk cache s haligned hphase stage hcursor
  let nextCache : ReferenceReplayCache I := { cache with
    seen := cache.seen ++ [.wrote stage bit s.clock, .report stage (s.ledger.truth stage) s.clock]
    events := cache.events ++ [(kind, decide (bit ≠ s.ledger.truth stage))]
    phase := .reported }
  let nextState : State I := record accounting s (.write stage bit) (writeResponses C s stage bit)
    (reportedWriteLedger C s stage bit) s.cursor false
  have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans hactive
  have hstage := referenceStateAligned_stage input initialAvailable risk cache s haligned stage hcursor
  have hserial : s.clock = (historyActions cache.seen).length := by
    rw [haligned.seen]
    exact (prefix_historyActions_length input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp).symm
  have hpacket := referenceAvailableReplay_write_packet input initialAvailable risk s.history cache haligned.parsed
    hh hphase stage hstage kind hkind current hcurrent hlen bit (s.ledger.truth stage) s.clock hserial
  have hparse : referenceAvailableReplay input initialAvailable risk nextState.history = some nextCache := by
    simpa only [record, writeResponses, hearly, ite_true, writeLedger, nextCache, nextState,
      List.singleton_append] using hpacket
  have hfields := haligned.current_fields stage hcursor
  simp only [hphase, referenceCurrentLedgerFits] at hfields
  have hcorrect : referenceReplayCorrect nextCache stage = decide (bit = s.ledger.truth stage) := by
    simp [referenceReplayCorrect, nextCache, historyWrite, historyReport, List.filterMap_append,
      List.filterMap_cons, eventWrite, eventReport]
  have hnextKind : referenceAvailableKind I initialAvailable nextCache = some kind := by
    simpa only [nextCache, referenceAvailableKind, referenceReplayStage,
      historyCursor_append_write_report] using hkind

      referenceBudgetStep kind (!(referenceReplayCorrect nextCache stage)) current := by
    rw [hcorrect]
    simp only [referenceReplayRisk, nextCache, budgetPath_append, referenceBudgetPath]
    change (referenceReplayRisk risk cache).bind

  · exact hh
  · simpa only [nextCache, nextState, record, historyCursor_append_write_report] using haligned.cursor

  · intro currentStage hcurrentCursor

      hearly, ite_true, writeLedger, Function.update_self]

      using haligned.entry_tools

theorem referenceStateAligned_allocate (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) {Seed : Type*} (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s nextState : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes n s)
    (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (cache : ReferenceReplayCache I)
    (haligned : ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable budget cache s)
    (hphase : cache.phase = .reported) (stage : I.Stage) (hcursor : s.cursor = stage.val)
    (handle : MismatchHandle I) (tool : I.Tool)
    (hmismatch : referenceReplayMismatch cache stage handle = true)
    (hpick : referenceAvailableRepairTool I initialAvailable stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) = some tool)
    (current : ℚ) (hcurrent : referenceReplayRisk budget cache = some current)
    (hstep : Step input C .uncapped accounting tapes s (.allocate handle tool) nextState) :
    ∃ nextCache, ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable budget nextCache nextState := by
  cases hstep with
  | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
    let nextCache : ReferenceReplayCache I := { cache with
      seen := cache.seen ++ [.committed handle tool]
      phase := .allocated tool }
    have hs := referenceAvailableReplay_some_spec input initialAvailable budget s.history cache haligned.parsed
    have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans active
    have hstage := referenceStateAligned_stage input initialAvailable budget cache s haligned stage hcursor
    have hhandleStage := referenceReplayMismatch_stage cache stage handle hmismatch
    have hpickSpec := (referenceAvailableRepairTool_spec I initialAvailable stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) tool hpick).1
    have hmem : tool ∈ initialAvailable := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp hpickSpec).2).1
    have hnotEntry : tool ∉ historyUsed cache.entryHistory := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp hpickSpec).2).2
    have hentry : historyUsed cache.entryHistory = historyUsed cache.seen := by
      simpa only [referenceEntryToolsFit, hphase] using haligned.entry_tools
    have hnot : tool ∉ historyUsed cache.seen := hentry ▸ hnotEntry
    have hcompat : tool ∈ I.eligible stage := hhandleStage ▸ compatible
    have hparser : referenceAvailableStep input initialAvailable budget cache (.committed handle tool) = some nextCache := by
      simp [referenceAvailableStep, hh, hstage, hcurrent, hphase, hmismatch, hcompat, hnot, hmem, hpick, nextCache]
    have hcur : historyCursor nextCache.seen = historyCursor cache.seen :=
      historyCursor_append_noAdvance cache.seen (.committed handle tool) rfl
    have hparse := replay_extend input initialAvailable budget s.history cache nextCache (.committed handle tool)
      haligned.parsed hparser ⟨by simp [nextCache], hs.2.2.2.1, hcur ▸ hs.2.2.2.2.1,
        congrArg (fun seen => seen ++ [.committed handle tool]) haligned.seen⟩
    have hfields := haligned.current_fields stage hcursor
    simp only [hphase, referenceCurrentLedgerFits] at hfields
    have hwf := prefix_ledgerWellFormed input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp
    have hexUnused : ∀ e ∈ s.ledger.executions, e.tool ≠ tool := by
      intro e he heq
      obtain ⟨a, ha, _, hatool, _⟩ := hwf.backed e he
      exact unused a ha (hatool.trans heq)
    refine ⟨nextCache, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · exact hparse
    · exact congrArg (fun seen => seen ++ [.committed handle tool]) haligned.seen
    · exact hh
    · exact hcur.trans haligned.cursor
    · simpa only [nextCache, record, referencePhaseReportCount, hphase] using haligned.trace_count
    · intro ht
      cases ht
    · intro currentStage hc
      have heq : currentStage = stage := Fin.ext (hc.symm.trans hcursor)
      subst currentStage
      refine ⟨handle, hhandleStage, ?_, hcompat, ?_, hexUnused, hfields.2.2.2⟩
      · exact valid
      · exact ⟨⟨handle, tool, s.clock⟩, by simp [record, allocateLedger], rfl, rfl⟩
    · simp only [referenceEntryToolsFit, nextCache, historyUsed_append_commitment]
      exact ⟨congrArg (insert tool) hentry, hnotEntry⟩
    · intro _ currentStage hc
      obtain ⟨kind, entryRisk, hk, hv, hu⟩ := haligned.reported_update (by simp [hphase, referencePhaseReportCount]) currentStage hc
      refine ⟨kind, entryRisk, ?_, hv, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [nextCache, referenceAvailableKind, referenceReplayStage, hcur] using hk
      · have hcorrect := replayCorrect_append_unrelated cache (.committed handle tool) (.allocated tool) currentStage rfl rfl
        simpa only [nextCache, referenceReplayRisk, hcorrect] using hu
    · intro _ _
      exact ⟨current, hcurrent⟩

    (hstep : Step input C .uncapped accounting tapes s (.advance stage) nextState) :

  | advance stage live written resources =>

  have hparse := replay_extend input initialAvailable budget s.history cache nextCache .stopped haligned.parsed hparser
    ⟨by simp [nextCache, hphase], hs.2.2.2.1, hcur ▸ hs.2.2.2.2.1,
      congrArg (fun seen => seen ++ [.stopped]) haligned.seen⟩
  refine ⟨nextCache, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · simpa only [stopState, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] using hparse
  · exact congrArg (fun seen => seen ++ [.stopped]) haligned.seen
  · rfl
  · exact hcur.trans haligned.cursor
  · exact haligned.trace_count
  · intro _
    exact haligned.testing_risk hphase
  · intro stage hstage
    have hs : stage.val < I.stageCount := stage.isLt
    change s.cursor = stage.val at hstage
    omega
  · have hused := historyUsed_append_noCommitment cache.seen .stopped rfl
    simpa only [referenceEntryToolsFit, nextCache, hused] using haligned.entry_tools
  · intro ht
    simp only [nextCache, hphase, referencePhaseReportCount] at ht
    contradiction
  · intro tool ht
    simp only [nextCache, hphase] at ht
    rcases ht with ht | ht <;> cases ht

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceState.signature_start: theorem referenceStateAligned_step {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceState.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceStateAligned_step {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (limit : ReferenceObservationLimit I)
    (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s nextState : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes n s)
    (cache : ReferenceReplayCache I) (haligned : ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable budget cache s)
    (hstep : Step input C .uncapped accounting tapes s
      (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history) nextState) :
    ∃ nextCache, ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable budget nextCache nextState := by
  have hactive := step_source_active input C .uncapped accounting tapes hstep
  have habandon : referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history = .abandon →
      ∃ nextCache, ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable budget nextCache nextState := by
    intro ha
    have hs := hstep
    rw [ha] at hs
    have heq := step_deterministic input C .uncapped accounting tapes hs (.abandon s hactive)
    rw [heq]
    exact referenceStateAligned_abandon input initialAvailable budget cache s haligned hactive
  by_cases hallow : historyAllowsAction s.history (referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history)
  · have hrule : referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history =
        referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history := by
      exact ite_eq_left hallow
    have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans hactive
    by_cases hbound : s.cursor < I.stageCount
    · let stage : I.Stage := ⟨s.cursor, hbound⟩
      have hcursor : s.cursor = stage.val := rfl
      have hstage := referenceStateAligned_stage input initialAvailable budget cache s haligned stage hcursor
      cases hphase : cache.phase with
      | written =>
        exact ((referenceAvailableReplay_some_spec input initialAvailable budget s.history cache haligned.parsed).2.2.1 hphase).elim
      | testing =>
        have ha := referenceRule_testing_eq_of_aligned input C accounting initialAvailable budget limit
          seed truth tapes hp hactive cache haligned hphase stage hcursor
        rcases referenceTestingAction_supported input initialAvailable budget limit cache stage with hreview | ⟨bit, hwrite⟩ | habort
        · have hs := hstep
          rw [ha, hreview] at hs
          obtain ⟨nextCache, result, hs', ha'⟩ := referenceStateAligned_review input C accounting tapes
            initialAvailable budget cache s haligned hphase hactive stage hcursor
            (referenceTestingAction_review_target input initialAvailable budget limit cache stage hreview)
          rw [step_deterministic input C .uncapped accounting tapes hs hs']
          exact ⟨nextCache, ha'⟩
        · have hs := hstep
          rw [ha, hwrite] at hs
          obtain ⟨nextCache, result, hs', ha'⟩ := referenceStateAligned_write input C hearly accounting
            (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes hp initialAvailable budget cache
            haligned hphase hactive stage hcursor bit
          rw [step_deterministic input C .uncapped accounting tapes hs hs']
          exact ⟨nextCache, ha'⟩
        · exact habandon (ha.trans habort)
      | reported =>
        cases hc : referenceReplayCorrect cache stage with
        | true =>
          have ha : referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history = .advance stage := by
            rw [hrule]
            simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hc]
          have hs := hstep
          rw [ha] at hs
          obtain ⟨current, hcurrent⟩ := referenceStateAligned_reported_correct_risk input initialAvailable budget cache s
            haligned hphase stage hcursor hc
          exact referenceStateAligned_advance input C accounting (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit)
            seed truth tapes hp initialAvailable budget cache haligned stage hcursor (Or.inl ⟨hphase, hc⟩) current hcurrent hs
        | false =>
          cases hr : referenceReplayRisk budget cache with
          | none =>
            apply habandon
            rw [hrule]
            simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hc, hr]
          | some current =>
            cases hv : referenceVisibleHandle s.history stage with
            | none =>
              apply habandon
              rw [hrule]
              simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hc, hr, hv]
            | some handle =>
              cases ht : referenceAvailableRepairTool I initialAvailable stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) with
              | none =>
                apply habandon
                rw [hrule]
                simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hc, hr, hv, ht]
              | some tool =>
                have ha : referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history = .allocate handle tool := by
                  rw [hrule]
                  simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hc, hr, hv, ht]
                have hs := hstep
                rw [ha] at hs
                have hm := (referenceStateAligned_reported_mismatch input C hearly accounting
                  (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes hp initialAvailable budget cache
                  haligned hphase stage hcursor hc handle hv).2
                exact referenceStateAligned_allocate input C accounting (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit)
                  seed truth tapes hp initialAvailable budget cache haligned hphase stage hcursor handle tool hm ht current hr hs
      | allocated tool =>
        cases hv : referenceVisibleHandle s.history stage with
        | none =>
          apply habandon
          rw [hrule]
          simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hv]
        | some handle =>
          have ha : referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history = .execute handle tool := by
            rw [hrule]
            simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hv]
          have hs := hstep
          rw [ha] at hs
          obtain ⟨oldHandle, hhs, hvalid, _, _, _, _⟩ := by
            simpa only [hphase, referenceCurrentLedgerFits] using haligned.current_fields stage hcursor
          have hvo := prefix_visibleHandle_of_valid input C hearly .uncapped accounting
            (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes hp oldHandle hvalid
          rw [hhs] at hvo
          have heq : handle = oldHandle := Option.some.inj (hv.symm.trans hvo)
          subst handle
          have hm := prefix_replayMismatch_of_valid input C hearly .uncapped accounting
            (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes hp cache haligned.seen oldHandle hvalid
          rw [hhs] at hm
          exact referenceStateAligned_execute input C accounting tapes initialAvailable budget cache haligned
            stage hcursor oldHandle tool hphase hm hs
      | executed tool =>
        have ha : referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history = .advance stage := by
          rw [hrule]
          simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase]
        have hs := hstep
        rw [ha] at hs
        obtain ⟨current, hcurrent⟩ := haligned.correction_risk tool (Or.inr hphase)
        exact referenceStateAligned_advance input C accounting (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit)
          seed truth tapes hp initialAvailable budget cache haligned stage hcursor (Or.inr ⟨tool, hphase⟩) current hcurrent hs
    · have hcursor : s.cursor = I.stageCount := by
        have hc := (prefix_cursorInvariant input C .uncapped accounting
          (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes hp).bound
        omega
      have hs := referenceAvailableReplay_some_spec input initialAvailable budget s.history cache haligned.parsed
      have hphase : cache.phase = .testing := by
        cases hc : cache.phase with
        | testing => rfl
        | written => exact (hs.2.2.1 hc).elim
        | reported | allocated tool | executed tool =>
          have ht := haligned.trace_count
          simp only [hc, referencePhaseReportCount] at ht
          omega
      have hstage : referenceReplayStage I cache = none := by
        simp [referenceReplayStage, haligned.cursor, hbound]
      have hhistory : historyCursor s.history = I.stageCount := by
        rw [← haligned.seen, haligned.cursor, hcursor]
      have ha : referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history = .stop := by
        rw [hrule]
        simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hhistory]
      have hs' := hstep
      rw [ha] at hs'
      rw [step_deterministic input C .uncapped accounting tapes hs' (.stop s hactive)]
      exact referenceStateAligned_stop input initialAvailable budget cache s haligned hactive hphase hcursor
  · exact habandon (ite_eq_right hallow)

theorem prefix_referenceStateAligned {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (limit : ReferenceObservationLimit I) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes n s) :
    ∃ cache, ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable budget cache s := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => exact ⟨referenceReplayInitial I, referenceStateAligned_initial input initialAvailable budget hbudget hsmall truth⟩
  | next earlier step ih =>
    obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := ih
    exact referenceStateAligned_step input C hearly accounting initialAvailable budget limit seed truth tapes earlier cache haligned step

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceCandi.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceCandidateAction_allowed_of_aligned
PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceCandi.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceCandidateAction_allowed_of_aligned {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed)
    (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes n s)
    (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (limit : ReferenceObservationLimit I)
    (cache : ReferenceReplayCache I) (haligned : ReferenceStateAligned input initialAvailable budget cache s) :
    historyAllowsAction s.history (referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history) := by
  cases hh : cache.halted with
  | true => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, historyAllowsAction]
  | false =>
    cases hs : referenceReplayStage I cache with
    | none =>
      simp only [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, hs]
      split_ifs <;> trivial
    | some stage =>
      have hcursor : s.cursor = stage.val := haligned.cursor.symm.trans (cursor_of_replayStage cache stage hs)
      have hch : historyCursor s.history = stage.val := by rw [← haligned.seen]; exact haligned.cursor.trans hcursor
      cases hphase : cache.phase with
      | testing =>
        have hcand : referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history =
            referenceTestingAction input initialAvailable budget limit cache stage := by
          simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase]
        rw [hcand]
        exact referenceTestingAction_allowed_of_aligned input C accounting policy seed truth tapes hp
          initialAvailable budget limit cache haligned hphase stage hcursor
      | written => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase, historyAllowsAction]
      | reported =>
        have hf := haligned.current_fields stage hcursor
        simp only [hphase, referenceCurrentLedgerFits] at hf
        cases hc : referenceReplayCorrect cache stage with
        | true =>
          have hcand : referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history = .advance stage := by
            simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase, hc]
          rw [hcand]
          refine ⟨hch, ?_⟩
          rw [prefix_historyWritten input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp stage]
          exact hf.1
        | false =>
          cases hr : referenceReplayRisk budget cache with
          | none => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase, hc, hr, historyAllowsAction]
          | some current =>
            cases hv : referenceVisibleHandle s.history stage with
            | none => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase, hc, hr, hv, historyAllowsAction]
            | some handle =>
              cases ht : referenceAvailableRepairTool I initialAvailable stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) with
              | none => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase, hc, hr, hv, ht, historyAllowsAction]
              | some tool =>
                have hcand : referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history = .allocate handle tool := by
                  simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase, hc, hr, hv, ht]
                rw [hcand]
                obtain ⟨hvalid, hm⟩ := referenceStateAligned_reported_mismatch input C hearly accounting policy seed truth tapes hp
                  initialAvailable budget cache haligned hphase stage hcursor hc handle hv
                have hhs := referenceReplayMismatch_stage cache stage handle hm
                have hpick := (referenceAvailableRepairTool_spec I initialAvailable stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) tool ht).1
                have hentry : historyUsed cache.entryHistory = historyUsed s.history := by
                  simpa only [referenceEntryToolsFit, hphase, haligned.seen] using haligned.entry_tools
                refine ⟨by simpa only [hhs] using hch,
                  prefix_historyValidHandle_of_valid input C hearly .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp handle hvalid,
                  ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
                · simpa only [hhs] using (Finset.mem_inter.mp hpick).1
                · rw [← hentry]
                  exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp hpick).2).2
                · intro pair hpair
                  rw [prefix_historyCommitments input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp] at hpair
                  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpair
                  simpa only [hhs] using hf.2.2.1 a ha
      | allocated tool =>
        cases hv : referenceVisibleHandle s.history stage with
        | none => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase, hv, historyAllowsAction]
        | some handle =>
          have hcand : referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history = .execute handle tool := by
            simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase, hv]
          rw [hcand]
          obtain ⟨oldHandle, hhs, hvalid, hcompat, hcommitted, hunused, hstageUnused⟩ := by
            simpa only [hphase, referenceCurrentLedgerFits] using haligned.current_fields stage hcursor
          have hvo := prefix_visibleHandle_of_valid input C hearly .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp oldHandle hvalid
          rw [hhs] at hvo
          have heq : handle = oldHandle := Option.some.inj (hv.symm.trans hvo)
          subst handle
          refine ⟨by simpa only [hhs] using hch,
            prefix_historyValidHandle_of_valid input C hearly .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp oldHandle hvalid,
            by simpa only [hhs] using hcompat, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · obtain ⟨a, ha, hh, ht⟩ := hcommitted
            rw [prefix_historyCommitments input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp]
            exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, Prod.ext hh ht⟩
          · intro pair hpair
            rw [prefix_historyExecutions input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp] at hpair
            obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpair
            exact hunused e he
          · intro pair hpair
            rw [prefix_historyExecutions input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp] at hpair
            obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpair
            simpa only [hhs] using hstageUnused e he
      | executed tool =>
        have hcand : referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history = .advance stage := by
          simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hs, hphase]
        rw [hcand]
        refine ⟨hch, ?_⟩
        rw [prefix_historyWritten input C .uncapped accounting policy seed truth tapes hp stage]
        have hf := haligned.current_fields stage hcursor
        simp only [hphase, referenceCurrentLedgerFits] at hf
        exact hf.1

theorem referenceRule_eq_candidate_of_prefix {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool)
    (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (limit : ReferenceObservationLimit I) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes n s) :
    referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit seed s.history =
      referenceCandidateAction input initialAvailable budget limit s.history := by
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting initialAvailable budget hbudget hsmall
    limit seed truth tapes hp
  exact ite_eq_left (referenceCandidateAction_allowed_of_aligned input C hearly accounting
    (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget limit) seed truth tapes hp initialAvailable budget limit cache haligned)

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceBudge.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceBudgetMass_on_entry
PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceBudge.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceBudgetMass_on_entry
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (stage nextStage : I.Stage)
    (hnextStage : nextStage.val = stage.val + 1) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) :
    input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩
          referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) +
      (∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
        referenceEntryBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget nextStage sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget history).getD 0 : ℝ) *
        input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) := by
  classical
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
  let E := referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history
  have hE : MeasurableSet E := measurableSet_referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history
  by_cases hex : ∃ sample : Unit × input.World, sample ∈ E
  · obtain ⟨witness, hw⟩ := hex
    obtain ⟨kind, risk, hk, hr, hv, ht⟩ := referenceEntryRisk_kind_target input C hearly accounting available budget
      hbudget hsmall witness stage history hw
    have hi : (∫⁻ sample in E, referenceEntryBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget nextStage sample ∂μ) ≤
        ∫⁻ sample in E, referenceChildBudgetEnvelope input C accounting available budget stage kind risk sample ∂μ := by
      apply setLIntegral_mono' hE
      intro sample hs
      exact referenceNextEntryBudget_le_on_entry input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage nextStage
        hnextStage history kind risk hk hr sample hs
    change μ (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) +
      (∫⁻ sample in E, referenceEntryBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget nextStage sample ∂μ) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget history).getD 0 : ℝ) * μ E
    rw [hr, Option.getD_some]
    cases kind with
    | infiniteRank =>
      have hzero : μ (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) = 0 := by
        rw [show referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E = ∅ from
          noToolFailure_entry_empty input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage history (by rw [hk]; simp)]
        exact measure_empty
      rw [hzero, zero_add]
      simpa only [referenceChildBudgetEnvelope, setLIntegral_const] using hi
    | noTool =>
      have he : μ (referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) * μ E :=
        referenceStageWriteError_on_entry_le input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage history (risk / 2) ht
      have hf : μ (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) ≤
          μ (referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) :=
        measure_mono (fun sample hs => (referenceNoToolFailure_on_entry_kind input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage history hs).2)
      have hchild : (∫⁻ sample in E, referenceEntryBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget nextStage sample ∂μ) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) * μ E := by
        simpa only [referenceChildBudgetEnvelope, setLIntegral_const] using hi
      calc
        _ ≤ μ (referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) +
            ENNReal.ofReal ((risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) * μ E := add_le_add hf hchild
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) * μ E +
            μ (referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) := add_comm _ _
        _ ≤ _ := referenceBudget_noTool_entry_mass risk hv.1.le _ _ he
    | finiteBad depth =>
      have hzero : μ (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) = 0 := by
        rw [show referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E = ∅ from
          noToolFailure_entry_empty input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage history (by rw [hk]; simp)]
        exact measure_empty
      rw [hzero, zero_add]
      have he : μ (referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((controllerTarget risk depth.val : ℚ) : ℝ) * μ E :=
        referenceStageWriteError_on_entry_le input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage history _ ht
      have herror := measurableSet_referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage
      have heval : (∫⁻ sample in E, referenceChildBudgetEnvelope input C accounting available budget stage (.finiteBad depth) risk sample ∂μ) =
          ENNReal.ofReal ((risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) * μ E +
            ENNReal.ofReal ((controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk depth.val) : ℚ) : ℝ) *
              μ (referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) := by
        simp only [referenceChildBudgetEnvelope]
        rw [lintegral_add_right _ (measurable_const.indicator herror), setLIntegral_const,
          lintegral_indicator herror, setLIntegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply herror]
      exact (hi.trans_eq heval).trans (referenceBudget_finiteBad_entry_mass risk hv depth _ _ he)
  · have hEmpty : E = ∅ := Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr (fun sample hs => hex ⟨sample, hs⟩)
    change μ (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩ E) +
      (∫⁻ sample in E, referenceEntryBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget nextStage sample ∂μ) ≤ _
    rw [hEmpty]
    simp
