theorem referenceStage_budget_mass_nonincreasing
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (stage : I.Stage) :
    input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage) +
      (∫⁻ sample, referenceNextBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget stage sample
        ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample, referenceEntryBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget stage sample
        ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) := by
  have hnext := lintegral_eq_tsum_referenceEntry input C accounting available budget stage _
    (measurable_referenceNextBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget stage)
    (referenceNextBudget_zero_of_no_entry input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage)
  calc
    _ = (∑' history : List (VisibleEvent I), input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
          (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩
            referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history)) +
        (∑' history : List (VisibleEvent I), ∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
          referenceNextBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget stage sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) := by
      rw [failureMass_eq_tsum_entry input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage, hnext]
    _ = ∑' history : List (VisibleEvent I),
        (input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage ∩
          referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) +
          ∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
            referenceNextBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget stage sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) := ENNReal.tsum_add.symm
    _ ≤ ∑' history : List (VisibleEvent I), ENNReal.ofReal ((referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget history).getD 0 : ℝ) *
        input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) :=
      ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (referenceBudgetMass_on_entry_allStages input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage)
    _ = _ := (currentBudgetMass_eq_tsum_entry input C accounting available budget stage).symm

theorem referenceBudgetMassAt_initial
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) :
    referenceBudgetMassAt input C accounting available budget 0 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((budget / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
  by_cases hzero : 0 < I.stageCount
  · simp only [referenceBudgetMassAt, hzero, dite_true]
    have hpoint : ∀ sample : Unit × input.World,
        referenceEntryBudgetPotential input C accounting available budget ⟨0, hzero⟩ sample =
          ENNReal.ofReal ((budget / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
      intro sample
      have he := entryHistory_stageZero input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule (Seed := Unit) input available budget none)
        ⟨0, hzero⟩ rfl sample
      simp only [referenceEntryBudgetPotential, he, referenceAvailableEntryRisk_initial input available budget hbudget hsmall, Option.getD_some]
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ _sample : Unit × input.World, ENNReal.ofReal ((budget / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ)
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) := lintegral_congr hpoint
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((budget / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by simp
  · simp only [referenceBudgetMassAt, hzero, dite_false]
    exact zero_le

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceIdeal.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceIdealRisk_le_half
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) :
    risk input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) (Measure.dirac ()) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((budget : ℝ) / 2) := by
  have hsum : (∑ stage : I.Stage, input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
      (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range I.stageCount, referenceFailureMassAt input C accounting available budget k := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ stage : I.Stage, referenceFailureMassAt input C accounting available budget stage.val := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro stage _
        unfold referenceFailureMassAt
        rw [dite_eq_left (show stage.val < I.stageCount from stage.isLt)]
      _ = _ := Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range _ I.stageCount
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ stage : I.Stage, input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage) :=
      referenceRisk_le_sum_noToolFailure input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range I.stageCount, referenceFailureMassAt input C accounting available budget k := hsum
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((budget / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) :=
      referenceFailureMass_sum_le_initial (referenceFailureMassAt input C accounting available budget)
        (referenceBudgetMassAt input C accounting available budget) I.stageCount _
        (referenceBudgetMassAt_step input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall)
        (referenceBudgetMassAt_initial input C accounting available budget hbudget hsmall)
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      push_cast
      rfl

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_referen.signature_start: theorem prefix_referencePosteriorWrite_realization {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_referen.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_referencePosteriorWrite_realization {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n s)
    (hactive : s.halted = false) (stage : I.Stage) (bit : Bool)
    (haction : referenceRule input available budget none sample.1 s.history = .write stage bit)
    (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ)
    (hentry : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample = some history)
    (htarget : referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget history = some p) :
    (input.experiment stage).posteriorThresholdStop p (sample.2 stage).2 = ((s.ledger.reviews stage).toNat : ℕ∞) ∧
      bit = ((input.experiment stage).posteriorSPRT p).rule.decision () (sample.2 stage).2 := by
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall none
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp
  have hcand := (referenceRule_eq_candidate_of_prefix input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall none
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp).symm.trans haction
  obtain ⟨hphase, hstage, htest⟩ := candidate_write_testing input available budget s.history cache haligned.parsed stage bit hcand
  have hcursor := haligned.cursor.symm.trans (cursor_of_replayStage cache stage hstage)
  obtain ⟨origin, he, _, ht, hprogress⟩ := prefix_testing_origin input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall sample
    hp cache haligned hactive hphase stage hcursor
  have heq : origin = history := Option.some.inj (he.symm.trans hentry)
  rw [heq] at ht
  have hpCache : referenceAvailableCacheTarget I available budget cache = some p := ht.symm.trans htarget
  have hb := cacheTarget_bounds I available budget p cache hpCache
  have hvalid : ∀ symbol ∈ historyObservations s.history stage, symbol < (input.experiment stage).alphabetSize :=
    fun symbol hm => prefix_historyObservation_alphabet input C .uncapped accounting
      (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp stage symbol hm
  have hvalidCache : ∀ symbol ∈ historyObservations cache.seen stage, symbol < (input.experiment stage).alphabetSize := by
    simpa only [haligned.seen] using hvalid
  obtain ⟨hhit, hbit⟩ := referenceTestingAction_posteriorWrite_hit input available budget p cache stage bit hpCache hvalidCache htest
  have hhit' : (input.experiment stage).rationalWordHits p (historyObservationWord input s.history stage hvalid) = true := by
    simpa only [haligned.seen] using hhit
  have hbit' : bit = (input.experiment stage).rationalWordMAP (historyObservationWord input s.history stage hvalid) := by
    simpa only [haligned.seen] using hbit
  have hboundary := (prefix_historyObservationWord_hits_iff input C .uncapped accounting
    (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp stage hvalid p hb.1 hb.2).mp hhit'
  have hle := ((input.experiment stage).posteriorThresholdStop_le_iff p (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) (s.ledger.reviews stage).toNat).mpr
    ⟨_, le_rfl, hboundary⟩
  have hfinite := prefix_reviews_natCast_toNat input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp stage
  have hw : worldTapes input sample.2 stage = (sample.2 stage).2 := by funext k; rfl
  have hge : ((s.ledger.reviews stage).toNat : ℕ∞) ≤
      (input.experiment stage).posteriorThresholdStop p (worldTapes input sample.2 stage) := by
    rw [hfinite, hw]
    exact hprogress p hpCache
  have hstop := le_antisymm hle hge
  refine ⟨by simpa only [hw] using hstop, ?_⟩
  have hmap := prefix_historyObservationWord_MAP_at_stop input C .uncapped accounting
    (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp stage hvalid p hstop
  simpa only [hw] using hbit'.trans hmap

theorem referenceStagePosteriorError_subset_entryPosteriorError (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (stage : I.Stage) :
    referenceStagePosteriorError input C hearly accounting available budget stage ⊆
      entryPosteriorError input C .uncapped accounting (referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget).rule
        stage (referenceAvailableEntryChoice input available budget) := by
  rintro ⟨⟨⟩, world⟩ ⟨n, bit, history, p, hactive, hwrite, hentry, htarget, hwrong⟩
  obtain ⟨_, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget).rule
    (referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget).legal ((), world) n
  have hreal := prefix_referencePosteriorWrite_realization input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall ((), world)
    hp hactive stage bit hwrite history p hentry htarget
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change entryGatedTarget (referenceAvailableEntryChoice input available budget)
      ((), entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage ((), world)) = some p
    have he : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage ((), world) = some history := hentry
    rw [he]
    exact htarget
  · change ((input.experiment stage).posteriorSPRT p).rule.decision () (world stage).2 ≠ (world stage).1
    rw [← hreal.2]
    exact hwrong

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceStage.signature_start: theorem referenceStagePosteriorError_on_entry_le (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceStage.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceStagePosteriorError_on_entry_le (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (stage : I.Stage)
    (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ)
    (htarget : referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget history = some p) :
    input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        (referenceStagePosteriorError input C hearly accounting available budget stage ∩
          {sample | entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget).rule
            stage sample = some history}) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (p : ℝ) * input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        {sample | entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget).rule
          stage sample = some history} := by
  let policy := referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
  let record := entrySeedHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage
  let joint := fun sample : Unit × input.World => (record sample, sample.2 stage)
  let rectangle : Set ((Unit × EntryHistory I) × input.StageSample stage) :=
    {((), some history)} ×ˢ fixedPosteriorError input stage p
  have hrecord : Measurable record := measurable_entrySeedHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule stage
  have hjoint : Measurable joint := hrecord.prodMk ((measurable_pi_apply stage).comp measurable_snd)
  have hrectangle : MeasurableSet rectangle := (measurableSet_singleton _).prod (measurableSet_fixedPosteriorError input stage p)
  have hsubset : referenceStagePosteriorError input C hearly accounting available budget stage ∩
      {sample | entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history} ⊆ joint ⁻¹' rectangle := by
    intro sample hs
    obtain ⟨q, hq, herror⟩ := referenceStagePosteriorError_subset_entryPosteriorError input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage hs.1
    have he : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history := hs.2
    have hq' : referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget history = some q := by
      change entryGatedTarget (referenceAvailableEntryChoice input available budget)
        (sample.1, entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample) = some q at hq
      rw [he] at hq
      exact hq
    have hqp : q = p := Option.some.inj (hq'.symm.trans htarget)
    subst q
    refine ⟨?_, herror⟩
    change (sample.1, entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample) ∈ {((), some history)}
    rw [he]
    cases sample.1
    exact Set.mem_singleton _
  have hmass : (μ.map record) {((), some history)} = μ
      {sample | entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history} := by
    rw [Measure.map_apply hrecord (measurableSet_singleton _)]
    congr 1
    ext sample
    change (sample.1, entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample) = ((), some history) ↔ _
    cases sample.1
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  have hp := referenceAvailableEntryTarget_valid input available budget p history htarget
  calc
    μ (referenceStagePosteriorError input C hearly accounting available budget stage ∩
        {sample | entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history})
      ≤ μ (joint ⁻¹' rectangle) := measure_mono hsubset
    _ = (μ.map joint) rectangle := (Measure.map_apply hjoint hrectangle).symm
    _ = ((μ.map record).prod (input.stageLaw stage)) rectangle := by
      rw [entrySeedHistory_jointLaw input C .uncapped accounting policy (Measure.dirac ()) stage]
    _ = (μ.map record) {((), some history)} * input.stageLaw stage (fixedPosteriorError input stage p) := Measure.prod_prod _ _
    _ ≤ (μ.map record) {((), some history)} * ENNReal.ofReal (p : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_right (stageLaw_fixedPosteriorError_le input stage p hp.1 hp.2) _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (p : ℝ) * μ
        {sample | entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history} := by
      rw [hmass, mul_comm]

theorem seededWorld_ae_all_posteriorSPRT_finite {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (stage : I.Stage) :
    ∀ᵐ sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν, ∀ p : ℚ, 0 < p → p ≤ 1 / 4 →
      (input.experiment stage).posteriorThresholdStop p (sample.2 stage).2 ≠ ⊤ := by
  rw [ae_all_iff]
  intro p
  by_cases hv : 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 1 / 4
  · have hs := stageLaw_posteriorSPRT_ae_finite input stage p hv.1 hv.2
    rw [← input.seededWorldLaw_coordinate ν stage] at hs
    have hw := ae_of_ae_map ((measurable_pi_apply stage).comp measurable_snd).aemeasurable hs
    filter_upwards [hw] with sample hsample
    intro _ _
    exact hsample
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ hp hq => (hv ⟨hp, hq⟩).elim)

    stage sample hinfinite

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRule_.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRule_ne_abandon_of_infinite_rank
PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRule_.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceRule_ne_abandon_of_infinite_rank {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (htop : errorRank I.compatibility available = ⊤)
    (limit : ReferenceObservationLimit I) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget limit)
      seed truth tapes n s) (hactive : s.halted = false) :
    referenceRule input available budget limit seed s.history ≠ .abandon := by
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall limit seed truth tapes hp
  have hinv := infiniteReplay_of_parse input available budget s.history cache htop haligned.parsed
  have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans hactive
  rw [referenceRule_eq_candidate_of_prefix input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall limit seed truth tapes hp]
  cases hstage : referenceReplayStage I cache with
  | none =>
    have hcursor : historyCursor s.history = I.stageCount := by
      have hb := (prefix_cursorInvariant input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceRule input available budget limit) seed truth tapes hp).bound
      have hnot : ¬ historyCursor cache.seen < I.stageCount := by
        intro h
        simp [referenceReplayStage, h] at hstage
      rw [← haligned.seen, haligned.cursor]
      rw [haligned.cursor] at hnot
      omega
    simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hcursor]
  | some stage =>
    have hc : s.cursor = stage.val := haligned.cursor.symm.trans (cursor_of_stage cache stage hstage)
    have hk := availableKind_top available cache stage hstage hinv.rank
    cases hphase : cache.phase with
    | testing => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, referenceTestingAction, hk]
    | written => exact ((referenceAvailableReplay_some_spec input available budget s.history cache
        haligned.parsed).2.2.1 hphase).elim
    | reported =>
      cases hcorrect : referenceReplayCorrect cache stage with
      | true => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hcorrect]
      | false =>
        obtain ⟨kind, entryRisk, hk', _, hr⟩ := haligned.reported_update
          (by simp [hphase, referencePhaseReportCount]) stage hc
        have hkind : kind = .infiniteRank := Option.some.inj (hk'.symm.trans hk)
        subst kind
        have hrisk : referenceReplayRisk budget cache = some entryRisk := by
          simpa only [referenceBudgetStep] using hr
        have hf := haligned.current_fields stage hc
        simp only [referenceCurrentLedgerFits, hphase] at hf
        obtain ⟨bit, hwritten⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hf.1
        have hwrite := prefix_historyWrite input C .uncapped accounting
          (referenceRule input available budget limit) seed truth tapes hp stage
        rw [hwritten] at hwrite
        have hvisible : referenceVisibleHandle s.history stage = some ⟨stage, s.ledger.writeSerial stage⟩ := by
          simp [referenceVisibleHandle, hwrite]
        obtain ⟨tool, hpick⟩ := repair_exists_of_rank_top available cache stage hstage hinv.rank
        simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hcorrect, hrisk, hvisible, hpick]
    | allocated tool =>
      obtain ⟨handle, hhandle, hvalid, _, _, _, _⟩ := by
        simpa only [hphase, referenceCurrentLedgerFits] using haligned.current_fields stage hc
      have hvisible := prefix_visibleHandle_of_valid input C hearly .uncapped accounting
        (referenceRule input available budget limit) seed truth tapes hp handle hvalid
      rw [hhandle] at hvisible
      simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hvisible]
    | executed tool => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase]

theorem referenceRun_halted_of_infinite_rank {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (htop : errorRank I.compatibility available = ⊤)
    (limit : ReferenceObservationLimit I) (sample : Seed × input.World) :
    (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget limit)
      sample (zeroReviewActionBound I + 1)).halted = true := by
  by_contra hh
  have ha : (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget limit)
      sample (zeroReviewActionBound I + 1)).halted = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh
  have hp := run_prefix_of_active input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget limit)
    (referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting available budget limit) sample
    (zeroReviewActionBound I + 1) ha
  have hz := prefix_reference_reviews_zero_of_infinite_rank input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall htop limit sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp
  have hn := prefix_length_le_of_zero_reviews input C .uncapped accounting
    (referenceRule input available budget limit) sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2)
    (worldTapes input sample.2) hp hz
  omega

theorem prefix_reference_pastCorrect {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (limit : ReferenceObservationLimit I) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget limit)
      seed truth tapes n s) :
    ∀ stage : I.Stage, stage.val < s.cursor →
      s.ledger.written stage = some (s.ledger.truth stage) ∨
        ∃ e ∈ s.ledger.executions, e.handle.stage = stage := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => intro stage hstage; exact (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hstage).elim
  | @next n s next earlier step ih =>
    generalize haction : referenceRule input available budget limit seed s.history = action at step
    cases step with
    | review current live port resources => exact ih
    | write current bit live port resources =>
      intro stage hstage
      have hne : stage ≠ current := by
        intro heq
        subst stage
        change current.val < s.cursor at hstage
        have hc := live.2
        omega
      simpa only [record, reportedWriteLedger, hearly, ite_true, writeLedger, Function.update_of_ne hne] using ih stage hstage
    | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources => exact ih
    | execute handle tool active valid compatible committed unused uncorrected window resources =>
      intro stage hstage
      rcases ih stage hstage with hcorrect | ⟨e, he, hs⟩
      · exact Or.inl hcorrect
      · exact Or.inr ⟨e, List.mem_append_left _ he, hs⟩
    | advance current live written resources =>
      intro stage hstage
      by_cases hold : stage.val < s.cursor
      · exact ih stage hold
      · have heq : stage = current := by
          apply Fin.ext
          change stage.val < s.cursor + 1 at hstage
          have hc := live.2
          omega
        subst stage
        exact referenceAdvance_correct_or_repaired input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall
          limit seed truth tapes earlier current (.advance s current live written resources) haction
    | stop active | abandon active => exact ih

theorem referenceRun_success_of_infinite_rank {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (htop : errorRank I.compatibility available = ⊤)
    (limit : ReferenceObservationLimit I) (sample : Seed × input.World) :
    runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget limit) sample := by
  have hhalt := referenceRun_halted_of_infinite_rank input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall htop limit sample
  obtain ⟨n, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget limit)
    (referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting available budget limit) sample (zeroReviewActionBound I + 1)
  exact ⟨zeroReviewActionBound I + 1, hhalt,
    prefix_reference_halted_success_of_infinite_rank input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget
      hsmall htop limit sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp hhalt⟩

theorem referenceRisk_zero_of_infinite_rank {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed]

    (htop : errorRank I.compatibility available = ⊤)

    exact referenceRun_success_of_infinite_rank input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall htop limit sample
  rw [risk, hempty, measure_empty]

theorem referenceRun_ae_halts
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∀ᵐ sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()),
      ∃ n, (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n).halted = true := by
  have hlocal : ∀ stage : I.Stage,
      ∀ᵐ sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()),
        sample ∉ referenceStageInfiniteReviews input C hearly accounting available budget stage := by
    intro stage
    apply ae_iff.mpr
    have heq : {sample : Unit × input.World |
        ¬ sample ∉ referenceStageInfiniteReviews input C hearly accounting available budget stage} =
        referenceStageInfiniteReviews input C hearly accounting available budget stage := by
      ext sample
      simp
    rw [heq]
    exact referenceStageInfiniteReviews_measure_zero input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hlocal] with sample hsample
  exact referenceRun_halts_of_not_infinite_reviews input C hearly accounting available budget sample hsample

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRule_.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceRule_abandon_noTool_error {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) seed truth tapes n s)
    (hactive : s.halted = false)
    (haction : referenceRule input available budget none seed s.history = .abandon) :
    ∃ (stage : I.Stage) (cache : ReferenceReplayCache I),
      ReferenceStateAligned input available budget cache s ∧ s.cursor = stage.val ∧
      cache.phase = .reported ∧ referenceReplayCorrect cache stage = false ∧
      referenceAvailableKind I available cache = some .noTool ∧
      s.ledger.written stage = some (!s.ledger.truth stage) := by
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall none seed truth tapes hp
  have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans hactive
  have ha : referenceCandidateAction input available budget none s.history = .abandon :=
    (referenceRule_eq_candidate_of_prefix input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall none
      seed truth tapes hp).symm.trans haction
  cases hstage : referenceReplayStage I cache with
  | none =>
    have hb := (prefix_cursorInvariant input C .uncapped accounting
      (referenceRule input available budget none) seed truth tapes hp).bound
    have hnot : ¬ historyCursor cache.seen < I.stageCount := by
      intro h
      simp [referenceReplayStage, h] at hstage
    have hcursor : historyCursor s.history = I.stageCount := by
      rw [← haligned.seen, haligned.cursor]
      rw [haligned.cursor] at hnot
      omega
    simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hcursor] at ha
  | some stage =>
    have hc : s.cursor = stage.val := haligned.cursor.symm.trans (cursor_of_stage cache stage hstage)
    cases hphase : cache.phase with
    | testing =>
      have ht : referenceTestingAction input available budget none cache stage = .abandon := by
        simpa only [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, hstage, hphase] using ha
      exact (referenceTestingAction_ideal_ne_abandon input C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
        seed truth tapes hp available budget cache haligned hphase hactive stage hc ht).elim
    | written => exact ((referenceAvailableReplay_some_spec input available budget s.history cache haligned.parsed).2.2.1 hphase).elim
    | reported =>
      have hf := haligned.current_fields stage hc
      simp only [referenceCurrentLedgerFits, hphase] at hf
      obtain ⟨bit, hwritten⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hf.1
      have hw := prefix_historyWrite input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
        seed truth tapes hp stage
      rw [hwritten] at hw
      let handle : MismatchHandle I := ⟨stage, s.ledger.writeSerial stage⟩
      have hvisible : referenceVisibleHandle s.history stage = some handle := by
        simp [referenceVisibleHandle, hw, handle]
      cases hcorrect : referenceReplayCorrect cache stage with
      | true => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hcorrect] at ha
      | false =>
        obtain ⟨kind, entryRisk, hkind, _, hupdate⟩ := haligned.reported_update
          (by simp [hphase, referencePhaseReportCount]) stage hc
        have hcase : referenceAvailableRankCase I available stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) = some kind := by
          simpa only [referenceAvailableKind, hstage, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some] using hkind
        have hkindNoTool : kind = .noTool := by
          cases hrisk : referenceReplayRisk budget cache with
          | none =>
            rw [hrisk, hcorrect] at hupdate
            cases kind <;> simp [referenceBudgetStep] at hupdate ⊢
          | some current =>
            cases hpick : referenceAvailableRepairTool I available stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) with
            | none => exact rankCase_noTool_of_repair_none available stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) kind hcase hpick
            | some tool =>
              simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hcorrect, hrisk, hvisible, hpick] at ha
        have hvalid := (referenceStateAligned_reported_mismatch input C hearly accounting
          (referenceRule input available budget none) seed truth tapes hp available budget cache haligned
          hphase stage hc hcorrect handle hvisible).1
        refine ⟨stage, cache, haligned, hc, hphase, hcorrect, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa only [hkindNoTool] using hkind
        · exact hvalid.1
    | allocated tool =>
      obtain ⟨handle, hs, hvalid, _, _, _, _⟩ := by
        simpa only [referenceCurrentLedgerFits, hphase] using haligned.current_fields stage hc
      have hvisible := prefix_visibleHandle_of_valid input C hearly .uncapped accounting
        (referenceRule input available budget none) seed truth tapes hp handle hvalid
      rw [hs] at hvisible
      simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase, hvisible] at ha
    | executed tool => simp [referenceCandidateAction, haligned.parsed, hh, hstage, hphase] at ha

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRule_.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceRule_stop_success {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) seed truth tapes n s)
    (hactive : s.halted = false)
    (haction : referenceRule input available budget none seed s.history = .stop) :
    (stopState s false).ledger.success C := by
  classical
  have hpnext : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
      seed truth tapes (n + 1) (stopState s false) := .next hp (haction ▸ .stop s hactive)
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall none seed truth tapes hp
  obtain ⟨nextCache, hnextAligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall none seed truth tapes hpnext
  have hs := referenceAvailableReplay_some_spec input available budget s.history cache haligned.parsed
  have hs' := referenceAvailableReplay_some_spec input available budget (s.history ++ [.stopped]) nextCache hnextAligned.parsed
  rw [List.foldlM_append, hs.2.1] at hs'
  have hsingle : referenceAvailableStep input available budget cache .stopped = some nextCache := by
    simpa using hs'.2.1
  have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans hactive
  simp only [referenceAvailableStep, hh, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] at hsingle
  obtain ⟨hg, _⟩ := some_if_some _ _ _ hsingle
  have hcursor : s.cursor = I.stageCount := haligned.cursor.symm.trans hg.1
  have hcorrect (stage : I.Stage) : s.ledger.written stage = some (s.ledger.truth stage) ∨
      ∃ e ∈ s.ledger.executions, e.handle.stage = stage :=
    prefix_reference_pastCorrect input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall none
      seed truth tapes hp stage (hcursor ▸ stage.isLt)
  have hwf := prefix_ledgerWellFormed input C .uncapped accounting
    (referenceRule input available budget none) seed truth tapes hp
  have hall : allWritten s.ledger := by
    intro stage
    rcases hcorrect stage with hw | ⟨e, he, hs⟩
    · rw [hw]; simp
    · have hg := (hwf.genuine e he).1
      rw [hs] at hg
      rw [hg]; simp
  apply (prefix_success_iff_physical input C .uncapped accounting
    (referenceRule input available budget none) seed truth tapes hpnext).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, ?_⟩
  · change decide (allWritten s.ledger) = true
    exact decide_eq_true hall
  · intro stage
    exact (finalOutput_correct_iff _ stage).mpr (hcorrect stage)

theorem referenceFailure_subset_nontermination_union_noTool
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) :
    {sample : Unit × input.World |
      ¬ runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample} ⊆
    {sample : Unit × input.World | ¬ ∃ n,
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n).halted = true} ∪
      ⋃ stage : I.Stage, referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage := by
  intro sample hfailure
  by_cases hhalt : ∃ n, (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n).halted = true
  · obtain ⟨n, hh⟩ := hhalt
    obtain ⟨_, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
      (referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting available budget none) sample n
    rcases prefix_halted_success_or_noToolFailure input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall sample hp hh with
      hsuccess | ⟨stage, hstage⟩
    · exact (hfailure ⟨n, hh, hsuccess⟩).elim
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨stage, hstage⟩)
  · exact Or.inl hhalt

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRisk_.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceRisk_le_sum_noToolFailure
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) :
    risk input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) (Measure.dirac ()) ≤
      ∑ stage : I.Stage, input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        ({sample : Unit × input.World | ¬ ∃ n,
          (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n).halted = true} ∪
            ⋃ stage : I.Stage, referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage) :=
      measure_mono (referenceFailure_subset_nontermination_union_noTool input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall)
    _ ≤ input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) {sample : Unit × input.World | ¬ ∃ n,
          (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n).halted = true} +
        input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (⋃ stage : I.Stage, referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage) :=
      measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ 0 + ∑ stage : I.Stage, input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        (referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage) := by
      rw [referenceRun_nontermination_measure_zero input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall]
      simpa only [zero_add, tsum_fintype] using
        (measure_iUnion_le (μ := input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()))
          (fun stage : I.Stage => referenceStageNoToolFailure input C accounting available budget stage))
    _ = _ := zero_add _

end PaperProofs.Common.Native

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_referen.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_referenceEntryBudgetTrace {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n s) :
    ∀ cache : ReferenceReplayCache I, ReferenceStateAligned input available budget cache s →
      s.halted = false → ∀ stage : I.Stage, s.cursor = stage.val →
      ∃ entry, ReferenceEntryBudgetTrace input C accounting available budget sample cache entry stage := by
  induction hp with
  | initial =>
    intro cache haligned _ stage hcursor
    have hi := referenceAvailableReplay_initial input available budget hbudget hsmall
    have he : cache = referenceReplayInitial I := Option.some.inj (haligned.parsed.symm.trans hi)
    subst cache
    refine ⟨referenceReplayInitial I, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · exact entryHistory_stageZero input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
        stage hcursor.symm sample
    · exact hi
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · exact hcursor
    · intro _; rfl
    · intro h
      simp only [referenceReplayInitial, referencePhaseReportCount] at h
      contradiction
  | @next n s next earlier step ih =>
    intro cache haligned hactive stage hcursor
    obtain ⟨old, hold⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall none
      sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) earlier
    generalize haction : referenceRule input available budget none sample.1 s.history = action at step
    cases step with
    | review current live port resources =>
      change s.cursor = stage.val at hcursor
      have heq : current = stage := Fin.ext (live.2.symm.trans hcursor)
      subst current
      have hsingle := replay_single_after input available budget s.history old cache
        (.observation stage ((worldTapes input sample.2) stage (s.ledger.reviews stage).toNat).val)
        hold.parsed haligned.parsed
      obtain ⟨hphase, he⟩ := replay_step_shape input available budget old cache _ hsingle
      subst cache
      obtain ⟨entry, horigin⟩ := ih old hold live.1 stage live.2
      refine ⟨entry, horigin.actual_entry, horigin.parsed_entry, horigin.entry_testing, horigin.entry_active,
        horigin.entry_seen, horigin.entry_snapshot, horigin.entry_cursor, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro _
        exact horigin.testing_events hphase
      · intro h
        simp only [hphase, referencePhaseReportCount] at h
        contradiction
    | allocate handle tool active valid compatible unused unallocated window resources =>
      change s.cursor = stage.val at hcursor
      have hsingle := replay_single_after input available budget s.history old cache (.committed handle tool)
        hold.parsed haligned.parsed
      obtain ⟨hphase, he⟩ := replay_step_shape input available budget old cache _ hsingle
      subst cache
      obtain ⟨entry, horigin⟩ := ih old hold active stage hcursor
      refine ⟨entry, horigin.actual_entry, horigin.parsed_entry, horigin.entry_testing, horigin.entry_active,
        horigin.entry_seen, horigin.entry_snapshot, horigin.entry_cursor, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h; cases h
      · intro _
        obtain ⟨kind, risk, hk, hv, hr, hu⟩ := horigin.reported_budget (by simp [hphase, referencePhaseReportCount])
        refine ⟨kind, risk, hk, hv, hr, ?_⟩
        have hc : referenceReplayCorrect {old with
            seen := old.seen ++ [.committed handle tool]
            phase := .allocated tool} stage = referenceReplayCorrect old stage := by
          simp [referenceReplayCorrect, historyWrite, historyReport, List.filterMap_append, eventWrite, eventReport]

      change s.cursor = stage.val at hcursor
      have hsingle := replay_single_after input available budget s.history old cache (.executed handle tool)
        hold.parsed haligned.parsed
      obtain ⟨hphase, he⟩ := replay_step_shape input available budget old cache _ hsingle
      subst cache

      refine ⟨entry, horigin.actual_entry, horigin.parsed_entry, horigin.entry_testing, horigin.entry_active,

        have hc : referenceReplayCorrect {old with
            seen := old.seen ++ [.executed handle tool]
            phase := .executed tool} stage = referenceReplayCorrect old stage := by
          simp [referenceReplayCorrect, historyWrite, historyReport, List.filterMap_append, eventWrite, eventReport]
        simpa only [referenceReplayRisk, hc] using hu

      change s.cursor = stage.val at hcursor
      have heq : current = stage := Fin.ext (live.2.symm.trans hcursor)
      subst current
      have hpacket := replay_packet_after input available budget s.history (writeResponses C s stage bit) old cache
        hold.parsed haligned.parsed
      have hpacket' : [VisibleEvent.wrote stage bit s.clock, VisibleEvent.report stage (s.ledger.truth stage) s.clock].foldlM
          (referenceAvailableStep input available budget) old = some cache := by
        simpa only [writeResponses, hearly, ite_true, writeLedger, List.singleton_append] using hpacket
      cases hw : referenceAvailableStep input available budget old (.wrote stage bit s.clock) with
      | none => simp [hw] at hpacket'
      | some written =>
        have hphase : old.phase = .testing := replay_step_shape input available budget old written _ hw
        obtain ⟨entry, horigin⟩ := ih old hold live.1 stage live.2
        obtain ⟨kind, risk, hk, hr, hv, hlen⟩ := referenceStateAligned_testing_ready input available budget old s hold hphase stage live.2
        have hh : old.halted = false := hold.halted.trans live.1
        have hstage := referenceStateAligned_stage input available budget old s hold stage live.2
        have hserial : s.clock = (historyActions old.seen).length := by
          rw [hold.seen]
          exact (prefix_historyActions_length input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
            sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) earlier).symm
        have hcanonical := referenceAvailableReplay_write_packet input available budget s.history old hold.parsed hh hphase
          stage hstage kind hk risk hr hlen bit (s.ledger.truth stage) s.clock hserial
        have he : cache = {old with
            seen := old.seen ++ [.wrote stage bit s.clock, .report stage (s.ledger.truth stage) s.clock]
            events := old.events ++ [(kind, decide (bit ≠ s.ledger.truth stage))]
            phase := .reported} := by
          apply Option.some.inj
          exact haligned.parsed.symm.trans (by
            simpa only [record, writeResponses, hearly, ite_true, writeLedger, List.singleton_append] using hcanonical)
        subst cache
        have hevents := horigin.testing_events hphase
        have hentryRisk : referenceReplayRisk budget entry = some risk := by
          simpa only [referenceReplayRisk, hevents] using hr
        have hentryKind : referenceAvailableKind I available entry = some kind := by
          have hc : historyCursor old.seen = historyCursor entry.seen :=
            (hold.cursor.trans live.2).trans horigin.entry_cursor.symm
          rw [← kind_at_entry available old entry hc horigin.entry_snapshot.symm]
          exact hk

          horigin.entry_seen, horigin.entry_snapshot, horigin.entry_cursor, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro h; cases h
        · intro _
          refine ⟨kind, risk, hentryKind, hv, hentryRisk, ?_⟩
          have hc : referenceReplayCorrect {old with
              seen := old.seen ++ [.wrote stage bit s.clock, .report stage (s.ledger.truth stage) s.clock]
              events := old.events ++ [(kind, decide (bit ≠ s.ledger.truth stage))]
              phase := .reported} stage = decide (bit = s.ledger.truth stage) := by
            simp [referenceReplayCorrect, historyWrite, historyReport, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons, eventWrite, eventReport]
          rw [hc]
          simp only [referenceReplayRisk, budgetPath_append, referenceBudgetPath]
          change (referenceReplayRisk budget old).bind
            (fun child => (referenceBudgetStep kind (decide (bit ≠ s.ledger.truth stage)) child).bind some) = _
          rw [hr]
          simp
    | advance current live written resources =>
      have hsingle := replay_single_after input available budget s.history old cache (.advanced current)
        hold.parsed haligned.parsed
      have he := replay_step_shape input available budget old cache _ hsingle
      change cache = {old with
        seen := old.seen ++ [.advanced current]
        entryHistory := old.seen ++ [.advanced current]
        phase := .testing} at he
      subst cache
      have hbefore : s.cursor < stage.val := by
        change s.cursor + 1 = stage.val at hcursor
        omega
      have hpnext : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
          sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) (n + 1)
          (record accounting s (.advance current) [.advanced current] (advanceLedger s current) (s.cursor + 1) false) := by
        apply Prefix.next earlier
        rw [haction]
        exact .advance s current live written resources
      have hentry := entry_at_increment input C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
        (referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting available budget none) sample n s _ stage
        (prefix_eq_run_sample input C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample earlier)
        (prefix_eq_run_sample input C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample hpnext) hbefore hcursor
      refine ⟨{old with
        seen := old.seen ++ [.advanced current]
        entryHistory := old.seen ++ [.advanced current]
        phase := .testing}, ?_⟩
      constructor
      · simpa only [hold.seen, record] using hentry
      · simpa only [hold.seen, record] using haligned.parsed
      · rfl
      · exact hold.halted.trans live.1
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · exact haligned.cursor.trans hcursor
      · intro _; rfl
      · intro h
        simp only [referencePhaseReportCount] at h
        contradiction

theorem referenceEntryBudgetTrace_of_prefix {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n s)
    (hactive : s.halted = false) (stage : I.Stage) (hcursor : s.cursor = stage.val) :
    ∃ cache entry, ReferenceStateAligned input available budget cache s ∧
      ReferenceEntryBudgetTrace input C accounting available budget sample cache entry stage := by
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall none sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp
  obtain ⟨entry, horigin⟩ := prefix_referenceEntryBudgetTrace input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall sample hp cache haligned hactive stage hcursor
  exact ⟨cache, entry, haligned, horigin⟩

theorem referenceAdvance_entry_budget {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    {n : ℕ} {s next : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n s)
    (stage nextStage : I.Stage) (hnextStage : nextStage.val = stage.val + 1)
    (hstep : Step input C .uncapped accounting (worldTapes input sample.2) s (.advance stage) next)
    (haction : referenceRule input available budget none sample.1 s.history = .advance stage) :
    ∃ cache history kind risk,
      ReferenceStateAligned input available budget cache s ∧
      entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample = some history ∧
      entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) nextStage sample = some next.history ∧
      referenceAvailableEntryKind input available budget history = some kind ∧
      referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget history = some risk ∧ ReferenceBudgetValid risk ∧
      referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget next.history =
        referenceBudgetStep kind (!(referenceReplayCorrect cache stage)) risk := by
  have hactive := step_source_active input C .uncapped accounting (worldTapes input sample.2) hstep
  have hpnext : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) (n + 1) next := by
    apply Prefix.next hp
    rw [haction]
    exact hstep
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall none sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp
  obtain ⟨nextCache, hnextAligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall none sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hpnext
  cases hstep with
  | advance stage live written resources =>
    have hsingle := replay_single_after input available budget s.history cache nextCache (.advanced stage)
      haligned.parsed hnextAligned.parsed
    have he := replay_step_shape input available budget cache nextCache _ hsingle
    have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans live.1
    simp only [referenceAvailableStep, hh, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] at hsingle
    obtain ⟨_, _, hsingle⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hsingle
    obtain ⟨_, _, hsingle⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hsingle
    have hphase : referencePhaseReportCount cache.phase = 1 := by
      rcases (some_if_some _ _ _ hsingle).1.2 with ⟨hphase, _⟩ | ⟨tool, hphase⟩ <;>
        simp [hphase, referencePhaseReportCount]
    obtain ⟨entry, horigin⟩ := prefix_referenceEntryBudgetTrace input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall
      sample hp cache haligned live.1 stage live.2
    obtain ⟨kind, risk, hentry, hk, hr, hv, hu⟩ := horigin.reported_risk hphase
    have hcursorNext : (record accounting s (.advance stage) [.advanced stage]
        (advanceLedger s stage) (s.cursor + 1) false).cursor = nextStage.val := by
      change s.cursor + 1 = nextStage.val
      rw [live.2, hnextStage]
    have hbefore : s.cursor < nextStage.val := by rw [live.2, hnextStage]; omega
    have hentryNext := entry_at_increment input C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
      (referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting available budget none) sample n s _ nextStage
      (prefix_eq_run_sample input C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample hp)
      (prefix_eq_run_sample input C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample hpnext) hbefore hcursorNext
    refine ⟨cache, cache.entryHistory, kind, risk, haligned, hentry, hentryNext, hk, hr, hv, ?_⟩
    simp only [referenceAvailableEntryRisk, hnextAligned.parsed, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some]
    rw [he]
    exact hu

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceEntry.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceEntryRisk_kind_target {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (stage : I.Stage) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (hentry : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
      stage sample = some history) :
    ∃ kind risk,
      referenceAvailableEntryKind input available budget history = some kind ∧
      referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget history = some risk ∧ ReferenceBudgetValid risk ∧
      referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget history = referenceBudgetTarget kind risk := by
  obtain ⟨n, hcursor, hbefore, hhistory⟩ :=
    (entryHistory_some_iff input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample history).mp hentry
  have hlegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule (Seed := Seed) input available budget none) :=
    referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting available budget none
  have ha := run_first_stage_active input C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) hlegal sample stage n hcursor hbefore
  have hp := run_prefix_of_active input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) hlegal sample n ha
  obtain ⟨cache, entry, haligned, horigin⟩ := referenceEntryBudgetTrace_of_prefix input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall sample hp ha stage hcursor
  have hsnapshot : cache.entryHistory = history := Option.some.inj (horigin.actual_entry.symm.trans hentry)
  have hparse : referenceAvailableReplay input available budget history = some cache := by
    rw [← hhistory]
    exact haligned.parsed
  have hparseEntry : referenceAvailableReplay input available budget history = some entry := by
    rw [← hsnapshot]
    exact horigin.parsed_entry
  have heq : entry = cache := Option.some.inj (hparseEntry.symm.trans hparse)
  subst entry
  obtain ⟨kind, risk, hk, hr, hv, hlen⟩ := referenceStateAligned_testing_ready input available budget cache _ haligned
    horigin.entry_testing stage hcursor
  refine ⟨kind, risk, ?_, ?_, hv, ?_⟩
  · simp only [referenceAvailableEntryKind, hparse, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, hk]
  · simp only [referenceAvailableEntryRisk, hparse, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, hr]
  · simp only [referenceAvailableEntryTarget, hparse, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some]
    cases kind <;>
      simp [referenceAvailableCacheTarget, horigin.entry_active, horigin.entry_testing, hk, hr,
        hv.1, Nat.le_of_lt hlen, referenceBudgetTarget]
    all_goals simpa only [one_div] using hv.2

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceNextE.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceNextEntry_has_advance {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (stage nextStage : I.Stage)
    (hnextStage : nextStage.val = stage.val + 1) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (hentry : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
      nextStage sample = some history) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (s next : State I),
      Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1
        (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n s ∧
      run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n = s ∧
      Step input C .uncapped accounting (worldTapes input sample.2) s (.advance stage) next ∧
      referenceRule input available budget none sample.1 s.history = .advance stage ∧ next.history = history := by
  obtain ⟨n, hcursor, hbefore, hhistory⟩ :=
    (entryHistory_some_iff input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) nextStage sample history).mp hentry
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    change 0 = nextStage.val at hcursor
    have hs := stage.isLt
    omega
  | succ n =>
    have hlegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule (Seed := Seed) input available budget none) :=
      referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting available budget none
    have ha : (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n).halted = false := by
      apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
      intro hh
      rw [run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n hh] at hcursor
      exact hbefore n (Nat.lt_succ_self n) hcursor
    have hp := run_prefix_of_active input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) hlegal sample n ha
    obtain ⟨next, hs⟩ := hlegal sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n _ hp ha
    have he := run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n next ha hs
    rw [he] at hcursor hhistory
    generalize haction : referenceRule input available budget none sample.1
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n).history = action at hs
    cases hs with
    | review | write | allocate | execute | stop | abandon =>
      exact (hbefore n (Nat.lt_succ_self n) hcursor).elim
    | advance current live written resources =>
      have hcurrent : current = stage := by
        apply Fin.ext
        change (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample n).cursor + 1 = nextStage.val at hcursor
        have hc := live.2
        omega
      subst current
      exact ⟨n, _, _, hp, rfl, .advance _ stage live written resources, haction, hhistory⟩

end PaperProofs.Common.Native

theorem referenceBudgetMass_telescope (failure budget : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (N : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ i, i < N → failure i + budget (i + 1) ≤ budget i) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, failure i) + budget N ≤ budget 0 := by
  revert hstep
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro _hstep
    simp
  | succ N ih =>
    intro hstep
    have hprevious := ih (fun i hi => hstep i (by omega))
    calc
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, failure i) + (failure N + budget (N + 1)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        ac_rfl
      _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, failure i) + budget N :=
        add_le_add_right (hstep N (Nat.lt_succ_self N)) _
      _ ≤ _ := hprevious

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceCostA.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceCostAsymptotics_of_shorter_cost
PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceCostA.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceCostAsymptotics_of_shorter_cost
    (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (ih : ∀ (J : Instance) (child : StatisticalInput J), J.stageCount < I.stageCount →
      ReferenceCostAsymptotics child) :
    ReferenceCostAsymptotics input := by
  by_cases hsmallSize : I.stageCount ≤ 1
  · exact (referenceCostClaims_atMostOne input hsmallSize).1
  intro available depth hrank
  let first : I.Stage := ⟨0, by change 0 < I.stageCount; omega⟩
  let nextStage : I.Stage := ⟨1, by change 1 < I.stageCount; omega⟩
  have hfirst : first.val = 0 := rfl
  have hnext : nextStage.val = 1 := rfl
  have hfinite : errorRank I.compatibility available ≠ ⊤ := by rw [hrank]; exact ENat.natCast_ne_top depth
  have hdepth : 1 ≤ depth := by
    have hp := errorRank_pos I.compatibility available
    rw [hrank] at hp
    have : 0 < depth := by exact_mod_cast hp
    omega
  have hrec := I.errorRank_head_freshSuffix first hfirst available
  have hgoodOrder : (depth : ℕ∞) ≤ errorRank (I.freshSuffix nextStage.val).compatibility available := by
    rw [← hrank, hrec]
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hbadOrder : (depth : ℕ∞) ≤
      1 + badChildRank (I.eligible first) (I.freshSuffix 1).compatibility available := by
    rw [← hrank, hrec]
    exact min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨kind, hkind⟩ := referenceAvailableRankCase_exists I available first ∅
  cases kind with
  | infiniteRank =>
    have hsem := referenceAvailableRankCase_semantics I available first ∅ .infiniteRank hkind
    have htop : errorRank I.compatibility available = ⊤ := by
      simpa only [hfirst, List.drop_zero, Finset.sdiff_empty] using hsem
    exact (hfinite htop).elim
  | noTool =>
    have hsem := referenceAvailableRankCase_semantics I available first ∅ .noTool hkind
    simp only [Finset.sdiff_empty] at hsem
    have hbad : badChildRank (I.eligible first) (I.freshSuffix 1).compatibility available = 0 :=
      (badChildRank_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr hsem.2
    rw [hbad, add_zero] at hbadOrder
    have hdUpper : depth ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hbadOrder
    have hdOne : depth = 1 := by omega
    subst depth
    have hcoefficient : input.orderedCoefficient available =

          (input.freshSuffix nextStage.val).orderedCoefficient available else 0) +
          (input.experiment first).coefficient := by
      simpa only [hnext, hrank, hbad, zero_add, ENat.natCast_one, ite_true] using
        input.orderedCoefficient_head_freshSuffix first hfirst available hfinite
    apply referenceCostAsymptotics_initial_step_of_bounds input ih available first nextStage
      (by simp only [hnext]; norm_num) 1 (by norm_num) hrank hgoodOrder
      (input.experiment first).coefficient (input.experiment first).coefficient_pos.le hcoefficient
      0 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (referenceEntryLocalObservationPrice_noTool_asymptotic input available first)
    intro budget hbudget hsmall _ C hcurrent accounting
    simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_zero, add_zero] using
      referenceExpectedBill_noTool_step input available first nextStage hfirst hnext hkind
        budget hbudget hsmall C hcurrent accounting
  | finiteBad badDepth =>
    have hsem := referenceAvailableRankCase_semantics I available first ∅ (.finiteBad badDepth) hkind
    simp only [Finset.sdiff_empty] at hsem
    have hbad : badChildRank (I.eligible first) (I.freshSuffix 1).compatibility available =
        (badDepth.val : ℕ∞) := by
      simpa only [Instance.freshSuffix, hfirst, Nat.zero_add] using hsem.2
    have horderBad : depth ≤ badDepth.val + 1 := by
      rw [hbad] at hbadOrder
      exact ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp (by
        simpa only [ENat.natCast_add, ENat.natCast_one, add_comm] using hbadOrder)
    let localLead := (input.experiment first).coefficient * (if depth = badDepth.val + 1 then 1 else 0)
    have hlocalLead : 0 ≤ localLead := by
      dsimp [localLead]
      have hA := (input.experiment first).coefficient_pos
      split_ifs <;> positivity
    have hcrit : ((badDepth.val : ℕ∞) + 1 = (depth : ℕ∞)) ↔ depth = badDepth.val + 1 := by
      rw [← ENat.natCast_one, ← ENat.natCast_add, ENat.natCast_inj]
      omega
    have hcoefficient : input.orderedCoefficient available =
        (if errorRank (I.freshSuffix nextStage.val).compatibility available = (depth : ℕ∞) then
          (input.freshSuffix nextStage.val).orderedCoefficient available else 0) + localLead := by
      simpa only [hnext, hrank, hbad, hcrit, localLead, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] using
        input.orderedCoefficient_head_freshSuffix first hfirst available hfinite
    obtain ⟨_, bound, stepCutoff, _, _, hbound, hstepCutoff, hstep⟩ :=
      referenceExpectedBill_finiteBad_step_of_shorter_cost input ih available first nextStage hfirst hnext badDepth hkind
    exact referenceCostAsymptotics_initial_step_of_bounds input ih available first nextStage
      (by simp only [hnext]; norm_num) depth hdepth hrank hgoodOrder localLead hlocalLead hcoefficient
      bound stepCutoff hbound hstepCutoff
      (referenceEntryLocalObservationPrice_finiteBad_asymptotic input available first hfirst badDepth hkind depth hdepth horderBad)

theorem referenceCostAsymptotics (input : StatisticalInput I) :
    ReferenceCostAsymptotics input := by
  have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (J : Instance) (child : StatisticalInput J),
      J.stageCount = n → ReferenceCostAsymptotics child := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro J child hsize
      apply referenceCostAsymptotics_of_shorter_cost child
      intro K grandchild hshort
      exact ih K.stageCount (by omega) K grandchild rfl
  exact hall I.stageCount I input rfl

theorem referenceBadBranchCostBound_of_shorter_cost
    (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (ih : ∀ (J : Instance) (child : StatisticalInput J), J.stageCount < I.stageCount →
      ReferenceCostAsymptotics child) :
    ReferenceBadBranchCostBound input := by
  intro stage available depth hdepth _hbad tool _htool hchildRank
  let childInput := input.freshSuffix (stage.val + 1)
  let childAvailable := available.erase tool
  have hshort : (I.freshSuffix (stage.val + 1)).stageCount < I.stageCount := by
    rw [I.freshSuffix_stageCount]
    have hs : stage.val < I.stageCount := stage.isLt
    omega
  have hcost := ih (I.freshSuffix (stage.val + 1)) childInput hshort
  have hRank : errorRank (I.freshSuffix (stage.val + 1)).compatibility childAvailable = (depth : ℕ∞) :=
    hchildRank
  have hfinite : errorRank (I.freshSuffix (stage.val + 1)).compatibility childAvailable ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [hRank]
    exact ENat.natCast_ne_top depth
  have hcoefficient : 0 < childInput.orderedCoefficient childAvailable :=
    childInput.orderedCoefficient_pos childAvailable hfinite
  obtain ⟨childCutoff, hchildCutoff, hchildCost⟩ := hcost childAvailable depth hRank 1 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨numericBound, numericCutoff, hnumericBound, hnumericCutoff, hnumeric⟩ :=
    controllerTarget_scaledBadRisk_iteratedLog_cutoff depth hdepth 2 (by norm_num)
  have hchildBudget : Tendsto
      (fun risk : ℚ => ((2 * controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk depth) : ℚ) : ℝ))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using rationalRisk_cast_tendsto_zero.comp
      (scaled_controllerBadRisk_tendsto_zero depth hdepth 2 (by norm_num))
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ risk : ℚ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0),
      ((2 * controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk depth) : ℚ) : ℝ) < childCutoff :=
    hchildBudget.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hchildCutoff)
  obtain ⟨inputCutoff, hinputCutoff, hinput⟩ := rationalEventually_positive_cutoff hsmall
  refine ⟨2 * childInput.orderedCoefficient childAvailable * numericBound,
    min numericCutoff inputCutoff, by positivity, lt_min hnumericCutoff hinputCutoff, ?_⟩
  intro risk hrisk hquarter hcutoff
  dsimp only
  intro C hcurrent accounting
  let badRisk := controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk depth)
  have hbadBounds := controllerBadRisk_bounds risk (controllerTarget risk depth) hrisk hquarter
    (controllerTarget_pos risk depth) (controllerTarget_le_quarter risk depth)
  have hbadPositive : 0 < badRisk := controllerBadRisk_positive risk (controllerTarget risk depth)
    hrisk hquarter (controllerTarget_pos risk depth) (controllerTarget_le_quarter risk depth)
  have hbudget : 0 < 2 * badRisk := by positivity
  have hbudgetSmall : 2 * badRisk ≤ 1 / 2 := by dsimp [badRisk]; linarith [hbadBounds.2]
  have hchildSmall : ((2 * badRisk : ℚ) : ℝ) < childCutoff :=
    hinput risk hrisk (hcutoff.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  have hnum := hnumeric risk hrisk (hcutoff.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
  have hb := hchildCost (2 * badRisk) hbudget hbudgetSmall hchildSmall C hcurrent accounting
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (controllerTarget risk depth : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (controllerTarget_pos risk depth).le
  change ENNReal.ofReal (controllerTarget risk depth : ℝ) *
    expectedBill childInput C .uncapped accounting
      (referenceIdealPolicy childInput C hcurrent.1 accounting childAvailable (2 * badRisk)).rule (Measure.dirac ()) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (controllerTarget risk depth : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 1) * childInput.orderedCoefficient childAvailable *
          iteratedLog depth ((2 * badRisk : ℚ) : ℝ)⁻¹) := mul_le_mul' le_rfl hb
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * childInput.orderedCoefficient childAvailable) *
        ((controllerTarget risk depth : ℝ) * iteratedLog depth (1 / ((2 * badRisk : ℚ) : ℝ)))) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hp]
      congr 1
      simp only [one_div]
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnum.2.2 (by positivity))

PaperProofs.Common.Native.lintegral_on_r.name: PaperProofs.Common.Native.lintegral_on_referenceEntry_stageFunction
PaperProofs.Common.Native.lintegral_on_r.full_declaration_source:
theorem lintegral_on_referenceEntry_stageFunction
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (stage : I.Stage) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (f : input.StageSample stage → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
      f (sample.2 stage) ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) =
      input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) *
        ∫⁻ localSample, f localSample ∂input.stageLaw stage := by
  classical
  let policy := referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
  let record := entrySeedHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage
  let atom : Set (Unit × EntryHistory I) := {((), some history)}
  let weight : Unit × EntryHistory I → ℝ≥0∞ := atom.indicator (fun _ => 1)
  let joint := fun sample : Unit × input.World => (record sample, sample.2 stage)
  let g : (Unit × EntryHistory I) × input.StageSample stage → ℝ≥0∞ := fun z => weight z.1 * f z.2
  have hr : Measurable record := measurable_entrySeedHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule stage
  have hj : Measurable joint := hr.prodMk ((measurable_pi_apply stage).comp measurable_snd)
  have hw : Measurable weight := measurable_const.indicator (measurableSet_singleton _)
  have hg : Measurable g := (hw.comp measurable_fst).mul (hf.comp measurable_snd)
  have hpoint : ∀ sample : Unit × input.World,
      (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history).indicator
        (fun x => f (x.2 stage)) sample = g (joint sample) := by
    intro sample
    cases hu : sample.1
    by_cases he : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history
    · have hm : sample ∈ referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history := he
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm]
      have hrval : record sample = ((), some history) := by simp only [record, entrySeedHistory, hu, he]
      simp only [g, joint, weight, hrval, atom, Set.indicator_of_mem (Set.mem_singleton _), one_mul]
    · have hm : sample ∉ referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history := he
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hm]
      have hrval : record sample ∉ atom := by
        intro hh
        have hc : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history :=
          congrArg Prod.snd (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hh)
        exact he hc
      simp only [g, joint, weight, Set.indicator_of_notMem hrval, zero_mul]
  have hmass : (μ.map record) atom = μ (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) := by
    rw [Measure.map_apply hr (measurableSet_singleton _)]
    congr 1
    ext sample
    change (sample.1, entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample) = ((), some history) ↔ _
    cases sample.1
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
    rfl
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ sample, g (joint sample) ∂μ := by
      rw [← lintegral_indicator (measurableSet_referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history)]
      exact lintegral_congr hpoint
    _ = ∫⁻ z, g z ∂μ.map joint := (lintegral_map hg hj).symm
    _ = ∫⁻ z, g z ∂(μ.map record).prod (input.stageLaw stage) := by
      rw [entrySeedHistory_jointLaw input C .uncapped accounting policy (Measure.dirac ()) stage]
    _ = (∫⁻ r, weight r ∂μ.map record) * ∫⁻ x, f x ∂input.stageLaw stage :=
      lintegral_prod_mul hw.aemeasurable hf.aemeasurable
    _ = _ := by
      rw [show (∫⁻ r, weight r ∂μ.map record) = (μ.map record) atom by
        exact (lintegral_indicator_const (measurableSet_singleton _) 1).trans (one_mul _)]
      rw [hmass]

theorem referenceStageObservationBill_on_entry_sharp_le
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (stage : I.Stage)
    (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ)
    (htarget : referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget history = some p) :
    (∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
      runStageObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample
      ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) ≤
      input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((input.experiment stage).coefficient *
          (Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + (input.experiment stage).logIncrementBound true +
            2 * |Real.log ((input.experiment stage).priorReal true / (input.experiment stage).priorReal false)|)) := by
  let E := input.experiment stage
  have hp := referenceAvailableEntryTarget_valid input available budget p history htarget
  have hpR : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.1
  have hpone : (p : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    have hh : (p : ℝ) ≤ ((1 / 4 : ℚ) : ℝ) := Rat.cast_le.mpr hp.2
    norm_num at hh
    linarith
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hpR).mpr (by linarith))
  have hB : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + E.logIncrementBound true +
      2 * |Real.log (E.priorReal true / E.priorReal false)| := by
    have hK := E.logIncrementBound_nonneg true
    positivity
  have hb := E.bayesObservationCharge_le_drift_bound (Measure.dirac ()) (E.posteriorSPRT p)
    _ hB (E.posteriorSPRT_expectedObservationCharge_finite p
      (BinaryExperiment.posteriorThreshold_nonneg p hp.1 hp.2))
    (fun x => by simpa only [add_assoc] using E.posteriorSPRT_sharpObservationCharge p hp.1 hp.2 x)
  exact (referenceStageObservationBill_on_entry_le input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage history p htarget).trans
    (mul_le_mul_right hb _)
