PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRemai.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceRemainingObservationBill_on_entry_le
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (stage : I.Stage)
    (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ)
    (htarget : referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget history = some p) :
    (∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
      runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage.val sample
      ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) ≤
      input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) *
          (input.experiment stage).bayesObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ()) ((input.experiment stage).posteriorSPRT p) +
        (∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history ∩
            referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage,
          runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) (stage.val + 1) sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) +
        (∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history \
            referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage,
          runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) (stage.val + 1) sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) := by
  let rule : PolicyRule I Unit := referenceRule input available budget none
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
  let A := referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history
  let E := referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage
  let future := runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting rule (stage.val + 1)
  have hsplit : (∫⁻ sample in A, future sample ∂μ) =
      (∫⁻ sample in A ∩ E, future sample ∂μ) + ∫⁻ sample in A \ E, future sample ∂μ := by
    rw [← lintegral_add_measure, Measure.restrict_inter_add_sdiff _
      (measurableSet_referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget stage)]
  have hb := referenceStageObservationBill_on_entry_le input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage history p htarget
  calc
    _ = (∫⁻ sample in A, runStageObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting rule stage sample ∂μ) +
        ∫⁻ sample in A, future sample ∂μ := by
      calc
        _ = ∫⁻ sample in A, runStageObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting rule stage sample + future sample ∂μ :=
          lintegral_congr (runRemainingObservationBill_step input C .uncapped accounting rule stage)
        _ = _ := lintegral_add_left (measurable_runStageObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting rule
          (measurable_referenceRule input available budget none) stage) _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [hsplit]
      simpa only [add_assoc] using add_le_add hb (le_refl ((∫⁻ sample in A ∩ E, future sample ∂μ) + ∫⁻ sample in A \ E, future sample ∂μ))

  unfold referenceAvailableRankCase referenceRankCase
  have hcurrent : referenceRankAt (I.freshSuffix first)
      ⟨stage.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt stage.isLt⟩ (referenceRankExcluded (I.freshSuffix first) (available \ oldUsed) used) =
      referenceRankAt I ⟨(I.freshStageLift first stage).val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (I.freshStageLift first stage).isLt⟩
        (referenceRankExcluded I available (oldUsed ∪ used)) := by
    rw [referenceRankAt_eq, referenceRankAt_eq,
      referenceRank_remaining (I.freshSuffix first) (available \ oldUsed) used,
      referenceRank_remaining I available (oldUsed ∪ used), freshSuffix_drop_stage]
    change errorRank (I.compatibility.drop (I.freshStageLift first stage).val) ((available \ oldUsed) \ used) = _
    have hrem : (available \ oldUsed) \ used = available \ (oldUsed ∪ used) := by ext tool; simp [and_assoc]

    have hrem : (available \ oldUsed) \ used = available \ (oldUsed ∪ used) := by ext tool; simp [and_assoc]
    exact congrArg (badChildRank (I.eligible (I.freshStageLift first stage))

theorem referenceEntry_replay_snapshot {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (stage : I.Stage) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (hentry : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample = some history) :
    ∃ cache : ReferenceReplayCache I,
      referenceAvailableReplay input available budget history = some cache ∧
      cache.seen = history ∧ cache.entryHistory = history ∧ cache.phase = .testing ∧ cache.halted = false ∧
      historyCursor cache.seen = stage.val ∧ cache.events.length = stage.val := by
  obtain ⟨n, hcursor, hbefore, hhistory⟩ :=
    (entryHistory_some_iff input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample history).mp hentry
  have hlegal := referenceRule_uncapped_legal (Seed := Seed) input C hearly accounting available budget none
  have ha := first_entry_active input C accounting _ hlegal sample stage n hcursor hbefore
  have hp := run_prefix_of_active input C .uncapped accounting _ hlegal sample n ha
  obtain ⟨cache, entry, haligned, horigin⟩ := referenceEntryBudgetTrace_of_prefix input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall sample hp ha stage hcursor
  have hsnapshot : cache.entryHistory = history := Option.some.inj (horigin.actual_entry.symm.trans hentry)
  have hparse : referenceAvailableReplay input available budget history = some cache := by
    rw [← hhistory]
    exact haligned.parsed
  have hparseEntry : referenceAvailableReplay input available budget history = some entry := hsnapshot ▸ horigin.parsed_entry
  have heq : entry = cache := Option.some.inj (hparseEntry.symm.trans hparse)
  subst entry
  refine ⟨cache, hparse, haligned.seen.trans hhistory, hsnapshot, horigin.entry_testing,
    horigin.entry_active, haligned.cursor.trans hcursor, ?_⟩
  simpa only [horigin.entry_testing, referencePhaseReportCount, Nat.add_zero, hcursor] using haligned.trace_count

theorem referenceEntry_firstAction_eq_freshSuffix {Seed : Type*}

    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (stage : I.Stage) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))

      referenceRule input available budget none sample.1 history =
        referenceSuffixActionLift I stage.val (historyActions history).length
          (referenceRule (input.freshSuffix stage.val) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk) none sample.1 []) := by
  obtain ⟨risk, hr, hv, ht⟩ := referenceEntry_target_eq_freshSuffix input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall
    sample stage history hentry
  obtain ⟨cache, hp, hseen, hsnap, hphase, hactive, hcursor, _⟩ := referenceEntry_replay_snapshot input C hearly accounting
    available budget hbudget hsmall sample stage history hentry
  have hstage : referenceReplayStage I cache = some stage := by
    unfold referenceReplayStage
    rw [hcursor, dite_eq_left (show stage.val < I.stageCount from stage.isLt)]
  obtain ⟨kind, hk⟩ := referenceAvailableRankCase_exists I available stage (historyUsed history)
  have hkind : referenceAvailableKind I available cache = some kind := by simp only [referenceAvailableKind, hstage, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, hsnap, hk]
  have hword : historyObservations cache.seen stage = [] := hseen ▸ referenceEntry_observations_nil input C hearly accounting available budget sample stage history hentry
  have hcurrent : referenceAvailableCacheTarget I available budget cache =
      referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget history := by simp only [referenceAvailableEntryTarget, hp, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some]
  have hfirstKind : referenceAvailableKind (I.freshSuffix stage.val) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history)
      (referenceReplayInitial (I.freshSuffix stage.val)) = some kind :=
    (referenceAvailableKind_fresh_initial I stage available (historyUsed history)).trans hk
  have hbpos : 0 < 2 * risk := by linarith [hv.1]
  have hbsmall : 2 * risk ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith [hv.2]
  have hfparse := referenceAvailableReplay_initial (input.freshSuffix stage.val) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk) hbpos hbsmall
  have hfirstTarget : referenceAvailableCacheTarget (I.freshSuffix stage.val) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk)
      (referenceReplayInitial (I.freshSuffix stage.val)) = referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget history := by
    rw [ht]
    simp only [referenceAvailableEntryTarget, hfparse, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some]
  have htest := referenceTestingAction_empty input available budget cache stage kind _ hkind hcurrent hword
  have hftest := referenceTestingAction_empty (input.freshSuffix stage.val) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk)
    (referenceReplayInitial (I.freshSuffix stage.val)) (referenceFreshHead I stage) kind _ hfirstKind hfirstTarget rfl
  obtain ⟨n, hrunCursor, hbefore, hhistory⟩ :=
    (entryHistory_some_iff input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample history).mp hentry

  have ha := first_entry_active input C accounting _ hlegal sample stage n hrunCursor hbefore
  have hprefix := run_prefix_of_active input C .uncapped accounting _ hlegal sample n ha
  have hcandidate := referenceRule_eq_candidate_of_prefix input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall none
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hprefix
  rw [hhistory] at hcandidate

  | wrote stage bit serial => exact referenceSuffixCacheJoin_step_write input first available budget risk base cache hbase stage bit serial

theorem referenceSuffix_candidateAction (input : StatisticalInput I) (first : ℕ)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget risk : ℚ) (base : ReferenceReplayCache I)
    (hbase : ReferenceSuffixBase I first budget risk base)
    (hparseBase : referenceAvailableReplay input available budget base.seen = some base)
    (history : List (VisibleEvent (I.freshSuffix first))) (cache : ReferenceReplayCache (I.freshSuffix first))
    (hparse : referenceAvailableReplay (input.freshSuffix first) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) base.seen) (2 * risk) history = some cache) :
    referenceCandidateAction input available budget none (referenceSuffixHistoryJoin I first base.seen history) =
      referenceSuffixActionLift I first (historyActions base.seen).length
        (referenceCandidateAction (input.freshSuffix first) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) base.seen) (2 * risk) none history) := by
  have hg := referenceSuffix_replay_join input first available budget risk base hbase hparseBase history cache hparse
  have hstage := referenceSuffixCacheJoin_stage I first budget risk base cache hbase
  have hh : (referenceSuffixCacheJoin I first base cache).halted = cache.halted := rfl
  simp only [referenceCandidateAction, hg, hparse, hh]
  cases hhalt : cache.halted with
  | true => rfl
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, hstage]
    cases hs : referenceReplayStage (I.freshSuffix first) cache with
    | none =>
      simp only [Option.map_none]
      have hc : historyCursor (referenceSuffixHistoryJoin I first base.seen history) = I.stageCount ↔
          historyCursor history = (I.freshSuffix first).stageCount := by
        rw [historyCursor_referenceSuffixJoin, hbase.cursor, I.freshSuffix_stageCount]
        have hb := hbase.bound
        omega
      rw [if_congr hc rfl rfl]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    | some stage =>
      simp only [Option.map_some]
      have hv : referenceVisibleHandle (referenceSuffixHistoryJoin I first base.seen history) (I.freshStageLift first stage) =
          (referenceVisibleHandle history stage).map (referenceSuffixHandleLift I first (historyActions base.seen).length) := by
        simp only [referenceVisibleHandle, historyWrite_referenceSuffixJoin I first base.seen history stage (hbase.written stage)]
        cases historyWrite history stage <;> rfl
      have hpick : referenceAvailableRepairTool I available (I.freshStageLift first stage)
          (historyUsed (referenceSuffixCacheJoin I first base cache).entryHistory) =
          referenceAvailableRepairTool (I.freshSuffix first) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) base.seen) stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) := by
        change referenceAvailableRepairTool I available (I.freshStageLift first stage)
          (historyUsed (referenceSuffixHistoryJoin I first base.seen cache.entryHistory)) = _
        rw [historyUsed_referenceSuffixJoin]
        exact (referenceAvailableRepairTool_freshSuffix I first available (historyUsed base.seen)
          (historyUsed (I := I.freshSuffix first) cache.entryHistory) stage).symm
      have hp : (referenceSuffixCacheJoin I first base cache).phase = referenceSuffixPhaseLift I first cache.phase := rfl
      rw [hp]
      cases hphase : cache.phase with
      | testing => exact referenceSuffix_testingAction input first available budget risk base cache hbase stage
      | written => rfl
      | executed tool => rfl
      | allocated tool =>
        simp only [referenceSuffixPhaseLift, hv]
        cases referenceVisibleHandle history stage <;> rfl
      | reported =>
        simp only [referenceSuffixPhaseLift, referenceSuffixCacheJoin_correct I first budget risk base cache hbase stage,
          referenceSuffixCacheJoin_risk I first budget risk base cache hbase, hv, hpick]
        cases hc : referenceReplayCorrect cache stage with
        | true => rfl
        | false =>
          simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
          cases referenceReplayRisk (2 * risk) cache <;> cases referenceVisibleHandle history stage <;>
            cases referenceAvailableRepairTool (I.freshSuffix first) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) base.seen) stage (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) <;> rfl

        (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input first sample.2) k) := by

  let childRule : PolicyRule (I.freshSuffix first) Seed :=
    referenceRule (input.freshSuffix first) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) base.seen) (2 * risk) none
  let childSample : Seed × (input.freshSuffix first).World := (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input first sample.2)
  have hlegal := referenceRule_uncapped_legal (Seed := Seed) input C hearly accounting available budget none
  have hchildLegal := referenceRule_uncapped_legal (Seed := Seed) (input.freshSuffix first) childC hchildEarly childAccounting
    (available \ historyUsed (I := I) base.seen) (2 * risk) none
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa only [Nat.add_zero, run] using hstart
  | succ k ih =>
    change ReferenceSuffixView I first base.seen (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample (start + (k + 1)))
      (run (input.freshSuffix first) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule childSample (k + 1))
    by_cases hh : (run (input.freshSuffix first) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule childSample k).halted = true
    · have hparentHalt : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample (start + k)).halted = true := ih.halted.trans hh
      rw [Nat.add_succ, run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting rule sample (start + k) hparentHalt,
        run_succ_of_halted (input.freshSuffix first) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule childSample k hh]
      exact ih
    · have hchildActive : (run (input.freshSuffix first) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule childSample k).halted = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh
      have hparentActive : (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample (start + k)).halted = false := ih.halted.trans hchildActive
      obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting rule hlegal sample (start + k)
      obtain ⟨l, _, hc⟩ := run_has_prefix (input.freshSuffix first) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule hchildLegal childSample k

        C hearly accounting childC hchildEarly childAccounting sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2)
        ((input.freshSuffix first).truthAt childSample.2) (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix first) childSample.2) hp hc ih

      obtain ⟨nextChild, hcs⟩ := hchildLegal sample.1 ((input.freshSuffix first).truthAt childSample.2)
        (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix first) childSample.2) l _ hc hchildActive
      have hpsLift := hps
      rw [ha] at hpsLift
      have hcounts := referenceSuffix_reviews_of_prefixes input first C accounting rule childC childAccounting childRule sample.1
        (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) ((input.freshSuffix first).truthAt childSample.2)
        (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix first) childSample.2) hp hc base.seen ih hbase.observations
      have htruths : ∀ stage, (run input C .uncapped accounting rule sample (start + k)).ledger.truth (I.freshStageLift first stage) =
          (run (input.freshSuffix first) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule childSample k).ledger.truth stage := by
        intro stage
        calc
          _ = input.truthAt sample.2 (I.freshStageLift first stage) := congrFun (prefix_truth input C .uncapped accounting rule sample.1 _ _ hp) _
          _ = (input.freshSuffix first).truthAt childSample.2 stage := rfl
          _ = _ := (congrFun (prefix_truth (input.freshSuffix first) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule sample.1 _ _ hc) stage).symm
      have hnext := referenceSuffix_step_view input first C childC hearly hchildEarly accounting childAccounting
        (worldTapes input sample.2) (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix first) childSample.2) base.seen ih hcounts htruths
        (fun stage index => (referenceSuffixWorld_letter input first sample.2 stage index).symm) hpsLift hcs
      rw [Nat.add_succ, run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting rule sample (start + k) nextParent hparentActive hps,
        run_succ_of_step (input.freshSuffix first) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule childSample k nextChild hchildActive hcs]

theorem referenceEntry_run_view {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (sample : Seed × input.World) (stage : I.Stage) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (hentry : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample = some history) :
    ∃ (base : ReferenceReplayCache I) (risk : ℚ) (start : ℕ), base.seen = history ∧
      referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget history = some risk ∧
      ReferenceSuffixBase I stage.val budget risk base ∧
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample start).cursor = stage.val ∧
      (∀ k < start, (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample k).cursor ≠ stage.val) ∧
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample start).history = history ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, ReferenceSuffixView I stage.val history
        (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample (start + k))
        (run (input.freshSuffix stage.val) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix stage.val)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix stage.val))
          (referenceRule (input.freshSuffix stage.val) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk) none)
          (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input stage.val sample.2) k) := by
  obtain ⟨base, risk, hparse, hseen, hrisk, hbase⟩ := referenceEntry_suffixBase input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall sample stage history hentry
  obtain ⟨start, hcursor, hbefore, hhistory⟩ :=
    (entryHistory_some_iff input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample history).mp hentry
  have hparseBase : referenceAvailableReplay input available budget base.seen = some base := by rw [hseen]; exact hparse
  have hlegal := referenceRule_uncapped_legal (Seed := Seed) input C hearly accounting available budget none
  obtain ⟨m, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) hlegal sample start
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall none
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp
  have hparsed : referenceAvailableReplay input available budget history = some cache := by rw [← hhistory]; exact haligned.parsed
  have heq : cache = base := Option.some.inj (hparsed.symm.trans hparse)
  subst cache
  have hhalt : (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample start).halted = false :=
    haligned.halted.symm.trans hbase.active
  have hclock : (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample start).clock =
      (historyActions base.seen).length := by
    rw [← prefix_historyActions_length input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
      sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp, hhistory, hseen]
  have hstart : ReferenceSuffixView I stage.val base.seen
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample start)
      (initial ((input.freshSuffix stage.val).truthAt (referenceSuffixWorld input stage.val sample.2))) := by
    constructor
    · simpa only [initial, referenceSuffixHistoryJoin, referenceSuffixHistoryLift, List.map_nil, List.append_nil] using hhistory.trans hseen.symm
    · simpa only [initial, Nat.add_zero] using hcursor
    · simpa only [initial, Nat.add_zero] using hclock
    · exact hhalt
  refine ⟨base, risk, start, hseen, hrisk, hbase, hcursor, hbefore, hhistory, ?_⟩
  intro k
  simpa only [hseen] using referenceSuffix_run_view input stage.val available budget risk hbudget hsmall base hbase hparseBase
    C hearly accounting (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix stage.val)) rfl (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix stage.val)) sample start hstart k

theorem referenceSuffixRunTransport (input : StatisticalInput I) (Seed : Type*) : ReferenceSuffixRunTransport input Seed := by
  intro C hcurrent accounting available budget hbudget hsmall sample stage history hentry
  obtain ⟨base, risk, start, hseen, hrisk, hbase, hcursor, hbefore, hhistory, views⟩ :=
    referenceEntry_run_view input C hcurrent.1 accounting available budget hbudget hsmall sample stage history hentry
  let childC := currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix stage.val)
  let childAccounting := zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix stage.val)
  let childRule : PolicyRule (I.freshSuffix stage.val) Seed :=
    referenceRule (input.freshSuffix stage.val) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk) none
  let childSample := (sample.1, referenceSuffixWorld input stage.val sample.2)
  have hlegal := referenceRule_uncapped_legal (Seed := Seed) input C hcurrent.1 accounting available budget none
  have hchildLegal := referenceRule_uncapped_legal (Seed := Seed) (input.freshSuffix stage.val) childC rfl childAccounting
    (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk) none
  have hobs : ∀ target : (I.freshSuffix stage.val).Stage, historyObservations history (I.freshStageLift stage.val target) = [] := by
    simpa only [hseen] using hbase.observations
  refine ⟨risk, start, hrisk, hbase.valid, hcursor, hbefore, hhistory, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    have hv := views k
    refine ⟨hv.history, hv.cursor, hv.clock, hv.halted, ?_⟩
    intro target
    obtain ⟨_, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) hlegal sample (start + k)
    obtain ⟨_, _, hc⟩ := run_has_prefix (input.freshSuffix stage.val) childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule hchildLegal childSample k
    exact referenceSuffix_reviews_of_prefixes input stage.val C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none)
      childC childAccounting childRule sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2)
      ((input.freshSuffix stage.val).truthAt childSample.2) (worldTapes (input.freshSuffix stage.val) childSample.2)
      hp hc history hv hobs target
  · exact referenceSuffix_observationBill_of_run_view input stage.val C accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) hlegal
      childC childAccounting childRule hchildLegal sample history start hobs views

PaperProofs.Common.Native.lintegral_on_r.full_declaration_source:
theorem lintegral_on_referenceEntry_freshSuffixFunction
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (stage : I.Stage) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (f : (input.freshSuffix stage.val).World → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
      f (input.restrictFreshWorld stage.val sample.2) ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) =
      input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) *
        ∫⁻ world, f world ∂(input.freshSuffix stage.val).worldLaw := by
  classical
  let policy := referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting available budget
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
  let record := entrySeedHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage
  let atom : Set (Unit × EntryHistory I) := {((), some history)}
  let weight : Unit × EntryHistory I → ℝ≥0∞ := atom.indicator (fun _ => 1)
  let joint := fun sample : Unit × input.World => (record sample, input.restrictFreshWorld stage.val sample.2)
  let g : (Unit × EntryHistory I) × (input.freshSuffix stage.val).World → ℝ≥0∞ := fun z => weight z.1 * f z.2
  have hr : Measurable record := measurable_entrySeedHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule stage
  have hj : Measurable joint := hr.prodMk ((input.measurable_restrictFreshWorld stage.val).comp measurable_snd)
  have hw : Measurable weight := measurable_const.indicator (measurableSet_singleton _)
  have hg : Measurable g := (hw.comp measurable_fst).mul (hf.comp measurable_snd)
  have hpoint : ∀ sample : Unit × input.World,
      (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history).indicator
        (fun x => f (input.restrictFreshWorld stage.val x.2)) sample = g (joint sample) := by
    intro sample
    cases hu : sample.1
    by_cases he : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history
    · have hm : sample ∈ referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history := he
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm]
      have hrval : record sample = ((), some history) := by simp only [record, entrySeedHistory, hu, he]
      simp only [g, joint, weight, hrval, atom, Set.indicator_of_mem (Set.mem_singleton _), one_mul]
    · have hm : sample ∉ referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history := he
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hm]
      have hrval : record sample ∉ atom := by
        intro hh
        exact he (congrArg Prod.snd (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hh))
      simp only [g, joint, weight, Set.indicator_of_notMem hrval, zero_mul]
  have hmass : (μ.map record) atom = μ (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) := by
    rw [Measure.map_apply hr (measurableSet_singleton _)]
    congr 1
    ext sample
    change (sample.1, entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule stage sample) = ((), some history) ↔ _
    cases sample.1
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
    rfl
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ sample, g (joint sample) ∂μ := by
      rw [← lintegral_indicator (measurableSet_referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history)]
      exact lintegral_congr hpoint
    _ = ∫⁻ z, g z ∂μ.map joint := (lintegral_map hg hj).symm
    _ = ∫⁻ z, g z ∂(μ.map record).prod (input.freshSuffix stage.val).worldLaw := by
      rw [entrySeedHistory_jointFreshSuffixLaw input C .uncapped accounting policy (Measure.dirac ()) stage]
    _ = (∫⁻ r, weight r ∂μ.map record) * ∫⁻ x, f x ∂(input.freshSuffix stage.val).worldLaw :=
      lintegral_prod_mul hw.aemeasurable hf.aemeasurable
    _ = _ := by
      rw [show (∫⁻ r, weight r ∂μ.map record) = (μ.map record) atom by
        exact (lintegral_indicator_const (measurableSet_singleton _) 1).trans (one_mul _)]
      rw [hmass]

theorem referenceRemainingObservationBill_on_entry_eq_freshSuffix
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hcurrent : C.IsCurrentAllocation)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (stage : I.Stage) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (risk : ℚ)
    (hrisk : referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget history = some risk) :
    (∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
      runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) stage.val sample
        ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) =
      input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) *
        expectedObservationBill (input.freshSuffix stage.val) (currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix stage.val)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix stage.val))
          (referenceRule (input.freshSuffix stage.val) (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk) none)
          (Measure.dirac ()) := by
  let childInput := input.freshSuffix stage.val
  let childC := currentRelaxedContract (I.freshSuffix stage.val)
  let childAccounting := zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix stage.val)
  let childRule : PolicyRule (I.freshSuffix stage.val) Unit :=
    referenceRule childInput (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk) none
  let f : childInput.World → ℝ≥0∞ :=
    fun world => runObservationBill childInput childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule ((), world)
  have hm : Measurable (runObservationBill childInput childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule) :=
    measurable_runObservationBill childInput childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule
      (measurable_referenceRule childInput (available \ historyUsed (I := I) history) (2 * risk) none)
  have hf : Measurable f := hm.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  have hdirac : expectedObservationBill childInput childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule (Measure.dirac ()) =
      ∫⁻ world, f world ∂childInput.worldLaw := by
    change (∫⁻ sample, runObservationBill childInput childC .uncapped childAccounting childRule sample
      ∂(Measure.dirac ()).prod childInput.worldLaw) = _
    rw [lintegral_prod _ hm.aemeasurable]
    exact lintegral_dirac' _ (measurable_of_countable _)
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ sample in referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history,
        f (input.restrictFreshWorld stage.val sample.2) ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) := by
      apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (measurableSet_referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history)
      intro sample hs
      exact referenceEntry_observationBill_eq_freshSuffix input C hcurrent accounting available budget hbudget hsmall
        stage history risk hrisk sample hs
    _ = input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) *
        ∫⁻ world, f world ∂childInput.worldLaw :=
      lintegral_on_referenceEntry_freshSuffixFunction input C hcurrent.1 accounting available budget stage history f hf
    _ = _ := by rw [← hdirac]

    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hcurrent : C.IsCurrentAllocation)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (stage : I.Stage) :
    (∫⁻ sample, runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
      (referenceRule input available budget none) stage.val sample
        ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) =
      ∑' history : List (VisibleEvent I),
        input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) *
          referenceEntryFreshObservationCost input available budget stage history := by
  rw [lintegral_eq_tsum_referenceEntry input C accounting available budget stage _
    (measurable_runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting _
      (measurable_referenceRule input available budget none) stage.val)
    (fun sample hs => runRemainingObservationBill_zero_of_no_entry input C .uncapped accounting _
      (referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hcurrent.1 accounting available budget none) sample stage hs)]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro history

  | none =>
    have hE : referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro sample hs

        hbudget hsmall sample stage history hs

      referenceEntryFreshObservationCost, hrisk, measure_empty, mul_zero]

    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (stage nextStage : I.Stage) (hnext : nextStage.val = stage.val + 1) :
    (∫⁻ sample, runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
      (referenceRule input available budget none) stage.val sample
        ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) =
      (∫⁻ sample, runStageObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) +
      ∑' history : List (VisibleEvent I),
        input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget nextStage history) *
          referenceEntryFreshObservationCost input available budget nextStage history := by
  calc
    _ = (∫⁻ sample, runStageObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample
          ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) +
        ∫⁻ sample, runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
          (referenceRule input available budget none) (stage.val + 1) sample
            ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) := by

      exact lintegral_add_left (measurable_runStageObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting _
        (measurable_referenceRule input available budget none) stage) _
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← hnext, referenceRemainingObservationBill_eq_entryFreshCosts input C hcurrent accounting available budget
        hbudget hsmall nextStage]

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceIniti.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceInitialNextEntry_children
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (first nextStage : I.Stage) (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hnext : nextStage.val = 1)
    (kind : ReferenceBudgetCase)
    (hkind : referenceAvailableRankCase I available first ∅ = some kind)
    (sample : Unit × input.World) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (hentry : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) nextStage sample = some history) :
    ∃ (error : Bool) (risk : ℚ), ReferenceBudgetValid risk ∧
      referenceAvailableEntryRisk input available budget history = some risk ∧
      some risk = referenceBudgetStep kind error (budget / 2) ∧
      (if error then ∃ tool, referenceAvailableRepairTool I available first ∅ = some tool ∧
          historyUsed history = {tool} else historyUsed history = ∅) ∧
      (error = true → sample ∈ referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget first) := by
  obtain ⟨n, s, next, hp, hrun, hs, ha, hhistory⟩ := referenceNextEntry_has_advance input C hearly accounting available budget
    sample first nextStage (by omega) history hentry
  obtain ⟨cache, oldHistory, oldKind, oldRisk, haligned, holdEntry, _, hk, hr, hv, hu⟩ :=
    referenceAdvance_entry_budget input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall sample hp first nextStage (by omega) hs ha
  have he : oldHistory = [] := Option.some.inj (holdEntry.symm.trans
    (entryHistory_stageZero input C .uncapped accounting _ first hfirst sample))
  subst oldHistory
  have hk0 := referenceAvailableEntryKind_initial input available budget hbudget hsmall first hfirst
  have hkeq : oldKind = kind := Option.some.inj (hk.symm.trans (hk0.trans hkind))
  subst oldKind
  have hreq : oldRisk = budget / 2 := Option.some.inj (hr.symm.trans
    (referenceAvailableEntryRisk_initial input available budget hbudget hsmall))
  subst oldRisk
  have hactive := step_source_active input C .uncapped accounting (worldTapes input sample.2) hs
  have hcursor : s.cursor = first.val := by cases hs with | advance _ live _ _ => exact live.2
  obtain ⟨entryCache, horigin⟩ := prefix_referenceEntryBudgetTrace input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall sample hp cache haligned hactive first hcursor
  have hentryNil : cache.entryHistory = [] := Option.some.inj (horigin.actual_entry.symm.trans
    (entryHistory_stageZero input C .uncapped accounting _ first hfirst sample))
  have hpnext : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) (n + 1) next := .next hp (ha ▸ hs)
  obtain ⟨nextCache, hnextAligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting available budget hbudget hsmall none
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hpnext
  have hparseNext : referenceAvailableReplay input available budget (s.history ++ [.advanced first]) = some nextCache := by
    cases hs with | advance _ live written resources => exact hnextAligned.parsed
  have hsingle := firstBranch_replay_single_after input available budget s.history cache nextCache (.advanced first)
    haligned.parsed hparseNext
  have hh : cache.halted = false := haligned.halted.trans hactive
  simp only [referenceAvailableStep, hh, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] at hsingle
  obtain ⟨current, hc, hsingle⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hsingle
  obtain ⟨_, _, hsingle⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hsingle
  obtain ⟨hg, _⟩ := firstBranch_some_if_some _ _ _ hsingle
  have hcur : current = first := hg.1.symm
  subst current
  obtain ⟨_, risk, _, hrisk, hvalid, _⟩ := referenceEntryRisk_kind_target input C hearly accounting available budget
    hbudget hsmall sample nextStage history hentry
  have hupdate : some risk = referenceBudgetStep kind (!(referenceReplayCorrect cache first)) (budget / 2) := by
    rw [hhistory] at hu
    exact hrisk.symm.trans hu
  have hused : historyUsed history = historyUsed cache.seen := by
    cases hs with
    | advance _ live written resources =>
      rw [← hhistory]
      change historyUsed (s.history ++ [.advanced first]) = historyUsed cache.seen
      rw [← haligned.seen]
      simp [historyUsed, historyCommitments, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons, eventCommitment]
  refine ⟨!(referenceReplayCorrect cache first), risk, hvalid, hrisk, hupdate, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases hg.2 with ⟨hphase, hcorrect⟩ | ⟨tool, hphase⟩
    · have hfit : historyUsed cache.entryHistory = historyUsed cache.seen := by
        simpa only [referenceEntryToolsFit, hphase] using haligned.entry_tools
      simp only [hcorrect, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
      rw [hused, ← hfit, hentryNil]
      simp [historyUsed, historyCommitments]
    · have hpicker := referenceAvailableReplay_repair_picker input available budget s.history cache haligned.parsed first tool hc (Or.inr hphase)
      have hfit : insert tool (historyUsed cache.entryHistory) = historyUsed cache.seen ∧ tool ∉ historyUsed cache.entryHistory := by
        simpa only [referenceEntryToolsFit, hphase] using haligned.entry_tools
      simp only [hpicker.2, Bool.not_false, ite_true]
      refine ⟨tool, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [hentryNil, historyUsed, historyCommitments] using hpicker.1
      · rw [hused, ← hfit.1, hentryNil]
        simp [historyUsed, historyCommitments]
  · intro herr
    have hcorrect : referenceReplayCorrect cache first = false := by
      cases hc : referenceReplayCorrect cache first <;> simp_all
    have hw : s.ledger.written first ≠ none := by cases hs with | advance _ _ written _ => exact written
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [hrun]
    exact firstBranch_wrong_of_not_correct input C hearly accounting _ sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2)
      (worldTapes input sample.2) hp cache haligned.seen first hw hcorrect

theorem lintegral_referenceNextEntryCostFunction
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hcurrent : C.IsCurrentAllocation)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (stage : I.Stage) :
    (∫⁻ sample, referenceNextEntryCostFunction input C accounting available budget stage sample
      ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())) =
      ∫⁻ sample, runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceRule input available budget none) stage.val sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) := by
  rw [referenceRemainingObservationBill_eq_entryFreshCosts input C hcurrent accounting available budget hbudget hsmall stage,
    lintegral_eq_tsum_referenceEntry input C accounting available budget stage _
      (measurable_referenceNextEntryCostFunction input C accounting available budget stage)
      (fun sample hs => by simp only [referenceNextEntryCostFunction, hs])]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro history
  have heq := setLIntegral_congr_fun (μ := input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()))
    (measurableSet_referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history)
    (fun sample (hs : sample ∈ referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget stage history) =>
      show referenceNextEntryCostFunction input C accounting available budget stage sample =
        referenceEntryFreshObservationCost input available budget stage history by
          simp only [referenceNextEntryCostFunction, show entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting
            (referenceRule input available budget none) stage sample = some history from hs])
  rw [heq, setLIntegral_const, mul_comm]

theorem referenceNextEntryCostFunction_finiteBad_le
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (first nextStage : I.Stage) (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hnext : nextStage.val = 1)
    (depth : ℕ+) (hkind : referenceAvailableRankCase I available first ∅ = some (.finiteBad depth))
    (tool : I.Tool) (hpick : referenceAvailableRepairTool I available first ∅ = some tool)
    (sample : Unit × input.World) :
    referenceNextEntryCostFunction input C accounting available budget nextStage sample ≤
      referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage available (budget / 2) +
        (referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget first).indicator
          (fun _ => referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage (available.erase tool)
            (2 * controllerBadRisk (budget / 2) (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val))) sample := by
  cases hentry : entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) nextStage sample with
  | none => simp only [referenceNextEntryCostFunction, hentry]; exact bot_le
  | some history =>
    obtain ⟨error, risk, _, hrisk, hstep, hused, herr⟩ := referenceInitialNextEntry_children input C hearly accounting
      available budget hbudget hsmall first nextStage hfirst hnext (.finiteBad depth) hkind sample history hentry
    cases error with
    | false =>
      have hr : risk = budget / 2 / 2 := Option.some.inj hstep
      have hu : historyUsed history = ∅ := hused
      have htwo : 2 * (budget / 2 / 2) = budget / 2 := by ring
      simp only [referenceNextEntryCostFunction, hentry, referenceEntryFreshObservationCost, hrisk, hu, hr, htwo]
      apply le_add_right
      change referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage (available \ (∅ : Finset I.Tool)) (budget / 2) ≤
        referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage available (budget / 2)
      rw [Finset.sdiff_empty]
    | true =>
      have hr : risk = controllerBadRisk (budget / 2) (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val) :=
        Option.some.inj hstep
      obtain ⟨picked, hselected, hu⟩ := hused
      have ht : picked = tool := Option.some.inj (hselected.symm.trans hpick)
      subst picked
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (herr rfl)]
      simp only [referenceNextEntryCostFunction, hentry, referenceEntryFreshObservationCost, hrisk, hu, hr]
      apply le_add_left
      change referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage (available \ ({tool} : Finset I.Tool))
        (2 * controllerBadRisk (budget / 2) (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val)) ≤
        referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage (available.erase tool)
          (2 * controllerBadRisk (budget / 2) (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val))
      rw [Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]

theorem referenceAvailableEntryTarget_initial
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (first : I.Stage) (hfirst : first.val = 0)
    (kind : ReferenceBudgetCase) (hkind : referenceAvailableRankCase I available first ∅ = some kind) :

      simpa only [referenceReplayInitial, historyCursor, List.filterMap_nil, List.length_nil] using hfirst.symm

    simp only [show first.val < I.stageCount from first.isLt, dite_true]

    unfold referenceAvailableKind

      List.filterMap_nil, List.map_nil, List.toFinset_nil] using hkind

  have hh : ((referenceReplayInitial I).halted || decide ((referenceReplayInitial I).phase ≠ .testing)) = false := rfl
  have hb : 0 < budget / 2 ∧ budget / 2 ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ (referenceReplayInitial I).events.length ≤ I.stageCount :=
    ⟨by linarith, by linarith, Nat.zero_le _⟩
  rw [referenceAvailableEntryTarget, referenceAvailableReplay_initial input available budget hbudget hsmall]

theorem referenceExpectedObservationBill_finiteBad_le
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hcurrent : C.IsCurrentAllocation)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ)
    (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2)
    (first nextStage : I.Stage) (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hnext : nextStage.val = 1)
    (depth : ℕ+) (hkind : referenceAvailableRankCase I available first ∅ = some (.finiteBad depth))
    (tool : I.Tool) (hpick : referenceAvailableRepairTool I available first ∅ = some tool) :
    expectedObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) (Measure.dirac ()) ≤
      referenceEntryLocalObservationPrice input available budget first [] +
        (referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage available (budget / 2) +
          ENNReal.ofReal (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val : ℝ) *
            referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage (available.erase tool)
              (2 * controllerBadRisk (budget / 2) (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val))) := by
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
  let E := referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget first
  let good := referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage available (budget / 2)
  let bad := referenceFreshChildObservationCost input nextStage (available.erase tool)
    (2 * controllerBadRisk (budget / 2) (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val))
  have hE : MeasurableSet E := measurableSet_referenceStageWriteError input C accounting available budget first
  have ht : referenceAvailableEntryTarget input available budget [] =
      some (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val) :=
    referenceAvailableEntryTarget_initial input available budget hbudget hsmall first hfirst (.finiteBad depth) hkind
  have hentry : referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget first [] = Set.univ := by
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro sample
    exact entryHistory_stageZero input C .uncapped accounting _ first hfirst sample
  have he : μ E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val : ℝ) := by
    have hb := referenceStageWriteError_on_entry_le input C hcurrent.1 accounting available budget
      hbudget hsmall first [] _ ht
    change μ (E ∩ referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget first []) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val : ℝ) * μ (referenceEntryEvent input C accounting available budget first []) at hb
    simpa only [hentry, Set.inter_univ, measure_univ, mul_one] using hb
  have hfuture : (∫⁻ sample, runRemainingObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
      (referenceRule input available budget none) nextStage.val sample ∂μ) ≤
        good + ENNReal.ofReal (controllerTarget (budget / 2) depth.val : ℝ) * bad := by
    rw [← lintegral_referenceNextEntryCostFunction input C hcurrent accounting available budget hbudget hsmall nextStage]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ sample, good + E.indicator (fun _ => bad) sample ∂μ :=
        lintegral_mono (referenceNextEntryCostFunction_finiteBad_le input C hcurrent.1 accounting available budget
          hbudget hsmall first nextStage hfirst hnext depth hkind tool hpick)
      _ = good + bad * μ E := by

theorem reference_single_stage_coefficient (input : StatisticalInput I)

  obtain ⟨hempty, hrank⟩ := reference_single_stage_finite_rank first hfirst hsize available hfinite
  have hweighted : input.weightedSchedule = [(I.eligible first, (input.experiment first).coefficient)] := by
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · simpa only [StatisticalInput.weightedSchedule, List.length_ofFn, List.length_singleton, Instance.stageCount] using hsize
    · intro index hleft hright
      have hi : index = 0 := by simpa only [List.length_singleton] using Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hright)
      subst index
      simp only [StatisticalInput.weightedSchedule, List.getElem_ofFn, List.getElem_cons_zero]

  have hbad := (badChildRank_eq_zero_iff (I.eligible first) [] available).mpr hempty

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceCostA.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceCostAsymptotics_single_stage (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (hsize : I.stageCount = 1) : ReferenceCostAsymptotics input := by
  intro available depth hrank epsilon hepsilon
  let first : I.Stage := ⟨0, by change 0 < I.stageCount; omega⟩
  have hfirst : first.val = 0 := rfl
  have hfinite : errorRank I.compatibility available ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [hrank]
    exact ENat.natCast_ne_top depth
  have hrankOne := (reference_single_stage_finite_rank first hfirst hsize available hfinite).2
  have hd : depth = 1 := ENat.natCast_inj.mp (hrank.symm.trans hrankOne)
  subst depth
  let E := input.experiment first
  let offset := Real.log (referenceQuotaConstant I.stageCount : ℝ) + E.logIncrementBound true +
    2 * |Real.log (E.priorReal true / E.priorReal false)|
  let fee : ℝ≥0∞ := (min I.stageCount I.toolCount : ℕ) * input.fees.maxCorrection
  have hfee : fee ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by finiteness) input.fees.maxCorrection_lt_top.ne
  obtain ⟨cutoff, hcutoff, hscalar⟩ := log_affine_cutoff E.coefficient E.coefficient_pos offset fee.toReal
    ENNReal.toReal_nonneg epsilon hepsilon
  refine ⟨cutoff, hcutoff, ?_⟩
  intro budget hbudget hsmall hcut C hcurrent accounting
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) < (budget : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbudget
  have hs := hscalar (budget : ℝ) hb hcut
  have hbound := referenceExpectedBill_le_global_add_corrections input C hcurrent.1 accounting available budget hbudget hsmall
  have heq (other : I.Stage) : other = first := by
    apply Fin.ext
    have ho : other.val < I.stageCount := other.isLt
    omega
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single first (fun other _ hne => (hne (heq other)).elim) (by simp)] at hbound
  change expectedBill input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) (Measure.dirac ()) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (E.coefficient * (Real.log ((referenceQuotaConstant I.stageCount : ℝ) / (budget : ℝ)) +
      E.logIncrementBound true + 2 * |Real.log (E.priorReal true / E.priorReal false)|)) + fee at hbound
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) < (referenceQuotaConstant I.stageCount : ℝ) := by
    unfold referenceQuotaConstant
    positivity
  have hoffset : Real.log ((referenceQuotaConstant I.stageCount : ℝ) / (budget : ℝ)) +
      E.logIncrementBound true + 2 * |Real.log (E.priorReal true / E.priorReal false)| =
        Real.log (budget : ℝ)⁻¹ + offset := by
    rw [Real.log_div hC.ne' hb.ne', Real.log_inv]
    dsimp [offset]
    ring
  rw [hoffset] at hbound
  have hcoefficient := reference_single_stage_coefficient input first hfirst hsize available hfinite
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (E.coefficient * (Real.log (budget : ℝ)⁻¹ + offset)) + fee := hbound
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (E.coefficient * (Real.log (budget : ℝ)⁻¹ + offset) + fee.toReal) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add hs.1 ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfee]
    _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by simpa only [hcoefficient, iteratedLog] using hs.2)

theorem iteratedLog_positive_mono_tail (depth : ℕ) :
    ∃ threshold : ℝ, 0 < threshold ∧ ∀ (x y : ℝ), threshold ≤ x → x ≤ y →
      0 < iteratedLog depth x ∧ iteratedLog depth x ≤ iteratedLog depth y := by
  induction depth with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    intro x y hx hxy
    exact ⟨by simpa only [iteratedLog] using (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hx), hxy⟩
  | succ depth ih =>
    obtain ⟨old, _hold, hmono⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨cutoff, hcutoff⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp ((iteratedLog_tendsto_atTop depth).eventually_ge_atTop 2)
    refine ⟨max 1 (max old cutoff), lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
    intro x y hx hxy
    have hox : old ≤ x := (le_max_left old cutoff).trans ((le_max_right 1 _).trans hx)
    have hcx : cutoff ≤ x := (le_max_right old cutoff).trans ((le_max_right 1 _).trans hx)
    have htwo := hcutoff x hcx
    have hm := hmono x y hox hxy
    change 0 < Real.log (iteratedLog depth x) ∧ Real.log (iteratedLog depth x) ≤ Real.log (iteratedLog depth y)
    exact ⟨Real.log_pos (by linarith), Real.log_le_log hm.1 hm.2⟩

PaperProofs.Statistics.controllerTarget_.full_declaration_source:
theorem controllerTarget_scaledBadRisk_iteratedLog_bounded (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (scale : ℚ) (hscale : 1 ≤ scale) :
    ∃ bound : ℝ, 0 ≤ bound ∧ ∀ᶠ risk : ℚ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0),
      0 ≤ iteratedLog j (1 / ((scale * controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk j) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      0 ≤ (controllerTarget risk j : ℝ) *
        iteratedLog j (1 / ((scale * controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk j) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (controllerTarget risk j : ℝ) *
        iteratedLog j (1 / ((scale * controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk j) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ≤ bound := by
  obtain ⟨threshold, _hthreshold, hmono⟩ := iteratedLog_positive_mono_tail j
  have hs : (0 : ℚ) < scale := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hscale
  have hinv := rationalInverse_tendsto_atTop.comp (scaled_controllerBadRisk_tendsto_zero j hj scale hs)
  have hlarge := hinv.eventually_ge_atTop threshold
  have hproduct := (controllerTarget_mul_iteratedLog_tendsto j hj).eventually
    (eventually_lt_nhds (by linarith : Real.log 2 / 4 < Real.log 2 / 4 + 1))
  refine ⟨Real.log 2 / 4 + 1, by have : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num); linarith, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, rationalRisk_eventually_le_quarter, hlarge, hproduct]
    with risk hr hq hlarge hproduct
  have hbad := controllerBadRisk_bounds risk (controllerTarget risk j) hr hq
    (controllerTarget_pos risk j) (controllerTarget_le_quarter risk j)
  have hbadPos := controllerBadRisk_positive risk (controllerTarget risk j) hr hq
    (controllerTarget_pos risk j) (controllerTarget_le_quarter risk j)
  have hrR : (0 : ℝ) < (risk : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show (0 : ℚ) < risk from hr)
  have horderQ : risk ≤ scale * controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk j) :=
    hbad.1.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left hbadPos.le hscale)
  have horderR : (risk : ℝ) ≤ ((scale * controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk j) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast horderQ
  have hinverse : 1 / ((scale * controllerBadRisk risk (controllerTarget risk j) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
      1 / (risk : ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hrR horderR
  have hm := hmono _ _ hlarge hinverse
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (controllerTarget risk j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (controllerTarget_pos risk j).le
  exact ⟨hm.1.le, mul_nonneg hp hm.1.le,
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm.2 hp).trans hproduct.le⟩

theorem rationalEventually_positive_cutoff {P : ℚ → Prop}
    (hP : ∀ᶠ risk : ℚ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), P risk) :
    ∃ cutoff : ℝ, 0 < cutoff ∧ ∀ risk : ℚ, 0 < risk → (risk : ℝ) < cutoff → P risk := by
  obtain ⟨neighborhood, hneighborhood, hsubset⟩ := mem_nhdsWithin_iff_exists_mem_nhds_inter.mp hP
  obtain ⟨cutoff, hcutoff, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hneighborhood
  refine ⟨cutoff, hcutoff, ?_⟩
  intro risk hrisk hsmall
  apply hsubset
  refine ⟨hball ?_, hrisk⟩
  change dist risk (0 : ℚ) < cutoff

theorem StatisticalInput.orderedCoefficient_head_freshSuffix (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (first : I.Stage) (hfirst : first.val = 0) (available : Finset I.Tool)
    (hfinite : errorRank I.compatibility available ≠ ⊤) :
    input.orderedCoefficient available =
      (if errorRank (I.freshSuffix 1).compatibility available = errorRank I.compatibility available
        then (input.freshSuffix 1).orderedCoefficient available else 0) +
      (if badChildRank (I.eligible first) (I.freshSuffix 1).compatibility available + 1 =
          errorRank I.compatibility available then (input.experiment first).coefficient else 0) := by
  let later : WeightedSchedule I.Tool := (input.freshSuffix 1).weightedSchedule
  let tail : List (Finset I.Tool) := (I.freshSuffix 1).compatibility
  change Statistics.orderedCoefficient input.weightedSchedule available =
    (if errorRank tail available = errorRank I.compatibility available then
      Statistics.orderedCoefficient later available else 0) +
    (if badChildRank (I.eligible first) tail available + 1 = errorRank I.compatibility available then
      (input.experiment first).coefficient else 0)
  have hweights : input.weightedSchedule = (I.eligible first, (input.experiment first).coefficient) :: later :=
    input.weightedSchedule_head_freshSuffix first hfirst
  have helig : eligibilitySchedule later = tail := (input.freshSuffix 1).weightedSchedule_eligibility
  have hcompat : I.eligible first :: tail = I.compatibility := (Instance.compatibility_head_freshSuffix first hfirst).symm
  rw [hweights]
  simp only [Statistics.orderedCoefficient, helig, hcompat, hfinite, ite_false]

  ∀ (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)

def ReferenceConditionalOverflowGuarantee (input : StatisticalInput I) : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Contract I) (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (delta : ℝ) (exponent : ℕ) (budget : ℚ),
    0 < delta → delta ≤ 1 / 2 →
    ReferenceRiskChoice I.stageCount delta exponent budget →
      ∀ (stage : I.Stage) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (truth : Bool),
        let ideal := referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting I.tools budget
        let entered := {sample : Unit × input.World |
          entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting ideal.rule stage sample = some history ∧
          (sample.2 stage).1 = truth}
        input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
          (referenceStageOverflow input C hearly accounting I.tools budget (referenceQuota input exponent) stage ∩ entered) ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * I.stageCount)) * input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ()) entered

theorem analyticQuota_eq_intCeil (E : BinaryExperiment) (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) :
    (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℤ) = ⌈max
      (2 * (Real.log ((referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) / delta) + E.priorLogOddsMax) / E.channelMinDivergence)
      ((8 * E.channelIncrementMax ^ 2 / E.channelMinDivergence ^ 2) * Real.log ((2 * N : ℝ) / delta))⌉ := by
  apply Int.natCast_ceil_eq_ceil
  have hlog := quotaLog_pos delta hdelta hsmall N
  have hprior : 0 ≤ E.priorLogOddsMax := abs_nonneg _
  have hfirst : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (Real.log ((referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) / delta) + E.priorLogOddsMax) /
      E.channelMinDivergence := div_nonneg (by linarith) E.channelMinDivergence_pos.le
  exact hfirst.trans (le_max_left _ _)

/-- The original analytic quota gives the exact frozen overflow constant.
Both truth directions use their real iid channel law and the actual first-exit
SPRT stopping function. The quota has not been weakened to a Markov quota. -/

theorem posteriorSPRT_overflow_real_le (E : BinaryExperiment) (p : ℚ) (hp : 0 < p) (hpquarter : p ≤ 1 / 4)
    (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hfloor : delta / (referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)) (x : Bool) :
    (E.tapeLaw x).real {tape | (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℕ∞) < E.posteriorThresholdStop p tape} ≤
      delta / (2 * N) := by
  have hplt : p < 1 := by linarith
  have hNreal : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hQreal : (0 : ℝ) < E.analyticQuota delta N := by exact_mod_cast E.analyticQuota_pos delta hdelta hsmall N
  have hM := E.channelIncrementMax_pos
  have hd := E.channelMinDivergence_pos
  have hsubset := E.posteriorSPRT_overflow_subset_deviation p hp hplt delta hdelta N hfloor x
  have hmeasure := measureReal_mono (μ := E.tapeLaw x) hsubset (measure_ne_top _ _)
  have hhoeffding := E.centeredNegativeIncrement_hoeffding x (E.analyticQuota delta N)
    (E.channelMinDivergence * (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℝ) / 2) (by positivity)
  have hexponent : -(E.channelMinDivergence * (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℝ) * E.channelIncrementMax ^ 2) =
      -(E.channelMinDivergence ^ 2 * (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℝ) / (8 * E.channelIncrementMax ^ 2)) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hM, ne_of_gt hQreal]
    ring
  rw [hexponent] at hhoeffding
  have hexpBound := E.analyticQuota_exponent_bound delta N
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(E.channelMinDivergence ^ 2 * (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℝ) / (8 * E.channelIncrementMax ^ 2))) :=
      hmeasure.trans hhoeffding
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log ((2 * N : ℝ) / delta)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hexpBound)
    _ = delta / (2 * N) := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (div_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * N) hdelta)]
      exact inv_div _ _

theorem posteriorSPRT_conditional_overflow_le (E : BinaryExperiment) (p : ℚ) (hp : 0 < p) (hpquarter : p ≤ 1 / 4)
    (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hfloor : delta / (referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)) (x : Bool) :
    E.conditionalLaw (Measure.dirac ()) x {sample |
      (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℕ∞) < (E.posteriorSPRT p).rule.stop sample.1 sample.2} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * N)) := by
  change (Measure.dirac ()).prod (E.tapeLaw x) {sample : Unit × E.Tape |
    (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℕ∞) < E.posteriorThresholdStop p sample.2} ≤ _
  have heq : {sample : Unit × E.Tape | (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℕ∞) < E.posteriorThresholdStop p sample.2} =
      Set.univ ×ˢ {tape | (E.analyticQuota delta N : ℕ∞) < E.posteriorThresholdStop p tape} := by
    ext sample
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, true_and]
  rw [heq, Measure.prod_prod, measure_univ, one_mul]
  exact E.posteriorSPRT_overflow_le p hp hpquarter delta hdelta hsmall N hN hfloor x

theorem entryPosteriorError_le (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (next : I.Stage)
    (choose : Seed × List (VisibleEvent I) → Option ℚ) (hchoose : Measurable choose)
    (hvalid : ∀ (seed : Seed) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ),
      choose (seed, history) = some p → 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 1 / 4) :
    input.seededWorldLaw ν (entryPosteriorError input C mode accounting policy.rule next choose) ≤
      ∫⁻ sample, selectedTargetBound (entryGatedTarget choose)
        (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next sample) ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν := by
  let target := entryGatedTarget choose
  have ht : Measurable target := measurable_entryGatedTarget choose hchoose
  have hr := measurable_entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule next
  have hn : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World => sample.2 next) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply next).comp measurable_snd
  have hs := measurableSet_selectedPosteriorError input next target ht
  have hv (record : Seed × EntryHistory I) (p : ℚ) (h : target record = some p) : 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    obtain ⟨history, _, hh⟩ := (entryGatedTarget_some_iff choose record p).mp h
    exact hvalid record.1 history p hh
  calc
    _ = (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (fun sample =>
        (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next sample, sample.2 next))
          (selectedPosteriorError input next target) := (Measure.map_apply (hr.prodMk hn) hs).symm
    _ = ((input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next)).prod
        (input.stageLaw next) (selectedPosteriorError input next target) := by
      rw [entrySeedHistory_jointLaw input C mode accounting policy ν next]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ record, selectedTargetBound target record
        ∂(input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next) :=
      selectedPosteriorError_product_le input next _ target ht hv
    _ = _ := lintegral_map (measurable_selectedTargetBound target ht) hr

PaperProofs.Common.Native.entryPosterior.full_declaration_source:
theorem entryPosteriorOverflow_le (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (next : I.Stage)
    (choose : Seed × List (VisibleEvent I) → Option ℚ) (hchoose : Measurable choose)
    (hvalid : ∀ (seed : Seed) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ),
      choose (seed, history) = some p → 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 1 / 4)
    (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (exponent : ℕ)
    (hqualifies : PaperProofs.Statistics.DyadicQualifies
      (2 * N * PaperProofs.Statistics.referenceQuotaConstant N) delta exponent)
    (hfloor : ∀ (seed : Seed) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ),
      choose (seed, history) = some p →
        delta / (PaperProofs.Statistics.referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)) :
    input.seededWorldLaw ν (entryPosteriorOverflow input C mode accounting policy.rule next choose
      ((input.experiment next).rationalQuota exponent)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * N)) * input.seededWorldLaw ν {sample |
        entryGatedTarget choose (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next sample) ≠ none} := by
  let target := entryGatedTarget choose
  have ht : Measurable target := measurable_entryGatedTarget choose hchoose
  have hr := measurable_entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule next
  have hn : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World => sample.2 next) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply next).comp measurable_snd
  have hs := measurableSet_selectedPosteriorOverflow input next target ht ((input.experiment next).rationalQuota exponent)
  have hv (record : Seed × EntryHistory I) (p : ℚ) (h : target record = some p) : 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    obtain ⟨history, _, hh⟩ := (entryGatedTarget_some_iff choose record p).mp h
    exact hvalid record.1 history p hh
  have hf (record : Seed × EntryHistory I) (p : ℚ) (h : target record = some p) :
      delta / (PaperProofs.Statistics.referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by
    obtain ⟨history, _, hh⟩ := (entryGatedTarget_some_iff choose record p).mp h
    exact hfloor record.1 history p hh
  have hactive : MeasurableSet {record | target record ≠ none} :=
    (ht (measurableSet_singleton none)).compl
  calc
    _ = (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (fun sample =>
        (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next sample, sample.2 next))
          (selectedPosteriorOverflow input next target ((input.experiment next).rationalQuota exponent)) :=
      (Measure.map_apply (hr.prodMk hn) hs).symm
    _ = ((input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next)).prod
        (input.stageLaw next) (selectedPosteriorOverflow input next target ((input.experiment next).rationalQuota exponent)) := by
      rw [entrySeedHistory_jointLaw input C mode accounting policy ν next]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * N)) *
        (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (entrySeedHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule next)
          {record | target record ≠ none} :=
      selectedPosteriorOverflow_product_le input next _ target ht hv delta hdelta hsmall N hN exponent hqualifies hf
    _ = _ := by rw [Measure.map_apply hr hactive]; rfl

theorem entryPosteriorOverflow_le_cap (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (next : I.Stage)
    (choose : Seed × List (VisibleEvent I) → Option ℚ) (hchoose : Measurable choose)
    (hvalid : ∀ (seed : Seed) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ),
      choose (seed, history) = some p → 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 1 / 4)
    (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (exponent : ℕ)
    (hqualifies : PaperProofs.Statistics.DyadicQualifies
      (2 * N * PaperProofs.Statistics.referenceQuotaConstant N) delta exponent)
    (hfloor : ∀ (seed : Seed) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) (p : ℚ),
      choose (seed, history) = some p →
        delta / (PaperProofs.Statistics.referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)) :
    input.seededWorldLaw ν (entryPosteriorOverflow input C mode accounting policy.rule next choose
      ((input.experiment next).rationalQuota exponent)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * N)) := by
  refine (entryPosteriorOverflow_le input C mode accounting policy ν next choose hchoose hvalid
    delta hdelta hsmall N hN exponent hqualifies hfloor).trans ?_
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * N)) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left prob_le_one zero_le
    _ = _ := mul_one _

PaperProofs.Common.Native.reference_entr.signature_start: theorem reference_entry_overflow_bound (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.reference_entr.full_declaration_source:
theorem reference_entry_overflow_bound (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (delta : ℝ) (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (exponent : ℕ) (budget : ℚ)
    (choice : ReferenceRiskChoice I.stageCount delta exponent budget)
    (hN : 0 < I.stageCount) (stage : I.Stage) :
    input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
      (entryPosteriorOverflow input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting I.tools budget).rule stage
        (referenceEntryChoice input budget) (referenceQuota input exponent stage)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * I.stageCount)) := by
  have hminimal := BinaryExperiment.quotaExponent_minimal budget choice.positive I.stageCount
  rw [choice.same_exponent] at hminimal
  apply entryPosteriorOverflow_referenceRisk_le input C .uncapped accounting
    (referenceIdealPolicy input C hearly accounting I.tools budget) (Measure.dirac ()) stage
    (referenceEntryChoice input budget) (measurable_referenceEntryChoice input budget)
    (fun _ history p hp => (referenceEntryTarget_bounds input budget p choice.positive choice.small history hp).imp_right And.left)
    delta hsmall budget choice.positive choice.conservative I.stageCount hN exponent hminimal.2.1
  intro _ history p hp
  have hfloor := (referenceEntryTarget_bounds input budget p choice.positive choice.small history hp).2.2
  exact_mod_cast hfloor

theorem referenceOverflowGuarantee_of_identification (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (hid : ReferenceOverflowIdentification input) : ReferenceOverflowGuarantee input := by
  intro C hearly accounting delta exponent budget hd hsmall choice
  rw [referenceOverflow_eq_iUnion]
  by_cases hN : 0 < I.stageCount
  · calc
      _ ≤ ∑ stage : I.Stage, input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
          (referenceStageOverflow input C hearly accounting I.tools budget (referenceQuota input exponent) stage) :=
        measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _stage : I.Stage, ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * I.stageCount)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro stage _
        exact (measure_mono (hid C hearly accounting budget exponent choice.positive choice.small stage)).trans
          (reference_entry_overflow_bound input C hearly accounting delta hsmall exponent budget choice hN stage)
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (delta / 2) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Instance.Stage, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        change (I.stageCount : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * I.stageCount)) = _
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg I.stageCount)]
        congr 1
        have hNR : (I.stageCount : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN.ne'
        field_simp [hNR]
  · have : IsEmpty I.Stage := ⟨fun stage => by have hs := stage.isLt; change stage.val < I.stageCount at hs; omega⟩
    simp

theorem prefix_referenceTesting_origin {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)

    (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input I.tools budget none) sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n s)
    (cache : ReferenceReplayCache I) (haligned : ReferenceStateAligned input I.tools budget cache s)
    (hactive : s.halted = false) (hphase : cache.phase = .testing) (stage : I.Stage) (hcursor : s.cursor = stage.val) :
    ∃ history : List (VisibleEvent I),
      entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input I.tools budget none) stage sample = some history ∧
      cache.entryHistory = history ∧
      referenceEntryTarget input budget history = referenceAvailableCacheTarget I I.tools budget cache ∧
      ∀ p : ℚ, referenceAvailableCacheTarget I I.tools budget cache = some p →
        s.ledger.reviews stage ≤ (input.experiment stage).posteriorThresholdStop p (sample.2 stage).2 := by
  obtain ⟨history, hentry, hsnapshot, htarget, hprogress⟩ :=
    prefix_testing_origin input C hearly accounting budget hbudget hsmall sample hp cache haligned hactive hphase stage hcursor
  refine ⟨history, hentry, hsnapshot, ?_, hprogress⟩
  simpa only [Instance.tools, referenceAvailableEntryTarget_univ] using htarget

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_referen.signature_start: theorem prefix_referenceReview_realization {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_referen.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_referenceReview_realization {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (budget : ℚ) (hbudget : 0 < budget) (hsmall : budget ≤ 1 / 2) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input I.tools budget none) sample.1
      (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n s)
    (hactive : s.halted = false) (stage : I.Stage)
    (haction : referenceRule input I.tools budget none sample.1 s.history = .review stage) :
    ∃ history : List (VisibleEvent I), ∃ p : ℚ,
      entryHistory input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input I.tools budget none) stage sample = some history ∧
      referenceEntryTarget input budget history = some p ∧
      s.ledger.reviews stage < (input.experiment stage).posteriorThresholdStop p (sample.2 stage).2 := by
  obtain ⟨cache, haligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting I.tools budget hbudget hsmall none
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp
  obtain ⟨next, hstep⟩ := referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting I.tools budget none
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) n s hp hactive
  have hnextPrefix := Prefix.next hp hstep
  obtain ⟨nextCache, hnextAligned⟩ := prefix_referenceStateAligned input C hearly accounting I.tools budget hbudget hsmall none
    sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hnextPrefix
  rw [haction] at hstep
  cases hstep with
  | review stage live port resources =>
    have hsingle := replay_single_after input I.tools budget s.history cache nextCache
      (.observation stage ((worldTapes input sample.2) stage (s.ledger.reviews stage).toNat).val)
      haligned.parsed hnextAligned.parsed
    have hphase := (replay_event_shape input I.tools budget cache nextCache _ hsingle).1
    obtain ⟨history, hentry, _, htarget, hprogress⟩ := prefix_referenceTesting_origin input C hearly accounting budget hbudget hsmall
      sample hp cache haligned hactive hphase stage live.2
    have ht := referenceRule_testing_eq_of_aligned input C accounting I.tools budget none sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2)
      (worldTapes input sample.2) hp hactive cache haligned hphase stage live.2
    obtain ⟨p, hpTarget, _⟩ := referenceTestingAction_review_nonhit input I.tools budget none cache stage (ht.symm.trans haction)
    refine ⟨history, p, hentry, htarget.trans hpTarget, ?_⟩

theorem channelDriftLower_le_divergence (E : BinaryExperiment) (x : Bool) :
    (E.channelDriftLower : ℝ) ≤ E.divergence x := by
  have hb (y : Fin E.alphabetSize) : (E.channelTVIndicator y : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := by
    unfold channelTVIndicator
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have h := E.boundedObservable_pinsker x (fun y => (E.channelTVIndicator y : ℝ)) hb
  have hTV := E.channelTV_eq_integral_difference
  change ((2 * E.channelTV ^ 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ E.divergence x
  cases x with
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.not_false] at h
    rw [← hTV] at h
    simpa only [Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_ofNat, Rat.cast_pow] using h
  | true =>
    simp only [Bool.not_true] at h
    have hgap : (∫ y, (E.channelTVIndicator y : ℝ) ∂(E.channelLaw true)) -
        (∫ y, (E.channelTVIndicator y : ℝ) ∂(E.channelLaw false)) = -(E.channelTV : ℝ) := by linarith
    rw [hgap, neg_sq] at h
    simpa only [Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_ofNat, Rat.cast_pow] using h
