  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro y _hy
  have h := abs_log_le_ratioIntegerBound (E.channel true y / E.channel false y)
    (div_pos (E.channel_pos true y) (E.channel_pos false y))
  have hNat : ratioIntegerBound (E.channel true y / E.channel false y) ≤ E.channelIntegerMax :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun z : Fin E.alphabetSize => ratioIntegerBound (E.channel true z / E.channel false z))
      (Finset.mem_univ y)
  have h' : |E.channelLogIncrement true y| ≤ ratioIntegerBound (E.channel true y / E.channel false y) := by
    simpa only [channelLogIncrement, Bool.not_true, channelReal, Rat.cast_div] using h
  exact h'.trans (by exact_mod_cast hNat)

theorem rationalQuota_dominates_analytic (E : BinaryExperiment) (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (exponent : ℕ)
    (hqualifies : DyadicQualifies (2 * N * referenceQuotaConstant N) delta exponent) :
    E.analyticQuota delta N ≤ E.rationalQuota exponent := by
  have hdLower : (0 : ℝ) < (E.channelDriftLower : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast E.channelDriftLower_pos
  have hd := E.channelMinDivergence_pos
  have hdle := E.channelDriftLower_le_minDivergence
  have hM := E.channelIncrementMax_le_integer
  have hL := E.priorLogOddsMax_le_integer
  have hlogs := dyadicQuota_log_bounds delta hdelta N hN exponent hqualifies
  have hMnonneg := E.channelIncrementMax_nonneg
  have hNreal : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hlogtail : 0 ≤ Real.log ((2 * N : ℝ) / delta) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hdelta).mpr
    have hNR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ N from hN)
    linarith
  have hMsq : E.channelIncrementMax ^ 2 ≤ (E.channelIntegerMax : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hDsq : (E.channelDriftLower : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ E.channelMinDivergence ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
  apply max_le
  · calc
      _ ≤ 2 * ((exponent : ℝ) + E.priorIntegerMax) / E.channelMinDivergence :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hlogs.1]) hd.le
      _ ≤ 2 * ((exponent : ℝ) + E.priorIntegerMax) / (E.channelDriftLower : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hdLower hdle
      _ ≤ _ := E.rationalQuota_drift_lower exponent
  · have hnum : 8 * E.channelIncrementMax ^ 2 * Real.log ((2 * N : ℝ) / delta) ≤
        8 * (E.channelIntegerMax : ℝ) ^ 2 * exponent := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMsq hlogtail
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogs.2 (sq_nonneg (E.channelIntegerMax : ℝ))
      nlinarith
    calc
      _ = (8 * E.channelIncrementMax ^ 2 * Real.log ((2 * N : ℝ) / delta)) / E.channelMinDivergence ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (8 * (E.channelIntegerMax : ℝ) ^ 2 * exponent) / E.channelMinDivergence ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (8 * (E.channelIntegerMax : ℝ) ^ 2 * exponent) / (E.channelDriftLower : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (sq_pos_of_pos hdLower) hDsq
      _ ≤ _ := E.rationalQuota_tail_lower exponent

theorem exists_referenceRisk_originalQuota_overflow (E : BinaryExperiment) (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (exponent : ℕ)
    (hminimal : IsMinimalDyadicExponent (2 * N * referenceQuotaConstant N) delta exponent) :
    ∃ referenceRisk : ℚ, 0 < referenceRisk ∧ referenceRisk ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      delta / 2 ≤ (referenceRisk : ℝ) ∧ (referenceRisk : ℝ) ≤ delta ∧
      quotaExponent referenceRisk N = exponent ∧
      ∀ (events : List ReferenceBudgetEvent) (_hlen : events.length ≤ N) (current target : ℚ),
        referenceBudgetPath (referenceRisk / 2) events = some current →
        ∀ kind : ReferenceBudgetCase, referenceBudgetTarget kind current = some target → ∀ x : Bool,
          E.conditionalLaw (Measure.dirac ()) x {sample |
            (E.rationalQuota exponent : ℕ∞) < (E.posteriorSPRT target).rule.stop sample.1 sample.2} ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * N)) := by
  obtain ⟨risk, hrisk, hriskSmall, hhalf, hriskDelta, hsame, _hpathTargets⟩ :=
    exists_referenceRisk_same_exponent_targets delta hdelta hsmall N hN exponent hminimal
  refine ⟨risk, hrisk, hriskSmall, hhalf, hriskDelta, quotaExponent_eq_original risk hrisk N exponent hsame, ?_⟩
  intro events hlen current target hpath kind htarget x
  have hinit : ReferenceBudgetValid (risk / 2) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hcurrent := (referenceBudgetPath_valid_floor events (risk / 2) current hinit hpath).1
  have ht := referenceBudgetTarget_valid_floor kind current target hcurrent htarget
  have hf := referenceBudgetPath_original_target_floor_real risk hrisk hriskSmall events N hlen current target hpath kind htarget
  have hf' : (risk : ℝ) / (referenceQuotaConstant N : ℝ) ≤ (target : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [referenceQuotaConstant, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_ofNat] using hf
  have hriskR : (0 : ℝ) < risk := by exact_mod_cast hrisk
  have hriskSmallR : (risk : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have h := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mpr hriskSmall
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have hoverflow := E.rationalQuota_conditional_overflow_le target ht.1 ht.2.1 (risk : ℝ) hriskR hriskSmallR N hN exponent
    hsame.2.1 hf' x
  exact hoverflow.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hriskDelta (by positivity)))

    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (next : I.Stage)

    (delta : ℝ) (hsmall : delta ≤ 1 / 2) (risk : ℚ) (hrisk : 0 < risk) (hriskDelta : (risk : ℝ) ≤ delta)

    (risk : ℝ) hriskReal (hriskDelta.trans hsmall) N hN exponent hqualifies hfloor).trans ?_
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal

theorem prefix_caps_of_certificates (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : Policy input C .uncapped accounting Seed)
    (quota : I.Stage → ℕ)
    (hreviews : ReviewQuotaCertificate input C accounting policy.rule quota)
    (hnormal : NormalCallCertificate input C .uncapped accounting policy C.normalCallBound)
    (hquota : ∀ i, quota i ≤ C.reviewQuota i)
    (htotal : C.normalCallBound + ∑ i, quota i + min I.stageCount I.toolCount ≤ C.totalCallCap)
    (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule seed truth tapes n s) : s.ledger.obeysCaps C := by
  have heq := prefix_eq_run input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule seed truth tapes hp
  let sample := (seed, replayWorld input truth tapes)
  have hr : ∀ i, s.ledger.reviews i ≤ (quota i : ℕ∞) := by
    intro i
    rw [← heq]
    exact hreviews sample n i
  have hn : s.ledger.normalCalls ≤ (C.normalCallBound : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact hnormal sample n
  refine ⟨fun i => (hr i).trans (ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr (hquota i)), ?_⟩
  exact (ledger_totalCalls_le_budget s.ledger quota C.normalCallBound hr hn

theorem native_value_le_certified_uncapped (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : Policy input C .uncapped accounting Seed)
    (quota : I.Stage → ℕ)
    (hreviews : ReviewQuotaCertificate input C accounting policy.rule quota)
    (hnormal : NormalCallCertificate input C .uncapped accounting policy C.normalCallBound)
    (hquota : ∀ i, quota i ≤ C.reviewQuota i)
    (htotal : C.normalCallBound + ∑ i, quota i + min I.stageCount I.toolCount ≤ C.totalCallCap)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (δ : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hsafe : risk input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule ν ≤ δ) :
    value input C .native accounting δ ≤ expectedBill input C .uncapped accounting policy.rule ν := by
  let native := policy.enforceCaps input C accounting quota hreviews hnormal hquota htotal
  have hs : risk input C .native accounting native.rule ν ≤ δ := by
    change risk input C .native accounting policy.rule ν ≤ δ
    rw [← risk_uncapped_eq_native input C accounting policy.rule native.legal ν]
    exact hsafe
  have hv := value_le_policy_any_seed input C .native accounting native ν δ hs
  change value input C .native accounting δ ≤ expectedBill input C .native accounting policy.rule ν at hv
  rwa [← expectedBill_uncapped_eq_native input C accounting policy.rule native.legal ν] at hv

end Measurable

theorem prefix_referenceRule_reviews_le_quota {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (initialAvailable : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (quota : I.Stage → ℕ)
    (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget (some quota)) seed truth tapes n s) :
    ∀ stage : I.Stage, s.ledger.reviews stage ≤ (quota stage : ℕ∞) := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => intro stage; exact bot_le
  | @next n s result earlier step ih =>
    generalize haction : referenceRule input initialAvailable budget (some quota) seed s.history = action at step
    cases step with
    | review current live port resources =>
      have hgate := referenceRule_review_lt_quota input initialAvailable budget quota seed s.history current haction
      intro stage
      by_cases heq : stage = current
      · subst stage
        simp only [record, reviewLedger, Function.update_self]
        rw [← prefix_historyObservations_length input C mode accounting
          (referenceRule input initialAvailable budget (some quota)) seed truth tapes earlier current]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hgate
      · simpa only [record, reviewLedger, Function.update_of_ne heq] using ih stage
    | write current bit live port resources =>
      intro stage
      simpa only [record, reportedWrite_reviews] using ih stage
    | allocate | execute | advance | stop | abandon => exact ih

theorem referenceRule_quota_coupling {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (quota : I.Stage → ℕ)
    (seed : Seed) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) :
    referenceRule input available budget (some quota) seed history =
      referenceRule input available budget none seed history ∨
    ∃ stage : I.Stage,
      referenceRule input available budget none seed history = .review stage ∧
      quota stage ≤ (historyObservations history stage).length ∧
      referenceRule input available budget (some quota) seed history = .abandon := by
  rcases referenceCandidateAction_quota_coupling input available budget quota history with hsame | ⟨stage, hi, hq, hb⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by simp only [referenceRule, hsame])
  · by_cases ha : historyAllowsAction history (referenceCandidateAction input available budget none history)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨stage, ?_, hq, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [referenceRule, ite_eq_left ha] using hi
      · simp only [referenceRule, hb, historyAllowsAction, ↓reduceIte]
    · have hiRule : referenceRule input available budget none seed history = .abandon :=
        ite_eq_right ha
      have hbRule : referenceRule input available budget (some quota) seed history = .abandon := by
        simp only [referenceRule, hb, historyAllowsAction, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Or.inl (hbRule.trans hiRule.symm)

/-- At every interpreter time the two paths still coincide, or the bounded
path has abandoned at one earlier ideal state. That state witnesses actual
overflow, and its entire old ledger remains present. -/

PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRun_q.signature_start: theorem referenceRun_quota_coupling (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.referenceRun_q.full_declaration_source:
theorem referenceRun_quota_coupling (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (quota : I.Stage → ℕ)
    (sample : Unit × input.World) (n : ℕ) :
    let ideal := referenceRule (Seed := Unit) input available budget none
    let bounded := referenceRule (Seed := Unit) input available budget (some quota)
    run input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n = run input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample n ∨
      (sample ∈ referenceOverflow input C hearly accounting available budget quota ∧
        ∃ k < n, run input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n =
          stopState (run input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample k) true) := by
  let ideal := referenceRule (Seed := Unit) input available budget none
  let bounded := referenceRule (Seed := Unit) input available budget (some quota)
  change run input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n = run input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample n ∨ _
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Or.inl rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases ih with heq | ⟨hoverflow, k, hkn, haborted⟩
    · by_cases hh : (run input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample n).halted = true
      · have hhb : (run input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n).halted = true := by rw [heq]; exact hh
        exact Or.inl (by rw [run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n hhb,
          run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample n hh, heq])
      · have hactive : (run input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample n).halted = false :=
          Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh
        rcases referenceRule_quota_coupling input available budget quota sample.1
            (run input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample n).history with hsame | ⟨stage, hi, hq, hb⟩
        · exact Or.inl (by
            simp only [run]
            rw [heq]
            change nextFromFrontier input C .uncapped accounting _
              (referenceRule input available budget (some quota) sample.1 _) _ = _
            rw [hsame])
        · have hidealLegal : LegalRule input C .uncapped accounting ideal :=
            referenceRule_uncapped_legal input C hearly accounting available budget none
          obtain ⟨prefixLength, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting ideal hidealLegal sample n
          have hqledger : (quota stage : ℕ∞) ≤ (run input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample n).ledger.reviews stage := by
            rw [← prefix_historyObservations_length input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample.1
              (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) hp stage]
            exact_mod_cast hq
          have ho : sample ∈ referenceOverflow input C hearly accounting available budget quota :=
            ⟨n, stage, hactive, hi, hqledger⟩
          have hactiveb : (run input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n).halted = false := by rw [heq]; exact hactive
          have hstep : Step input C .uncapped accounting (worldTapes input sample.2)
              (run input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n)
              (bounded sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n).history)
              (stopState (run input C .uncapped accounting ideal sample n) true) := by
            rw [heq]
            change Step input C .uncapped accounting _ _
              (referenceRule input available budget (some quota) sample.1 _) _
            rw [hb]
            exact .abandon _ hactive
          exact Or.inr ⟨ho, n, Nat.lt_succ_self n,
            run_succ_of_step input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n _ hactiveb hstep⟩
    · have hhb : (run input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n).halted = true := by
        rw [haborted]
        rfl
      exact Or.inr ⟨hoverflow, k, hkn.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self n), by
        rw [run_succ_of_halted input C .uncapped accounting bounded sample n hhb]
        exact haborted⟩

theorem referenceRisk_le_ideal_add_overflow (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hearly : C.reporting = .early) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (quota : I.Stage → ℕ) :
    risk input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget (some quota)) (Measure.dirac ()) ≤
      risk input C .uncapped accounting (referenceRule input available budget none) (Measure.dirac ()) +
        input.seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
          (referenceOverflow input C hearly accounting available budget quota) := by
  have hinclusion :
      {sample : Unit × input.World | ¬ runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceRule input available budget (some quota)) sample} ⊆
      {sample : Unit × input.World | ¬ runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceRule input available budget none) sample} ∪
        referenceOverflow input C hearly accounting available budget quota := by
    intro sample hfailed
    by_cases ho : sample ∈ referenceOverflow input C hearly accounting available budget quota
    · exact Or.inr ho
    · apply Or.inl
      intro hsuccess
      obtain ⟨n, hh, hs⟩ := hsuccess
      apply hfailed
      have heq := referenceRun_eq_of_not_overflow input C hearly accounting available budget quota sample ho n
      exact ⟨n, by rw [heq]; exact hh, by rw [heq]; exact hs⟩
  exact (measure_mono hinclusion).trans (measure_union_le _ _)

The proof is stronger than its numerical-quota instance: the same coupling
works for every per-stage quota, including zero. -/

def ActualExecutionCost (constant degree : ℕ) (implementation : Implementation)
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (exponent : ℕ)
    (policy : Policy input C .native accounting Unit) : Prop :=
  let horizon := quotaActionBound I (referenceQuota input exponent) + 1
  ∀ sample : Unit × input.World,
    (run input C .native accounting policy.rule sample horizon).halted = true ∧
    ∃ preparationTrace preparationFinal,
    Runs implementation.preparationMachine (preparationInput input C budget) preparationTrace preparationFinal ∧
    preparationFinal.Tape.right₀ = Turing.ListBlank.mk (preparationOutput input C budget) ∧
    visitedSpace implementation.preparationMachine (preparationInput input C budget).length preparationTrace ≤
      constant * (arithmeticScale input C budget)^degree ∧
    ∃ traces : Fin horizon → List (MachineState implementation.controllerStates),
    (∀ clock : Fin horizon,
      let state := run input C .native accounting policy.rule sample clock.val
      if state.halted then traces clock = [] else
        ∃ final, Runs implementation.controllerMachine
          (controllerInput input C available budget state.history) (traces clock) final ∧
          final.Tape.right₀ = Turing.ListBlank.mk (encode (encodeAction (policy.rule () state.history))) ∧
          visitedSpace implementation.controllerMachine
            (controllerInput input C available budget state.history).length (traces clock) ≤
              constant * generalStructureFactor I * (arithmeticScale input C budget)^degree) ∧
    preparationTrace.length +
      ∑ clock, (traces clock).length ≤
        constant * generalStructureFactor I * (arithmeticScale input C budget)^degree

theorem rationalWordHits_iff (E : BinaryExperiment) (p : ℚ) (hp : 0 < p) (hpone : p < 1)
    (word : E.StoppedWord) :
    E.rationalWordHits p word = true ↔
      Real.log ((1 - (p : ℝ)) / (p : ℝ)) ≤ |E.stoppedWordScore word| := by
  have hpReal : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have honeReal : (p : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hpone
  have hboundary : 0 < (1 - (p : ℝ)) / (p : ℝ) := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr honeReal) hpReal
  have hodds : 0 < (E.rationalWordOdds word : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast E.rationalWordOdds_pos word
  rw [rationalWordHits, decide_eq_true_eq, ← E.log_rationalWordOdds, le_abs',
    ← Real.log_inv ((1 - (p : ℝ)) / (p : ℝ)),
    Real.log_le_log_iff hodds (inv_pos.mpr hboundary), Real.log_le_log_iff hboundary hodds]
  rw [inv_div]
  norm_cast

PaperProofs.Common.StatisticalInput.nati.full_declaration_source:
theorem StatisticalInput.nativeUpperPriceLaw (input : StatisticalInput I) :
    input.NativeUpperPriceLaw := by
  intro depth hrank epsilon hepsilon
  have hfinite : errorRank I.compatibility I.tools ≠ ⊤ := by rw [hrank]; exact ENat.natCast_ne_top depth
  have hcoefficient := input.orderedCoefficient_pos I.tools hfinite
  have hdepth : 1 ≤ depth := by
    have hp := errorRank_pos I.compatibility I.tools
    rw [hrank] at hp
    have : 0 < depth := by exact_mod_cast hp
    omega
  let eta := min (epsilon / 4) 1
  have heta : 0 < eta := lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  have hetaOne : eta ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
  have hetaEpsilon : eta ≤ epsilon / 4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hproduct : (1 + eta) * (1 + eta) ≤ 1 + epsilon := by
    have hsquare : eta * eta ≤ eta := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨costCutoff, hcostCutoff, hcost⟩ := referenceCostAsymptotics input I.tools depth hrank eta heta
  obtain ⟨logCutoff, hlogCutoff, hlogs⟩ := iteratedLog_factorTwo_uniform_cutoff depth hdepth eta heta
  refine ⟨min costCutoff logCutoff, lt_min hcostCutoff hlogCutoff, ?_⟩
  intro delta exponent budget hdelta hcut hsmall choice C hcurrent accounting qualification
  have hbudgetCut : (budget : ℝ) < costCutoff :=
    choice.conservative.trans_lt (hcut.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
  have hlog := hlogs delta (budget : ℝ) hdelta (hcut.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
    choice.factor_two choice.conservative
  have hbill := hcost budget choice.positive choice.small hbudgetCut C hcurrent accounting
  calc
    _ ≤ expectedBill input C .uncapped accounting
        (referenceIdealPolicy input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget).rule (Measure.dirac ()) :=
      native_value_le_reference_ideal input C hcurrent accounting delta hdelta hsmall exponent budget choice qualification
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + eta) * input.orderedCoefficient I.tools *
        iteratedLog depth (budget : ℝ)⁻¹) := hbill
    _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by
      calc
        _ ≤ (1 + eta) * input.orderedCoefficient I.tools *
            ((1 + eta) * iteratedLog depth (1 / delta)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa only [one_div] using hlog.2) (by positivity)
        _ = ((1 + eta) * (1 + eta)) * input.orderedCoefficient I.tools * iteratedLog depth (1 / delta) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := by
          simpa only [one_div] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hproduct hcoefficient.le) hlog.1.le)

theorem StatisticalInput.nativeInfiniteRankPriceLaw (input : StatisticalInput I) :
    input.NativeInfiniteRankPriceLaw := by
  intro htop C hcurrent accounting budget exponent hbudget hsmall qualification
  let bounded := referenceBoundedPolicy input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget exponent
  let reviews := referenceReviewBounds input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget exponent hbudget hsmall
  let native := bounded.enforceCaps input C accounting (referenceQuota input exponent)
    reviews qualification.normal_calls qualification.stage_quota qualification.total_calls
  have heq (sample : Unit × input.World) (n : ℕ) :
      run input C .native accounting native.rule sample n =
        run input C .uncapped accounting bounded.rule sample n :=
    enforceCaps_run_eq input C accounting bounded (referenceQuota input exponent)
      reviews qualification.normal_calls qualification.stage_quota qualification.total_calls sample n
  have hzeroObservation : expectedObservationBill input C .native accounting native.rule (Measure.dirac ()) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = expectedObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting bounded.rule (Measure.dirac ()) := by
        unfold expectedObservationBill runObservationBill
        simp_rw [heq]
      _ = 0 := referenceExpectedObservationBill_infiniteRank input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget
        hbudget hsmall htop (some (referenceQuota input exponent)) (Measure.dirac ())
  refine ⟨native, ?_, hzeroObservation, ?_⟩
  · calc
      _ = risk input C .uncapped accounting bounded.rule (Measure.dirac ()) :=
        enforceCaps_risk_eq input C accounting bounded (referenceQuota input exponent)
          reviews qualification.normal_calls qualification.stage_quota qualification.total_calls (Measure.dirac ())
      _ = 0 := referenceRisk_zero_of_infinite_rank input C hcurrent.1 accounting I.tools budget
        hbudget hsmall htop (some (referenceQuota input exponent)) (Measure.dirac ())
  · have hbill := expectedBill_le_observation_add input C .native accounting native (Measure.dirac ())
    rw [hzeroObservation, zero_add] at hbill
    exact hbill

theorem StatisticalInput.nativeLowerPriceLaw_of_penaltyAsymptotics {I : Instance}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (hpenalty : input.PenaltyAsymptotics) : input.NativeLowerPriceLaw := by
  intro depth hrank ε hε
  have hrank0 : errorRank (I.compatibility.drop 0) I.tools = (depth : ℕ∞) := by
    simpa only [List.drop_zero] using hrank
  obtain ⟨_, hC, hlim⟩ := (hpenalty 0 I.tools).2 depth hrank0
  simp only [StatisticalInput.suffixCoefficient_zero] at hC hlim
  let scale : ℝ → ℝ := fun penalty => input.orderedCoefficient I.tools * iteratedLog depth penalty
  have hscale : Tendsto scale atTop atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hC (iteratedLog_tendsto_atTop depth)
  have hratio : ∀ᶠ penalty in atTop,
      1 - ε / 2 < input.healthyPenaltyReal 0 I.tools penalty / scale penalty :=
    hlim.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by linarith : 1 - ε / 2 < 1))
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ penalty : ℝ in atTop,
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) * scale penalty) ≤
        input.healthyPenalty 0 I.tools (ENNReal.ofReal penalty) - 1 := by
    filter_upwards [hratio, hscale.eventually_gt_atTop 0, hscale.eventually_ge_atTop (2 / ε)]
      with penalty hr hs hlarge
    have hg : (1 - ε / 2) * scale penalty ≤ input.healthyPenaltyReal 0 I.tools penalty :=
      le_of_lt ((lt_div_iff₀ hs).mp hr)
    have htwo : 2 ≤ scale penalty * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hlarge
    have hraw : (1 - ε) * scale penalty ≤ input.healthyPenaltyReal 0 I.tools penalty - 1 := by
      nlinarith
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (input.healthyPenaltyReal 0 I.tools penalty - 1) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hraw
      _ = _ := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1), ENNReal.ofReal_one]
        exact congrArg (fun value : ℝ≥0∞ => value - 1)
          (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (input.healthyPenalty_ne_top 0 I.tools ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top))
  obtain ⟨threshold, hthreshold⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hbound
  let cutoff : ℝ := max 1 threshold + 1
  have hc : 0 < cutoff := by dsimp [cutoff]; linarith [le_max_left (1 : ℝ) threshold]
  refine ⟨1 / cutoff, one_div_pos.mpr hc, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ hsmall C hcurrent accounting
  have hinv : cutoff ≤ δ⁻¹ := by
    calc
      cutoff = 1 / (1 / cutoff) := by rw [one_div_one_div]
      _ ≤ 1 / δ := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hδ hsmall.le
      _ = _ := one_div δ
  have hthresholdInv : threshold ≤ δ⁻¹ :=
    (show threshold ≤ cutoff by dsimp [cutoff]; linarith [le_max_right (1 : ℝ) threshold]).trans hinv
  have hrelaxed := hthreshold δ⁻¹ hthresholdInv
  have hnative := input.healthyPenalty_initial_value_lower C hcurrent accounting (ENNReal.ofReal δ)
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hδ] at hnative
  exact hrelaxed.trans hnative

PaperProofs.Retained.matchingAugmentatio.signature_start: theorem matchingAugmentation (I : Instance) : MatchingAugmentation I := by
PaperProofs.Retained.matchingAugmentatio.full_declaration_source:
theorem matchingAugmentation (I : Instance) : MatchingAugmentation I := by
  classical
  intro small large hsmall hlarge hcard
  obtain ⟨f, hfinj, hfcomp⟩ := exists_extended_matching hsmall hlarge
  let toUnion : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ large \ small} →
      {i : I.Stage // i ∈ small ∪ large} := fun i =>
    ⟨i.val, Finset.mem_union_right small (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp i.property).1⟩
  have hreal : ∃ i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ large \ small},
      ∃ r : I.Tool, f (toUnion i) = Sum.inl r := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hright (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ large \ small}) :
        ∃ d : Dummy small large, f (toUnion i) = Sum.inr d := by
      cases hvalue : f (toUnion i) with
      | inl r => exact False.elim (hnone ⟨i, r, hvalue⟩)
      | inr d => exact ⟨d, rfl⟩
    let d : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ large \ small} → Dummy small large :=
      fun i => Classical.choose (hright i)
    have hd (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ large \ small}) : f (toUnion i) = Sum.inr (d i) :=
      Classical.choose_spec (hright i)
    have hdinj : Injective d := by
      intro i j hij
      have hf : f (toUnion i) = f (toUnion j) := by rw [hd i, hd j, hij]
      have hstage : i.val = j.val :=
        congrArg (fun z : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ small ∪ large} => z.val) (hfinj hf)
      exact Subtype.ext hstage
    have hdiff : (large \ small).card ≤ (small \ large).card := by
      simpa only [Dummy, Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective d hdinj
    have hsmallCard := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter small large
    have hlargeCard := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter large small
    rw [Finset.inter_comm large small] at hlargeCard
    omega
  obtain ⟨extra, r0, hextra⟩ := hreal
  refine ⟨extra.val, extra.property, ?_⟩
  let toUnion' : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ insert extra.val small} →
      {i : I.Stage // i ∈ small ∪ large} := fun i =>
    ⟨i.val, by
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp i.property with hsame | hmem
      · rw [hsame]
        exact Finset.mem_union_right small (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp extra.property).1
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left large hmem⟩
  have hleft (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ insert extra.val small}) :
      ∃ r : I.Tool, f (toUnion' i) = Sum.inl r := by
    by_cases hi : i.val ∈ small
    · have hno (d : Dummy small large) : f (toUnion' i) ≠ Sum.inr d := by
        intro heq
        have hmem := hfcomp (toUnion' i)
        rw [heq] at hmem
        exact dummy_not_mem_extended small large (toUnion' i) hi d hmem
      cases hvalue : f (toUnion' i) with
      | inl r => exact ⟨r, rfl⟩
      | inr d => exact False.elim (hno d hvalue)
    · have hieq : i.val = extra.val := (Finset.mem_insert.mp i.property).resolve_right hi
      have hunion : toUnion' i = toUnion extra := Subtype.ext hieq
      exact ⟨r0, by rw [hunion]; exact hextra⟩
  let assignment : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ insert extra.val small} → I.Tool :=
    fun i => Classical.choose (hleft i)
  have hassignment (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ insert extra.val small}) :
      f (toUnion' i) = Sum.inl (assignment i) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hleft i)
  refine ⟨assignment, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    have hf : f (toUnion' i) = f (toUnion' j) := by
      rw [hassignment i, hassignment j, hij]
    have hstage : i.val = j.val :=
      congrArg (fun z : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ small ∪ large} => z.val) (hfinj hf)
    exact Subtype.ext hstage
  · intro i
    have hmem := hfcomp (toUnion' i)
    rw [hassignment i] at hmem
    exact (real_mem_extended small large (toUnion' i) (assignment i)).mp hmem

theorem transversalMatroid_circuit (I : Instance) (errors : Finset I.Stage) :
    (transversalMatroid I).IsCircuit (errors : Set I.Stage) ↔ Circuit I errors := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hcircuit
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hmatch
      exact hcircuit.not_indep ((transversalMatroid_indep I errors).mpr hmatch)
    · intro smaller hproper
      exact (transversalMatroid_indep I smaller).mp
        (hcircuit.ssubset_indep (Finset.coe_ssubset.mpr hproper))
  · intro hcircuit
    apply Matroid.isCircuit_iff_forall_ssubset.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro hindep
      exact hcircuit.1 ((transversalMatroid_indep I errors).mp hindep)
    · rw [transversalMatroid_ground]
      exact Set.subset_univ _
    · intro subset hproper
      have hfinite : subset.Finite := Set.toFinite subset
      have hproper' : hfinite.toFinset ⊂ errors := by
        apply Finset.coe_ssubset.mp
        simpa only [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] using hproper
      have hmatch := hcircuit.2 hfinite.toFinset hproper'
      have hindep := (transversalMatroid_indep I hfinite.toFinset).mpr hmatch
      simpa only [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] using hindep

theorem minimum_circuit_exists (I : Instance) (hfinite : girth I ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ errors, Circuit I errors ∧ girth I = (errors.card : ℕ∞) := by
  have hnonempty : (circuits I).Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    have hempty := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h
    exact hfinite (by simp only [girth, hempty, Finset.inf_empty])
  obtain ⟨errors, hmem, heq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf
    (circuits I) hnonempty (fun errors => (errors.card : ℕ∞))
  exact ⟨errors, (mem_circuits I errors).mp hmem, heq⟩

def HealthyStepClaims (I : Instance) : Prop :=
  (∀ (stage : I.Stage) (old : Finset I.Stage), Healthy I stage.val old →
    stage ∉ old ∧ Healthy I (stage.val + 1) old ∧
      (Healthy I (stage.val + 1) (insert stage old) ↔ Matchable I (insert stage old))) ∧
  (∀ (stage : I.Stage) (old : Finset I.Stage), Healthy I stage.val old →
    ¬ Matchable I (insert stage old) →
      Play I (stagesFrom I stage.val) old {stage} 1 false ∧
        ∀ future : Finset I.Stage, ¬ Matchable I (insert stage old ∪ future)) ∧
  (∀ (stage : I.Stage) (old errors : Finset I.Stage) (count : ℕ) (success : Bool),
    Healthy I stage.val old →
      Play I (stagesFrom I (stage.val + 1)) old errors count success →
        Play I (stagesFrom I stage.val) old errors count success) ∧
  (∀ (stage : I.Stage) (old errors : Finset I.Stage) (count : ℕ) (success : Bool),
    Healthy I stage.val old →
      Play I (stagesFrom I (stage.val + 1)) (insert stage old) errors count success →
        Play I (stagesFrom I stage.val) old (insert stage errors) (count + 1) success)

def NativeRearrangement {I : Instance} (input : StatisticalInput I) : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Contract I), C.IsEarlyRetained → ∀ (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
    letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
    ∀ policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed,
      ∃ delayed : Policy input C .uncapped accounting Seed,
        TerminalOnly input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule ∧
        ∃ shadow : Seed → List (VisibleEvent I) → List (VisibleEvent I),
          Measurable (fun pair : Seed × List (VisibleEvent I) => shadow pair.1 pair.2) ∧
          (∀ sample n, ∃ oldClock,
            shadow sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule sample n).history =
              (run input C mode accounting policy.rule sample oldClock).history ∧
            informationTrace (shadow sample.1 (run input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule sample n).history) =
              informationTrace (run input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule sample n).history) ∧
          (∀ sample, runSuccess input C mode accounting policy.rule sample →
            runSuccess input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule sample ∧
            eventualPairs input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule sample = eventualPairs input C mode accounting policy.rule sample ∧
            ∀ n, ∃ newClock, (informationTrace (run input C mode accounting policy.rule sample n).history).IsPrefix
              (informationTrace (run input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule sample newClock).history)) ∧
          (∀ sample, runObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule sample ≤
            runObservationBill input C mode accounting policy.rule sample ∧
            runActualBill input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule sample ≤ runActualBill input C mode accounting policy.rule sample) ∧
          ∀ (ν : Measure Seed), IsProbabilityMeasure ν →
            risk input C .uncapped accounting delayed.rule ν ≤ risk input C mode accounting policy.rule ν

theorem native_rearrangement (input : StatisticalInput I) : NativeRearrangement.{u} input := by
  intro C hretained accounting mode Seed m
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
  intro source
  refine ⟨policy input C hretained accounting source.rule source.measurable_rule,
    delayed_terminalOnly input C accounting source.rule,
    shadowHistory accounting source.rule, measurable_shadowHistory accounting source.rule source.measurable_rule,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact shadow_run input C hretained mode accounting source.rule source.legal
  · exact success_preserved input C hretained mode accounting source.rule source.legal
  · intro sample
    exact ⟨observationBill_domination input C hretained mode accounting source.rule source.legal sample,
      actualBill_domination input C hretained mode accounting source.rule source.legal sample⟩
  · intro ν _
    unfold risk
    apply measure_mono
    intro sample hfailure hsource
    exact hfailure (success_preserved input C hretained mode accounting source.rule source.legal sample hsource).1

theorem executedStages_matchable (L : Ledger I) (hwf : LedgerWellFormed L) :
    Matchable I (executedStages L) := by
  classical
  have hex (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ executedStages L}) :
      ∃ e ∈ L.executions, e.handle.stage = i.val := (mem_executedStages L i.val).mp i.property
  let chosen (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ executedStages L}) : Execution I := Classical.choose (hex i)
  have hmem (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ executedStages L}) : chosen i ∈ L.executions :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hex i)).1
  have hstage (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ executedStages L}) : (chosen i).handle.stage = i.val :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hex i)).2
  refine ⟨fun i => (chosen i).tool, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j htool
    have heq : chosen i = chosen j :=
      List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hwf.execution_tools (hmem i) (hmem j) htool
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← hstage i, ← hstage j, heq]
  · intro i
    have hcompatible := hwf.compatible (chosen i) (hmem i)
    rwa [hstage i] at hcompatible

inductive Play (I : Instance) : List I.Stage → Finset I.Stage → Finset I.Stage → ℕ → Bool → Prop where
  | failed (later : List I.Stage) (past : Finset I.Stage) (bad : ¬ Matchable I past) :
      Play I later past ∅ 0 false
  | terminal (past : Finset I.Stage) (healthy : Matchable I past) : Play I [] past ∅ 0 true
  | correct {i : I.Stage} {later : List I.Stage} {past errors : Finset I.Stage}
      {count : ℕ} {success : Bool} (healthy : Matchable I past)
      (continuation : Play I later past errors count success) :
      Play I (i :: later) past errors count success
  | error {i : I.Stage} {later : List I.Stage} {past errors : Finset I.Stage}
      {count : ℕ} {success : Bool} (healthy : Matchable I past)
      (continuation : Play I later (insert i past) errors count success) :
      Play I (i :: later) past (insert i errors) (count + 1) success

PaperProofs.Retained.bad_successor_rank_.name: PaperProofs.Retained.bad_successor_rank_iff_girthHead
PaperProofs.Retained.bad_successor_rank_.full_declaration_source:
theorem bad_successor_rank_iff_girthHead (I : Instance) (i : I.Stage) (depth : ℕ)
    (hdepth : girth I = (depth : ℕ∞)) :
    errorRank I (stagesFrom I (i.val + 1)) {i} = ((depth - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ↔
      i ∈ girthHeads I := by
  have hpositive : 0 < depth := by
    have h := one_le_girth I
    rw [hdepth] at h
    exact ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp h
  constructor
  · intro hrank
    have hle : errorRank I (stagesFrom I (i.val + 1)) {i} ≤ ((depth - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := hrank.le
    obtain ⟨errors, hfuture, hcard, hbad⟩ :=
      (rank_le_nat_iff_future_set I _ _ _).mp hle
    have hbad' : ¬ Matchable I (insert i errors) := by
      simpa only [Finset.singleton_union] using hbad
    have hupper : (insert i errors).card ≤ depth := by
      have h := Finset.card_insert_le i errors
      omega
    have hlower : depth ≤ (insert i errors).card := by
      have h := girth_le_card_of_unmatchable hbad'
      rw [hdepth] at h
      exact ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp h
    have hsize : (insert i errors).card = depth := Nat.le_antisymm hupper hlower
    have hsize' : ((insert i errors).card : ℕ∞) = girth I := by rw [hsize, ← hdepth]
    have hcircuit := circuit_of_unmatchable_card_girth hbad' hsize'
    apply (mem_girthHeads I i).mpr
    refine ⟨insert i errors, ⟨hcircuit, by simp, ?_⟩, hsize'⟩
    intro j hj
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with hji | hmem
    · exact hji ▸ le_rfl
    · have hstage := (mem_stagesFrom I (i.val + 1) j).mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp (hfuture hmem))
      change i.val ≤ j.val
      omega
  · intro hhead
    obtain ⟨errors, ⟨hcircuit, hi, hfirst⟩, hsize⟩ := (mem_girthHeads I i).mp hhead
    have hsize' : errors.card = depth := by exact_mod_cast (hsize.trans hdepth)
    have hfuture : errors.erase i ⊆ (stagesFrom I (i.val + 1)).toFinset := by
      intro j hj
      have hmem := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).2
      have hne := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
      have hle : i.val ≤ j.val := hfirst j hmem
      have hneval : j.val ≠ i.val := fun heq => hne (Fin.ext heq)
      apply List.mem_toFinset.mpr
      apply (mem_stagesFrom I (i.val + 1) j).mpr
      omega
    have hbad : ¬ Matchable I ({i} ∪ errors.erase i) := by
      simpa only [Finset.singleton_union, Finset.insert_erase hi] using hcircuit.1
    have hcount : (errors.erase i).card ≤ depth - 1 := by
      simp only [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, hsize', le_refl]
    apply (rank_eq_nat_iff I _ _ (depth - 1)).mpr
    refine ⟨?_, fun smaller hsmall => safe_bad_below_girth I _ i depth hdepth smaller hsmall⟩
    exact (not_safe_iff_future_set I _ _ _).mpr ⟨errors.erase i, hfuture, hcount, hbad⟩

end PaperProofs.Retained

  ∀ (stage : I.Stage) (old : Finset I.Stage), Healthy I stage.val old →
    ∀ (C : Contract I), C.IsEarlyRetained → ∀ (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (mode : ResourceMode)
      (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
      letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
      ∀ (ν : Measure Seed) (hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν),
        letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν

          (∀ sample, input.preBirthView stage sample ∈ A → ∃ history,
            entryHistory input C mode accounting policy.rule stage sample = some history ∧
              reportedErrors I history stage.val = old) →
          ∀ penalty : ℝ≥0∞,
            input.seededWorldLaw ν {sample | input.preBirthView stage sample ∈ A} * freshPenalty input stage.val old penalty ≤
              (∫⁻ sample, {sample | input.preBirthView stage sample ∈ A}.indicator
                (runFutureObservationBill input C mode accounting policy.rule stage.val) sample ∂input.seededWorldLaw ν) +
              penalty * input.seededWorldLaw ν {sample | input.preBirthView stage sample ∈ A ∧ ¬ runSuccess input C mode accounting policy.rule sample}

      (∀ sample n, (∀ i, (run input C .uncapped accounting (boundedPolicy input C hretained accounting budget exponent).rule sample n).ledger.reviews i ≤ referenceQuota input exponent i) ∧
        (run input C .uncapped accounting (boundedPolicy input C hretained accounting budget exponent).rule sample n).ledger.executions.length ≤ min I.stageCount I.toolCount) ∧
      (OriginalQualification input C hretained accounting budget exponent →
        ∃ policy : Policy input C .native accounting Unit,
          policy.rule = (boundedPolicy input C hretained accounting budget exponent).rule ∧

PaperProofs.Retained.PRetFullHistoryBrid.signature_start: theorem fullHistoryPenaltyBridge (input : StatisticalInput I) : FullHistoryPenaltyBridge.{uBridge} input := by
PaperProofs.Retained.PRetFullHistoryBrid.full_declaration_source:
theorem fullHistoryPenaltyBridge (input : StatisticalInput I) : FullHistoryPenaltyBridge.{uBridge} input := by
  intro stage old _hhealthy C hC accounting mode Seed m
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
  intro ν hν
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  intro source A hmA hgate penalty
  classical
  let μ := input.seededWorldLaw ν
  let G := {sample : Seed × input.World | input.preBirthView stage sample ∈ A}

    ((measurable_entryStartupAt input C mode accounting source.rule source.measurable_rule stage record.1)

    ext sample
    constructor
    · intro hs
      obtain ⟨record, hr⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hs

    · intro hs
      obtain ⟨history, hh, _⟩ := hgate sample hs
      obtain ⟨n, hc, hbefore, _⟩ := (entryHistory_some_iff input C mode accounting source.rule stage sample history).mp hh

    rw [← hUnion]

    lintegral_indicator_const hfail, Measure.restrict_apply hfail] at hbound

    ext sample
    exact and_comm

RootRetainedQueries.rankQueryCorrect.signature_start: theorem rankQueryCorrect (I : Instance) : RankQueryCorrect I := by
RootRetainedQueries.rankQueryCorrect.full_declaration_source:
theorem rankQueryCorrect (I : Instance) : RankQueryCorrect I := by
  classical
  intro next old
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro hnone
      apply (rank_eq_top_iff I (stagesFrom I next) old).mpr
      intro budget
      by_contra hbad
      obtain ⟨future, hsub, _, hbad⟩ :=
        (not_safe_iff_future_set I (stagesFrom I next) old budget).mp hbad
      have hcard : future.card ≤ I.stageCount := by
        simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Instance.stageCount] using future.card_le_univ
      have hunsafe : unsafeBudget I next old future.card = true :=
        (unsafeBudget_iff I next old future.card).mpr
          ((rank_le_nat_iff_future_set I (stagesFrom I next) old future.card).mpr
            ⟨future, hsub, le_rfl, hbad⟩)
      have hn := List.find?_eq_none.mp hnone future.card (List.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      exact hn hunsafe
    · intro htop
      apply List.find?_eq_none.mpr
      intro depth _ hd
      have hle := (unsafeBudget_iff I next old depth).mp hd
      rw [htop] at hle
      exact ENat.natCast_ne_top depth (top_le_iff.mp hle)
  · intro depth
    rw [rankIndex, find_range_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hd, _, hsmall⟩
      apply (rank_eq_nat_iff I (stagesFrom I next) old depth).mpr
      refine ⟨(rank_le_nat_iff I (stagesFrom I next) old depth).mp
        ((unsafeBudget_iff I next old depth).mp hd), ?_⟩
      intro smaller hs
      by_contra hbad
      have ht := (unsafeBudget_iff I next old smaller).mpr
        ((rank_le_nat_iff I (stagesFrom I next) old smaller).mpr hbad)
      simp only [hsmall smaller hs, Bool.false_eq_true] at ht
    · intro h
      refine ⟨(unsafeBudget_iff I next old depth).mpr h.le,
        by have := finite_rank_bound I next old depth h; omega, ?_⟩
      intro smaller hs
      apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
      intro ht
      have hsafe := ((rank_eq_nat_iff I (stagesFrom I next) old depth).mp h).2 smaller hs
      exact ((rank_le_nat_iff I (stagesFrom I next) old smaller).mp
        ((unsafeBudget_iff I next old smaller).mp ht)) hsafe

end RootRetainedQueries

theorem terminalScriptCompletion (input : StatisticalInput I) : TerminalScriptCompletion input := by
  intro C hretained accounting budget limit sample start
  dsimp only
  intro _active cursor complete matchable
  have legal := retainedRule_uncapped_legal input C hretained accounting budget limit
  obtain ⟨later,bound,halted⟩ := run_halts_after_allWritten input C .uncapped accounting
    (retainedRule input budget limit) legal sample start complete
  have writtenEq : (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample later).ledger.written =
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample start).ledger.written := by
    funext stage
    cases written : (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample start).ledger.written stage with
    | none => exact (complete stage written).elim
    | some bit =>
      have still := run_written_some_after input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit)
        legal sample start (later-start) stage bit written
      rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le bound] at still
      exact still
  have truthEq : (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample later).ledger.truth =
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample start).ledger.truth :=
    (run_truth input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) legal sample later).trans
      (run_truth input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) legal sample start).symm
  have errorsEq : ordinaryMismatches (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample later).ledger =
      ordinaryMismatches (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample start).ledger := by
    simp only [ordinaryMismatches,writtenEq,truthEq]
  have completeLater : allWritten (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample later).ledger := by
    simpa only [allWritten,writtenEq] using complete
  have cursorLater : (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample later).cursor = I.stageCount := by
    have lower := run_cursor_monotone input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) legal sample bound
    change (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample start).cursor ≤
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample later).cursor at lower
    have upper := (run_cursorInvariant input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) legal sample later).bound
    rw [cursor] at lower
    exact Nat.le_antisymm upper lower
  obtain ⟨_,_,path⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) legal sample later
  have success := halted_terminal_success input C hretained accounting budget limit sample.1 _ _ path
    halted cursorLater completeLater (errorsEq.symm ▸ matchable)
  have well := prefix_ledgerWellFormed input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample.1 _ _ path
  have executed := executedStages_eq_mismatches_of_success _ C well success
  have count : (executedStages (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample later).ledger).card =
      (run input C .uncapped accounting (retainedRule input budget limit) sample later).ledger.executions.length := by
    rw [executedStages,List.toFinset_card_of_nodup well.execution_stages,List.length_map]
  exact ⟨later,bound,halted,success,count.symm.trans ((congrArg Finset.card executed).trans (congrArg Finset.card errorsEq))⟩

theorem observationEnvelopeAsymptotics (input : StatisticalInput I) :
    ObservationEnvelopeAsymptotics input := by
  intro depth hg epsilon hepsilon
  have hd : 1 ≤ depth := by
    have h := one_le_girth I
    rw [hg] at h
    exact ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp h
  have hC : 0 < headCoefficient input := headCoefficient_pos input (by rw [hg]; exact ENat.natCast_ne_top depth)
  have hu : ∀ eta : ℝ, 0 < eta → ∀ᶠ risk : ℚ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0),
      observationEnvelopeReal input 0 ∅ risk ≤
        (headCoefficient input + eta) * iteratedLog depth (1 / (risk : ℝ)) := by
    intro eta heta
    simpa only [suffixCoefficient_zero] using observationEnvelope_head_upper input depth hg 0 eta heta
  have hh := half_precise_upper _ (headCoefficient input) depth hd hu
    (epsilon * headCoefficient input) (mul_pos hepsilon hC)
  obtain ⟨cutoff, hcutoff, hnum⟩ := rationalEventually_positive_cutoff hh
  refine ⟨cutoff, hcutoff, ?_⟩
  intro budget hbudget hsmall hcut
  have hv : ReferenceBudgetValid (budget / 2) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  rw [← ofReal_observationEnvelopeReal input 0 ∅ (budget / 2) hv]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hn := hnum budget hbudget hcut
  have he : headCoefficient input + epsilon * headCoefficient input = (1 + epsilon) * headCoefficient input := by ring
  simpa only [he, one_div] using hn

end PaperProofs.Retained.PRetObservationEnvelope119

PaperProofs.Retained.terminal_matching_t.signature_start: theorem terminal_matching_trace (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Retained.terminal_matching_t.full_declaration_source:
theorem terminal_matching_trace (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : Native.NormalAccounting I) (tapes : Native.ReviewTapes input)
    (s : Native.State I) (hallocation : C.allocation = .terminalBarrier)
    (hexecution : C.execution = .terminalBarrier) (hinvariant : Native.Invariant C s)
    (hactive : s.halted = false) (hwritten : Native.allWritten s.ledger)
    (hcommit : s.ledger.commitments = []) (hexecute : s.ledger.executions = [])
    (hreported : ∀ i ∈ ordinaryMismatches s.ledger, ∃ time, s.ledger.reportTime i = some time)
    (hmatchable : Matchable I (ordinaryMismatches s.ledger)) :
    ∃ assignment : Matching I (ordinaryMismatches s.ledger), ∃ finished,
      UncappedTrace input C accounting tapes s finished ∧ Native.Invariant C finished ∧
      finished.halted = true ∧ finished.ledger.success C ∧
      finished.ledger.executions.length = (ordinaryMismatches s.ledger).card ∧
      finished.ledger.actualBill input.fees = s.ledger.actualBill input.fees +
        ∑ i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ ordinaryMismatches s.ledger},
          ENNReal.ofReal (input.fees.correction i.val (assignment.val i) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let errors := ordinaryMismatches s.ledger
  obtain ⟨assignment⟩ := (matchable_iff_matching I errors).mp hmatchable
  have hhandles (i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ errors}) : Native.validHandle s (originalHandle s i.val) := by
    refine ⟨(mem_ordinaryMismatches s.ledger i.val).mp i.property, rfl, ?_⟩
    exact hreported i.val i.property
  have htools : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset {i : I.Stage // i ∈ errors}),
      ∀ a ∈ s.ledger.commitments, a.tool ≠ assignment.val i := by
    intro i _ a ha
    rw [hcommit] at ha
    cases ha
  have hstages : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset {i : I.Stage // i ∈ errors}),
      ∀ a ∈ s.ledger.commitments, a.handle.stage ≠ i.val := by
    intro i _ a ha
    rw [hcommit] at ha
    cases ha
  obtain ⟨repaired, htrace, hinvariantRepair, hactiveRepair, htruthRepair, hwrittenRepair,
      hcovered, _, hcount, hfee⟩ :=
    repair_finite input C accounting tapes hallocation hexecution s errors assignment.val
      assignment.property.1 assignment.property.2 Finset.univ s hinvariant hactive hhandles htools hstages
  have hallwritten : Native.allWritten repaired.ledger := by
    intro i
    simpa only [hwrittenRepair] using hwritten i
  have hmismatches : ordinaryMismatches repaired.ledger = errors := by
    ext i
    simp only [errors, mem_ordinaryMismatches, hwrittenRepair, htruthRepair]
  have hcovered' (i : I.Stage) (hi : i ∈ ordinaryMismatches repaired.ledger) :
      i ∈ executedStages repaired.ledger := by
    have hi' : i ∈ errors := hmismatches ▸ hi
    exact hcovered ⟨i, hi'⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)
  let finished := Native.stopState repaired false
  have hstop : Native.Step input C .uncapped accounting tapes repaired .stop finished :=
    Native.Step.stop repaired hactiveRepair
  have hinvariantFinished := Native.step_invariant input C .uncapped accounting tapes hstop hinvariantRepair
  have hsuccess : finished.ledger.success C := by
    refine ⟨?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [finished, Native.stopState, hallwritten]
    · simp [Ledger.windowObligations, hallocation, hexecution]
    · intro i
      rcases written_correct_or_mismatch repaired.ledger hallwritten i with hcorrect | hmismatch
      · exact Or.inl hcorrect
      · exact Or.inr ((mem_executedStages repaired.ledger i).mp (hcovered' i hmismatch))
  have htraceFinished : UncappedTrace input C accounting tapes s finished :=
    htrace.trans (Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨.stop, hstop⟩)
  refine ⟨assignment, finished, htraceFinished, hinvariantFinished, rfl, hsuccess, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change repaired.ledger.executions.length = errors.card
    simpa only [hexecute, List.length_nil, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, Nat.zero_add] using hcount
  · change repaired.ledger.actualBill input.fees = s.ledger.actualBill input.fees + _
    exact hfee

an actual native Prefix. This still returns a finite Step trace; compiling
its choices into one visible-history Policy is a separate obligation. -/

theorem terminal_matching_trace_from_prefix (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : Native.NormalAccounting I) (tapes : Native.ReviewTapes input)
    {Seed : Type*} (policy : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (mode : Native.ResourceMode) {n : ℕ} {s : Native.State I}
    (hp : Native.Prefix input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes n s)
    (hallocation : C.allocation = .terminalBarrier) (hexecution : C.execution = .terminalBarrier)
    (hactive : s.halted = false) (hwritten : Native.allWritten s.ledger)
    (hcommit : s.ledger.commitments = []) (hexecute : s.ledger.executions = [])
    (hreported : ∀ i ∈ ordinaryMismatches s.ledger, ∃ time, s.ledger.reportTime i = some time)
    (hmatchable : Matchable I (ordinaryMismatches s.ledger)) :
    ∃ assignment : Matching I (ordinaryMismatches s.ledger), ∃ finished,
      UncappedTrace input C accounting tapes s finished ∧ Native.Invariant C finished ∧
      finished.halted = true ∧ finished.ledger.success C ∧
      finished.ledger.executions.length = (ordinaryMismatches s.ledger).card ∧
      finished.ledger.actualBill input.fees = s.ledger.actualBill input.fees +
        ∑ i : {i : I.Stage // i ∈ ordinaryMismatches s.ledger},
          ENNReal.ofReal (input.fees.correction i.val (assignment.val i) : ℝ) :=
  terminal_matching_trace input C accounting tapes s hallocation hexecution
    (Native.prefix_invariant input C mode accounting policy seed truth tapes hp)
    hactive hwritten hcommit hexecute hreported hmatchable

end PaperProofs.Retained

theorem freshRisk_encoded_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (next : ℕ) (old : Finset I.Stage)
    (policy : Policy (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next)) Seed) (ν : Measure Seed) :
    freshRisk input next old (strategyPolicy (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next))
      .uncapped (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next))).rule
      (encodedSeedLaw (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
        (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next)) policy ν) = freshRisk input next old policy.rule ν := by
  unfold freshRisk
  have hm : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × (input.freshSuffix next).World =>
      (encodeSeed (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
        (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next)) policy sample.1, sample.2)) :=
    ((measurable_encodeSeed (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
      (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next)) policy).comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
  have hs : MeasurableSet {sample | ¬ freshSuccess input next old
      (strategyPolicy (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
        (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next))).rule sample} := by
    simpa only [Set.compl_ofPred] using (measurableSet_freshSuccess input next old
      (strategyPolicy (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
        (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next))).rule
      (strategyPolicy (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
        (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next))).measurable_rule).compl
  rw [seededWorldLaw_encoded (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
    (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next)) policy ν, Measure.map_apply hm hs]
  congr 1
  ext sample
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, freshSuccess, run_encoded_eq]

theorem freshPenalty_le_penalty (input : StatisticalInput I) (next : ℕ) (old : Finset I.Stage)
    (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) : freshPenalty input next old penalty ≤ penalty := by
  let ν : Measure Unit := Measure.dirac ()
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := by dsimp [ν]; infer_instance

        (abandonPolicy (input.freshSuffix next) (freshContract (I.freshSuffix next)) .uncapped
          (zeroNormalAccounting (I.freshSuffix next)) Unit).rule ν ≤ 1 from prob_le_one) penalty))

theorem prefix_retainedRule_reviews_le_quota (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (budget : ℚ) (quota : I.Stage → ℕ)
    (seed : Unit) (truth : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting (retainedRule input budget (some quota))
      seed truth tapes n s) :
    ∀ stage : I.Stage, s.ledger.reviews stage ≤ (quota stage : ℕ∞) := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => intro stage; exact bot_le
  | @next n s result earlier step ih =>
    generalize haction : retainedRule input budget (some quota) seed s.history = action at step
    cases step with
    | review current live port resources =>
      have hgate := retainedRule_review_lt_quota input budget quota seed s.history current haction
      intro stage
      by_cases heq : stage = current
      · subst stage
        simp only [record, reviewLedger, Function.update_self]
        rw [← prefix_historyObservations_length input C mode accounting
          (retainedRule input budget (some quota)) seed truth tapes earlier current]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hgate
      · simpa only [record, reviewLedger, Function.update_of_ne heq] using ih stage
    | write current bit live port resources =>
      intro stage
      simpa only [record, reportedWrite_reviews] using ih stage
    | allocate | execute | advance | stop | abandon => exact ih

                ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + epsilon) * headCoefficient input * iteratedLog depth delta⁻¹) ∧

RootRetainedHead.nativeLowerPriceLaw_of_.name: RootRetainedHead.nativeLowerPriceLaw_of_recursion
RootRetainedHead.nativeLowerPriceLaw_of_.signature_start: theorem nativeLowerPriceLaw_of_recursion (input : StatisticalInput I) (hrec : FreshPenaltyRecursion input) :
RootRetainedHead.nativeLowerPriceLaw_of_.full_declaration_source:
theorem nativeLowerPriceLaw_of_recursion (input : StatisticalInput I) (hrec : FreshPenaltyRecursion input) :
    NativeLowerPriceLaw input := by
  intro depth hg ε hε
  have hfinite : girth I ≠ ⊤ := by rw [hg]; exact ENat.natCast_ne_top depth
  have hC := headCoefficient_pos input hfinite
  have hn : 0 < I.stageCount := by
    obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := girthHeads_nonempty I hfinite
    have hi : i.val < I.stageCount := i.isLt
    omega
  have hlim := head_leading input hrec depth hg
  let scale : ℝ → ℝ := fun penalty => headCoefficient input * iteratedLog depth penalty
  have hscale : Tendsto scale atTop atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hC (iteratedLog_tendsto_atTop depth)
  have hratio : ∀ᶠ penalty in atTop,
      1 - ε / 2 < freshPenaltyReal input 0 ∅ penalty / scale penalty :=
    hlim.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by linarith : 1 - ε / 2 < 1))
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ penalty : ℝ in atTop,
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) * scale penalty) ≤ freshPenalty input 0 ∅ (ENNReal.ofReal penalty) - 1 := by
    filter_upwards [hratio, hscale.eventually_gt_atTop 0, hscale.eventually_ge_atTop (2 / ε)]
      with penalty hr hs hlarge
    have hf : (1 - ε / 2) * scale penalty ≤ freshPenaltyReal input 0 ∅ penalty :=
      le_of_lt ((lt_div_iff₀ hs).mp hr)
    have htwo : 2 ≤ scale penalty * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hlarge
    have hraw : (1 - ε) * scale penalty ≤ freshPenaltyReal input 0 ∅ penalty - 1 := by
      nlinarith only [hf, htwo]
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (freshPenaltyReal input 0 ∅ penalty - 1) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hraw
      _ = _ := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1), ENNReal.ofReal_one]
        exact congrArg (fun value : ℝ≥0∞ => value - 1)
          (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (freshPenalty_ne_top input 0 ∅ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top))
  obtain ⟨threshold, hthreshold⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hbound
  let cutoff : ℝ := max 1 threshold + 1
  have hc : 0 < cutoff := by dsimp [cutoff]; linarith [le_max_left (1 : ℝ) threshold]
  refine ⟨1 / cutoff, one_div_pos.mpr hc, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ hsmall C hretained accounting
  have hinv : cutoff ≤ δ⁻¹ := by
    calc
      cutoff = 1 / (1 / cutoff) := by rw [one_div_one_div]
      _ ≤ 1 / δ := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hδ hsmall.le
      _ = _ := one_div δ
  have hthresholdInv : threshold ≤ δ⁻¹ :=
    (show threshold ≤ cutoff by dsimp [cutoff]; linarith [le_max_right (1 : ℝ) threshold]).trans hinv
  have hrelaxed := hthreshold δ⁻¹ hthresholdInv
  have hnative := initial_inverse_lower input hn C hretained accounting (ENNReal.ofReal δ)
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hδ] at hnative
  simpa only [scale, mul_assoc] using hrelaxed.trans hnative

end RootRetainedHead

theorem nativeInfiniteGirthLaw (input : StatisticalInput I) : NativeInfiniteGirthLaw input := by
  intro top C hearly accounting budget exponent positive small qualification
  let policy := PRetNativeImplementation118.nativeBoundedPolicy input C hearly accounting budget exponent qualification
  have observations : expectedObservationBill input C .native accounting policy.rule (Measure.dirac ()) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = expectedObservationBill input C .uncapped accounting
          (boundedPolicy input C hearly accounting budget exponent).rule (Measure.dirac ()) := by
        unfold expectedObservationBill
        apply lintegral_congr
        intro sample
        unfold runObservationBill
        apply iSup_congr
        intro n
        exact congrArg (fun state : State I => state.ledger.observationBill input.fees)
          (PRetNativeImplementation118.nativeBounded_run_eq input C hearly accounting budget exponent qualification sample n)
      _ = 0 := expectedObservationBill_zero input top C hearly accounting budget (some (referenceQuota input exponent))
  refine ⟨policy, rfl, ?_, observations, ?_⟩
  · rw [← risk_uncapped_eq_native input C accounting policy.rule policy.legal]
    change risk input C .uncapped accounting
      (retainedRule input budget (some (referenceQuota input exponent))) (Measure.dirac ()) = 0
    rw [rule_limit_eq input top budget (some (referenceQuota input exponent))]
    exact PRetInfiniteRisk.idealRisk_zero_of_girth_top input top C hearly accounting budget positive small
  · have full := expectedBill_le_observation_add input C .native accounting policy (Measure.dirac ())
    rw [observations, zero_add] at full
    exact full

end RootRetainedInfinite

def HeadExtractionClaims (constant wordFactor scratchFactor : ℕ) (implementation : Implementation) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℕ) (full : List (Finset (Fin q))), LaminarSchedule full → ∀ used : Finset (Fin q),
    let N := full.length
    let t := CompactControllerClaims.treeSize q full
    let bits := AlgorithmClaims.indexWidth wordFactor N q
    let capWords := CompactControllerClaims.capacityWords scratchFactor N q t
    let heapWords := CompactControllerClaims.physicalHeaderWords + AlgorithmClaims.packedCapacityWords q capWords bits + scratchFactor * (N + q + t + 1)
    let empty := fun _ => BitVec.ofNat bits 0
    let source := CompactControllerClaims.controllerInput q full used
    ∃ preSteps headSteps : ℕ,
    let built := AlgorithmClaims.packingRun source implementation.preprocessor preSteps (AlgorithmClaims.packingInitial empty)
    let result := AlgorithmClaims.packingRun (CompactControllerClaims.callInput q full .query) implementation.heads headSteps (AlgorithmClaims.packingInitial built.heap)
    RawTreePreprocessingClaims.DynamicRunCorrect heapWords source implementation.preprocessor preSteps empty ∧
    RawTreePreprocessingClaims.totalCost heapWords source implementation.preprocessor preSteps empty ≤ constant * CompactControllerClaims.preprocessingWork N q t ∧
    CompactControllerClaims.HeapRepresents q full capWords ⟨0, used, false⟩ built.heap ∧
    RawTreePreprocessingClaims.DynamicRunCorrect heapWords (CompactControllerClaims.callInput q full .query) implementation.heads headSteps built.heap ∧
    CompactControllerClaims.callCost q full implementation.heads .query headSteps built.heap ≤ constant * headWork q full ∧
    CompactControllerClaims.HeapRepresents q full capWords ⟨N, used, false⟩ result.heap ∧
    let base := (result.register .index).toNat
    base + (headWords q full used).length ≤ heapWords ∧
    RawTreePreprocessingClaims.heapWordsAt result.heap base (headWords q full used).length = headWords q full used

def ActualCompactCost (constant wordFactor scratchFactor degree : ℕ) (implementation : Implementation)
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (available : Finset I.Tool) (budget : ℚ) (exponent : ℕ)
    (policy : Policy input C .native accounting Unit) : Prop :=
  let N := I.stageCount
  let q := I.toolCount
  let t := CompactControllerClaims.treeSize q I.compatibility
  let bits := AlgorithmClaims.indexWidth wordFactor N q
  let capWords := CompactControllerClaims.capacityWords scratchFactor N q t
  let heapWords := CompactControllerClaims.physicalHeaderWords + AlgorithmClaims.packedCapacityWords q capWords bits + scratchFactor * (N + q + t + 1)
  let empty := fun _ => BitVec.ofNat bits 0
  let source := CompactControllerClaims.controllerInput q I.compatibility (Finset.univ \ available)
  let horizon := quotaActionBound I (referenceQuota input exponent) + 1
  let allowance := constant * (RationalControllerComputation.arithmeticScale input C budget + CompactControllerClaims.preprocessingWork N q t + 1)^degree
  ∃ preSteps : ℕ,
  let built := AlgorithmClaims.packingRun source implementation.preprocessor preSteps (AlgorithmClaims.packingInitial empty)
  RawTreePreprocessingClaims.DynamicRunCorrect heapWords source implementation.preprocessor preSteps empty ∧
  RawTreePreprocessingClaims.totalCost heapWords source implementation.preprocessor preSteps empty ≤ constant * CompactControllerClaims.preprocessingWork N q t ∧
  CompactControllerClaims.HeapRepresents q I.compatibility capWords ⟨0, Finset.univ \ available, false⟩ built.heap ∧
  ∀ sample : Unit × input.World,
  let final := run input C .native accounting policy.rule sample horizon
  final.halted = true ∧
  ∃ counts : List ℕ,
  let commands := commandsAt I final.history
  counts.length = commands.length ∧ commands.length ≤ 2 * N + 1 ∧
  CompactControllerClaims.CommandsRunClaims constant q I.compatibility capWords heapWords implementation.live
    ⟨0, Finset.univ \ available, false⟩ commands counts built.heap ∧
  CompactControllerClaims.commandsCost q I.compatibility implementation.live commands counts built.heap ≤ constant * (N + 1) * CompactControllerClaims.liveWork q t ∧
  ∃ preparationTrace preparationFinal,
  RationalControllerComputation.Runs implementation.scalar.preparationMachine (RationalControllerComputation.preparationInput input C budget) preparationTrace preparationFinal ∧
  preparationFinal.Tape.right₀ = Turing.ListBlank.mk (RationalControllerComputation.preparationOutput input C budget) ∧
  RationalControllerComputation.visitedSpace implementation.scalar.preparationMachine
    (RationalControllerComputation.preparationInput input C budget).length preparationTrace ≤ allowance ∧
  ∃ traces : Fin horizon → List (RationalControllerComputation.MachineState implementation.plannerStates),
  (∀ clock : Fin horizon,
    let state := run input C .native accounting policy.rule sample clock.val
    let current := commandsAt I state.history
    current.IsPrefix commands ∧
    CompactControllerClaims.CommandsRunClaims constant q I.compatibility capWords heapWords implementation.live
      ⟨0, Finset.univ \ available, false⟩ current (counts.take current.length) built.heap ∧
    if state.halted then traces clock = [] else
      let records := queryRecords q I.compatibility implementation.live current (counts.take current.length) built.heap
      ∃ bitFinal, RationalControllerComputation.Runs implementation.plannerMachine (plannerInput input C available budget state.history records)
        (traces clock) bitFinal ∧
        bitFinal.Tape.right₀ = Turing.ListBlank.mk (RationalControllerComputation.encode (RationalControllerComputation.encodeAction (policy.rule () state.history))) ∧
        RationalControllerComputation.visitedSpace implementation.plannerMachine
          (plannerInput input C available budget state.history records).length (traces clock) ≤ allowance) ∧
  preparationTrace.length + ∑ clock, (traces clock).length ≤ allowance

theorem laminar (q : ℕ) (order : Order) :
    Structure.LaminarTree.LaminarSchedule (starInstance q order).compatibility := by
  intro left hl right hr
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hl
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hr
  unfold eligibility
  cases hi : label q order i with
  | none => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Finset.subset_univ _))
  | some r =>
    cases hj : label q order j with
    | none => exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Finset.subset_univ _))
    | some s =>
      by_cases hrs : r = s
      · subst s; exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Finset.Subset.refl _))
      · exact Or.inl (Finset.disjoint_singleton.mpr (by simpa using hrs))

PaperProofs.Star.matchable_iff_card_le.name: PaperProofs.Star.matchable_iff_card_le
PaperProofs.Star.matchable_iff_card_le.full_declaration_source:
theorem matchable_iff_card_le (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (order : Order)
    (errors : Finset (starInstance q order).Stage) :
    Retained.Matchable (starInstance q order) errors ↔ errors.card ≤ q := by
  constructor
  · exact Retained.Matchable.card_le_tools
  · intro hcard
    have htotal : (Finset.univ : Finset (starInstance q order).Stage).card = q + 1 := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Instance.Stage, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact stageCount_eq q order
    obtain ⟨missing, _, hmissing⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card
      (show errors.card < (Finset.univ : Finset (starInstance q order).Stage).card by omega)
    let fallback : Fin q := (stageLabel q order missing).getD ⟨0, hq⟩
    let assigned : {i : (starInstance q order).Stage // i ∈ errors} → Fin q :=
      fun i => (stageLabel q order i.val).getD fallback
    refine ⟨assigned, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j heq
      change @Eq (Fin q) (assigned i) (assigned j) at heq
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply stageLabel_injective q order
      cases hi : stageLabel q order i.val with
      | none =>
        cases hj : stageLabel q order j.val with
        | none => rfl
        | some r =>
          have hr : fallback = r := by simpa only [assigned, hi, hj, Option.getD_none,
            Option.getD_some] using heq
          cases hm : stageLabel q order missing with
          | none =>
            have him := stageLabel_injective q order (hi.trans hm.symm)
            exact False.elim (hmissing (him ▸ i.property))
          | some s =>
            have hrs : s = r := by simpa only [fallback, hm, Option.getD_some] using hr
            have hjm : j.val = missing := stageLabel_injective q order (by simp only [hj, hm, hrs])
            exact False.elim (hmissing (hjm ▸ j.property))
      | some r =>
        cases hj : stageLabel q order j.val with
        | none =>
          have hr : r = fallback := by simpa only [assigned, hi, hj, Option.getD_none,
            Option.getD_some] using heq
          cases hm : stageLabel q order missing with
          | none =>
            have hjm := stageLabel_injective q order (hj.trans hm.symm)
            exact False.elim (hmissing (hjm ▸ j.property))
          | some s =>
            have hrs : r = s := by simpa only [fallback, hm, Option.getD_some] using hr
            have him : i.val = missing := stageLabel_injective q order (by simp only [hi, hm, hrs])
            exact False.elim (hmissing (him ▸ i.property))
        | some s =>
          have hrs : r = s := by simpa only [assigned, hi, hj, Option.getD_some] using heq
          exact congrArg some hrs
    · intro i
      rw [eligible_formula]
      change assigned i ∈ (match stageLabel q order i.val with
        | none => Finset.univ | some r => {r} : Finset (Fin q))
      cases hi : stageLabel q order i.val with
      | none => exact Finset.mem_univ _
      | some r =>
        simp only [assigned, hi, Option.getD_some]
        exact Finset.mem_singleton_self r

PaperProofs.Star.circuit_iff_univ.full_declaration_source:
theorem circuit_iff_univ (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (order : Order)
    (errors : Finset (starInstance q order).Stage) :
    Retained.Circuit (starInstance q order) errors ↔ errors = Finset.univ := by
  have htotal : (Finset.univ : Finset (starInstance q order).Stage).card = q + 1 := by
    simp only [Finset.card_univ, Instance.Stage, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact stageCount_eq q order
  constructor
  · intro hc
    have hbad : q < errors.card := by
      exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hc.1 ((matchable_iff_card_le q hq order errors).mpr h))
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.subset_univ _)
    omega
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hm
      have := (matchable_iff_card_le q hq order Finset.univ).mp hm
      omega

    · intro smaller hproper
      apply (matchable_iff_card_le q hq order smaller).mpr
      have := Finset.card_lt_card hproper
      omega

    Retained.girth (starInstance q order) = (q + 1 : ℕ) := by

theorem girthHeads_eq (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (order : Order) :
    Retained.girthHeads (starInstance q order) = {firstStage q order} := by
  classical
  ext i
  rw [Retained.mem_girthHeads, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨errors, ⟨hc, _, hhead⟩, _⟩
    have hfull := (circuit_iff_univ q hq order errors).mp hc
    subst errors
    exact le_antisymm (hhead _ (Finset.mem_univ _)) (firstStage_le q order i)
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨Finset.univ, ⟨(circuit_iff_univ q hq order Finset.univ).mpr rfl,
      Finset.mem_univ _, fun j _ => firstStage_le q order j⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [girth_eq q hq order]
    congr 1
    simp only [Finset.card_univ, Instance.Stage, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact stageCount_eq q order

def experiment (P : Parameters) : BinaryExperiment where
  alphabetSize := 2
  priorOne := 1 / 2
  prior_pos := by norm_num
  prior_lt_one := by norm_num
  channel x y :=
    if y.val = (if x then 1 else 0) then 1 / 2 + P.gamma else 1 / 2 - P.gamma
  channel_pos := by
    intro x y
    split_ifs <;> linarith [P.gamma_pos, P.gamma_le_quarter]
  channel_sum := by
    intro x
    cases x <;> norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  channel_distinct := by
    intro heq
    have h := congrFun heq (0 : Fin 2)
    norm_num at h
    linarith [P.gamma_pos]
  observationFee := P.reviewFee
  observationFee_pos := P.reviewFee_pos

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.P.name: PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.Parameters.divergence_eq_kappa
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.P.signature_start: theorem divergence_eq_kappa (P : Parameters) (x : Bool) : P.experiment.divergence x = P.kappa := by
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.P.full_declaration_source:
theorem divergence_eq_kappa (P : Parameters) (x : Bool) : P.experiment.divergence x = P.kappa := by
  have hm : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) - (P.gamma : ℝ) := by
    have hg := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mpr P.gamma_le_quarter
    norm_num at hg
    linarith
  have hp : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) + (P.gamma : ℝ) := by
    have hg : 0 < (P.gamma : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast P.gamma_pos
    linarith
  have hratio : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (P.gamma : ℝ)) / (1 / 2 - (P.gamma : ℝ)) = (P.odds : ℝ) := by
    simp only [odds, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_add, Rat.cast_sub, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_ofNat]
    field_simp
  have hreverse : Real.log (((1 / 2 : ℝ) - (P.gamma : ℝ)) / (1 / 2 + (P.gamma : ℝ))) = -P.h := by
    rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hm) (ne_of_gt hp)]
    rw [h, ← hratio, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hp) (ne_of_gt hm)]
    ring
  have hforward : Real.log (((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (P.gamma : ℝ)) / (1 / 2 - (P.gamma : ℝ))) = P.h := by
    rw [hratio]; rfl
  change (∑ y : Fin 2, P.experiment.channelReal x y *
    Real.log (P.experiment.channelReal x y / P.experiment.channelReal (!x) y)) = _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hr (y : Fin 2) (z : Bool) : P.experiment.channelReal z y =
      if y.val = (if z then 1 else 0) then (1 / 2 : ℝ) + (P.gamma : ℝ)
      else (1 / 2 : ℝ) - (P.gamma : ℝ) := by
    unfold BinaryExperiment.channelReal
    rw [P.channel_formula]
    split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> rfl
  simp only [hr]
  cases x <;> norm_num only [Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.not_true,
    ↓reduceIte, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, zero_ne_one, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, reduceCtorEq] <;>
    rw [hforward, hreverse] <;> unfold kappa <;> ring
