theorem phiReal_le_log_inv {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hhalf : p ≤ 1 / 2) :
    phiReal p ≤ Real.log (1 / p) := by
  have hq : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have hlogq : Real.log (1 - p) ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hq.le (by linarith)
  have hlogp : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / p) :=
    Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr (by linarith))
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * p := by linarith
  have hsum : Real.log ((1 - p) / p) = Real.log (1 - p) + Real.log (1 / p) := by
    rw [Real.log_div hq.ne' hp.ne', one_div, Real.log_inv]
    ring
  rw [phiReal, hsum]
  nlinarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hfactor hlogq, mul_nonneg hp.le hlogp]

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.l.name: PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.log_inv_sub_two_le_phiReal
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.l.full_declaration_source:
theorem log_inv_sub_two_le_phiReal {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hhalf : p ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.log (1 / p) - 2 ≤ phiReal p := by
  have hq : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have hlogq : 0 ≤ -Real.log (1 - p) := neg_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_nonpos hq.le (by linarith))
  have hplog : p * Real.log (1 / p) ≤ 1 - p := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hp)) hp.le
    have heq : p * (1 / p - 1) = 1 - p := by field_simp
    rwa [heq] at h
  have hqlog : (1 - p) * (-Real.log (1 - p)) ≤ p := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hq)) hq.le
    rw [Real.log_inv] at h
    have heq : (1 - p) * ((1 - p)⁻¹ - 1) = p := by field_simp; ring
    rwa [heq] at h
  have hterm : (1 - 2 * p) * (-Real.log (1 - p)) ≤ p :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith : 1 - 2 * p ≤ 1 - p) hlogq).trans hqlog
  have hsum : Real.log ((1 - p) / p) = Real.log (1 - p) + Real.log (1 / p) := by
    rw [Real.log_div hq.ne' hp.ne', one_div, Real.log_inv]
    ring
  rw [phiReal, hsum]
  nlinarith

theorem bayesObservationCharge_eq_posteriorInformation (P : Parameters) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (test : P.experiment.AdmissibleRule Seed)
    (hfinite : ∀ x, P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test x ≠ ⊤) :
    P.experiment.bayesObservationCharge ν test = ENNReal.ofReal P.a * P.expectedPosteriorInformation ν test := by
  have hinfo : P.expectedPosteriorInformation ν test =
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.kappa * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test false).toReal +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test true).toReal)) := by
    rw [P.expectedPosteriorInformation_eq_stoppedLaw ν test hfinite]
    simp_rw [phi_of_pos (P.wordPosteriorError_pos _)]
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (P.posteriorPhi_integrable ν test hfinite)
      (ae_of_all _ fun record => phiReal_nonneg (P.wordPosteriorError_pos record.2)
        (P.wordPosteriorError_le_half record.2)), P.integral_posteriorPhi ν test hfinite]
  have hc (x : Bool) : P.experiment.expectedObservationCharge ν test x =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((P.reviewFee : ℝ) * (P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test x).toReal) := by
    calc
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (P.experiment.observationFee : ℝ) * P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test x :=
        P.experiment.expectedObservationCharge_eq ν test x
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (P.experiment.observationFee : ℝ) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test x).toReal := by rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (hfinite x)]
      _ = _ := (ENNReal.ofReal_mul P.experiment.observationFee_real_pos.le).symm
  rw [hinfo, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul P.a_pos.le]
  have ha : P.a * P.kappa = (P.reviewFee : ℝ) := by
    unfold a
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ P.kappa_pos.ne'
  have hr : P.a * (P.kappa * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test false).toReal +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test true).toReal)) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((P.reviewFee : ℝ) * (P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test false).toReal) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((P.reviewFee : ℝ) * (P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test true).toReal) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ha]
    ring
  rw [hr]
  unfold BinaryExperiment.bayesObservationCharge
  simp only [P.priorMass_eq_half, hc, Fintype.sum_bool]
  rw [← ofReal_half,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_add
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast P.reviewFee_pos.le) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast P.reviewFee_pos.le) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg))]
  congr 1
  ring

theorem bayesStoppedLaw_rectangle (P : Parameters) (ν : Measure Seed)
    (test : P.experiment.AdmissibleRule Seed)
    (hfinite : ∀ x, P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test x ≠ ⊤)
    (seeds : Set Seed) (hs : MeasurableSet seeds) (word : P.experiment.StoppedWord) :
    P.bayesStoppedLaw ν test (seeds ×ˢ {word}) =
      ν (seeds ∩ P.experiment.stoppingSeeds test word) * ENNReal.ofReal (P.wordEvidence word / 2) := by
  rw [bayesStoppedLaw, Measure.add_apply, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    P.experiment.transcriptLaw_rectangle_singleton ν test false (hfinite false) seeds hs word,
    P.experiment.transcriptLaw_rectangle_singleton ν test true (hfinite true) seeds hs word]
  have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) := ofReal_half.symm
  have hadd : (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (P.experiment.wordProbability false word) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (P.experiment.wordProbability true word) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.wordEvidence word / 2) := by
    rw [hhalf, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2),
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2),
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_add
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (P.experiment.wordProbability_pos false word).le)
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (P.experiment.wordProbability_pos true word).le)]
    congr 1
    unfold wordEvidence
    ring
  calc
    _ = ν (seeds ∩ P.experiment.stoppingSeeds test word) *
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (P.experiment.wordProbability false word) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (P.experiment.wordProbability true word)) := by
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hadd]

theorem bayesStoppedLaw_posterior_withDensity (P : Parameters) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (test : P.experiment.AdmissibleRule Seed)
    (hfinite : ∀ x, P.experiment.expectedSamples ν test x ≠ ⊤) (x : Bool) :
    (P.bayesStoppedLaw ν test).withDensity
      (fun record => ENNReal.ofReal (P.wordPosteriorMass x record.2)) =

    ⟨by norm_num [Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]⟩
  symm
  apply Measure.ext_prod
  intro seeds words hs _hw
  have hset : seeds ×ˢ words = ⋃ word : words, seeds ×ˢ {word.val} := by
    ext record
    simp only [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hs', hw'⟩
      exact ⟨⟨record.2, hw'⟩, hs', rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨word, hs', hw'⟩
      exact ⟨hs', hw' ▸ word.property⟩
  have hdisj : Pairwise (fun word word' : words => Disjoint (seeds ×ˢ {word.val}) (seeds ×ˢ {word'.val})) := by
    intro word word' hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro record hr hr'
    exact hne (Subtype.ext (hr.2.symm.trans hr'.2))
  have hm (word : words) : MeasurableSet (seeds ×ˢ {word.val}) :=
    hs.prod (measurableSet_singleton word.val)
  rw [hset, measure_iUnion hdisj hm, measure_iUnion hdisj hm]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro word
  rw [Measure.smul_apply, withDensity_apply _ (hm word)]
  have hconstant : ∫⁻ record in seeds ×ˢ {word.val}, ENNReal.ofReal (P.wordPosteriorMass x record.2)
      ∂(P.bayesStoppedLaw ν test) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.wordPosteriorMass x word.val) * P.bayesStoppedLaw ν test (seeds ×ˢ {word.val}) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ _record in seeds ×ˢ {word.val}, ENNReal.ofReal (P.wordPosteriorMass x word.val)
          ∂(P.bayesStoppedLaw ν test) := by
        apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (hm word)
        intro record hr
        change ENNReal.ofReal (P.wordPosteriorMass x record.2) =
          ENNReal.ofReal (P.wordPosteriorMass x word.val)
        rw [hr.2]
      _ = _ := by simp
  rw [hconstant]
  exact (P.wordPosterior_rectangle_bayes ν test hfinite seeds hs word.val x).symm

PaperProofs.Star.Parameters.cutPosterior.full_declaration_source:
theorem cutPosterior_normalization (P : Star.Parameters) (order : Order)
    (history : List (VisibleEvent (starInstance P.tools order)))
    (truth : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage → Bool) :
    P.cutPosterior order history truth * (∑ bits, P.cutLikelihood order history bits) =
      P.cutLikelihood order history truth := by
  unfold cutLikelihood
  have hsum : (∑ bits : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage → Bool,
      ∏ stage, P.channel.experiment.priorMass (bits stage) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (P.channel.experiment.wordProbability (bits stage) (P.preReportWord order history stage))) =
      ∏ stage, ∑ x : Bool, P.channel.experiment.priorMass x *
        ENNReal.ofReal (P.channel.experiment.wordProbability x (P.preReportWord order history stage)) :=
    (Fintype.prod_sum (fun (stage : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage) (x : Bool) =>
      P.channel.experiment.priorMass x *
        ENNReal.ofReal (P.channel.experiment.wordProbability x (P.preReportWord order history stage)))).symm
  rw [hsum]
  unfold cutPosterior
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun stage _ => P.localPosterior_mul_evidence order history stage (truth stage)

PaperProofs.Star.Parameters.preReportLaw.full_declaration_source:
theorem preReportLaw_rectangle (P : Star.Parameters) (order : Order)
    (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (rule : PolicyRule (starInstance P.tools order) Seed)
    (hm : MeasurableRule rule) (hlegal : LegalRule (P.input order) C .native accounting rule)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (seeds : Set Seed) (hs : MeasurableSet seeds)
    (history : List (VisibleEvent (starInstance P.tools order))) :
    preReportLaw (P.input order) C accounting rule ν (seeds ×ˢ {history}) =
      ν (seeds ∩ P.cutSeedGate order C accounting rule history) * (∑ truth, P.cutLikelihood order history truth) := by
  classical
  rw [preReportLaw, Measure.map_apply (measurable_preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule hm)
    (hs.prod (measurableSet_singleton history))]
  have heq : (preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule) ⁻¹' (seeds ×ˢ {history}) =
      ⋃ truth, P.jointCutEvent order C accounting rule seeds history truth := by
    ext sample
    change (sample.1 ∈ seeds ∧ preReportPublicHistory (P.input order) C accounting rule sample = history) ↔ _
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, jointCutEvent, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hseed, hh⟩
      exact ⟨(P.input order).truthAt sample.2, hseed, rfl, hh⟩
    · rintro ⟨truth, hseed, _, hh⟩
      exact ⟨hseed, hh⟩
  have hdisj : Pairwise (fun truth truth' => Disjoint
      (P.jointCutEvent order C accounting rule seeds history truth)
      (P.jointCutEvent order C accounting rule seeds history truth')) := by
    intro truth truth' hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro sample hleft hright
    exact hne (hleft.2.1.symm.trans hright.2.1)
  rw [heq, measure_iUnion hdisj (fun truth => P.measurableSet_jointCutEvent order C accounting rule hm seeds hs history truth),
    tsum_fintype]
  simp_rw [P.jointCutEvent_law order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal ν seeds hs history]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

PaperProofs.Star.Parameters.cutTruthReco.full_declaration_source:
theorem cutTruthRecordLaw_eq_withDensity (P : Star.Parameters) (order : Order)
    (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (rule : PolicyRule (starInstance P.tools order) Seed)
    (hm : MeasurableRule rule) (hlegal : LegalRule (P.input order) C .native accounting rule)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (truth : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage → Bool) :
    P.cutTruthRecordLaw order C accounting rule ν truth =
      (preReportLaw (P.input order) C accounting rule ν).withDensity
        (fun record => P.cutPosterior order record.2 truth) := by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (P.cutTruthRecordLaw order C accounting rule ν truth) := by
    unfold cutTruthRecordLaw
    infer_instance
  apply Measure.ext_prod
  intro seeds histories hs _hh
  have hset : seeds ×ˢ histories = ⋃ history : histories, seeds ×ˢ {history.val} := by
    ext record
    simp only [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hseed, hh⟩
      exact ⟨⟨record.2, hh⟩, hseed, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨history, hseed, hh⟩
      exact ⟨hseed, hh ▸ history.property⟩
  have hdisj : Pairwise (fun history history' : histories =>
      Disjoint (seeds ×ˢ {history.val}) (seeds ×ˢ {history'.val})) := by
    intro history history' hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro record hr hr'
    exact hne (Subtype.ext (hr.2.symm.trans hr'.2))
  have hmeas (history : histories) : MeasurableSet (seeds ×ˢ {history.val}) := hs.prod (measurableSet_singleton _)
  rw [hset, measure_iUnion hdisj hmeas, measure_iUnion hdisj hmeas]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro history
  rw [withDensity_apply _ (hmeas history)]
  have hconstant : (∫⁻ record in seeds ×ˢ {history.val}, P.cutPosterior order record.2 truth
      ∂preReportLaw (P.input order) C accounting rule ν) =
      P.cutPosterior order history.val truth *
        preReportLaw (P.input order) C accounting rule ν (seeds ×ˢ {history.val}) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ _record in seeds ×ˢ {history.val}, P.cutPosterior order history.val truth
          ∂preReportLaw (P.input order) C accounting rule ν := by
        apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (hmeas history)
        intro record hr
        change P.cutPosterior order record.2 truth = P.cutPosterior order history.val truth
        rw [hr.2]
      _ = _ := by simp
  rw [hconstant]
  exact P.cutTruthRecordLaw_rectangle order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal ν seeds hs history.val truth

    (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (rule : PolicyRule (starInstance P.tools order) Seed)

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_retarge.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_retarget_reportFree (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hlate : C.reporting = .late) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth truth' : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes tapes' : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes n s) (hf : ReportFree s.history)
    (htape : ∀ i k, k < (historyObservations s.history i).length → tapes' i k = tapes i k) :
    Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth' tapes' n (retargetTruth s truth') := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => exact .initial
  | @next n s next earlier step ih =>
    have hbefore := step_reportFree_source input C mode accounting tapes step hf
    have hobs : ∀ i k, k < (historyObservations s.history i).length → tapes' i k = tapes i k := by
      intro i k hk
      exact htape i k (lt_of_lt_of_le hk (step_historyObservations_length_mono input C mode accounting tapes step i))
    have hprev := ih hbefore hobs
    have hclear := prefix_reportTime_none_of_reportFree input C hlate mode accounting rule seed truth tapes earlier hbefore
    have hread : ∀ i, rule seed s.history = .review i →
        tapes' i (s.ledger.reviews i).toNat = tapes i (s.ledger.reviews i).toNat := by
      intro i haction
      have hs : Step input C mode accounting tapes s (.review i) next := haction ▸ step
      exact htape i _ (review_index_lt_next_observations input C mode accounting tapes i hs
        (prefix_historyObservations_length_toNat input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes earlier i))
    exact .next hprev (step_retarget_reportFree input C hlate mode accounting tapes tapes' truth' hclear hf hread step)

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_event_e.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_event_eq_seedGate_prod_cylinder (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hlate : C.reporting = .late) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (anchor : Seed) (truth truth' : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule anchor truth tapes n s) (hf : ReportFree s.history) :
    {sample : Seed × ReviewTapes input |
      Prefix input C mode accounting rule sample.1 truth' sample.2 n (retargetTruth s truth')} =
      prefixSeedGate input C mode accounting rule tapes n s ×ˢ publicWordCylinder input s.history := by
  have hc := prefix_mem_publicWordCylinder input C mode accounting rule anchor truth tapes hp
  ext sample
  constructor
  · intro hp'
    have hc' := prefix_mem_publicWordCylinder input C mode accounting rule sample.1 truth' sample.2
      (s := retargetTruth s truth') hp'
    have hback := prefix_replay_of_publicWordCylinder input C hlate mode accounting rule sample.1 truth'
      s.ledger.truth sample.2 tapes (s := retargetTruth s truth') hp' hf hc
    change Prefix input C mode accounting rule sample.1 s.ledger.truth tapes n s at hback
    exact ⟨hback, hc'⟩
  · rintro ⟨hseed, hc'⟩
    exact prefix_replay_of_publicWordCylinder input C hlate mode accounting rule sample.1 s.ledger.truth truth'
      tapes sample.2 hseed hf hc'

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_jointTr.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_jointTruth_seedEvent_law (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hlate : C.reporting = .late) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed] (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hm : MeasurableRule rule)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (anchor : Seed) (truth truth' : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule anchor truth tapes n s) (hf : ReportFree s.history)
    (B : Set Seed) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    let event := {sample : Seed × input.World | sample.1 ∈ B ∧ input.truthAt sample.2 = truth' ∧
      Prefix input C mode accounting rule sample.1 truth' (worldTapes input sample.2) n (retargetTruth s truth')}
    MeasurableSet event ∧
      input.seededWorldLaw ν event =
        ν (B ∩ prefixSeedGate input C mode accounting rule tapes n s) *
          ∏ i, (input.experiment i).priorMass (truth' i) * ENNReal.ofReal
            ((input.experiment i).wordProbability (truth' i)
              (historyObservationWord input s.history i
                (prefix_historyObservation_alphabet input C mode accounting rule anchor truth tapes hp i))) := by
  have hvalid := prefix_historyObservation_alphabet input C mode accounting rule anchor truth tapes hp
  dsimp only
  rw [prefix_jointTruth_seedEvent_eq_rectangle input C hlate mode accounting rule anchor truth truth' tapes hp hf hvalid B]
  constructor
  · exact (hB.inter (measurableSet_prefixSeedGate input C mode accounting rule hm hlegal tapes n s
      (prefix_clock input C mode accounting rule anchor truth tapes hp))).prod
      (measurableSet_worldWordCylinder input truth' _)
  · rw [StatisticalInput.seededWorldLaw, Measure.prod_prod, worldLaw_worldWordCylinder]

end PaperProofs.Common.Native

theorem late_write_history_takeWhile (C : Contract I) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (s : State I) (i : I.Stage) (bit : Bool) (hf : ReportFree s.history) :
    (record accounting s (.write i bit) (writeResponses C s i bit)
      (reportedWriteLedger C s i bit) s.cursor false).history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport =
      s.history ++ [.wrote i bit s.clock] := by
  change (s.history ++ writeResponses C s i bit).takeWhile beforeTruthReport = _

theorem prefix_replay_late_write_cut (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hlate : C.reporting = .late) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule)
    (seed : Seed) (truth truth' : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes tapes' : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s next : State I} (i : I.Stage) (bit : Bool)
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes n s) (hf : ReportFree s.history)
    (ha : rule seed s.history = .write i bit)
    (hs : Step input C mode accounting tapes s (.write i bit) next)
    (hcyl : tapes' ∈ publicWordCylinder input s.history) :
    ∃ next', Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth' tapes' (n + 1) next' ∧
      Step input C mode accounting tapes' (retargetTruth s truth') (.write i bit) next' ∧
      next'.history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport = next.history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport := by
  have hp' := prefix_replay_of_publicWordCylinder input C hlate mode accounting rule seed
    truth truth' tapes tapes' hp hf hcyl
  have hactive : (retargetTruth s truth').halted = false := by
    change s.halted = false
    exact step_source_active input C mode accounting tapes hs
  obtain ⟨next', hs'⟩ := hlegal seed truth' tapes' n (retargetTruth s truth') hp' hactive
  have ha' : rule seed (retargetTruth s truth').history = .write i bit := ha
  rw [ha'] at hs'
  refine ⟨next', .next hp' (ha'.symm ▸ hs'), hs', ?_⟩
  cases hs
  cases hs'
  rw [late_write_history_takeWhile C hlate accounting s i bit hf,
    late_write_history_takeWhile C hlate accounting (retargetTruth s truth') i bit hf]
  rfl

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_replay_.signature_start: theorem prefix_replay_public_cut (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_replay_.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_replay_public_cut (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hlate : C.reporting = .late) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hlegal : LegalRule input C mode accounting rule)
    (seed : Seed) (truth truth' : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes tapes' : ReviewTapes input)
    {n : ℕ} {s : State I} (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes n s)
    (htape : ∀ i k, k < (historyObservations (s.history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport) i).length →
      tapes' i k = tapes i k) :
    ∃ k ≤ n, ∃ s', Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth' tapes' k s' ∧
      s'.history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport = s.history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport ∧
      (ReportFree s.history → s' = retargetTruth s truth') ∧
      (¬ ReportFree s.history → ¬ ReportFree s'.history) := by
  revert htape
  induction hp with
  | initial =>
    intro htape
    exact ⟨0, le_rfl, initial truth', .initial, rfl, fun _ => rfl,
      fun hn => False.elim (hn (by intro event he; cases he))⟩
  | @next n s next earlier step ih =>
    intro htape
    by_cases hnext : ReportFree next.history
    · have htape' : ∀ i k, k < (historyObservations next.history i).length → tapes' i k = tapes i k := by
        simpa only [List.takeWhile_eq_self_iff.mpr hnext] using htape
      have hp' := prefix_retarget_reportFree input C hlate mode accounting rule seed truth truth'
        tapes tapes' (.next earlier step) hnext htape'
      exact ⟨n + 1, le_rfl, retargetTruth next truth', hp', rfl, fun _ => rfl,
        fun hn => False.elim (hn hnext)⟩
    · by_cases hbefore : ReportFree s.history
      · obtain ⟨i, bit, ha⟩ := (step_reportFree_or_write input C hlate mode accounting rule seed
          truth tapes earlier hbefore step).resolve_left hnext
        have hs : Step input C mode accounting tapes s (.write i bit) next := ha ▸ step
        have hcut : next.history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport = s.history ++ [.wrote i bit s.clock] := by
          cases hs
          exact late_write_history_takeWhile C hlate accounting s i bit hbefore
        have hobs (j : I.Stage) : historyObservations (next.history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport) j =
            historyObservations s.history j := by
          rw [hcut]
          simp [historyObservations, eventObservation]
        have hcyl : tapes' ∈ publicWordCylinder input s.history := by
          intro j k hk
          have hletter := htape j k (by rw [hobs]; exact hk)
          rw [hletter]
          exact prefix_mem_publicWordCylinder input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes earlier j k hk
        obtain ⟨next', hp', hs', hcut'⟩ := prefix_replay_late_write_cut input C hlate mode accounting
          rule hlegal seed truth truth' tapes tapes' i bit earlier hbefore ha hs hcyl
        have hnot : ¬ ReportFree next'.history := by
          cases hs
          cases hs'
          intro hf'
          apply hnext
          apply (late_write_reportFree_iff C hlate accounting s i bit hbefore).mpr
          exact reportFree_write_not_allWritten C hlate accounting (retargetTruth s truth') i bit hf'
        exact ⟨n + 1, le_rfl, next', hp', hcut', fun hf => False.elim (hnext hf), fun _ => hnot⟩
      · have hcut := step_cut_eq_of_not_reportFree input C mode accounting tapes step hbefore
        rw [hcut] at htape
        obtain ⟨k, hkn, s', hp', hcut', _, hn⟩ := ih htape
        exact ⟨k, hkn.trans (Nat.le_succ n), s', hp', hcut'.trans hcut.symm,
          fun hf => False.elim (hnext hf), fun _ => hn hbefore⟩

PaperProofs.Common.Native.preReportPubli.full_declaration_source:
theorem preReportPublicHistory_replay {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hlate : C.reporting = .late) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .native accounting rule) (sample : Seed × input.World)
    (truth' : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes' : ReviewTapes input)
    (htape : ∀ i k, k < (historyObservations (preReportPublicHistory input C accounting rule sample) i).length →
      tapes' i k = worldTapes input sample.2 i k) :
    preReportPublicHistory input C accounting rule (sample.1, replayWorld input truth' tapes') =
      preReportPublicHistory input C accounting rule sample := by
  let horizon := nativeActionBound C + 1
  obtain ⟨m, hmh, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix input C .native accounting rule hlegal sample horizon
  obtain ⟨k, hkm, s', hp', hc, hf, hn⟩ := prefix_replay_public_cut input C hlate .native accounting
    rule hlegal sample.1 (input.truthAt sample.2) truth' (worldTapes input sample.2) tapes' hp htape
  have heq := prefix_eq_run input C .native accounting rule sample.1 truth' tapes' hp'
  obtain ⟨extra, hextra⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (hkm.trans hmh)
  by_cases hreport : ReportFree (run input C .native accounting rule sample horizon).history
  · have hhalt : s'.halted = true := by
      rw [hf hreport]
      exact run_halted_nativeActionBound_succ input C accounting rule hlegal sample
    have hh : (run input C .native accounting rule (sample.1, replayWorld input truth' tapes') k).halted = true := by
      rw [heq]
      exact hhalt
    have hafter := run_after_halt input C .native accounting rule (sample.1, replayWorld input truth' tapes') k hh extra
    change (run input C .native accounting rule (sample.1, replayWorld input truth' tapes') horizon).history.takeWhile
      beforeTruthReport = _
    rw [hextra, hafter, heq]
    exact hc
  · have hnot : ¬ ReportFree (run input C .native accounting rule (sample.1, replayWorld input truth' tapes') k).history := by
      rw [heq]
      exact hn hreport
    have hafter := run_cut_after_report input C .native accounting rule hlegal
      (sample.1, replayWorld input truth' tapes') k hnot extra
    change (run input C .native accounting rule (sample.1, replayWorld input truth' tapes') horizon).history.takeWhile
      beforeTruthReport = _
    rw [hextra]
    exact hafter.1.trans (by rw [heq]; exact hc)

PaperProofs.Common.Native.preReportPubli.full_declaration_source:
theorem preReportPublicHistory_eq_iff_gate_and_cylinder {Seed : Type*}
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .native accounting rule) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (htapes : tapes ∈ publicWordCylinder input history) (sample : Seed × input.World) :
    preReportPublicHistory input C accounting rule sample = history ↔
      sample.1 ∈ preReportSeedGate input C accounting rule truth tapes history ∧
        worldTapes input sample.2 ∈ publicWordCylinder input history := by
  constructor
  · intro hh
    have hc := preReportPublicHistory_mem_publicWordCylinder input C accounting rule hlegal sample
    rw [hh] at hc
    have ht : ∀ i k, k < (historyObservations (preReportPublicHistory input C accounting rule sample) i).length →
        tapes i k = worldTapes input sample.2 i k := by
      intro i k hk
      rw [hh] at hk
      exact Fin.ext ((htapes i k hk).trans (hc i k hk).symm)
    exact ⟨(preReportPublicHistory_replay input C hlate accounting rule hlegal sample truth tapes ht).trans hh, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨hgate, hc⟩
    have hgate' : preReportPublicHistory input C accounting rule (sample.1, replayWorld input truth tapes) = history := hgate
    have ht : ∀ i k, k < (historyObservations
        (preReportPublicHistory input C accounting rule (sample.1, replayWorld input truth tapes)) i).length →
        worldTapes input sample.2 i k = worldTapes input (replayWorld input truth tapes) i k := by
      intro i k hk
      rw [hgate'] at hk
      exact Fin.ext ((hc i k hk).trans (htapes i k hk).symm)
    have hrep := preReportPublicHistory_replay input C hlate accounting rule hlegal
      (sample.1, replayWorld input truth tapes) (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) ht
    have heta : replayWorld input (input.truthAt sample.2) (worldTapes input sample.2) = sample.2 := rfl
    rw [heta] at hrep
    exact hrep.trans hgate'

theorem preReport_jointTruth_seedEvent_law {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hm : MeasurableRule rule)
    (hlegal : LegalRule input C .native accounting rule) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (truth truth' : I.Stage → Bool) (tapes : ReviewTapes input) (history : List (VisibleEvent I))
    (htapes : tapes ∈ publicWordCylinder input history)
    (hvalid : ∀ i symbol, symbol ∈ historyObservations history i → symbol < (input.experiment i).alphabetSize)
    (B : Set Seed) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    let event := {sample : Seed × input.World | sample.1 ∈ B ∧ input.truthAt sample.2 = truth' ∧
      preReportPublicHistory input C accounting rule sample = history}
    MeasurableSet event ∧ input.seededWorldLaw ν event =
      ν (B ∩ preReportSeedGate input C accounting rule truth tapes history) *
        ∏ i, (input.experiment i).priorMass (truth' i) *
          ENNReal.ofReal ((input.experiment i).wordProbability (truth' i)
            (historyObservationWord input history i (hvalid i))) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [preReport_jointTruth_seedEvent_eq_rectangle input C hlate accounting rule hlegal truth truth' tapes history htapes hvalid B]
  constructor
  · exact (hB.inter (measurableSet_preReportSeedGate input C accounting rule hm truth tapes history)).prod
      (measurableSet_worldWordCylinder input truth' _)
  · rw [StatisticalInput.seededWorldLaw, Measure.prod_prod, worldLaw_worldWordCylinder]

PaperProofs.Common.Native.prefix_preRepo.full_declaration_source:
theorem prefix_preReport_historyWritten (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (hlate : C.reporting = .late) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    {Seed : Type*} (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (seed : Seed) (truth : I.Stage → Bool)
    (tapes : ReviewTapes input) {n : ℕ} {s : State I}
    (hp : Prefix input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes n s) (i : I.Stage) :
    historyWritten (s.history.takeWhile beforeTruthReport) i = s.ledger.written i := by
  induction hp with
  | initial => rfl
  | @next n s next hp hs ih =>
    by_cases hnext : ReportFree next.history
    · rw [List.takeWhile_eq_self_iff.mpr hnext]
      exact prefix_historyWritten input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes (.next hp hs) i
    · by_cases hsource : ReportFree s.history
      · obtain hf | ⟨j, bit, ha⟩ :=
          step_reportFree_or_write input C hlate mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp hsource hs
        · exact False.elim (hnext hf)
        · have hpnext := Prefix.next hp hs
          generalize haction : rule seed s.history = action at hs ha
          cases hs with
          | write k b =>
            cases ha
            rw [late_write_history_takeWhile C hlate accounting s j bit hsource]
            have hfull := prefix_historyWritten input C mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hpnext i
            change historyWritten (s.history ++ writeResponses C s j bit) i = _ at hfull
            have hparse : historyWritten (s.history ++ [.wrote j bit s.clock]) i =
                historyWritten (s.history ++ writeResponses C s j bit) i := by
              unfold historyWritten
              rw [historyWrite_append_writeResponses]
              simp only [historyWrite, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons,
                List.filterMap_nil, eventWrite]
              by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hji]
            exact hparse.trans hfull
          | review | allocate | execute | advance | stop | abandon => cases ha
      · rw [step_cut_eq_of_not_reportFree input C mode accounting tapes hs hsource, ih,
          step_written_eq_of_allWritten input C mode accounting tapes hs
            (prefix_allWritten_of_not_reportFree input C hlate mode accounting rule seed truth tapes hp hsource)]

PaperProofs.Star.Parameters.preReport_ba.full_declaration_source:
theorem preReport_badTruth_event_integral (P : Star.Parameters) (order : Order)
    (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order))
    (rule : PolicyRule (starInstance P.tools order) Seed) (hm : MeasurableRule rule)
    (hlegal : LegalRule (P.input order) C .native accounting rule)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (B : Set (Seed × List (VisibleEvent (starInstance P.tools order)))) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    (P.input order).seededWorldLaw ν
      {sample | preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule sample ∈ B ∧
        (P.input order).truthAt sample.2 =
          P.cutBadTruth order (preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule sample).2} =
      ∫⁻ record, B.indicator
        (fun record => P.cutPosterior order record.2 (P.cutBadTruth order record.2)) record
        ∂preReportLaw (P.input order) C accounting rule ν := by
  classical
  let fibres (truth : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage → Bool) :=
    B ∩ {record | P.cutBadTruth order record.2 = truth}
  let events (truth : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage → Bool) :=
    {sample | preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule sample ∈ fibres truth ∧
      (P.input order).truthAt sample.2 = truth}
  have hselect : Measurable (fun record : Seed × List (VisibleEvent (starInstance P.tools order)) =>
      P.cutBadTruth order record.2) := (measurable_of_countable (P.cutBadTruth order)).comp measurable_snd
  have hfibres (truth : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage → Bool) : MeasurableSet (fibres truth) :=
    hB.inter (hselect (measurableSet_singleton truth))
  have hrecord := measurable_preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule hm
  have htruth : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × (P.input order).World => (P.input order).truthAt sample.2) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i => ((P.input order).measurable_truthAt i).comp measurable_snd
  have hevents (truth : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage → Bool) : MeasurableSet (events truth) :=
    ((hfibres truth).preimage hrecord).inter (htruth (measurableSet_singleton truth))
  have hdisjf : Pairwise (fun truth truth' => Disjoint (fibres truth) (fibres truth')) := by
    intro truth truth' hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro record hr hr'
    exact hne (hr.2.symm.trans hr'.2)
  have hdisje : Pairwise (fun truth truth' => Disjoint (events truth) (events truth')) := by
    intro truth truth' hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro sample hs hs'
    exact hne (hs.2.symm.trans hs'.2)
  have hfibres_union : B = ⋃ truth, fibres truth := by
    ext record
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, fibres, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · intro hr
      exact ⟨P.cutBadTruth order record.2, hr, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, hr, _⟩
      exact hr
  have hevents_union :
      {sample | preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule sample ∈ B ∧
        (P.input order).truthAt sample.2 =
          P.cutBadTruth order (preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule sample).2} =
        ⋃ truth, events truth := by
    ext sample
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, events, fibres, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hB, heq⟩
      exact ⟨_, ⟨hB, rfl⟩, heq⟩
    · rintro ⟨truth, ⟨hB, hselector⟩, heq⟩
      exact ⟨hB, heq.trans hselector.symm⟩
  rw [hevents_union, measure_iUnion hdisje hevents, lintegral_indicator hB,
    hfibres_union, lintegral_iUnion hfibres hdisjf]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro truth
  rw [P.preReport_truth_event_integral order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal ν
    (fibres truth) (hfibres truth) truth, lintegral_indicator (hfibres truth)]
  apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (hfibres truth)
  intro record hr
  change P.cutPosterior order record.2 truth = P.cutPosterior order record.2 (P.cutBadTruth order record.2)
  rw [hr.2]

theorem preReport_failure_lower (P : Star.Parameters) (order : Order)
    (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order))
    (rule : PolicyRule (starInstance P.tools order) Seed) (hm : MeasurableRule rule)
    (hlegal : LegalRule (P.input order) C .native accounting rule)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (B : Set (Seed × List (VisibleEvent (starInstance P.tools order)))) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    (∫⁻ record, B.indicator
      (fun record => ∏ i, ENNReal.ofReal (P.preReportMAPError order record.2 i)) record
      ∂preReportLaw (P.input order) C accounting rule ν) ≤
    (P.input order).seededWorldLaw ν
      {sample | preReportRecord (P.input order) C accounting rule sample ∈ B ∧
        ¬ runSuccess (P.input order) C .native accounting rule sample} := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ record, B.indicator
        (fun record => P.cutPosterior order record.2 (P.cutBadTruth order record.2)) record
        ∂preReportLaw (P.input order) C accounting rule ν := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro record
      by_cases hr : record ∈ B
      · simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr] using P.cutPosterior_badTruth_lower order record.2
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, le_refl]
    _ = _ := (P.preReport_badTruth_event_integral order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal ν B hB).symm
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply measure_mono
      intro sample hs
      exact ⟨hs.1, P.cutBadTruth_forces_failure order C hlate accounting rule hlegal sample hs.2⟩

theorem runObservationBill_of_halted (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)

    (sample : Seed × input.World) (n : ℕ) (hhalt : (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).halted = true) :

      (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).ledger.observationBill input.fees := by
  apply le_antisymm

PaperProofs.Common.StatisticalInput.seed.signature_start: theorem seededWorldLaw_external_current (input : StatisticalInput I) (i : I.Stage) (ν : Measure Seed)
PaperProofs.Common.StatisticalInput.seed.full_declaration_source:
theorem seededWorldLaw_external_current (input : StatisticalInput I) (i : I.Stage) (ν : Measure Seed)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] :
    (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map (fun sample => (input.externalStageView i sample, sample.2 i)) =
      (input.externalStageLaw i ν).prod (input.stageLaw i) := by
  have hp := input.measurable_otherStagesView i
  have hn : Measurable (fun world : input.World => world i) := measurable_pi_apply i
  have hworld : input.worldLaw.map (fun world => (input.otherStagesView i world, world i)) =
      (input.worldLaw.map (input.otherStagesView i)).prod (input.stageLaw i) := by
    rw [(input.otherStagesView_independent_current i).map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
      hp.aemeasurable hn.aemeasurable, input.worldLaw_coordinate]
  have hseeded : (input.seededWorldLaw ν).map
      (fun sample => (sample.1, (input.otherStagesView i sample.2, sample.2 i))) =
      ν.prod ((input.worldLaw.map (input.otherStagesView i)).prod (input.stageLaw i)) := by
    calc
      _ = ν.prod (input.worldLaw.map (fun world => (input.otherStagesView i world, world i))) := by
        have hmap : Prod.map (id : Seed → Seed)
            (fun world : input.World => (input.otherStagesView i world, world i)) =
            (fun sample : Seed × input.World => (sample.1, (input.otherStagesView i sample.2, sample.2 i))) := rfl
        unfold seededWorldLaw
        rw [← hmap]
        simpa only [Measure.map_id] using
          (Measure.map_prod_map ν input.worldLaw measurable_id (hp.prodMk hn)).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hworld]
  rw [input.seededWorldLaw_externalStageView]
  apply (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc :
    (Seed × input.OtherStages i) × input.StageSample i ≃ᵐ
      Seed × input.OtherStages i × input.StageSample i).map_measurableEquiv_injective
  have hpair : Measurable (fun sample : Seed × input.World => (input.externalStageView i sample, sample.2 i)) :=
    (input.measurable_externalStageView i).prodMk (hn.comp measurable_snd)
  rw [Measure.map_map MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.measurable hpair, Measure.prodAssoc_prod]
  exact hseeded

theorem nativeStageTest_finiteET (P : Star.Parameters) (order : Order)
    (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order))
    (rule : PolicyRule (starInstance P.tools order) Seed) (hm : MeasurableRule rule)
    (hlegal : LegalRule (P.input order) C .native accounting rule)
    (i : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage) (ν : Measure (Seed × P.OtherWorld order i))
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (x : Bool) :
    P.channel.experiment.expectedSamples ν (P.nativeStageTest order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal i) x ≠ ⊤ := by
  have hbound : P.channel.experiment.expectedSamples ν (P.nativeStageTest order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal i) x ≤
      (C.reviewQuota i : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    unfold BinaryExperiment.expectedSamples
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ _sample, (C.reviewQuota i : ℝ≥0∞) ∂(P.channel.experiment.conditionalLaw ν x) := by
        apply lintegral_mono
        intro sample
        have hstop := P.nativeStageTest_stop_le order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal i sample.1 sample.2
        have hfinite : (P.nativeStageTest order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal i).rule.stop sample.1 sample.2 ≠ ⊤ :=
          ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.natCast_ne_top _) hstop
        simp only [BinaryExperiment.sampleCountENNReal, hfinite, ↓reduceIte]
        exact_mod_cast ENat.toNat_le_toNat hstop (ENat.natCast_ne_top _)
      _ = _ := by simp
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) hbound

PaperProofs.Star.Parameters.nativeStage_.full_declaration_source:
theorem nativeStage_information (P : Star.Parameters) (order : Order)
    (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hlate : C.reporting = .late)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order))
    (rule : PolicyRule (starInstance P.tools order) Seed) (hm : MeasurableRule rule)
    (hlegal : LegalRule (P.input order) C .native accounting rule)
    (i : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] :
    (∫⁻ sample, P.channel.experiment.observationCharge
      ((historyObservations (preReportPublicHistory (P.input order) C accounting rule sample) i).length : ℕ∞)
      ∂(P.input order).seededWorldLaw ν) =
        ENNReal.ofReal P.channel.a * ∫⁻ sample, BinarySymmetric.phi
          (P.preReportMAPError order (preReportPublicHistory (P.input order) C accounting rule sample) i)
          ∂(P.input order).seededWorldLaw ν := by
  let test := P.nativeStageTest order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal i
  let outerLaw := (P.input order).externalStageLaw i ν
  have hobs : (∫⁻ sample, P.channel.experiment.observationCharge
      ((historyObservations (preReportPublicHistory (P.input order) C accounting rule sample) i).length : ℕ∞)
      ∂(P.input order).seededWorldLaw ν) = P.channel.experiment.bayesObservationCharge outerLaw test := by
    rw [P.lintegral_world_stage order i ν _ (P.measurable_nativeStageCharge order C accounting rule hm i)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    congr 1
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro sample
    rw [← P.nativeStageTest_stop_eq_cut order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal i sample.1 x sample.2]
  have hinfo : (∫⁻ sample, BinarySymmetric.phi
      (P.preReportMAPError order (preReportPublicHistory (P.input order) C accounting rule sample) i)
      ∂(P.input order).seededWorldLaw ν) = P.channel.expectedPosteriorInformation outerLaw test := by
    rw [P.lintegral_world_stage order i ν _ (P.measurable_nativeStageInformation order C accounting rule hm i)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    congr 1
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro sample
    exact (P.nativeStageTest_information_eq_cut order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal i sample.1 x sample.2).symm
  rw [hobs, hinfo]
  exact P.channel.bayesObservationCharge_eq_posteriorInformation outerLaw test
    (fun x => P.nativeStageTest_finiteET order C hlate accounting rule hm hlegal i outerLaw x)

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.p.signature_start: theorem phi_sum_support {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ)
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.p.full_declaration_source:
theorem phi_sum_support {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hhalf : ∀ i, p i ≤ 1 / 2) (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log delta⁻¹ + 1 - 2 * Fintype.card ι) ≤
      (∑ i, phi (p i)) + ENNReal.ofReal delta⁻¹ * ∏ i, ENNReal.ofReal (p i) := by
  classical
  have hprod : 0 < ∏ i, p i := Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => hp i)
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => log_inv_sub_two_le_phiReal (hp i) (hhalf i))
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  have hlogs : Real.log (∏ i, p i)⁻¹ = ∑ i, Real.log (1 / p i) := by
    rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_prod (fun i _ => (hp i).ne')]
    simp only [one_div, Real.log_inv, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hsupport := log_inv_support (∏ i, p i) delta hprod hdelta
  rw [hlogs] at hsupport
  have hscalar : Real.log delta⁻¹ + 1 - 2 * Fintype.card ι ≤
      (∑ i, phiReal (p i)) + (∏ i, p i) / delta := by linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ i, phiReal (p i)) + (∏ i, p i) / delta) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hscalar
    _ = _ := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add
        (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => phiReal_nonneg (hp i) (hhalf i)))
        (div_nonneg hprod.le hdelta.le),
        ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => phiReal_nonneg (hp i) (hhalf i))]
      simp_rw [phi_of_pos (hp _)]
      congr 1
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hprod.le,
        ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun i _ => (hp i).le), mul_comm]

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.p.name: PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.phi_sum_lintegral_lower
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.p.signature_start: theorem phi_sum_lintegral_lower {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.p.full_declaration_source:
theorem phi_sum_lintegral_lower {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ ω i, 0 < p i ω) (hhalf : ∀ ω i, p i ω ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hmeas : Measurable (fun ω => ∏ i, ENNReal.ofReal (p i ω)))
    (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hproduct : (∫⁻ ω, ∏ i, ENNReal.ofReal (p i ω) ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log delta⁻¹ - 2 * Fintype.card ι) ≤ ∫⁻ ω, ∑ i, phi (p i ω) ∂μ := by
  classical
  let information := fun ω => ∑ i, phi (p i ω)
  let scaledProduct := fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal delta⁻¹ * ∏ i, ENNReal.ofReal (p i ω)
  have hscaledMeas : Measurable scaledProduct := measurable_const.mul hmeas
  have hscaled : (∫⁻ ω, scaledProduct ω ∂μ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [show scaledProduct = (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal delta⁻¹ * ∏ i, ENNReal.ofReal (p i ω)) from rfl,
      lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal delta := mul_le_mul_right hproduct _
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hdelta.le), inv_mul_cancel₀ hdelta.ne', ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  have hpoint : ∀ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log delta⁻¹ + 1 - 2 * Fintype.card ι) ≤
      information ω + scaledProduct ω := fun ω => phi_sum_support (fun i => p i ω) (hp ω) (hhalf ω) delta hdelta
  have hintegral : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log delta⁻¹ + 1 - 2 * Fintype.card ι) ≤
      (∫⁻ ω, information ω ∂μ) + 1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ _ω : Ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log delta⁻¹ + 1 - 2 * Fintype.card ι) ∂μ := by simp
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ ω, information ω + scaledProduct ω ∂μ := lintegral_mono hpoint
      _ = (∫⁻ ω, information ω ∂μ) + ∫⁻ ω, scaledProduct ω ∂μ := lintegral_add_right information hscaledMeas
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add_right hscaled _
  by_cases hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log delta⁻¹ - 2 * Fintype.card ι
  · have hrewrite : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log delta⁻¹ + 1 - 2 * Fintype.card ι) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log delta⁻¹ - 2 * Fintype.card ι) + 1 := by
      rw [show Real.log delta⁻¹ + 1 - 2 * Fintype.card ι =
        (Real.log delta⁻¹ - 2 * Fintype.card ι) + 1 from by ring,
        ENNReal.ofReal_add hnonneg (by norm_num), ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    rw [hrewrite] at hintegral
    exact (ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp hintegral
  · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (le_of_not_ge hnonneg)]
    exact zero_le

end PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.P.full_declaration_source:
theorem bscSPRT_expectedObservationCharge_le (P : Parameters) (p : ℚ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hhalf : p ≤ 1 / 2) (x : Bool) :
    P.experiment.expectedObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ()) (P.experiment.posteriorSPRT p) x ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.a * (Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + P.h)) := by
  have ha := bscThreshold_nonneg p hp hhalf
  have hfinite := P.experiment.posteriorSPRT_expectedSamples_finite p ha x
  have hcharge := P.experiment.posteriorSPRT_expectedObservationCharge_finite p ha x
  have hplt : p < 1 := by linarith
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ sample ∂(P.experiment.conditionalLaw (Measure.dirac ()) x),
      P.experiment.wordLogLikelihood x
        (P.experiment.stoppedTranscript (P.experiment.posteriorSPRT p) sample).2 ≤
          Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + P.h := by
    filter_upwards [P.experiment.expectedSamples_finite_stop (Measure.dirac ())
      (P.experiment.posteriorSPRT p) x hfinite] with sample hs
    have hstop : P.experiment.posteriorThresholdStop p sample.2 =
        (P.experiment.posteriorThresholdStop p sample.2).toNat := (ENat.natCast_toNat hs).symm
    have hsbound := P.bscSPRT_score_at_stop_le p hp hhalf sample.2 _ hstop
    have hlog := BinaryExperiment.posteriorThreshold_le_log_inv p hp hplt
    have hscore := P.experiment.stoppedWordScore_transcript p sample
    rw [P.stoppedWordScore_eq_wordLogLikelihood] at hscore
    cases x with
    | false =>
      rw [P.wordLogLikelihood_false_eq_neg_true, hscore]
      exact (neg_le_abs _).trans (by linarith)
    | true =>
      rw [hscore]
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by linarith)
  have hmean : P.kappa *
      (P.experiment.expectedSamples (Measure.dirac ()) (P.experiment.posteriorSPRT p) x).toReal ≤
        Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + P.h := by
    rw [← P.divergence_eq_kappa x, ← P.experiment.integral_stoppedSum_wald (Measure.dirac ())
      (P.experiment.posteriorSPRT p) x hfinite]
    have hmono := integral_mono_ae
      (P.experiment.integrable_wordLogLikelihood_comp_transcript (Measure.dirac ())
        (P.experiment.posteriorSPRT p) x hfinite)
      (integrable_const (Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + P.h)) hbound
    simpa only [integral_const, measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul] using hmono
  have hreal : (P.experiment.expectedObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ())
      (P.experiment.posteriorSPRT p) x).toReal ≤ P.a * (Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + P.h) := by
    rw [P.experiment.expectedObservationCharge_eq, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal P.experiment.observationFee_real_pos.le]
    calc
      _ ≤ (P.reviewFee : ℝ) * ((Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + P.h) / P.kappa) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((le_div_iff₀ P.kappa_pos).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hmean))
          (by exact_mod_cast P.reviewFee_pos.le)
      _ = _ := by unfold a; ring
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hcharge]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal

theorem countEnvelopeAsymptotics (P : Parameters) : P.CountEnvelopeAsymptotics := by
  constructor

    have hweighted' : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,

  · intro k _hk epsilon he

RootStarCostSum.count_cost_sum.name: RootStarCostSum.count_cost_sum
RootStarCostSum.count_cost_sum.signature_start: theorem count_cost_sum (P : Parameters) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hq : r ≤ 1/4) :
RootStarCostSum.count_cost_sum.full_declaration_source:
theorem count_cost_sum (P : Parameters) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hq : r ≤ 1/4) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (P.tools+1),
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range j, ENNReal.ofReal (countTargetReal (P.countBudgetReal r i) (P.tools-i))) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (P.channel.a * (Real.log (1 / countTargetReal (P.countBudgetReal r j) (P.tools-j)) + P.channel.h))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.countObservationEnvelope P.tools r) := by
  have invariant : ∀ n, n ≤ P.tools+1 →
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range j, ENNReal.ofReal (target P r i)) * ENNReal.ofReal (price P r j)) +
        (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ENNReal.ofReal (target P r i)) * tail P r n = tail P r 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      have before : n ≤ P.tools+1 := by omega
      have step := tail_step P r hr hq n (by omega)
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.prod_range_succ]
      calc
        _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range j, ENNReal.ofReal (target P r i)) * ENNReal.ofReal (price P r j)) +
            (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ENNReal.ofReal (target P r i)) *
              (ENNReal.ofReal (price P r n) + ENNReal.ofReal (target P r n) * tail P r (n+1)) := by
          rw [mul_add]; ac_rfl
        _ = tail P r 0 := by rw [← step]; exact ih before
  have final := invariant (P.tools+1) le_rfl
  simpa only [tail, Nat.add_one_le_iff, lt_self_iff_false, ite_false, mul_zero, add_zero,
    Nat.zero_le, ite_true, Nat.sub_zero, countBudgetReal, target, price] using final

end RootStarCostSum

def ConditionalOverflow (P : Star.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (order : Order) (kind : PortKind) (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)), kind.contracts C →
    ∀ (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (delta : ℝ) (exponent : ℕ),
      0 < delta → delta ≤ 1 / 2 → IsMinimalDyadicExponent (20 * (P.tools + 1 : ℕ)) delta exponent →
      ∀ (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
        letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
        ∀ (ν : Measure Seed) (hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν),
          letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
          ∀ (stage : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage) (x : Bool)
            (B : Set (Seed × List (VisibleEvent (starInstance P.tools order)))), MeasurableSet B →
            (P.input order).seededWorldLaw ν
              (P.entryOverflowEvent order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent) C accounting stage x B) ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * (P.tools + 1 : ℕ))) *
                (P.input order).seededWorldLaw ν (P.entryTestEvent order kind (delta / 2) C accounting stage x B)

def StarOverflowAssembly (P : Star.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (order : Order) (kind : PortKind) (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)), kind.contracts C →
    ∀ (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (delta : ℝ) (exponent : ℕ),
      0 < delta → delta ≤ 1 / 2 → IsMinimalDyadicExponent (20 * (P.tools + 1 : ℕ)) delta exponent →
      ReviewQuotaCertificate (P.input order) C accounting
        (P.starReferenceRule order kind (delta / 2) (some (P.commonQuota exponent)) (Seed := Unit))
        (fun _ => P.commonQuota exponent) ∧
      P.ReferenceAllPathCharges order kind (delta / 2) (some (P.commonQuota exponent)) C accounting ∧
      (P.input order).seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        (P.anyStarOverflow order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent) C accounting) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (delta / 2) ∧
      risk (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting
        (P.starReferenceRule order kind (delta / 2) (some (P.commonQuota exponent)) (Seed := Unit)) (Measure.dirac ()) ≤
          risk (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting
            (P.starReferenceRule order kind (delta / 2) none (Seed := Unit)) (Measure.dirac ()) +
              (P.input order).seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
                (P.anyStarOverflow order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent) C accounting)

def SameTapeStarTruncation (P : Star.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (order : Order) (kind : PortKind) (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)), kind.contracts C →
    ∀ (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (r : ℝ) (quota : ℕ), 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 4 →
      ∀ sample : Unit × (P.input order).World,
        let ideal := run (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting (P.starReferenceRule order kind r none) sample
        let bounded := run (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting (P.starReferenceRule order kind r (some quota)) sample
        ((∀ n, bounded n = ideal n) ∨ ∃ cut,
          (∀ n, n ≤ cut → bounded n = ideal n) ∧ (ideal cut).halted = false ∧
          bounded (cut + 1) = stopState (ideal cut) true ∧
          ∀ n, bounded (cut + 1 + n) = stopState (ideal cut) true) ∧
        runActualBill (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting (P.starReferenceRule order kind r (some quota)) sample ≤
          runActualBill (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting (P.starReferenceRule order kind r none) sample

theorem sameTapeStarTruncation (P : Parameters) : P.SameTapeStarTruncation := by
  intro order kind C _hC accounting r quota _hr _hq sample
  have h := run_same_or_first_abandon (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting
    (P.starReferenceRule order kind r (some quota)) (P.starReferenceRule order kind r none)
    (starRule_quota_coupling P order kind r quota) sample
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  apply iSup_le
  intro n
  rcases h with hall | ⟨cut, hprefix, _, _, hafter⟩
  · rw [hall n]
    exact prefixBill_le_runActualBill (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting _ sample n
  · by_cases hn : n ≤ cut
    · rw [hprefix n hn]
      exact prefixBill_le_runActualBill (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting _ sample n
    · have heq : n = cut + 1 + (n - (cut + 1)) := by omega
      rw [heq, hafter, stop_actualBill]
      exact prefixBill_le_runActualBill (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting _ sample cut

end RootStarOverflow

theorem referenceAllPathCharges (P : Parameters) (order : Order) (kind : PortKind)
    (r : ℝ) (limit : Option ℕ) (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hC : kind.contracts C)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) :
    P.ReferenceAllPathCharges order kind r limit C accounting := by
  have hlegal := star_legal_uncapped (Seed := Unit) P order kind r limit C hC accounting
  have hmin : min (starInstance P.tools order).stageCount (starInstance P.tools order).toolCount = P.tools := by
    rw [stageCount_eq]
    change min (P.tools + 1) P.tools = P.tools
    omega
  have hmax : (P.input order).fees.maxCorrection ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (P.correctionFee : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro pair _
    exact le_rfl
  intro sample
  constructor
  · intro n
    simpa only [hmin] using run_actualCorrections_le (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting _ hlegal sample n
  · have hbill := runActualBill_le_observation_add (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting _ hlegal sample
    rw [hmin] at hbill
    exact hbill.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax zero_le))

end RootStarOverflow

RootStarOverflow.anyStarOverflow_le.name: RootStarOverflow.anyStarOverflow_le
RootStarOverflow.anyStarOverflow_le.full_declaration_source:
theorem anyStarOverflow_le (P : Parameters) (order : Order) (kind : PortKind)
    (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)) (hC : kind.contracts C)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (delta : ℝ) (exponent : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 < delta) (hq : delta ≤ 1 / 2)
    (he : PaperProofs.Statistics.IsMinimalDyadicExponent (20 * (P.tools + 1 : ℕ)) delta exponent) :
    (P.input order).seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
      (P.anyStarOverflow order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent) C accounting) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (delta / 2) := by
  let law := (P.input order).seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
  let cap := ENNReal.ofReal (delta / (2 * (P.tools + 1 : ℕ)))
  have hcard : (Finset.univ : Finset (starInstance P.tools order).Stage).card = P.tools + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ]
    rw [Fintype.card_fin]
    simp only [starInstance, List.length_ofFn]
  have hstage (stage : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage) :
      law (⋃ truth : Bool, P.entryOverflowEvent order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent)
        C accounting stage truth (Set.univ : Set (Unit × _))) ≤ cap := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ truth : Bool, law (P.entryOverflowEvent order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent)
          C accounting stage truth (Set.univ : Set (Unit × _))) := measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ truth : Bool, cap * law (P.entryTestEvent order kind (delta / 2) C accounting stage truth Set.univ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro truth _
        exact conditionalOverflow P order kind C hC accounting delta exponent hd hq he
          Unit inferInstance (Measure.dirac ()) inferInstance stage truth Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
      _ = cap * ∑ truth : Bool, law (P.entryTestEvent order kind (delta / 2) C accounting stage truth Set.univ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ cap * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (entry_truth_probability_sum P order kind (delta / 2) C accounting stage) zero_le
      _ = cap := mul_one _
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ stage : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage,
        law (⋃ truth : Bool, P.entryOverflowEvent order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent)
          C accounting stage truth (Set.univ : Set (Unit × _))) := measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _stage : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage, cap := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun stage _ => hstage stage)
    _ = (P.tools + 1 : ℕ) * cap := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [cap]
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (P.tools + 1 : ℕ))]
      congr 1
      have hn : (P.tools + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      push_cast
      field_simp

end RootStarOverflow

RootStarOverflow.nativeStarImplementatio.name: RootStarOverflow.nativeStarImplementation_of_risk
RootStarOverflow.nativeStarImplementatio.full_declaration_source:
theorem nativeStarImplementation_of_risk (P : Parameters) (hoverflow : P.StarOverflowAssembly)
    (hrisk : ∀ (order : Order) (kind : PortKind) (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)), kind.contracts C →
      ∀ (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 4 →
        risk (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting (P.starReferenceRule order kind r none (Seed := Unit))
          (Measure.dirac ()) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) : P.NativeStarImplementation := by
  intro order kind C hC accounting delta exponent hd hq qualification
  let rule := P.starReferenceRule order kind (delta / 2) (some (P.commonQuota exponent)) (Seed := Unit)
  let bounded : Policy (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting Unit :=
    ⟨rule, P.measurable_starReferenceRule order kind (delta / 2) (some (P.commonQuota exponent)),
      star_legal_uncapped P order kind (delta / 2) (some (P.commonQuota exponent)) C hC accounting⟩
  let quota := fun _stage : (starInstance P.tools order).Stage => P.commonQuota exponent
  have hreviews : ReviewQuotaCertificate (P.input order) C accounting bounded.rule quota :=
    reviewQuotaCertificate P order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent) C hC accounting
  have hnormal : NormalCallCertificate (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting bounded C.normalCallBound :=
    qualification.normal_calls
  have hcard : (Finset.univ : Finset (starInstance P.tools order).Stage).card = P.tools + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    simp only [starInstance, List.length_ofFn]
  have hmin : min (starInstance P.tools order).stageCount (starInstance P.tools order).toolCount = P.tools := by
    rw [stageCount_eq]
    change min (P.tools + 1) P.tools = P.tools
    omega
  have htotal : C.normalCallBound + ∑ stage, quota stage +
      min (starInstance P.tools order).stageCount (starInstance P.tools order).toolCount ≤ C.totalCallCap := by
    simpa [quota, hcard, nsmul_eq_mul, hmin] using qualification.total_calls
  let native := bounded.enforceCaps (P.input order) C accounting quota hreviews hnormal qualification.stage_quota htotal
  refine ⟨native, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [enforceCaps_risk_eq]
    have hassembly := hoverflow order kind C hC accounting delta exponent hd hq qualification.minimal_exponent
    have hideal := hrisk order kind C hC accounting (delta / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    calc
      _ ≤ risk (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting
          (P.starReferenceRule order kind (delta / 2) none (Seed := Unit)) (Measure.dirac ()) +
            (P.input order).seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
              (P.anyStarOverflow order kind (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent) C accounting) := hassembly.2.2.2
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (delta / 2) + ENNReal.ofReal (delta / 2) := add_le_add hideal hassembly.2.2.1
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal delta := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by linarith : 0 ≤ delta / 2) (by linarith : 0 ≤ delta / 2)]
        congr 1
        ring
  · rw [enforceCaps_expectedBill_eq]
    apply lintegral_mono
    intro sample
    exact (sameTapeStarTruncation P order kind C hC accounting (delta / 2) (P.commonQuota exponent)
      (by linarith) (by linarith) sample).2

end RootStarOverflow

RootStarOverflow.starOverflowAssembly.full_declaration_source:
theorem starOverflowAssembly (P : Parameters) : P.StarOverflowAssembly := by
  apply starOverflowAssembly_of_identification P
  intro order kind C hC accounting r _hr _hquarter quota sample clock stage active selected reached
  have legal := star_legal_uncapped (Seed := Unit) P order kind r none C hC accounting
  obtain ⟨length, _, hp⟩ := run_has_prefix (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting
    (P.starReferenceRule order kind r none) legal sample clock
  obtain ⟨next, step⟩ := legal sample.1 ((P.input order).truthAt sample.2)
    (worldTapes (P.input order) sample.2) length _ hp active
  have selected' : P.starReferenceRule order kind r none sample.1
      (run (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting (P.starReferenceRule order kind r none) sample clock).history = .review stage := selected
  rw [selected'] at step
  cases step with
  | review _ live port _ =>
    apply PDROC.StarFirstExit.Local.review_at_quota_mem_anyStarOverflow P order kind r C accounting
      sample clock stage quota live port selected'
    rw [← prefix_historyObservations_length (P.input order) C .uncapped accounting
      (P.starReferenceRule order kind r none) sample.1 ((P.input order).truthAt sample.2)
      (worldTapes (P.input order) sample.2) hp stage]

def ThreePrices (P : Star.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon → epsilon < 1 → ∃ cutoff : ℝ, 0 < cutoff ∧
    ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → delta < cutoff → delta ≤ 1 / 2 →
      ∀ (order : Order) (kind : PortKind), 0 < P.leadingScale order kind delta ∧
        ∀ (C : Contract (starInstance P.tools order)), kind.contracts C →
          ∀ (accounting : NormalAccounting (starInstance P.tools order)) (exponent : ℕ),
            P.OriginalStarQualification order kind delta exponent C accounting →
              ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - epsilon) * P.leadingScale order kind delta) ≤
                P.value order C .native accounting (ENNReal.ofReal delta) ∧
              P.value order C .native accounting (ENNReal.ofReal delta) ≤
                ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + epsilon) * P.leadingScale order kind delta)

controller's H0 certificate. No finite-cost/ET, MAP or feasibility condition

RootStarPriceEnvelope.uniform_upper.name: RootStarPriceEnvelope.uniform_upper
RootStarPriceEnvelope.uniform_upper.full_declaration_source:
theorem uniform_upper (P : Parameters) (epsilon : ℝ) (he : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∃ cutoff : ℝ, 0 < cutoff ∧ ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → delta < cutoff → delta ≤ 1/2 →
      ∀ (order : Order) (kind : PortKind), 0 < P.leadingScale order kind delta ∧
        observationEnvelope P order kind delta + (P.tools : ℝ) * (P.correctionFee : ℝ) ≤
          (1+epsilon) * P.leadingScale order kind delta := by
  have lr := count_half_eventually P 0 ((P.tools : ℝ)*(P.correctionFee : ℝ)) epsilon he
  have uf := count_half_eventually P 1 ((P.tools : ℝ)*(P.correctionFee : ℝ)) epsilon he
  have count := count_half_eventually P P.tools ((P.tools : ℝ)*(P.correctionFee : ℝ)) epsilon he
  have allCases : ∀ᶠ delta : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ (order : Order) (kind : PortKind),
      0 < P.leadingScale order kind delta ∧
        observationEnvelope P order kind delta + (P.tools : ℝ)*(P.correctionFee : ℝ) ≤
          (1+epsilon) * P.leadingScale order kind delta := by
    filter_upwards [lr, uf, count] with delta hlr huf hc
    intro order kind
    cases kind <;> cases order
    all_goals simp only [leadingScale, priceDepth, observationEnvelope]
    · simpa only [Nat.reduceAdd, currentObservationEnvelope, countObservationEnvelope, mul_assoc] using huf
    · exact hc
    · exact hc
    · exact hc
    · simpa only [Nat.reduceAdd, countObservationEnvelope] using hlr
    · simpa only [Nat.reduceAdd, countObservationEnvelope] using hlr
  obtain ⟨cutoff, positive, below⟩ := RootStarEnvelope.positive_cutoff allCases
  exact ⟨cutoff, positive, fun delta hd ht _ => below delta hd ht⟩

end RootStarPriceEnvelope

def experiment (P : Parameters) : Statistics.BinaryExperiment where
  alphabetSize := 2
  priorOne := 1 / 2
  prior_pos := by norm_num
  prior_lt_one := by norm_num
  channel x y :=
    if y.val = (if x then 1 else 0) then 1 / 2 + P.certificate.gamma
    else 1 / 2 - P.certificate.gamma
  channel_pos := by
    intro x y
    split_ifs <;> linarith [P.certificate.gamma_pos, P.certificate.gamma_le_quarter]
  channel_sum := by
    intro x
    cases x <;> norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  channel_distinct := by
    intro heq
    have h := congrFun heq (0 : Fin 2)
    norm_num at h
    linarith [P.certificate.gamma_pos]
  observationFee := P.reviewFee
  observationFee_pos := P.reviewFee_pos

theorem symmetricHitting_expectedSamples_eq (P : Parameters) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (x : Bool) :
    P.experiment.expectedSamples (Measure.dirac ()) (P.symmetricHittingTest m) x =
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.endpointMeanCount m : ℝ) := by
  have hf := P.symmetricHittingTest_expectedSamples_finite m x
  have hw := P.experiment.integral_stoppedSum_wald (Measure.dirac ()) (P.symmetricHittingTest m) x hf
  rw [P.symmetricHitting_integral_stoppedSum m hm x, P.divergence_eq_kappa] at hw
  have he : (P.experiment.expectedSamples (Measure.dirac ()) (P.symmetricHittingTest m) x).toReal =
      ((m : ℝ) * P.h * (1 - 2 * (P.endpointError m : ℝ))) / P.kappa := by
    apply (eq_div_iff P.kappa_pos.ne').mpr
    nlinarith [hw]
  have hreal : (P.experiment.expectedSamples (Measure.dirac ()) (P.symmetricHittingTest m) x).toReal =
      (P.endpointMeanCount m : ℝ) := by
    rw [he]
    unfold endpointMeanCount kappa
    push_cast
    have hg : (P.gamma : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast P.gamma_pos.ne'
    field_simp [hg, P.h_pos.ne']
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hf).symm.trans (congrArg ENNReal.ofReal hreal)

theorem symmetricHittingTest_stop_le_iff (P : Parameters) (m : ℕ) (tape : P.experiment.Tape) (n : ℕ) :
    (P.symmetricHittingTest m).rule.stop () tape ≤ n ↔
      ∃ k ≤ n, m ≤ (P.signedSum tape k).natAbs := by
  change P.experiment.posteriorThresholdStop (P.endpointError m) tape ≤ n ↔ _
  rw [P.experiment.posteriorThresholdStop_le_iff]
  apply exists_congr
  intro k
  apply and_congr_right
  intro _
  rw [P.endpointThreshold, P.abs_logOddsScore_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hr : (m : ℝ) ≤ ((P.signedSum tape k).natAbs : ℝ) := by nlinarith [P.h_pos]
    exact_mod_cast hr
  · intro h
    have hr : (m : ℝ) ≤ ((P.signedSum tape k).natAbs : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    nlinarith [P.h_pos]

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.P.full_declaration_source:
theorem symmetricHittingTest_hits_exact (P : Parameters) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (tape : P.experiment.Tape) (n : ℕ)
    (hstop : (P.symmetricHittingTest m).rule.stop () tape = n) :
    (P.signedSum tape n).natAbs = m := by
  have hhit : m ≤ (P.signedSum tape n).natAbs := by
    obtain ⟨k, hkn, hk⟩ := (P.symmetricHittingTest_stop_le_iff m tape n).mp (by rw [hstop])
    have hnk : n ≤ k := by
      have hle := (P.symmetricHittingTest_stop_le_iff m tape k).mpr ⟨k, le_rfl, hk⟩
      rw [hstop] at hle
      exact ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp hle
    simpa only [Nat.le_antisymm hkn hnk] using hk
  cases n with
  | zero => simp only [P.signedSum_zero, Int.natAbs_zero] at hhit; omega
  | succ n =>
    have hbefore : (P.signedSum tape n).natAbs < m := by
      apply Nat.lt_of_not_ge
      intro h
      have hle := (P.symmetricHittingTest_stop_le_iff m tape n).mpr ⟨n, le_rfl, h⟩
      rw [hstop] at hle
      have hn := ENat.natCast_le_natCast.mp hle
      omega
    have hupper := P.signedSum_natAbs_succ_le tape n
    omega

theorem rocArbitraryDecisionLower (P : Parameters) : RocArbitraryDecisionLower.{u} P := by
  intro Seed ms ν hν test he heone
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := ms
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  by_cases htop : P.experiment.bayesObservationCharge ν test = ⊤
  · rw [htop]
    exact le_top
  · have hobj : P.experiment.bayesObjective ν test 0 ≠ ⊤ := by
      simpa only [BinaryExperiment.bayesObjective, zero_mul, add_zero] using htop
    have hf := P.experiment.bayesObjective_finite_expectedSamples ν test 0 hobj
    have hp : 0 < P.adjustedBayesError ν test := lt_min he (by linarith)
    exact _root_.PDROC.rocPrice_le_charge_of_posterior_average P ν test hf
      (_root_.PDROC.posteriorError_integrable P ν test)
      (P.adjustedBayesError ν test) hp (P.adjustedBayesError_mem_Icc ν test).2
      (_root_.PDROC.integral_posteriorError_le_adjusted P ν test hf)

    decision := fun seed _ => seed
    stopping := by intro seed tape tape' n _; rfl

PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.P.name: PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.Parameters.adjacentMixtureTest
PaperProofs.Statistics.BinarySymmetric.P.full_declaration_source:
noncomputable def adjacentMixtureTest (P : Parameters) (m : ℕ) :
    P.experiment.AdmissibleRule (Bool × Bool) :=
  (fun lower upper : P.experiment.AdmissibleRule Bool => ({
  rule := {
    stop := fun seed tape =>
      if seed.1 then lower.rule.stop seed.2 tape else upper.rule.stop seed.2 tape
    decision := fun seed tape =>
      if seed.1 then lower.rule.decision seed.2 tape else upper.rule.decision seed.2 tape
    stopping := by
      intro seed tape tape' n hprefix
      cases hb : seed.1 <;> simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      · exact upper.rule.stopping seed.2 tape tape' n hprefix
      · exact lower.rule.stopping seed.2 tape tape' n hprefix
    stoppedDecision := by
      intro seed tape tape' n hs hs' hprefix
      cases hb : seed.1 <;> simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hs hs' ⊢
      · exact upper.rule.stoppedDecision seed.2 tape tape' n hs hs' hprefix
      · exact lower.rule.stoppedDecision seed.2 tape tape' n hs hs' hprefix
  }
  measurable_stop := by
    have hp : Measurable (fun sample : (Bool × Bool) × P.experiment.Tape => (sample.1.2, sample.2)) :=
      (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
    exact Measurable.ite ((measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst) (measurableSet_singleton true))
      (lower.measurable_stop.comp hp) (upper.measurable_stop.comp hp)
  measurable_decision := by
    have hp : Measurable (fun sample : (Bool × Bool) × P.experiment.Tape => (sample.1.2, sample.2)) :=
      (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
    exact Measurable.ite ((measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst) (measurableSet_singleton true))
      (lower.measurable_decision.comp hp) (upper.measurable_decision.comp hp)
  } : P.experiment.AdmissibleRule (Bool × Bool)))
    (P.rocEndpointTest m) (P.rocEndpointTest (m + 1))

def RecordRepresentationClaims (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  P.AuxiliaryPosteriorLevels ∧
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
    letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
    ∀ (ν : Measure Seed) (hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν),
      letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
      ∀ original : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting Seed,
        expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting original.rule ν ≠ ⊤ →
        ∃ stopped : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting Seed,
          FirstFailureDomination (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting original stopped ∧
          ∃ (SimSeed : Type u) (ms : MeasurableSpace SimSeed),
            letI : MeasurableSpace SimSeed := ms
            ∃ (νs : Measure SimSeed), IsProbabilityMeasure νs ∧
              ∃ (actual : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting SimSeed)
                (data : RecordSimulatorData P.sharedInstance Seed SimSeed),
                P.BoundaryRepresentation fee hfee C accounting ν νs stopped actual data ∧
                ∀ penalty : ℝ≥0∞,
                  paidPenaltyObjective (P.input fee hfee) C.val accounting actual.rule νs penalty ≤
                    expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting original.rule ν +
                      penalty * risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting original.rule ν
