PaperProofs.Paid.completedHistory_some_i.signature_start: theorem completedHistory_some_iff {Seed : Type u} (input : StatisticalInput I)
PaperProofs.Paid.completedHistory_some_i.full_declaration_source:
theorem completedHistory_some_iff {Seed : Type u} (input : StatisticalInput I)
    (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (sample : Seed × input.World) (history : List (VisibleEvent I)) :
    completedHistory input C mode accounting rule sample = some history ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).halted = true ∧
        (∀ k < n, (run input C mode accounting rule sample k).halted ≠ true) ∧
        (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).history = history := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hh
    by_cases he : ∃ n : ℕ, (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).halted = true
    · have hhistory : (run input C mode accounting rule sample (Nat.find he)).history = history := by
        simpa [completedHistory, he] using hh
      exact ⟨Nat.find he, Nat.find_spec he, fun _ hk => Nat.find_min he hk, hhistory⟩
    · simp [completedHistory, he] at hh
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, hbefore, hhistory⟩
    have he : ∃ k : ℕ, (run input C mode accounting rule sample k).halted = true := ⟨n, hn⟩
    have hfind : Nat.find he = n := (Nat.find_eq_iff he).mpr ⟨hn, hbefore⟩
    simp [completedHistory, he, hfind, hhistory]

PaperProofs.Paid.measurable_completedHis.name: PaperProofs.Paid.measurable_completedHistory
PaperProofs.Paid.measurable_completedHis.full_declaration_source:
theorem measurable_completedHistory {Seed : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (rule : PolicyRule I Seed) (hm : MeasurableRule rule) :
    Measurable (completedHistory input C mode accounting rule) := by
  have hhalt (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {sample : Seed × input.World |
      (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).halted = true} :=
    (measurable_run input C mode accounting rule hm n)
      (MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_top (s := {state : State I | state.halted = true}))
  apply measurable_to_countable'
  intro outcome
  cases outcome with
  | none =>
    have heq : (completedHistory input C mode accounting rule) ⁻¹' {none} =
        (⋃ n : ℕ, {sample : Seed × input.World |
          (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).halted = true})ᶜ := by
      ext sample
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, completedHistory_none_iff,
        Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [heq]
    exact (MeasurableSet.iUnion hhalt).compl
  | some history =>
    have hhistory (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {sample : Seed × input.World |
        (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).history = history} :=
      (measurable_run input C mode accounting rule hm n)
        (MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_top (s := {state : State I | state.history = history}))
    have heq : (completedHistory input C mode accounting rule) ⁻¹' {some history} =
        ⋃ n : ℕ, {sample : Seed × input.World |
            (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).halted = true} ∩
          ((⋂ k : ℕ, {sample : Seed × input.World |
            k < n → (run input C mode accounting rule sample k).halted ≠ true}) ∩
          {sample : Seed × input.World |
            (run input C mode accounting rule sample n).history = history}) := by
      ext sample
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, completedHistory_some_iff,
        Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [heq]
    apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
    intro n
    refine (hhalt n).inter ((MeasurableSet.iInter fun k => ?_).inter (hhistory n))
    by_cases hk : k < n
    · have hs : {sample : Seed × input.World |
          k < n → (run input C mode accounting rule sample k).halted ≠ true} =
          {sample : Seed × input.World |
            (run input C mode accounting rule sample k).halted = true}ᶜ := by
        ext sample
        simp [hk]
      rw [hs]
      exact (hhalt k).compl
    · simp [hk]

PDROC.uniformLocalSurrogate.full_declaration_source:
theorem uniformLocalSurrogate (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : P.UniformLocalSurrogate := by
  constructor
  · intro p hp hhalf
    have hb := rocChord_surrogate_bounds P.binarySymmetric p hp hhalf
    have he : P.rocSurrogate p = ENNReal.ofReal
        (max (P.binarySymmetric.a * phiReal p)
          ((P.binarySymmetric.reviewFee : ℝ) / (P.binarySymmetric.gamma : ℝ) * (1 / 2 - p))) := by
      rw [PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.rocSurrogate, phi_of_pos hp,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul P.a_pos.le,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (show 0 ≤ (P.reviewFee : ℝ) / (P.certificate.gamma : ℝ) by
          exact div_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast P.reviewFee_pos.le)
            (by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.gamma_pos.le)), ENNReal.ofReal_max]
      rfl
    rw [he, P.binarySymmetric.rocPrice_of_pos p hp hhalf]
    constructor
    · exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hb.1
    · have h := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hb.2
      simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat] using h
  · exact endpointCharge_succ_le_four P.binarySymmetric

end PDROC

def SurvivingEntryClaims (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
    letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
    ∀ (ν : Measure Seed) (hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν),
      letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
      ∀ policy : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting Seed,
        (∀ stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage,
          ∃ gate : Seed × (P.input fee hfee).PastWorld stage → Bool,
            Measurable gate ∧ ∀ sample,
              sample ∈ P.survivingEntry fee hfee C mode accounting policy.rule stage ↔
                gate ((P.input fee hfee).preBirthView stage sample) = true) ∧
        (∀ (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hfee).World) (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage),
          sample ∈ P.nextStageFilledEntry fee hfee C mode accounting policy.rule stage →
            entryHistory (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule stage sample = none ∧
              P.paidRunReviewCount fee hfee C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage = 0) ∧
        (∀ sample, (P.unwrittenSurvivingStages fee hfee C mode accounting policy.rule sample).card ≤ 1) ∧
        (risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν ≤ P.targetRisk →
          ∀ stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage,
            1 - P.targetRisk ≤ (P.input fee hfee).seededWorldLaw ν
              (P.survivingEntry fee hfee C mode accounting policy.rule stage))

/-- D09: all actual observations are charged, while only the surviving
pre-birth histories are retained on the information lower side. -/

theorem survivingInformationLower (P : Parameters) : P.SurvivingInformationLower.{u} := by
  intro fee hf C mode accounting Seed m
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
  intro ν hν
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  intro policy
  have h := survivingInformationLower_uncapped P fee hf C accounting
    (PDROC.uncappedSourcePolicy (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy) ν
  have hr : run (P.input fee hf) C.val .uncapped accounting
      (PDROC.uncappedSourcePolicy (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy).rule =
      run (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule := by
    funext sample n
    exact PDROC.uncappedSourcePolicy_run (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy sample n
  have hentry (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World) :
      entryHistory (P.input fee hf) C.val .uncapped accounting
        (PDROC.uncappedSourcePolicy (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy).rule stage sample =
      entryHistory (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule stage sample := by
    cases he : entryHistory (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule stage sample with
    | none =>
      apply (entryHistory_none_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr
      intro hn
      apply (entryHistory_none_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp he
      simpa only [hr] using hn
    | some history =>
      apply (entryHistory_some_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr
      simpa only [hr] using (entryHistory_some_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp he
  have hcount (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World) (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) :
      P.paidRunReviewCount fee hf C .uncapped accounting
        (PDROC.uncappedSourcePolicy (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy).rule sample stage =
      P.paidRunReviewCount fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage := by
    unfold Parameters.paidRunReviewCount
    simp only [hr]
  have hposterior (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World) (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) :
      P.paidRunPosteriorError fee hf C .uncapped accounting
        (PDROC.uncappedSourcePolicy (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy).rule sample stage =
      P.paidRunPosteriorError fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage := by
    exact congrArg (fun count : ℕ∞ => if count = 0 then (1 / 2 : ℝ) else if count = ⊤ then 0 else
      P.binarySymmetric.wordPosteriorError ⟨count.toNat, fun k => (sample.2 stage).2 k.val⟩) (hcount sample stage)
  simpa only [Parameters.survivingEntry, Parameters.actualSurvivingEntry,
    Parameters.nextStageFilledEntry, hentry, hposterior,
    expectedObservationBill, runObservationBill, hr] using h

end PDLower

PDLower.markedPosteriorComparison.name: PDLower.markedPosteriorComparison
PDLower.markedPosteriorComparison.full_declaration_source:
theorem markedPosteriorComparison (P : Parameters) : P.MarkedPosteriorComparison.{u} := by
  intro fee hf C mode accounting Seed m
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
  intro ν hν
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  intro policy
  let source := PDROC.uncappedSourcePolicy (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy
  have hr : run (P.input fee hf) C.val .uncapped accounting source.rule =
      run (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule := by
    funext sample n
    exact PDROC.uncappedSourcePolicy_run (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy sample n
  have he (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World) :
      entryHistory (P.input fee hf) C.val .uncapped accounting source.rule stage sample =
      entryHistory (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule stage sample := by
    cases he : entryHistory (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule stage sample with
    | none =>
      apply (entryHistory_none_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr
      intro hn
      apply (entryHistory_none_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp he
      simpa only [hr] using hn
    | some history =>
      apply (entryHistory_some_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr
      simpa only [hr] using (entryHistory_some_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp he
  have hs (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) :
      P.survivingEntry fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule stage =
        P.survivingEntry fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule stage := by
    ext sample
    simp only [Parameters.survivingEntry, Parameters.actualSurvivingEntry,
      Parameters.nextStageFilledEntry, he, hr]
  have hc (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World) (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) :
      P.paidRunReviewCount fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule sample stage =
      P.paidRunReviewCount fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage := by
    unfold Parameters.paidRunReviewCount
    simp only [hr]
  have hp (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World) (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) :
      P.paidRunPosteriorError fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule sample stage =
      P.paidRunPosteriorError fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage := by
    exact congrArg (fun count : ℕ∞ => if count = 0 then (1 / 2 : ℝ) else if count = ⊤ then 0 else
      P.binarySymmetric.wordPosteriorError ⟨count.toNat, fun k => (sample.2 stage).2 k.val⟩) (hc sample stage)
  have hd (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World) (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) :
      P.actualOrdinaryDecision fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule sample stage =
      P.actualOrdinaryDecision fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage := by
    classical
    exact congrArg (fun running : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World → ℕ → State P.sharedInstance =>
      if ∃ n : ℕ, (running sample n).ledger.written stage = some true then some true
      else if ∃ n : ℕ, (running sample n).ledger.written stage = some false then some false else none) hr
  have hfilled (sample : Seed × (P.input fee hf).World) (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) :
      P.filledOrdinaryDecision fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule sample stage =
      P.filledOrdinaryDecision fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage := by
    unfold Parameters.filledOrdinaryDecision
    rw [hd sample stage]
    cases hd' : P.actualOrdinaryDecision fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage with
    | some bit => rfl
    | none =>
      exact congrArg (fun count : ℕ∞ => if count = ⊤ then false else
        P.experiment.posteriorRecordDecision ((), ⟨count.toNat, fun k => (sample.2 stage).2 k.val⟩)) (hc sample stage)
  have hm (stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage) :
      P.markedErrorEvent fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule stage =
      P.markedErrorEvent fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule stage := by
    ext sample
    change (sample ∈ P.survivingEntry fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule stage ∧
      P.filledOrdinaryDecision fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule sample stage ≠ (sample.2 stage).1) ↔
      (sample ∈ P.survivingEntry fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule stage ∧
        P.filledOrdinaryDecision fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage ≠ (sample.2 stage).1)
    rw [hs stage, hfilled sample stage]
  have h : (∑ stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage,
      ∫⁻ sample, (P.survivingEntry fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule stage).indicator
        (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (P.paidRunPosteriorError fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule sample stage)) sample
          ∂(P.input fee hf).seededWorldLaw ν) ≤
      ∑ stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage, (P.input fee hf).seededWorldLaw ν
        (P.markedErrorEvent fee hf C .uncapped accounting source.rule stage) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro stage _
    exact markedPosterior_stage_lower_uncapped P fee hf C accounting source ν stage
  simpa only [hs, hp, hm] using h

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.survivalMass.full_declaration_source:
theorem survivalMassLower_pos (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : 0 < P.survivalMassLower := by
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < P.certificate.stages := by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.stages_pos
  have hd : (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 64 := by
    have h := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mpr P.certificate.risk_le
    norm_num at h
    exact h

def UsageLower (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (mode : ResourceMode)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
    letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
    ∀ (ν : Measure Seed) (hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν),
      letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
      ∀ policy : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting Seed,
        risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν ≤ P.targetRisk →
          let repairs := meanRepairCount (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν
          ENNReal.ofReal (P.a * P.survivalMassLower) *
              Statistics.BinarySymmetric.phi
                (min (1 / 2) ((repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) / P.survivalMassLower)) +
            ENNReal.ofReal (fee : ℝ) * expectedRepairCount (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν ≤
              expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν

end PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters

PDLower.usageLower.name: PDLower.usageLower
PDLower.usageLower.full_declaration_source:
theorem usageLower (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : P.UsageLower.{u} := by
  intro fee hf C mode accounting Seed ms
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := ms
  intro ν hν
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  intro policy hrisk
  let repairs := meanRepairCount (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν
  let b := repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)
  let m := P.survivalMassLower
  have hm : 0 < m := P.survivalMassLower_pos
  have hd : 0 < (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.risk_pos
  have hb : 0 < b := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hd
  have hcost := expectedObservation_add_correctionCount_le P fee hf C mode accounting policy ν
  have hinformation := survivingInformationLower P fee hf C mode accounting Seed ms ν hν policy
  by_cases hhalf : 1 / 2 ≤ b / m
  · have heq : min (1 / 2) (b / m) = 1 / 2 := min_eq_left hhalf
    change ENNReal.ofReal (P.a * m) * phi (min (1 / 2) (b / m)) + _ ≤ _
    rw [heq, phi_half, mul_zero, zero_add]
    exact le_trans (le_add_left le_rfl) hcost
  · have hs := (survivingEntryClaims P fee hf C mode accounting Seed ms ν hν policy).2.2.2 hrisk
    have hδ : 0 ≤ (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) := hd.le
    have hmass : ENNReal.ofReal m ≤ ∑ stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage,
        (P.input fee hf).seededWorldLaw ν (P.survivingEntry fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule stage) := by
      calc
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * (1 - P.targetRisk) := by
          rw [show m = (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * (1 - (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) from rfl,
            ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ hδ]
          norm_num [Parameters.targetRisk]
        _ = ∑ _stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage, (1 - P.targetRisk) := by
          have hcard : Fintype.card P.sharedInstance.Stage = P.certificate.stages := by
            change Fintype.card (Fin P.sharedInstance.compatibility.length) = _
            rw [Fintype.card_fin]
            exact P.stageCount_eq
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, hcard, nsmul_eq_mul]
          norm_num
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun stage _ => hs stage)
    have hpost : (∑ stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage,
        ∫⁻ sample, (P.survivingEntry fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule stage).indicator
          (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (P.paidRunPosteriorError fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage)) sample
            ∂(P.input fee hf).seededWorldLaw ν) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal b := by
      have hp := posteriorFailureAllowance P fee hf C mode accounting Seed ms ν hν policy hrisk
      apply hp.trans_eq
      change expectedRepairCount (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν +
        ENNReal.ofReal (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) = ENNReal.ofReal (repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ))
      have hrepair : ENNReal.ofReal repairs = expectedRepairCount (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν :=
        ofReal_meanRepairCount (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule policy.legal ν
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (show 0 ≤ repairs from ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) hd.le, hrepair]
    have hperspective := gated_perspective ((P.input fee hf).seededWorldLaw ν)
      (fun stage => P.survivingEntry fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule stage)
      (fun stage => P.measurableSet_survivingEntry fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule stage)
      (fun stage sample => P.paidRunPosteriorError fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage)
      (fun stage sample => (paidRunPosteriorError_range P fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage).1)
      (fun stage sample => (paidRunPosteriorError_range P fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule sample stage).2)
      (fun stage => measurable_paidRunPosteriorError P fee hf C mode accounting policy.rule policy.measurable_rule stage)
      m b hm hb (lt_of_not_ge hhalf).le hmass hpost
    have hobservation : ENNReal.ofReal (P.a * m) * phi (min (1 / 2) (b / m)) ≤
        expectedObservationBill (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν := by
      rw [min_eq_right (lt_of_not_ge hhalf).le, ENNReal.ofReal_mul P.a_pos.le, mul_assoc]
      exact (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hperspective).trans hinformation
    exact (add_le_add hobservation le_rfl).trans hcost

end PDLower

PDLower.gated_perspective.name: PDLower.gated_perspective
PDLower.gated_perspective.signature_start: theorem gated_perspective {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [Fintype ι]
PDLower.gated_perspective.full_declaration_source:
theorem gated_perspective {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure α) (E : ι → Set α) (hE : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (E i))
    (p : ι → α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i a, 0 ≤ p i a) (hph : ∀ i a, p i a ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hpm : ∀ i, Measurable (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (p i a)))
    (m b : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hb : 0 < b) (hbh : b / m ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hmass : ENNReal.ofReal m ≤ ∑ i, μ (E i))
    (hpost : (∑ i, ∫⁻ a, (E i).indicator (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (p i a)) a ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal b) :
    ENNReal.ofReal m * phi (b / m) ≤
      ∑ i, ∫⁻ a, (E i).indicator (fun a => phi (p i a)) a ∂μ := by
  classical
  let z := b / m
  let k := -phiDerivative z
  let A := phiReal z + k * z
  have hz : 0 < z := div_pos hb hm
  have hk : 0 ≤ k := neg_nonneg.mpr (phiDerivative_nonpos hz hbh)
  have hφ : 0 ≤ phiReal z := phiReal_nonneg hz hbh
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := add_nonneg hφ (mul_nonneg hk hz.le)
  have hlocal (i : ι) : ENNReal.ofReal A * μ (E i) ≤
      (∫⁻ a, (E i).indicator (fun a => phi (p i a)) a ∂μ) +
        ENNReal.ofReal k * ∫⁻ a, (E i).indicator (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (p i a)) a ∂μ := by
    have hkg : Measurable (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal k * (E i).indicator (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (p i a)) a) :=
      measurable_const.mul ((hpm i).indicator (hE i))
    rw [← lintegral_indicator_const (hE i), ← lintegral_const_mul _ ((hpm i).indicator (hE i)),
      ← lintegral_add_right _ hkg]
    apply lintegral_mono
    intro a
    by_cases ha : a ∈ E i
    · simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem ha] using phi_support hz hbh (hp i a) (hph i a)
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem ha, mul_zero, add_zero, le_refl]
  have hsum : ENNReal.ofReal A * (∑ i, μ (E i)) ≤
      (∑ i, ∫⁻ a, (E i).indicator (fun a => phi (p i a)) a ∂μ) +
        ENNReal.ofReal k * (∑ i, ∫⁻ a, (E i).indicator (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (p i a)) a ∂μ) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hlocal i)
  have hcancel : ENNReal.ofReal m * phi z + ENNReal.ofReal k * ENNReal.ofReal b ≤
      (∑ i, ∫⁻ a, (E i).indicator (fun a => phi (p i a)) a ∂μ) +
        ENNReal.ofReal k * ENNReal.ofReal b := by
    calc
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (m * phiReal z + k * b) := by
        rw [phi_of_pos hz, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hm.le, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hk,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (mul_nonneg hm.le hφ) (mul_nonneg hk hb.le)]
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal A * ENNReal.ofReal m := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hA]
        congr 1
        dsimp [A, z]
        field_simp
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * (∑ i, μ (E i)) := mul_le_mul' le_rfl hmass
      _ ≤ _ := hsum.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hpost))
  exact ENNReal.le_of_add_le_add_right (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top) hcancel

end PDLower

theorem uniformFeeScalePolicyLower (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (C : P.PaymentContract)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) (fee : ℚ) (hf : 0 ≤ fee) :
    P.UniformFeeScalePolicyLower.{u} C accounting fee hf := by
  intro mode Seed ms
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := ms
  intro ν hν
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  intro policy hrisk
  let repairs := meanRepairCount (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν
  let m := P.survivalMassLower
  let p := min (1 / 2) ((repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) / m)
  have hm : 0 < m := P.survivalMassLower_pos
  have hd : 0 < (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.risk_pos
  have hdsmall : (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 64 := by
    have h := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mpr P.certificate.risk_le
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have hN : (1 : ℝ) ≤ P.certificate.stages := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt P.certificate.stages_pos)
  have hr : 0 ≤ repairs := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hfee : (0 : ℝ) ≤ fee := by exact_mod_cast hf
  have hp : 0 < p := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hr hd) hm)
  have hph : p ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hscalar := fee_scalar_original P.a_pos hN hd hdsmall hr hfee
  have husage := usageLower P fee hf C mode accounting Seed ms ν hν policy hrisk
  have hrepair : ENNReal.ofReal repairs = expectedRepairCount (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν :=
    ofReal_meanRepairCount (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule policy.legal ν
  calc
    P.feeScaleLowerAmount fee ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (P.a * m * phiReal p + (fee : ℝ) * repairs) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hscalar
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (P.a * m) * phi p +
        ENNReal.ofReal (fee : ℝ) * expectedRepairCount (P.input fee hf) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg P.a_pos.le hm.le) (phiReal_nonneg hp hph))
          (mul_nonneg hfee hr),
        ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg P.a_pos.le hm.le), ← phi_of_pos hp,
        ENNReal.ofReal_mul hfee,
        hrepair]
    _ ≤ _ := husage

def VirtualErrorCouplingClaims (P : Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
    letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
    ∀ (ν : Measure Seed) (hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν),
      letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
      ∀ original : Policy (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val mode accounting Seed,
        expectedBill (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val mode accounting original.rule ν ≠ ⊤ →
        ∃ stopped : Policy (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val .uncapped accounting Seed,
          FirstFailureDomination (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val mode accounting original stopped ∧
          ∃ (SimSeed : Type u) (ms : MeasurableSpace SimSeed),
            letI : MeasurableSpace SimSeed := ms
            ∃ (νs : Measure SimSeed), IsProbabilityMeasure νs ∧
              ∃ (actual : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting SimSeed)
                (data : OverlaySimulatorData P.sharedInstance Seed SimSeed),
                VirtualOverlayRepresentation P fee hfee C accounting ν νs stopped actual data ∧
                ∀ penalty : ℝ≥0∞,
                  paidPenaltyObjective (P.input fee hfee) C.val accounting actual.rule νs penalty ≤
                    expectedObservationBill (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val mode accounting original.rule ν +
                      P.overlayObservationIncrement fee + P.overlayCorrectionAmount fee +
                      penalty * risk (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val mode accounting original.rule ν

end PDROC.OverlayDraft

def VirtualOverlayRepresentation (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance)
    [MeasurableSpace SourceSeed] [MeasurableSpace SimSeed]
    (νsource : Measure SourceSeed) (νactual : Measure SimSeed)
    (source : Policy (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val .uncapped accounting SourceSeed)
    (actual : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting SimSeed)
    (data : OverlaySimulatorData P.sharedInstance SourceSeed SimSeed) : Prop :=
  OverlaySimulatorMeasurable data ∧ P.ShadowCausal data.toRecordSimulatorData ∧
    P.SourceRecordAlignment fee hfee C accounting νactual actual.rule data.toRecordSimulatorData ∧
    P.SourceHistoryLaw 0 (by norm_num) fee hfee C accounting νsource νactual source.rule actual.rule
      data.toRecordSimulatorData ∧
    OverlayStageRealization P fee hfee C accounting νactual actual.rule data ∧
    OverlayPathCoupling P fee hfee C accounting actual.rule data ∧
    OverlayRecordCells P fee hfee C accounting νactual actual.rule data ∧
    (P.input fee hfee).seededWorldLaw νactual
      {sample | completedHistory (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting actual.rule sample = none} = 0 ∧
    (∀ sample n,
      let virtual := data.shadow sample.1 (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting actual.rule sample n).history
      (.stopped ∈ virtual ∧ ∀ stage, PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.historyStageResolved P.sharedInstance virtual stage = true) →
        runSuccess (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting actual.rule sample) ∧
    risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting actual.rule νactual ≤
      risk (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val .uncapped accounting source.rule νsource ∧
    expectedObservationBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting actual.rule νactual ≤
      expectedObservationBill (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val .uncapped accounting source.rule νsource +
        P.overlayObservationIncrement fee ∧
    P.expectedActualCorrectionBill fee hfee C .uncapped accounting actual.rule νactual ≤ P.overlayCorrectionAmount fee ∧
    expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting actual.rule νactual ≤
      expectedObservationBill (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val .uncapped accounting source.rule νsource +
        P.overlayObservationIncrement fee + P.overlayCorrectionAmount fee

end Overlay

PDROC.OverlayDraft.OverlayStageRealizati.full_declaration_source:
def OverlayStageRealization (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance)
    [MeasurableSpace SimSeed] (ν : Measure SimSeed) (rule : PolicyRule P.sharedInstance SimSeed)
    (data : OverlaySimulatorData P.sharedInstance SourceSeed SimSeed) : Prop :=
  ∀ᵐ sample ∂(P.input fee hfee).seededWorldLaw ν,
    ∀ stage entry, entryHistory (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting rule stage sample = some entry →
      let record := data.record sample.1 stage entry
      match record.decision with
      | none => P.actualOrdinaryDecision fee hfee C .uncapped accounting rule sample stage = none ∧
          P.paidRunReviewCount fee hfee C .uncapped accounting rule sample stage = 0
      | some _ =>
        let test := P.overlayRecordTest fee hfee record
        let tape := (P.input fee hfee).reviewAt sample.2 stage
        ∃ n : ℕ, test.rule.stop (data.mixtureCoinsAtRecord sample.1 stage record) tape = (n : ℕ∞) ∧
          P.paidRunReviewCount fee hfee C .uncapped accounting rule sample stage = (n : ℕ∞) ∧
          P.actualOrdinaryDecision fee hfee C .uncapped accounting rule sample stage =
            some (test.rule.decision (data.mixtureCoinsAtRecord sample.1 stage record) tape) ∧
          (if test.rule.decision (data.mixtureCoinsAtRecord sample.1 stage record) tape then
            0 ≤ P.binarySymmetric.experiment.logOddsScore tape n
           else P.binarySymmetric.experiment.logOddsScore tape n ≤ 0)

PDROC.OverlayDraft.OverlayPathCoupling.full_declaration_source:
def OverlayPathCoupling (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance)
    (rule : PolicyRule P.sharedInstance SimSeed)
    (data : OverlaySimulatorData P.sharedInstance SourceSeed SimSeed) : Prop :=
  (∀ sample n,
    let actual := (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting rule sample n).history
    let virtual := data.shadow sample.1 actual
    (reservedPairs actual).Sublist (reservedPairs virtual) ∧
    (executedPairs actual).Sublist (executedPairs virtual) ∧
    historyUsed actual ⊆ historyUsed virtual) ∧
  (∀ sample stage, P.actualWriteError fee hfee C accounting rule stage sample →
    P.virtualWriteError fee hfee C accounting rule data.toRecordSimulatorData stage sample) ∧
  (∀ sample stage entry decision,
    entryHistory (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting rule stage sample = some entry →
    (data.record sample.1 stage entry).decision = some decision →
    (∃ n, (historyReport
      (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting rule sample n).history stage).isSome = true) →
      (P.virtualWriteError fee hfee C accounting rule data.toRecordSimulatorData stage sample ↔
        P.actualWriteError fee hfee C accounting rule stage sample ∨
          data.falsePositiveCoinAtRecord sample.1 stage (data.record sample.1 stage entry) = true)) ∧
  (∀ sample n stage,
    let actual := (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting rule sample n).history
    let virtual := data.shadow sample.1 actual
    (historyReport virtual stage).isSome = true →
      (historyReport actual stage).isSome = true ∧
      ∀ entry decision,
        entryHistory (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting rule stage sample = some entry →
        (data.record sample.1 stage entry).decision = some decision →
        (historyReport virtual stage).map Prod.fst = some (Bool.xor decision
          (P.actualWriteErrorFlag fee hfee C accounting rule stage sample ||
            data.falsePositiveCoinAtRecord sample.1 stage (data.record sample.1 stage entry)))) ∧
  ∀ sample n,
    (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting rule sample n).ledger.executions.length ≤
      min P.certificate.stages P.tools

      letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν

        ∃ (Seed' : Type) (m' : MeasurableSpace Seed'),

            ∃ paid : Native.Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting Seed',
              Native.risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting paid.rule ν' ≤
                Native.risk (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val mode accounting p.rule ν ∧
              Native.expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting paid.rule ν' ≤
                Native.expectedObservationBill (P.input 0 (by norm_num)) C.val mode accounting p.rule ν +

  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (n k : ℕ) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞),

theorem freshPaidPenalty_tools_antitone (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (n k : ℕ) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    P.freshPaidPenalty fee hfee n (k + 1) penalty ≤ P.freshPaidPenalty fee hfee n k penalty := by
  change paidPenaltyValue (P.freshInput n (k + 1) fee hfee) (paidRelaxedContract _) (zeroAccounting _) penalty ≤
    paidPenaltyValue (P.freshInput n k fee hfee) (paidRelaxedContract _) (zeroAccounting _) penalty
  conv_rhs => unfold paidPenaltyValue
  refine le_iInf fun Seed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
  let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
  refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_
  exact (paidPenaltyValue_le_policy _ _ _ penalty ν (upPolicy P fee hfee n k policy).val).trans
    (paidPenaltyObjective_upPolicy_le P fee hfee n k policy ν penalty)

end RootPaidToolTransport

RootBSCEndpointPenalty.endpointInf_le_ba.name: RootBSCEndpointPenalty.endpointInf_le_bayesObjective_any_seed
RootBSCEndpointPenalty.endpointInf_le_ba.full_declaration_source:
theorem endpointInf_le_bayesObjective_any_seed {Seed : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (P : Parameters) (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (test : P.experiment.AdmissibleRule Seed) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    endpointInf P d ≤ P.experiment.bayesObjective ν test (ENNReal.ofReal d) := by
  by_cases hf : P.experiment.bayesObjective ν test (ENNReal.ofReal d) = ⊤
  · rw [hf]
    exact le_top
  have hp := adjustedBayesError_pos_of_finite P ν test (ENNReal.ofReal d) hf
  have hh := (P.adjustedBayesError_mem_Icc ν test).2
  have he : 0 < (P.rocBayesError ν test).val := lt_of_lt_of_le hp (min_le_left _ _)
  have heone : (P.rocBayesError ν test).val < 1 := by
    have h := lt_of_lt_of_le hp (min_le_right (P.rocBayesError ν test).val (1 - (P.rocBayesError ν test).val))
    linarith
  have hroc := (PaperProofs.Statistics.PDROC.exactROCClaims P).1 Seed inferInstance ν inferInstance test he heone
  have herror : ENNReal.ofReal (P.adjustedBayesError ν test) ≤ P.experiment.bayesError ν test := by
    rw [← P.rocBayesError_exact ν test]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (min_le_left _ _)
  exact (endpointInf_le_roc P d hd _ hp hh).trans
    (add_le_add hroc (by simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_left herror (ENNReal.ofReal d)))

end RootBSCEndpointPenalty

PDMenu.paidEndpointInf_le_policy.name: PDMenu.paidEndpointInf_le_policy
PDMenu.paidEndpointInf_le_policy.signature_start: theorem paidEndpointInf_le_policy (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (n k : ℕ)
PDMenu.paidEndpointInf_le_policy.full_declaration_source:
theorem paidEndpointInf_le_policy (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (n k : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (C : Contract (freshInstance n k)) (hC : C.IsCurrentPayment)
    (accounting : NormalAccounting (freshInstance n k))
    (policy : Policy (P.freshInput n k fee hfee) C .uncapped accounting Seed)
    (ν : Measure Seed) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : penalty ≠ ⊤) :
    (⨅ m : ℕ, P.paidEndpointObjective fee hfee n k penalty m) ≤
      paidPenaltyObjective (P.freshInput n k fee hfee) C accounting policy.rule ν penalty := by
  let input := P.freshInput n k fee hfee
  let head : (freshInstance n k).Stage := ⟨0, by simpa [freshInstance] using hn⟩
  let good := P.paidGoodSuccessor fee hfee n k penalty
  let bad := P.paidBadSuccessor fee hfee n k penalty
  let gap := bad.toReal - good.toReal
  let test := nativeHeadTest input head policy.rule policy.measurable_rule
  have ho := paidSuccessorOrder P fee hfee n k penalty hn hp
  have hb : bad ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top hp ho.2.2
  have hgap : 0 ≤ gap := sub_nonneg.mpr (ENNReal.toReal_mono hb ho.2.1)
  have hstat := RootBSCEndpointPenalty.endpointInf_le_bayesObjective_any_seed P.binarySymmetric ν test gap hgap
  have hInf : (⨅ m : ℕ, P.paidEndpointObjective fee hfee n k penalty m) =
      good + RootBSCEndpointPenalty.endpointInf P.binarySymmetric gap := by
    simp_rw [paidEndpointObjective_eq_shifted P fee hfee n k penalty hn hp]
    exact ENNReal.add_iInf.symm
  calc
    _ = good + RootBSCEndpointPenalty.endpointInf P.binarySymmetric gap := hInf
    _ ≤ good + (input.experiment head).bayesObjective ν test (ENNReal.ofReal gap) := add_le_add le_rfl hstat
    _ ≤ _ := paidFresh_shiftedBayes_lower P fee hfee n k hn C hC accounting policy ν head rfl penalty hp

/-- The independent full-policy infimum retains the original private-seed
comparison class; no scalar recurrence has been inserted into its definition. -/

PaperProofs.Paid.paidPenaltyValue_le_pen.signature_start: theorem paidPenaltyValue_le_penalty (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Paid.paidPenaltyValue_le_pen.full_declaration_source:
theorem paidPenaltyValue_le_penalty (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (accounting : Native.NormalAccounting I) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    paidPenaltyValue input C accounting penalty ≤ penalty := by
  let ν : Measure Unit := Measure.dirac ()
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := by dsimp [ν]; infer_instance
  have h := paidPenaltyValue_le_policy input C accounting penalty ν
    (Native.abandonPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit)
  have hb : Native.expectedBill input C .uncapped accounting
      (Native.abandonPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit).rule ν = 0 := by
    simp only [Native.expectedBill, Native.abandon_runActualBill, lintegral_zero]
  rw [paidPenaltyObjective, hb, zero_add] at h
  exact h.trans (by simpa only [mul_one] using (mul_le_mul_right
    (show Native.risk input C .uncapped accounting
      (Native.abandonPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit).rule ν ≤ 1 from prob_le_one) penalty))

PaperProofs.Paid.paidPenaltyValue_recap_.signature_start: theorem paidPenaltyValue_recap_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
PaperProofs.Paid.paidPenaltyValue_recap_.full_declaration_source:
theorem paidPenaltyValue_recap_eq (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (quota : I.Stage → ℕ) (H H0 : ℕ) (accounting : Native.NormalAccounting I) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    paidPenaltyValue input (C.withCaps quota H H0) accounting penalty = paidPenaltyValue input C accounting penalty := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · conv_rhs => unfold paidPenaltyValue
    refine le_iInf fun Seed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
    let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_
    have h := paidPenaltyValue_le_policy input (C.withCaps quota H H0) accounting penalty ν
      (policy.recap input C quota H H0 accounting)
    change paidPenaltyValue input (C.withCaps quota H H0) accounting penalty ≤
      paidPenaltyObjective input (C.withCaps quota H H0) accounting policy.rule ν penalty at h
    rwa [paidPenaltyObjective_recap_eq] at h
  · conv_rhs => unfold paidPenaltyValue
    refine le_iInf fun Seed => le_iInf fun m => ?_
    let : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
    refine le_iInf fun ν => le_iInf fun hν => ?_
    let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
    refine le_iInf fun policy => ?_
    have h := paidPenaltyValue_le_policy input C accounting penalty ν
      (policy.uncapMetadata input C quota H H0 accounting)
    change paidPenaltyValue input C accounting penalty ≤ paidPenaltyObjective input C accounting policy.rule ν penalty at h
    rwa [← paidPenaltyObjective_recap_eq input C quota H H0 accounting policy.rule ν penalty] at h

allocation and physical execution both remain current-window requirements. -/

theorem freshPaidPenalty_empty (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters)
    (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (k : ℕ) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) :
    P.freshPaidPenalty fee hfee 0 k penalty = 0 := by
  have : IsEmpty (freshInstance 0 k).Stage := by
    change IsEmpty (Fin (List.replicate 0 (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k))).length)
    simp only [List.length_replicate]
    infer_instance
  let input := P.freshInput 0 k fee hfee
  let C := paidRelaxedContract (freshInstance 0 k)
  let accounting := zeroAccounting (freshInstance 0 k)
  let ν : Measure Unit := Measure.dirac ()
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := by dsimp [ν]; infer_instance
  have h := paidPenaltyValue_le_policy input C accounting penalty ν
    (Native.stopPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit)
  have hb : Native.expectedBill input C .uncapped accounting
      (Native.stopPolicy input C .uncapped accounting Unit).rule ν = 0 := by
    simp only [Native.expectedBill, Native.stop_runActualBill, lintegral_zero]
  rw [paidPenaltyObjective, hb, Native.stop_risk_empty, mul_zero, add_zero] at h
  exact le_antisymm h zero_le

def PaidMenuNecessary (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (n k : ℕ) (penalty : ℝ≥0∞) (m : ℕ),
    0 < n → penalty ≠ ⊤ → 1 ≤ m →

PDMenu.storedLeastTestingLevel_isLeastPa.signature_start: theorem storedLeastTestingLevel_isLeastPaid (P : Parameters) (fee penalty : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (hpenalty : 0 ≤ penalty)
PDMenu.storedLeastTestingLevel_isLeastPa.full_declaration_source:
theorem storedLeastTestingLevel_isLeastPaid (P : Parameters) (fee penalty : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (hpenalty : 0 ≤ penalty)
    (hLambda : penalty ≤ P.Lambda) (N K n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ≤ N) (hk : k ≤ K) :
    let table := P.solveMenuTable fee penalty K N
    let previous := table.getD (n - 1) (baseMenuRow K)
    P.IsLeastPaidEndpointMinimizer fee hfee n k (ENNReal.ofReal (penalty : ℝ))
      (P.leastTestingLevel fee penalty previous k) := by
  intro table previous
  have hindex : n - 1 < table.size := by rw [P.solveMenuTable_size]; omega
  have hprev : previous = table.getD (n - 1) #[] :=
    menuArray_getD_fallback table (n - 1) (baseMenuRow K) #[] hindex
  have hstats : ∀ j : ℕ, MenuStatsBound (previous.getD j abandonEntry) (n - 1) j := by
    intro j
    rw [hprev]
    exact solveMenuTable_stats P fee penalty N K (n - 1) (by omega) j
  have hvalues : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ K → P.freshPaidPenalty fee hfee (n - 1) j (ENNReal.ofReal (penalty : ℝ)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((previous.getD j abandonEntry).objective fee penalty : ℝ) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hprev]
    exact solveMenuTable_value P fee penalty hfee hpenalty hLambda N K (n - 1) (by omega) j hj
  have he := leastTestingLevel_isLeastPaid P fee penalty hfee hpenalty hLambda previous (n - 1) K k hk hstats hvalues
  have hnEq : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
  simpa only [hnEq] using he

end PDMenu

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.leastTesting.full_declaration_source:
theorem leastTestingLevel_spec (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee penalty : ℚ)
    (previous : MenuRow) (tools : ℕ) :
    let chosen := P.leastTestingLevel fee penalty previous tools
    chosen ≤ P.certificate.M ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ P.certificate.M →
        (P.menuTestingEntry fee penalty previous tools chosen).objective fee penalty ≤
          (P.menuTestingEntry fee penalty previous tools m).objective fee penalty) ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ P.certificate.M →
        (P.menuTestingEntry fee penalty previous tools chosen).objective fee penalty =
          (P.menuTestingEntry fee penalty previous tools m).objective fee penalty → chosen ≤ m := by
  dsimp only
  cases hchoice : (List.range (P.certificate.M + 1)).argmin
      (fun level => (P.menuTestingEntry fee penalty previous tools level).objective fee penalty) with
  | none =>
    have hnil := List.argmin_eq_none.mp hchoice
    have hlen := congrArg List.length hnil
    simp at hlen
  | some chosen =>
    have hs := List.argmin_eq_some_iff.mp hchoice
    have hc : chosen < P.certificate.M + 1 := List.mem_range.mp hs.1
    have heq : P.leastTestingLevel fee penalty previous tools = chosen := by
      simp only [leastTestingLevel, hchoice, Option.getD_some]
    rw [heq]
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro m hm
      exact hs.2.1 m (List.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    · intro m hm he
      have hi := hs.2.2 m (List.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) he.symm.le
      rw [index_in_range chosen (P.certificate.M + 1) hc,
        index_in_range m (P.certificate.M + 1) (by omega)] at hi
      exact hi

theorem compiledMenuRule_uncapped_legal (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (N K : ℕ) (table : MenuTable)

    LegalRule (P.freshInput N K fee hfee) C .uncapped accounting (P.compiledMenuRule N K table) := by
  intro seed truth tapes n state hp hactive
  let action := P.menuCandidateAction N K table seed state.history
  by_cases allowed : historyAllowsAction state.history action
  · obtain ⟨next, step⟩ := historyAllowsAction_sound (P.freshInput N K fee hfee) C hearly accounting
      (P.compiledMenuRule N K table) seed truth tapes hp hactive action allowed
    exact ⟨next, by simpa only [compiledMenuRule, action, ite_eq_left allowed] using step⟩
  · exact ⟨stopState state true, by
      simpa only [compiledMenuRule, action, ite_eq_right allowed] using
        (Step.abandon (input := P.freshInput N K fee hfee) (C := C) (mode := ResourceMode.uncapped)
          (accounting := accounting) (tapes := tapes) state hactive)⟩

def SolveCorrect (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) (solution : MultiplierSolve) : Prop :=
  solution.table = (P.solveMultiplier fee solution.multiplier).table ∧
  expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.solveRule solution)
      (menuSeedLaw P.certificate.stages P.tools) = ENNReal.ofReal (P.solveCost fee solution : ℝ) ∧
  risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.solveRule solution)
      (menuSeedLaw P.certificate.stages P.tools) = ENNReal.ofReal (P.solveRisk solution : ℝ) ∧
  paidPenaltyValue (P.input fee hfee) C.val accounting (ENNReal.ofReal (solution.multiplier : ℝ)) =
    ENNReal.ofReal ((P.solveRecord solution).objective fee solution.multiplier : ℝ)

def MajorityInitialBracket (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance),
    (∀ sample n, (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting P.majorityRule sample n).ledger.executions = []) ∧
    (∀ sample, runActualBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting P.majorityRule sample = ENNReal.ofReal (P.B : ℝ)) ∧
    expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting P.majorityRule (Measure.dirac ()) = ENNReal.ofReal (P.B : ℝ) ∧
    risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting P.majorityRule (Measure.dirac ()) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((P.certificate.risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) ∧
    let lower := P.solveMultiplier fee 0
    let upper := P.solveMultiplier fee P.Lambda
    P.SolveCorrect fee hfee C accounting lower ∧ P.SolveCorrect fee hfee C accounting upper ∧
    P.solveRisk lower = 1 ∧ P.solveCost fee lower = 0 ∧
    risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.solveRule upper) (menuSeedLaw P.certificate.stages P.tools) ≤
      paidPenaltyValue (P.input fee hfee) C.val accounting (ENNReal.ofReal (P.Lambda : ℝ)) / ENNReal.ofReal (P.Lambda : ℝ) ∧
    paidPenaltyValue (P.input fee hfee) C.val accounting (ENNReal.ofReal (P.Lambda : ℝ)) / ENNReal.ofReal (P.Lambda : ℝ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((P.B / P.Lambda) + P.certificate.risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) ∧
    P.solveRisk upper ≤ 3 * P.certificate.risk / 4

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.StateBracket.full_declaration_source:
def StateBracketCorrect (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) : MultiplierState → Prop
  | .exact solution =>
      P.SolveCorrect fee hfee C accounting solution ∧ 0 ≤ solution.multiplier ∧ solution.multiplier ≤ P.Lambda ∧
        P.solveRisk solution = P.certificate.risk
  | .bracket lower upper =>
      P.SolveCorrect fee hfee C accounting lower ∧ P.SolveCorrect fee hfee C accounting upper ∧
        0 ≤ lower.multiplier ∧ lower.multiplier < upper.multiplier ∧ upper.multiplier ≤ P.Lambda ∧
        P.certificate.risk < P.solveRisk lower ∧ P.solveRisk upper ≤ P.certificate.risk ∧
        0 ≤ P.solveRisk upper ∧ P.solveRisk lower ≤ 1 ∧
        0 ≤ P.solveCost fee lower ∧ 0 ≤ P.solveCost fee upper

/-- D20 is asserted for the REAL reachable search state, without assuming
its endpoint optimality, its bracket invariant, or its mixture law. -/

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.ExactMixture.full_declaration_source:
def ExactMixtureAndGap (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) (steps : ℕ),
    let state := P.multiplierSearch fee steps
    P.StateBracketCorrect fee hfee C accounting state ∧
    match state with
    | .exact solution =>
        risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) = P.targetRisk ∧
        expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) =
          ENNReal.ofReal (P.solveCost fee solution : ℝ) ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (P.solveCost fee solution : ℝ) = P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee
    | .bracket lower upper =>
        let w := P.mixtureWeight lower upper
        let U := P.mixtureCost fee lower upper
        let L := P.mixtureLower fee upper
        0 ≤ w ∧ w ≤ 1 ∧ (P.clippedMixtureWeight lower upper).val = (w : ℝ) ∧
        risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) = P.targetRisk ∧
        expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) = ENNReal.ofReal (U : ℝ) ∧
        -upper.multiplier ≤ (P.solveCost fee lower - P.solveCost fee upper) / (P.solveRisk lower - P.solveRisk upper) ∧
        (P.solveCost fee lower - P.solveCost fee upper) / (P.solveRisk lower - P.solveRisk upper) ≤ -lower.multiplier ∧
        0 ≤ U - L ∧ U - L ≤ (upper.multiplier - lower.multiplier) * (P.certificate.risk - P.solveRisk upper) ∧
        (upper.multiplier - lower.multiplier) * (P.certificate.risk - P.solveRisk upper) ≤
          (upper.multiplier - lower.multiplier) * P.certificate.risk ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (L : ℝ) ≤ P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee ∧
        P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (U : ℝ)

/-- D21's stopping implication for this fixed whole-policy mixture.
It compares to the original full-policy cap-relaxed value, not a recurrence. -/
PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.ExactMixture.type_evidence_kind: Full immutable formal source declaration plus active variable context; not a new kernel #check or reconstructed Lean type.

PDMenu.exactMixtureAndGap.name: PDMenu.exactMixtureAndGap
PDMenu.exactMixtureAndGap.full_declaration_source:
theorem exactMixtureAndGap (P : Parameters) : P.ExactMixtureAndGap := by
  intro fee hfee C accounting steps
  dsimp only
  have hi := multiplierSearch_stateBracketCorrect P fee hfee C accounting steps
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  cases hs : P.multiplierSearch fee steps with
  | exact solution =>
      simp only [hs] at hi ⊢
      exact searchExact_records P fee hfee C accounting solution hi
  | bracket lower upper =>
      simp only [hs] at hi ⊢
      have hm := searchBracket_mixture_records P fee hfee C accounting lower upper hi
      have hslope := searchBracket_slopeBounds P fee hfee C accounting lower upper hi
      have hg := searchBracket_gapBounds P fee hfee C accounting lower upper hi
      exact ⟨hm.1, hm.2.1, hm.2.2.1, hm.2.2.2.1, hm.2.2.2.2,
        hslope.1, hslope.2, hg.1, hg.2.1, hg.2.2,
        searchBracket_lower_le_value P fee hfee C accounting lower upper hi,
        searchBracket_value_le_mixture P fee hfee C accounting lower upper hi⟩

end PDMenu

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.stateRule_un.full_declaration_source:
theorem stateRule_uncapped_legal (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (state : MultiplierState)
    (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) :
    LegalRule (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) := by
  intro seed truth tapes n s hp hactive
  cases state with
  | exact solution =>
    have htransport := prefix_rule_transport (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting
      (P.stateRule (.exact solution)) (P.solveRule solution) seed seed.2 (fun _ => rfl) truth tapes hp
    exact P.compiledMenuRule_uncapped_legal P.certificate.stages P.tools solution.table fee hfee C.val C.property.1.1
      accounting seed.2 truth tapes n s htransport hactive
  | bracket lower upper =>
    cases hbit : seed.1 with
    | false =>
      have hrule : ∀ history, P.stateRule (.bracket lower upper) seed history = P.solveRule upper seed.2 history := by
        intro history
        simp only [stateRule, hbit, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
      have htransport := prefix_rule_transport (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting
        (P.stateRule (.bracket lower upper)) (P.solveRule upper) seed seed.2 hrule truth tapes hp
      obtain ⟨next, step⟩ := P.compiledMenuRule_uncapped_legal P.certificate.stages P.tools upper.table fee hfee C.val C.property.1.1
        accounting seed.2 truth tapes n s htransport hactive
      exact ⟨next, (hrule s.history).symm ▸ step⟩
    | true =>
      have hrule : ∀ history, P.stateRule (.bracket lower upper) seed history = P.solveRule lower seed.2 history := by
        intro history
        simp only [stateRule, hbit, ite_true]
      have htransport := prefix_rule_transport (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting
        (P.stateRule (.bracket lower upper)) (P.solveRule lower) seed seed.2 hrule truth tapes hp
      obtain ⟨next, step⟩ := P.compiledMenuRule_uncapped_legal P.certificate.stages P.tools lower.table fee hfee C.val C.property.1.1
        accounting seed.2 truth tapes n s htransport hactive
      exact ⟨next, (hrule s.history).symm ▸ step⟩

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.StoppedTwoFa.full_declaration_source:
def StoppedTwoFactor (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) (steps : ℕ),
    let state := P.multiplierSearch fee steps
    P.searchStopped fee state = true →
      risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) = P.targetRisk ∧
      expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) ≤
        2 * P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee

/-- Original cap arithmetic PLUS the H0 bound of THIS blind script only.
Risk, price, ET and success are not qualification fields. -/

PDMenu.stoppedTwoFactor.name: PDMenu.stoppedTwoFactor
PDMenu.stoppedTwoFactor.full_declaration_source:
theorem stoppedTwoFactor (P : Parameters) : P.StoppedTwoFactor := by
  intro fee hfee C accounting steps
  dsimp only
  intro hstop
  have hi := multiplierSearch_stateBracketCorrect P fee hfee C accounting steps
  cases hs : P.multiplierSearch fee steps with
  | exact solution =>
      rw [hs] at hi
      have he := searchExact_records P fee hfee C accounting solution hi
      refine ⟨he.1, ?_⟩
      rw [he.2.1, he.2.2]
      have htwo : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
      simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul' htwo (le_refl (P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee))
  | bracket lower upper =>
      rw [hs] at hi
      have hstop' : (upper.multiplier - lower.multiplier) * P.certificate.risk ≤
          P.mixtureCost fee lower upper / 2 := by
        simpa only [hs, PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.searchStopped, decide_eq_true_eq] using hstop
      have hm := searchBracket_mixture_records P fee hfee C accounting lower upper hi
      have hg := searchBracket_gapBounds P fee hfee C accounting lower upper hi
      have hprice := searchBracket_lower_le_value P fee hfee C accounting lower upper hi
      have hrat : P.mixtureCost fee lower upper ≤ 2 * P.mixtureLower fee upper := by
        linarith [hg.2.1, hg.2.2]
      refine ⟨hm.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
      rw [hm.2.2.2.2]
      calc
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * P.mixtureLower fee upper : ℚ) : ℝ) :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by exact_mod_cast hrat)
        _ = 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (P.mixtureLower fee upper : ℝ) := by
          rw [Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_ofNat, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
          norm_num
        _ ≤ 2 * P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee := mul_le_mul' le_rfl hprice

end PDMenu

def ZeroChargeOptimum (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance),
    (∀ sample, runActualBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.zeroChargeRule fee) sample = 0) ∧
    risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.zeroChargeRule fee) (menuSeedLaw P.certificate.stages P.tools) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.zeroChargeRisk fee : ℝ) ∧
    (∀ (mode : ResourceMode) (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
      letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
      ∀ (ν : Measure Seed) (hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν),
        letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
        ∀ policy : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting Seed,
          expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν = 0 →
            ENNReal.ofReal (P.zeroChargeRisk fee : ℝ) ≤ risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν) ∧
    (P.ZeroChargeOriginalQualification fee hfee C accounting →
      ∃ policy : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val .native accounting (MenuSeed P.certificate.stages P.tools),
        policy.rule = P.zeroChargeRule fee ∧
        expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .native accounting policy.rule (menuSeedLaw P.certificate.stages P.tools) = 0 ∧
        risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .native accounting policy.rule (menuSeedLaw P.certificate.stages P.tools) =
          ENNReal.ofReal (P.zeroChargeRisk fee : ℝ))

noncomputable def positiveChargeEvent (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (C : P.PaymentContract) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance)
    {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed] (rule : PolicyRule P.sharedInstance Seed) :
    Set (Seed × (P.input fee hfee).World) :=
  {sample | ∃ n,
    let state := run (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting rule sample n
    state.halted = false ∧ P.isPositiveVariableAction fee (rule sample.1 state.history) = true}

def PositiveChargeLower (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee), P.certificate.risk < P.zeroChargeRisk fee →
    0 < P.positiveValueFloor fee ∧
    ∀ (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance)
      (mode : ResourceMode) (Seed : Type u) (m : MeasurableSpace Seed),
      letI : MeasurableSpace Seed := m
      ∀ (ν : Measure Seed) (hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν),
        letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
        ∀ policy : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting Seed,
          risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν ≤ P.targetRisk →
            ENNReal.ofReal ((P.zeroChargeRisk fee - P.certificate.risk : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
              (P.input fee hfee).seededWorldLaw ν (P.positiveChargeEvent fee hfee C mode accounting policy.rule) ∧
            (∀ sample ∈ P.positiveChargeEvent fee hfee C mode accounting policy.rule,
              ENNReal.ofReal (P.firstChargeFloor fee : ℝ) ≤
                runActualBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule sample) ∧
            ENNReal.ofReal (P.positiveValueFloor fee : ℝ) ≤
              expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting policy.rule ν

  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance),
    (P.zeroChargeRisk fee ≤ P.certificate.risk →
      expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.idealSearchRule fee) (P.idealSearchSeedLaw fee) = 0 ∧
      risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.idealSearchRule fee) (P.idealSearchSeedLaw fee) ≤ P.targetRisk) ∧
    (P.certificate.risk < P.zeroChargeRisk fee →
      P.searchStopped fee (P.idealSearchState fee) = true ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.positiveValueFloor fee : ℝ) ≤ P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee ∧
      risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.idealSearchRule fee) (P.idealSearchSeedLaw fee) = P.targetRisk ∧
      expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.idealSearchRule fee) (P.idealSearchSeedLaw fee) ≤
        2 * P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee)

  intro fee hfee C accounting
  refine ⟨idealSearch_zero_records P fee hfee C accounting, ?_⟩
  intro hgap
  have hs := idealSearchState_stopped P fee hfee hgap C accounting
  have hstop := stoppedTwoFactor P fee hfee C accounting (P.bisectionBudget fee) hs
  have hn : ¬P.zeroChargeRisk fee ≤ P.certificate.risk := not_le.mpr hgap

  · simpa only [PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.idealSearchRule, PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.idealSearchSeedLaw,
      ite_eq_right hn, PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.idealSearchState] using hstop.1
  · simpa only [PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.idealSearchRule, PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.idealSearchSeedLaw,
      ite_eq_right hn, PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.idealSearchState] using hstop.2

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.walkUpdate.signature_start: def walkUpdate (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (level : ℕ) (truth : Bool) (previous : Array ℚ) : Array ℚ :=
PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.walkUpdate.full_declaration_source:
def walkUpdate (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (level : ℕ) (truth : Bool) (previous : Array ℚ) : Array ℚ :=
  (List.finRange (2 * level + 1)).foldl (fun next state =>
    (List.finRange 2).foldl (fun next letter =>
      let target := walkMove level state letter
      next.setIfInBounds target.val
        (next.getD target.val 0 + previous.getD state.val 0 * P.experiment.channel truth letter)) next)
    (Array.replicate (2 * level + 1) 0)

/-- The finite absorbing random-walk table stores its preceding row once.
It never consults the actual test error or a performance oracle. -/

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.cappedTest.name: PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.cappedTest
PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.cappedTest.full_declaration_source:
noncomputable def cappedTest (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (m : ℕ) :
    P.binarySymmetric.experiment.AdmissibleRule Bool where
  rule := {
    stop := fun _ tape => P.cappedStop m tape
    decision := P.cappedDecision m
    stopping := by
      intro seed tape tape' n hp
      simp only [cappedStop, min_le_iff]
      rw [P.binarySymmetric.experiment.posteriorThresholdStop_stopping (P.binarySymmetric.endpointError (m + 1))
        () tape tape' n hp]
    stoppedDecision := by
      intro seed tape tape' n hs hs' hp
      simp only [cappedDecision, hs, hs', ENat.toNat_natCast]
      rw [P.binarySymmetric.experiment.logOddsScore_eq_of_prefix tape tape' n hp] }
  measurable_stop := (P.measurable_cappedStop m).comp measurable_snd
  measurable_decision := by
    have hn : Measurable (fun sample : Bool × P.binarySymmetric.experiment.Tape => (P.cappedStop m sample.2).toNat) :=
      (measurable_of_countable ENat.toNat).comp
        ((P.measurable_cappedStop m).comp measurable_snd)
    have hjoint : Measurable (fun pair : P.binarySymmetric.experiment.Tape × ℕ =>
        P.binarySymmetric.experiment.logOddsScore pair.1 pair.2) :=
      measurable_from_prod_countable_left (fun n => P.binarySymmetric.experiment.measurable_logOddsScore n)
    have hscore := hjoint.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk hn)
    have hsign : Measurable (fun sample : Bool × P.binarySymmetric.experiment.Tape =>
        decide (0 ≤ P.binarySymmetric.experiment.logOddsScore sample.2 (P.cappedStop m sample.2).toNat)) := by
      apply measurable_to_bool
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, Set.preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, decide_eq_true_eq] using
        measurableSet_le measurable_const hscore
    exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_eq_fun hscore measurable_const) measurable_fst hsign

/-- The first independent coin chooses capped versus blind; the second
is the fair guess and the fair terminal tie, used on mutually exclusive branches. -/

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.BoundedEndpo.full_declaration_source:
def BoundedEndpointClaims (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ P.certificate.M →
    (∀ x : Bool,
      P.binarySymmetric.experiment.conditionalLaw BinarySymmetric.Parameters.fairGuessLaw x
        {sample | (P.binarySymmetric.symmetricHittingTest (m + 1)).rule.stop () sample.2 > P.certificate.Q} ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(P.certificate.gamma : ℝ)^2 * P.certificate.Q / 2))) ∧
    Real.exp (-(P.certificate.gamma : ℝ)^2 * P.certificate.Q / 2) ≤ Real.exp (-(P.certificate.E : ℝ)) ∧
    Real.exp (-(P.certificate.E : ℝ)) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ P.certificate.E ∧
    (1 / 2 : ℚ) ^ P.certificate.E ≤ P.certificate.gamma * P.certificate.epsilon ∧
    (∀ x : Bool, P.binarySymmetric.experiment.conditionalError BinarySymmetric.Parameters.fairGuessLaw (P.cappedTest m) x =
      ENNReal.ofReal (P.cappedError m : ℝ)) ∧
    0 ≤ P.cappedError m ∧
    P.binarySymmetric.endpointError (m + 1) ≤ (1 - 2 * P.certificate.gamma) * P.binarySymmetric.endpointError m ∧
    P.cappedError m ≤ P.binarySymmetric.endpointError (m + 1) + P.certificate.gamma * P.certificate.epsilon ∧
    P.binarySymmetric.endpointError (m + 1) + P.certificate.gamma * P.certificate.epsilon ≤
      P.binarySymmetric.endpointError m - P.certificate.gamma * P.certificate.epsilon ∧
    P.cappedError m < P.binarySymmetric.endpointError m

/-- D24: q_m is the independent finite rational DP, and both actual
truth-conditional errors (not just the Bayes average) are p_m. -/

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.calibratedTe.full_declaration_source:
noncomputable def calibratedTest (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (m : ℕ) :
    P.binarySymmetric.experiment.AdmissibleRule (Bool × Bool) :=
  (fun lower upper : P.binarySymmetric.experiment.AdmissibleRule Bool => ({
    rule := {
      stop := fun seed tape => if seed.1 then lower.rule.stop seed.2 tape else upper.rule.stop seed.2 tape
      decision := fun seed tape => if seed.1 then lower.rule.decision seed.2 tape else upper.rule.decision seed.2 tape
      stopping := by
        intro seed tape tape' n hp
        cases hb : seed.1 <;> simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        · exact upper.rule.stopping seed.2 tape tape' n hp
        · exact lower.rule.stopping seed.2 tape tape' n hp
      stoppedDecision := by
        intro seed tape tape' n hs hs' hp
        cases hb : seed.1 <;> simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hs hs' ⊢
        · exact upper.rule.stoppedDecision seed.2 tape tape' n hs hs' hp
        · exact lower.rule.stoppedDecision seed.2 tape tape' n hs hs' hp }
    measurable_stop := by
      have hp : Measurable (fun sample : (Bool × Bool) × P.binarySymmetric.experiment.Tape => (sample.1.2, sample.2)) :=
        measurable_fst.snd.prodMk measurable_snd
      exact Measurable.ite (measurable_fst.fst (measurableSet_singleton true))
        (lower.measurable_stop.comp hp) (upper.measurable_stop.comp hp)
    measurable_decision := by
      have hp : Measurable (fun sample : (Bool × Bool) × P.binarySymmetric.experiment.Tape => (sample.1.2, sample.2)) :=
        measurable_fst.snd.prodMk measurable_snd
      exact Measurable.ite (measurable_fst.fst (measurableSet_singleton true))
        (lower.measurable_decision.comp hp) (upper.measurable_decision.comp hp)
    } : P.binarySymmetric.experiment.AdmissibleRule (Bool × Bool)))
    (if m = 0 then P.binarySymmetric.fairGuessTest else P.cappedTest m) P.binarySymmetric.fairGuessTest

def calibratedMenuCandidate (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (table : MenuTable)
    (seed : P.CalibratedMenuSeed) (history : List (VisibleEvent P.sharedInstance)) : Action P.sharedInstance :=
  if historyHalted history then .stop else
  if hstage : historyCursor history < P.certificate.stages then
    let stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage := ⟨historyCursor history, by simpa [sharedInstance] using hstage⟩
    let entry := menuEntryAt table (P.certificate.stages - stage.val)
      (P.menuEntryTools P.certificate.stages P.tools history stage)
    match historyWrite history stage with
    | none => match entry.action with
      | .finish | .abandon => .abandon
      | .test level _ => P.calibratedTestingAction level seed history stage
    | some (bit, serial) => match historyReport history stage with
      | none => .abandon
      | some (truth, reportedSerial) =>
          if serial != reportedSerial then .abandon else
          if bit == truth then .advance stage else
          match entry.action with
          | .test _ .repair => P.menuRepairAction P.certificate.stages P.tools history stage
          | _ => .abandon
  else if historyCursor history = P.certificate.stages then .stop else .abandon

def CalibratedImplementationClaims (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) (steps : ℕ),
    let state := P.multiplierSearch fee steps
    P.executionSignatureLaw fee hfee C .uncapped accounting (P.calibratedStateRule state) (P.calibratedStateSeedLaw state) =
      P.executionSignatureLaw fee hfee C .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) ∧
    risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.calibratedStateRule state) (P.calibratedStateSeedLaw state) =
      risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) ∧
    P.actualCorrectionBillLaw fee hfee C .uncapped accounting (P.calibratedStateRule state) (P.calibratedStateSeedLaw state) =
      P.actualCorrectionBillLaw fee hfee C .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) ∧
    P.expectedActualCorrectionBill fee hfee C .uncapped accounting (P.calibratedStateRule state) (P.calibratedStateSeedLaw state) =
      P.expectedActualCorrectionBill fee hfee C .uncapped accounting (P.stateRule state) (P.searchSeedLaw state) ∧
    expectedObservationBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.calibratedStateRule state) (P.calibratedStateSeedLaw state) ≤

    (∀ (sample : P.CalibratedSearchSeed × (P.input fee hfee).World) (n : ℕ),

      (∑ i, (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.calibratedAlgorithmRule fee) sample n).ledger.reviews i) ≤
        (P.certificate.stages * P.certificate.Q : ℕ) ∧
      (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.calibratedAlgorithmRule fee) sample n).ledger.executions.length ≤ P.tools) ∧
    (P.CalibratedOriginalQualification fee hfee C accounting →
      ∃ policy : Policy (P.input fee hfee) C.val .native accounting P.CalibratedSearchSeed,
        policy.rule = P.calibratedAlgorithmRule fee ∧
        (∀ sample n, run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .native accounting policy.rule sample n =
          run (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting (P.calibratedAlgorithmRule fee) sample n) ∧
        risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .native accounting policy.rule (P.calibratedAlgorithmSeedLaw fee) ≤ P.targetRisk ∧
        P.uncappedValue C accounting fee hfee ≤ P.nativeValue C accounting fee hfee ∧
        P.nativeValue C accounting fee hfee ≤
          expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .native accounting policy.rule (P.calibratedAlgorithmSeedLaw fee) ∧
        expectedBill (P.input fee hfee) C.val .native accounting policy.rule (P.calibratedAlgorithmSeedLaw fee) ≤

def UniformRationalImplementationClaims : Prop :=
  ∃ (prepare solver calibrate core : Program) (labels : RoutineLabels)
    (Ctime Cspace Cbits Cprepare degree : ℕ),
    0 < Ctime ∧ 0 < Cspace ∧ 0 < Cbits ∧ 0 < Cprepare ∧
    ∀ (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ), 0 ≤ fee →
      (∃ trace final, Runs prepare (rawInput P fee) trace final ∧ final.output = preparedInput P fee ∧
        time prepare trace ≤ Cprepare * (variableGammaSize P fee)^degree ∧
        peakCells trace ≤ Cprepare * (variableGammaSize P fee)^degree ∧
        peakOperandBits trace ≤ Cprepare * (variableGammaSize P fee)^degree) ∧
      (∀ (penalty : ℚ) (n k : ℕ), ∃ trace final,
        Runs solver (solveInput P fee penalty n k) trace final ∧
        final.output = encodeTable (P.cachedSolveMenuTable P.endpointCache fee penalty k n) ∧
        time solver trace ≤ Ctime * (n + 1) * (k + 1) * (P.certificate.M + 1) ∧
        peakCells trace ≤ Cspace * (n + 1) * (k + 1) ∧
        peakOperandBits trace ≤ Cbits * ((n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) *
          (maximumMenuBits P fee + 1) + ratEncodingBits penalty + natBits n + natBits k + 1)) ∧
      (∃ trace final, Runs calibrate (calibrationInput P) trace final ∧
        final.output = encodeList encodeCalibration (P.calibrationWeightCache P.endpointCache).toList ∧
        time calibrate trace ≤ Ctime * P.certificate.Q * (P.certificate.M + 1)^2 ∧
        peakCells trace ≤ Cspace * (P.certificate.M + 1) ∧
        peakOperandBits trace ≤ Cbits * ((P.certificate.Q + 1) *
          (ratEncodingBits P.certificate.gamma + 2) + maximumMenuBits P fee + 1)) ∧
      ∃ trace final, Runs core (preparedInput P fee) trace final ∧
        decodeArtifact final.output = some (buildArtifact P fee) ∧
        final.output = encodeArtifact (buildArtifact P fee) ∧
        time core trace ≤ Ctime * sourceCoreScale P fee ∧
        peakCells trace ≤ Cspace * sourceRecordSpace P ∧
        peakOperandBits trace ≤ Cbits * coreOperandBound P fee ∧
        actualSolveRequests labels trace = (P.cachedSearchWithLog P.endpointCache fee (P.bisectionBudget fee)).2 ∧
        entryCount labels.solveEntry trace = (actualSolveRequests labels trace).length ∧
        entryCount labels.solveEntry trace ≤ P.bisectionBudget fee + 2 ∧
        entryCount labels.endpointEntry trace = 1 ∧ entryCount labels.calibrationEntry trace = 1 ∧
        SolverCallRefinement core labels P fee Ctime trace

def MenuBitClaims (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee penalty : ℚ) (L : ℕ), P.MenuEncodingBound fee L →
    natBits (P.menuCommonDenominator fee) ≤ (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ P.certificate.stages → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ P.tools →
      let entry := menuEntryAt (P.cachedSolveMenuTable P.endpointCache fee penalty P.tools P.certificate.stages) n k
      entry.observation.den ∣ (P.menuCommonDenominator fee)^n ∧
      entry.repairs.den ∣ (P.menuCommonDenominator fee)^n ∧
      entry.failure.den ∣ (P.menuCommonDenominator fee)^n ∧
      (entry.objective fee penalty).den ∣ (P.menuCommonDenominator fee)^(n + 1) * penalty.den ∧
      ratDenBits entry.observation ≤ (n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L ∧
      ratDenBits entry.repairs ≤ (n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L ∧
      ratDenBits entry.failure ≤ (n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L ∧
      ratDenBits (entry.objective fee penalty) ≤ (n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L + ratDenBits penalty ∧
      (∀ scalar ∈ [entry.observation, entry.repairs, entry.failure, entry.objective fee penalty],

theorem majority_risk_le_half (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (C : P.PaymentContract) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance) :
    risk (P.input fee hfee) C.val .uncapped accounting P.majorityRule (Measure.dirac ()) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((P.certificate.risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
  have hStageCard : Fintype.card P.sharedInstance.Stage = P.certificate.stages :=
    (Fintype.card_fin P.sharedInstance.compatibility.length).trans P.stageCount_eq
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage, (P.input fee hfee).seededWorldLaw (Measure.dirac ())
        {sample : Unit × (P.input fee hfee).World |
          majorityTapeDecision P (worldTapes (P.input fee hfee) sample.2 stage) ≠
            (P.input fee hfee).truthAt sample.2 stage} := majority_risk_le_sum_stage_errors P fee hfee C accounting
    _ ≤ ∑ _stage : P.sharedInstance.Stage,
        ENNReal.ofReal (((P.certificate.risk / (2 * (P.certificate.stages : ℚ))) : ℚ) : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun stage _ => majority_stage_error_le P fee hfee stage)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, hStageCard, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have hN : 0 < (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.stages_pos
      have hratio : (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * (((P.certificate.risk / (2 * (P.certificate.stages : ℚ))) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
          ((P.certificate.risk / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        field_simp [hN.ne']
      calc
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * (((P.certificate.risk / (2 * (P.certificate.stages : ℚ))) : ℚ) : ℝ)) := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
        _ = _ := congrArg ENNReal.ofReal hratio

PDLower.majorityBill_le_saturation.full_declaration_source:
theorem majorityBill_le_saturation (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (P.B : ℝ) ≤ 7 * P.saturationScale := by
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < P.reviewFee := by exact_mod_cast P.reviewFee_pos
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < P.certificate.stages := by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.stages_pos
  have hk := paid_kappa_t0_le P
  have hreal : (P.B : ℝ) ≤ 7 * P.saturationScaleReal := by
    calc
      _ = ((P.reviewFee : ℝ) * P.certificate.stages / P.kappa) *
          (P.kappa * (P.certificate.t0 : ℝ)) := by
        unfold Parameters.B
        push_cast
        field_simp [P.kappa_pos.ne']
      _ ≤ ((P.reviewFee : ℝ) * P.certificate.stages / P.kappa) *
          (7 * Real.log (1 + (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) / (P.certificate.risk : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc.le hN.le) P.kappa_pos.le)
      _ = _ := by unfold Parameters.saturationScaleReal Parameters.a; ring
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (7 * P.saturationScaleReal) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal
    _ = _ := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
      norm_num [Parameters.saturationScale]

end PDLower
