PDLower.feeScale_min_eq_lower.full_declaration_source:
theorem feeScale_min_eq_lower (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hf : 0 ≤ fee) :
    min (P.feeScale fee) P.saturationScale = 128 * P.feeScaleLowerAmount fee := by
  have hfee : (0 : ℝ) ≤ fee := by exact_mod_cast hf
  have hd : 0 < (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.risk_pos
  let u := (fee : ℝ) / P.a
  let z := (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) / (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := div_nonneg hfee P.a_pos.le
  have hz : 0 ≤ z := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hd.le
  have hscale : (0 : ℝ) ≤ P.a * P.certificate.stages := mul_nonneg P.a_pos.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hexpand : 128 * P.feeScaleLowerAmount fee =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((P.a * P.certificate.stages) * Real.log (1 + min u z)) := by
    change (128 : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal _ = _
    rw [show (128 : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (128 : ℝ) by norm_num,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexpand]
  rcases le_total u z with h | h
  · have hl : Real.log (1 + u) ≤ Real.log (1 + z) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hs : P.feeScale fee ≤ P.saturationScale := by
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hscale
    rw [min_eq_left hs]
    change ENNReal.ofReal ((P.a * P.certificate.stages) * Real.log (1 + u)) = _
    rw [min_eq_left h]
  · have hl : Real.log (1 + z) ≤ Real.log (1 + u) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hs : P.saturationScale ≤ P.feeScale fee := by
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hscale
    rw [min_eq_right hs]
    change ENNReal.ofReal ((P.a * P.certificate.stages) * Real.log (1 + z)) = _
    rw [min_eq_right h]

theorem paid_truth_assignment_mass (P : Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hf : 0 ≤ fee)

    exact funext_iff

  have hcard : Fintype.card P.sharedInstance.Stage = P.certificate.stages := by
    simp only [Parameters.sharedInstance, Instance.Stage, List.length_replicate, Fintype.card_fin]

PDLower.delayedPayment_numeric.name: PDLower.delayedPayment_numeric
PDLower.delayedPayment_numeric.full_declaration_source:
theorem delayedPayment_numeric (P : Parameters) (hstages : 6 ≤ P.certificate.stages)
    (repairs : ℝ)
    (hrepairs : repairs = (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) / 2 -
      P.certificate.stages * (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) :
    repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) <
      P.certificate.stages * (1 - (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) / 2 ∧
    0 < ENNReal.ofReal (P.a * P.certificate.stages * (1 - (P.certificate.risk : ℝ))) *
      BinarySymmetric.phi (min (1 / 2)
        ((repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) /
          ((P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * (1 - (P.certificate.risk : ℝ))))) := by
  have hN : (6 : ℝ) ≤ P.certificate.stages := by exact_mod_cast hstages
  have hNpositive : (0 : ℝ) < P.certificate.stages := by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.stages_pos
  have hrisk : (0 : ℝ) < P.certificate.risk := by exact_mod_cast P.certificate.risk_pos
  have hsmallCast := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mpr P.certificate.risk_le
  norm_num only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_ofNat] at hsmallCast
  have hhalf : (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hmass : 0 < (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * (1 - (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) :=
    mul_pos hNpositive (by linarith)
  have hrepairsPositive : 0 < repairs := by
    have hp := mul_pos hNpositive (sub_pos.mpr hhalf)
    nlinarith only [hrepairs, hp]
  have hgap := mul_pos (show 0 < (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) - 2 by linarith) hrisk
  have hstrict : repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ) <
      P.certificate.stages * (1 - (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) / 2 := by
    nlinarith only [hrepairs, hgap]
  have hratio : 0 < (repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) /
      ((P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * (1 - (P.certificate.risk : ℝ))) :=
    div_pos (add_pos hrepairsPositive hrisk) hmass
  have hratioHalf : (repairs + (P.certificate.risk : ℝ)) /
      ((P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * (1 - (P.certificate.risk : ℝ))) < 1 / 2 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hmass).mpr
    nlinarith only [hstrict]
  refine ⟨hstrict, ?_⟩
  rw [min_eq_right hratioHalf.le]
  exact ENNReal.mul_pos_iff.mpr ⟨ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_pos P.a_pos hmass), phi_pos_below_half hratio hratioHalf⟩

end PDLower

PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.sharedPool_r.name: PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.sharedPool_rank_replicate
PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.sharedPool_r.full_declaration_source:
theorem sharedPool_rank_replicate {Tool : Type*} [Fintype Tool] [DecidableEq Tool]
    (n : ℕ) (remaining : Finset Tool) :
    errorRank (List.replicate n (Finset.univ : Finset Tool)) remaining =
      if n ≤ remaining.card then ⊤ else ((remaining.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
  induction n generalizing remaining with
  | zero => simp only [List.replicate_zero, errorRank_terminal, Nat.zero_le, ite_true]
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hempty : remaining = ∅
    · subst remaining
      rw [List.replicate_succ, errorRank_no_tools]
      simp
    · have hne : remaining.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
      have hcard : 0 < remaining.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hne
      have hcardone : remaining.card - 1 + 1 = remaining.card := by omega
      have hchild (tool : Tool) (htool : tool ∈ remaining) :
          errorRank (List.replicate n (Finset.univ : Finset Tool)) (remaining.erase tool) =
            if n ≤ remaining.card - 1 then ⊤ else (remaining.card : ℕ∞) := by
        rw [ih, Finset.card_erase_of_mem htool, hcardone]
      have hbad : badChildRank (Finset.univ : Finset Tool)
          (List.replicate n Finset.univ) remaining =
          if n ≤ remaining.card - 1 then ⊤ else (remaining.card : ℕ∞) := by
        apply le_antisymm
        · apply Finset.sup_le
          intro tool htool
          exact (hchild tool (Finset.mem_inter.mp htool).2).le
        · obtain ⟨tool, htool⟩ := hne
          have hh := childRank_le_badChildRank (Finset.univ : Finset Tool)
            (List.replicate n Finset.univ) remaining (Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ tool, htool⟩)
          rwa [hchild tool htool] at hh
      rw [List.replicate_succ, errorRank_cons, ih, hbad]
      by_cases hn : n < remaining.card
      · have hsucc : n + 1 ≤ remaining.card := by omega
        have hprev : n ≤ remaining.card - 1 := by omega
        simp [hsucc, hn.le, hprev]
      · have hsucc : ¬ n + 1 ≤ remaining.card := by omega
        have hprev : ¬ n ≤ remaining.card - 1 := by omega
        by_cases hgood : n ≤ remaining.card
        · simp [hsucc, hprev, hgood, add_comm]
        · simp [hsucc, hprev, hgood, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_comm]

PDLower.freeNativeSqueeze.full_declaration_source:
theorem freeNativeSqueeze (pool : FixedSharedPool) : pool.FreeNativeSqueeze := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon _hepsilonOne
  obtain ⟨lowerCutoff, hlowerCutoff, hlower⟩ :=
    (pool.input 0 (by norm_num)).nativeLowerPriceLaw (pool.tools + 1) (fixedPool_rank pool)
      epsilon hepsilon
  obtain ⟨upperCutoff, hupperCutoff, hupper⟩ :=
    (pool.input 0 (by norm_num)).nativeUpperPriceLaw (pool.tools + 1) (fixedPool_rank pool)
      epsilon hepsilon
  refine ⟨min lowerCutoff upperCutoff, lt_min hlowerCutoff hupperCutoff, ?_⟩
  intro delta hdelta hsmall hcutoff C hC accounting qualification
  have hdeltaReal : (0 : ℝ) < delta := by exact_mod_cast hdelta
  have hsmallReal : (delta : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hsmallCast := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mpr hsmall
    norm_num only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_ofNat] at hsmallCast
    linarith
  have hstageCount : pool.sharedInstance.stageCount = pool.stages := by
    simp only [FixedSharedPool.sharedInstance, freshInstance, Instance.stageCount,
      List.length_replicate]
  have choice : ReferenceRiskChoice pool.sharedInstance.stageCount (delta : ℝ)
      (BinaryExperiment.quotaExponent delta pool.stages) delta := by
    simpa only [hstageCount] using pool.jointFreeRiskChoice delta hdelta hsmall
  constructor
  · have lower := hlower (delta : ℝ) hdeltaReal
      (hcutoff.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) C hC.1 accounting
    rw [fixedPool_coefficient] at lower
    simpa only [FixedSharedPool.nativeValue, FixedSharedPool.structuralScaleReal, mul_assoc]
      using lower
  · have upper := hupper (delta : ℝ) (BinaryExperiment.quotaExponent delta pool.stages) delta
      hdeltaReal (hcutoff.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) hsmallReal choice C hC.1 accounting qualification
    rw [fixedPool_coefficient] at upper
    simpa only [FixedSharedPool.nativeValue, FixedSharedPool.structuralScaleReal, mul_assoc]
      using upper

end PDLower

  intro ε hε _hεone A B D S hlower hupper

    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith)

    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith)

  · rw [mul_min, mul_add]
    exact min_le_min (add_le_add hlower (mul_le_of_le_one_left' hl)) (mul_le_of_le_one_left' hl)
  · rw [mul_min, mul_add]
    exact min_le_min (add_le_add hupper (le_mul_of_one_le_left' hu)) (le_mul_of_one_le_left' hu)

theorem universalFirst_half_additive_bound (P : PaperProofs.Star.Parameters) :
    ∃ bound cutoff : ℝ, 0 ≤ bound ∧ 0 < cutoff ∧
      ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → delta ≤ 1/2 → delta < cutoff →
        |P.currentObservationEnvelope (delta/2) - P.channel.a*iteratedLog 2 delta⁻¹| ≤ bound := by
  obtain ⟨bound, cutoff, boundNonnegative, cutoffPositive, boundAtBudget⟩ :=
    (RootStarEnvelope.universalFirstEnvelopeAsymptotics P).2
  have shifted := iteratedLog_two_dilation_sub_tendsto_zero.comp RootStarEnvelope.inverse_tendsto
  have scaled : Tendsto (fun delta : ℝ => P.channel.a *
      (iteratedLog 2 (delta/2)⁻¹ - iteratedLog 2 delta⁻¹)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simp only [inv_div]
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, one_div, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_zero] using shifted.const_mul P.channel.a
  have shiftSmall : ∀ᶠ delta : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      |P.channel.a*(iteratedLog 2 (delta/2)⁻¹ - iteratedLog 2 delta⁻¹)| ≤ 1 := by
    have boundOne := scaled.abs.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds (by norm_num : |(0 : ℝ)| < 1))
    exact boundOne.mono (fun _ h => h.le)
  obtain ⟨shiftCutoff, shiftPositive, shiftBound⟩ := RootStarEnvelope.positive_cutoff shiftSmall
  refine ⟨bound+1, min cutoff shiftCutoff, by linarith, lt_min cutoffPositive shiftPositive, ?_⟩
  intro delta positive small below
  have budgetPositive : 0 < delta/2 := by linarith
  have budgetSmall : delta/2 ≤ 1/4 := by linarith
  have budgetBelow : delta/2 < cutoff := by
    have : delta < cutoff := below.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  have budgetBound := boundAtBudget (delta/2) budgetPositive budgetSmall budgetBelow
  have deltaShift := shiftBound delta positive (below.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  calc
    _ = |(P.currentObservationEnvelope (delta/2) - P.channel.a*iteratedLog 2 (delta/2)⁻¹) +
          P.channel.a*(iteratedLog 2 (delta/2)⁻¹ - iteratedLog 2 delta⁻¹)| := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ |P.currentObservationEnvelope (delta/2) - P.channel.a*iteratedLog 2 (delta/2)⁻¹| +
          |P.channel.a*(iteratedLog 2 (delta/2)⁻¹ - iteratedLog 2 delta⁻¹)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ bound+1 := add_le_add (by simpa only [one_div] using budgetBound) deltaShift
